Paragraph.Text: if the taxpayer’s taxation year begins on or after January 1, 2024, and for the purposes referred to in paragraph (a) for which 40% is not the applicable percentage, 30%. (ratio des dépenses admissibles)

Definition.Text: received capacity means an amount of received capacity of a transferee for a taxation year as determined under subsection (4). (capacité reçue)

relevant affiliate interest and financing expenses of a controlled foreign affiliate of a taxpayer (determined as though the definition taxpayer in this subsection did not include the words “or a partnership”) for an affiliate taxation year means, subject to subsection (19), the total of all amounts (other than an amount that is deductible in computing any income or loss of the affiliate that is included in computing the affiliate’s income or loss from an active business because of paragraph 95(2)(a) or an amount that is described in clause 95(2)(a)(ii)(D) and treated as nil for the purposes of determining an amount for A or D in the definition foreign accrual property income in subsection 95(1)), each of which would be the affiliate’s interest and financing expenses (determined without regard to paragraph (j) of the description of A in the definition interest and financing expenses) for the affiliate taxation year for the purposes of determining, in respect of the taxpayer for the affiliate taxation year, each amount referred to in subparagraph 95(2)(f)(i) or (ii), if

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the references in the definition interest and financing expenses to “in the absence of this section” were read as references to “in the absence of clause 95(2)(f.11)(ii)(D)”; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: clause 95(2)(f.11)(ii)(A) were read without regard to the reference to subsection 18.2(2). (dépenses d’intérêts et de financement de la société affiliée pertinentes)

Definition.Text: relevant affiliate interest and financing revenues of a controlled foreign affiliate of a taxpayer (determined as though the definition taxpayer in this subsection did not include the words “or a partnership”) for an affiliate taxation year means, subject to subsection (19), the total of all amounts (other than an amount included in computing the affiliate’s income or loss from an active business under paragraph 95(2)(a) or (2.44)(b)), each of which would be the affiliate’s interest and financing revenues (determined without regard to paragraph (g) of the description of A in the definition interest and financing revenues) for the affiliate taxation year for the purposes of determining, in respect of the taxpayer for the affiliate taxation year, each amount referred to in subparagraph 95(2)(f)(i) or (ii), if clause 95(2)(f.11)(ii)(A) were read without regard to the reference to subsection 18.2(2). (revenus d’intérêts et de financement de la société affiliée pertinents)
relevant inter-affiliate interest, of a controlled foreign affiliate of a taxpayer for an affiliate taxation year, means an amount of interest to the extent that the amount

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: is paid or payable by the affiliate to, or received or receivable by the affiliate from, a controlled foreign affiliate (in this definition referred to as the “other affiliate”) of

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the taxpayer, or

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: a taxpayer that is an eligible group entity in respect of the taxpayer; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: would, in the absence of subsection (19), be included in

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: if the amount is paid or payable by the affiliate, the affiliate’s relevant affiliate interest and financing expenses for the affiliate taxation year and the other affiliate’s relevant affiliate interest and financing revenues for an affiliate taxation year, or

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: if the amount is received or receivable by the affiliate, the affiliate’s relevant affiliate interest and financing revenues for the affiliate taxation year and the other affiliate’s relevant affiliate interest and financing expenses for an affiliate taxation year. (intérêts pertinents entre sociétés affiliées)

Definition.Text: special purpose loss corporation, for a taxation year, means a particular corporation that

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: is an eligible group entity in respect of a financial holding corporation to which the particular corporation has interest paid or payable in the year;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: is formed or exists solely for the purpose of generating a loss of the particular corporation from the interest; and

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: would, in the absence of this section, have a loss for the year resulting from the interest that is, or will be, utilized exclusively by a financial institution group entity that is an eligible group entity in respect of the particular corporation. (société à usage déterminé ayant subi des pertes)

Definition.Text: specified participating percentage of a taxpayer, in respect of a controlled foreign affiliate of the taxpayer for an affiliate taxation year, means the percentage that would be the taxpayer’s aggregate participating percentage (as defined in subsection 91(1.3)), determined without regard to clause 95(2)(f.11)(ii)(D), in respect of the affiliate for the affiliate taxation year, if the definition participating percentage in subsection 95(1) were read without reference to

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: its paragraph (a); and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the portion of its paragraph (b) before its subparagraph (b)(i). (pourcentage de participation déterminé)

Definition.Text: specified pre-regime loss of a taxpayer, in respect of a taxation year, means the taxpayer’s non-capital loss for a preceding taxation year, if

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the preceding year ends before February 4, 2022;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the taxpayer files with the Minister, in respect of the loss, an election in writing in prescribed manner under this definition;

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: the election specifies

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the loss,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: each amount deducted, in respect of the loss, by the taxpayer under paragraph 111(1)(a) in computing its taxable income

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: for the year, and

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: each taxation year that precedes the year, and

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: the taxpayer’s adjusted taxable income for the year; and

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: the election is filed on or before the filing-due date of the taxpayer for the year. (perte antérieure au régime déterminée)

Definition.Text: tax-indifferent means a person or partnership that is

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: a person exempt from tax under section 149;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: a non-resident person;

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: a partnership more than 50% of the fair market value of all interests in which can reasonably be considered to be held, directly or indirectly through one or more trusts or partnerships, by any combination of persons described in paragraph (a) or (b); or

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: a trust resident in Canada if more than 50% of the fair market value of all interests as beneficiaries under the trust can reasonably be considered to be held, directly or indirectly through one or more trusts or partnerships, by any combination of persons described in paragraph (a) or (b). (indifférent relativement à l’impôt)

Definition.Text: taxpayer has the meaning assigned by subsection 248(1), but does not include a natural person or a partnership. (contribuable)
transaction includes an arrangement or event. (opération)
transferred capacity means an amount of transferred capacity of a transferor for a taxation year as determined under subsection (4). (capacité transférée)

Subsection.MarginalNote: Excessive interest and financing expenses limitation
Subsection.Text: Notwithstanding any other provision of this Act, in computing the income for a taxation year of a taxpayer (other than an excluded entity for the year) from a business or property or the taxable income of the taxpayer for the year, no deduction shall be made — and in determining the amount under paragraph 3(b) in respect of the taxpayer for the year, no reduction shall be made — in respect of any amount that is described in any of paragraphs (a) to (g) and (i) of the description of A in the definition interest and financing expenses in subsection (1) that would, in the absence of this section, be deductible in computing that income or taxable income — or would reduce that amount determined under paragraph 3(b) — to the extent of the proportion of that amount that is determined by the formula

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the taxpayer’s interest and financing expenses for the year;
is

FormulaParagraph.Label: (a)
FormulaParagraph.Text: if subsection 18.21(2) applies in respect of the taxpayer for the year, the amount determined in respect of the taxpayer for the year under that subsection, and

FormulaParagraph.Label: (b)
FormulaParagraph.Text: in any other case, the amount determined by the formula

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the taxpayer’s ratio of permissible expenses for the year, and
is the taxpayer’s adjusted taxable income for the year;
is the taxpayer’s interest and financing revenues for the year;

is the amount by which the total of all amounts each of which is an amount of received capacity of the taxpayer for the year, as determined under subsection (4), exceeds the total amount deductible under paragraph 111(1)(a.1) for the year;
is the amount of the taxpayer’s absorbed capacity for the year; and
is

FormulaParagraph.Label: (a)
FormulaParagraph.Text: if no amount is included in the taxpayer’s interest and financing expenses for the year under paragraph (j) of the description of A of that definition, or under paragraph (h) of the description of A of that definition in respect of a controlled foreign affiliate of a partnership of which the taxpayer is a member, the amount determined for A in that definition for the taxpayer for the year, or

FormulaParagraph.Label: (b)
FormulaParagraph.Text: in any other case, the amount that would be determined for A in the definition interest and financing expenses in subsection (1) for the taxpayer for the year if the reference to “the affiliate’s interest and financing expenses” in the definition relevant affiliate interest and financing expenses were read as a reference to “an amount determined for A in the definition interest and financing expenses for the affiliate”.

Subsection.Text: All or any portion, of a particular amount described in paragraph (c) or (d) of the description of A in the definition interest and financing expenses in subsection (1), that would, in the absence of subsection (2), have been deducted in computing the income of a taxpayer for a taxation year but that is not deductible because of subsection (2), is deemed to have been deductible and to have been deducted in the year for purposes of determining, in respect of any taxpayer at any time, such of the following amounts to which the particular amount relates:

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the total depreciation (as defined in subsection 13(21)) allowed for property of a prescribed class;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the amount the taxpayer may deduct under subsection 66(4);

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: the cumulative Canadian exploration expense (as defined in subsection 66.1(6));

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: the cumulative Canadian development expense (as defined in subsection 66.2(5));

Paragraph.Label: (e)
Paragraph.Text: the cumulative foreign resource expense (as defined in subsection 66.21(1)) in respect of a country;

Paragraph.Label: (f)
Paragraph.Text: the cumulative Canadian oil and gas property expense (as defined in subsection 66.4(5)); and

Paragraph.Label: (g)
Paragraph.Text: the amount the taxpayer may deduct under subsections 66.7(1), (2) or (2.3) to (5).

Subsection.MarginalNote: Transfer of cumulative unused excess capacity
Subsection.Text: For the purposes of this section, a taxpayer and another taxpayer (referred to in this section as the “transferor” and the “transferee”, respectively) may jointly elect in prescribed form to designate an amount equal to all or a portion of the transferor’s cumulative unused excess capacity, and that amount is an amount of transferred capacity of the transferor for a taxation year and an amount of received capacity of the transferee for a taxation year, if

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the taxation year of the transferor ends in the taxation year of the transferee;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: each of the transferor and the transferee is

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: a taxable Canadian corporation or a fixed interest commercial trust throughout its taxation year, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: an eligible group entity in respect of the other at the end of its taxation year;

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: where the transferor is a financial institution group entity or a financial holding corporation for its taxation year, the transferee is, for its taxation year,

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: a financial institution group entity,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: a financial holding corporation, or

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: a special purpose loss corporation;

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: the election or amended election

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: specifies the amount of the transferred capacity, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: is filed with the Minister by the transferor

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: on or before the later of the filing-due date of

Subclause.Label: (I)
Subclause.Text: the transferor for its taxation year, and

Subclause.Label: (II)
Subclause.Text: the transferee for its taxation year, or

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: on or before the day that is 90 days after the day of sending of

Subclause.Label: (I)
Subclause.Text: a notice of assessment of tax payable under this Part by the transferor or the transferee for their respective taxation years, or

Subclause.Label: (II)
Subclause.Text: a notification that no tax is payable under this Part by the transferor or the transferee for their respective taxation years;

Paragraph.Label: (e)
Paragraph.Text: the total of all amounts each of which would, if this subsection were read without reference to this paragraph, be an amount of transferred capacity of the transferor for its taxation year in respect of any transferee, does not exceed the transferor’s cumulative unused excess capacity for the year;

Paragraph.Label: (f)
Paragraph.Text: if the transferee is a financial holding corporation and the transferor is a financial institution group entity, it is the case that

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the total of all amounts, each of which is an amount that is included in computing the income of the financial holding corporation for its taxation year in respect of excluded interest, the payer of which is, for the taxation year of the payer in which the interest is payable,

FormulaParagraph.Label: (i)
FormulaParagraph.Text: a financial institution group entity, or

FormulaParagraph.Label: (ii)
FormulaParagraph.Text: a special purpose loss corporation, if the amount gives rise to a loss of the special purpose loss corporation that is, or will be, utilized solely by a financial institution group entity, and

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the total of all amounts, each of which would, in the absence of this paragraph, be an amount that is both

FormulaParagraph.Label: (i)
FormulaParagraph.Text: received capacity of the financial holding corporation for its taxation year, and

FormulaParagraph.Label: (ii)
FormulaParagraph.Text: transferred capacity of a financial institution group entity for one of its taxation years;

Paragraph.Label: (g)
Paragraph.Text: if the transferee is a special purpose loss corporation and the transferor is a financial institution group entity, it is the case that

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the total of all amounts, each of which is an amount that

FormulaParagraph.Label: (i)
FormulaParagraph.Text: would, in the absence of this section, be deductible in computing the income of the special purpose loss corporation for its taxation year,

FormulaParagraph.Label: (ii)
FormulaParagraph.Text: is paid or payable to a financial holding corporation,

FormulaParagraph.Label: (iii)
FormulaParagraph.Text: meets the conditions set out in paragraphs (a) to (d) of the definition excluded interest, and

FormulaParagraph.Label: (iv)
FormulaParagraph.Text: would, in the absence of this section, give rise to a loss that is, or will be, utilized solely by a financial institution group entity, and

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the total of all amounts, each of which would, in the absence of this paragraph, be an amount that is both

FormulaParagraph.Label: (i)
FormulaParagraph.Text: received capacity of the special purpose loss corporation for its taxation year, and

FormulaParagraph.Label: (ii)
FormulaParagraph.Text: transferred capacity of a financial institution group entity for one of its taxation years;

Paragraph.Label: (h)
Paragraph.Text: an amended election has not been filed in accordance with this section;

Paragraph.Label: (i)
Paragraph.Text: where the election is an amended election,

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the following conditions are met:

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: in the absence of any assessment, the condition set out in paragraph (e) would be met in respect of a prior election under this subsection made by the transferor and transferee for their respective taxation years, and

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: subsection (9) does not apply to a tax benefit in respect of a prior election for the taxation year of the transferor or transferee, or

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the Minister grants permission to amend the prior election under subsection (5); and

Paragraph.Label: (j)
Paragraph.Text: the transferee files an information return in accordance with subsection (6) for the calendar year in which the transferee’s taxation year ends.

Subsection.Text: The Minister may extend the time for making an election, or grant permission to amend an election, under subsection (4) if

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the transferor and the transferee demonstrate to the satisfaction of the Minister that

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the transferor, the transferee and each other eligible group entity in respect of the transferor and transferee made reasonable efforts to determine all amounts that may reasonably be considered relevant in making the election, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the election or amended election, as the case may be, is filed as soon as circumstances permit; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: in the opinion of the Minister, the circumstances are such that it would be just and equitable to permit the election to be made or amended.

Subsection.MarginalNote: Summary — cumulative unused excess capacity transfers
Subsection.Text: If one or more elections are filed under subsection (4), in which amounts are designated as received capacity of a particular transferee for a taxation year ending in a calendar year, the particular transferee shall file with the Minister for the calendar year an information return in prescribed form within six months after the end of the calendar year in respect of

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: each such election; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: each election filed under subsection (4) for a taxation year ending in the calendar year, by any other transferee that is an eligible group entity in respect of the particular transferee at the end of the other transferee’s taxation year.

Subsection.Text: For the purposes of this section, if any taxpayer is required to file an information return for a calendar year under subsection (6), the taxpayer is deemed to have filed the information return if

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: an information return under subsection (6) is filed for the calendar year by any other taxpayer (in this subsection referred to as the “designated filer” in respect of the taxpayer for the year) that is an eligible group entity in respect of the taxpayer at the end of the taxpayer’s taxation year ending in the calendar year; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the taxpayer jointly elects, with each other transferee described in paragraph (6)(b), to designate under this paragraph the designated filer to be a designated filer in respect of the taxpayer and each other transferee for the calendar year.

Subsection.Text: If an election or an amended election has been made under subsection (4), the Minister shall, notwithstanding subsections 152(4) and (5), assess or reassess the tax, interest or penalties payable under this Act by any taxpayer for any relevant taxation year as is necessary to give effect to the election or amended election.

If, at any time, a particular taxpayer is, becomes or ceases to be an eligible group entity, in respect of another taxpayer, a financial institution group entity or a financial holding corporation and it may reasonably be considered, having regard to all the circumstances, that one of the main purposes of the particular taxpayer being, becoming or ceasing to be an eligible group entity, in respect of the other taxpayer, a financial institution group entity or a financial holding corporation is to enable any taxpayer to obtain a tax benefit (within the meaning of subsection 245(1)), the particular taxpayer is deemed not to be, to have become, or to remain, as the case may be, an eligible group entity, in respect of the other taxpayer, a financial institution group entity or a financial holding corporation, as the case may be, at that time.

For the purposes of this Part, if a transferor and a transferee file an election (including an amended election) under subsection (4), no benefit is considered to have been conferred on the transferee as a consequence of the election.
For the purposes of this Part, if property is acquired at any time by a transferor as consideration for filing an election or amended election with a transferee under subsection (4)

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: where the property was owned by the transferee immediately before that time,

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the transferee is deemed to have disposed of the property at that time for proceeds equal to the fair market value of the property at that time, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: no amount may be deducted in computing the transferee’s income as a consequence of the transfer of the property, except any amount arising as a consequence of subparagraph (i);

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the cost at which the property was acquired by the transferor at that time is deemed to be equal to the fair market value of the property at that time; and

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: the transferor is not required to add an amount in computing income solely because of the acquisition at that time of the property.

Subsection.Text: For the purposes of this section,

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: a person or partnership that is (or is deemed by this paragraph to be) a member of a particular partnership that is a member of another partnership is deemed to be a member of the other partnership; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: a person’s share of the income or loss of a partnership includes the person’s direct or indirect, through one or more other partnerships, share of that income or loss.

Subsection.MarginalNote: Anti-avoidance — interest and financing revenues and expenses
Subsection.Text: A particular amount that would, in the absence of this subsection, be included under the description of A in the definition interest and financing revenues, or the description of B in the definition interest and financing expenses, in computing the income or loss of a taxpayer for a taxation year, must not be so included, if

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: an amount in respect of the particular amount is deductible in computing the foreign accrual property income of a corporation that is a foreign affiliate, but not a controlled foreign affiliate, of the taxpayer or of a person or partnership that does not deal at arm’s length with the taxpayer;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the particular amount is received or receivable, directly or indirectly and in whole or in part, by the taxpayer, or a partnership of which it is a member, from

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: a person that does not deal at arm’s length with the taxpayer and that is

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: an excluded entity,

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: a natural person, or

Clause.Label: (C)
Clause.Text: if the taxpayer is not a financial institution group entity or a financial holding corporation, a financial institution group entity or a financial holding corporation, or

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: a partnership of which a person described in subparagraph (i) is a member; or

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: one of the main purposes of a transaction or series of transactions is to include the particular amount under the description of A in the definition interest and financing revenues, or the description of B in the definition interest and financing expenses, in computing the income or loss of the taxpayer for a taxation year and

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the transaction or series results in an amount that

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: is not included in the description of B in the definition interest and financing revenues, or the description of A in the definition interest and financing expenses, in computing the income or loss of the taxpayer, or of a person not dealing at arm’s length with the taxpayer, for a taxation year, and

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: is deductible in computing the income of loss for a taxation year of the taxpayer or a person or partnership not dealing at arm’s length with the taxpayer, or

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: it can reasonably be considered that, in the absence of the transaction or series, the particular amount or an amount for which the particular amount was substituted

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: would have been included in computing the income or loss for a taxation year (other than as a dividend) of the taxpayer, or a person or partnership not dealing at arm’s length with the taxpayer, and

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: would not have been included under the description of A in the definition interest and financing revenues, or the description of B in the definition interest and financing expenses, in computing the income or loss of the taxpayer or a person not dealing at arm’s length with the taxpayer.

Subsection.Text: For the purposes of subparagraph (c)(iv) of the definition excluded entity, a person or partnership is deemed to be tax-indifferent and not to deal at arm’s length with the taxpayer or any eligible group entity in respect of the taxpayer throughout a taxation year of the taxpayer if

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: any portion of the interest and financing expenses of the taxpayer for the year is paid or payable by the taxpayer or any eligible group entity in respect of the taxpayer to the person or partnership as part of a transaction or series of transactions; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: it can reasonably be considered that one of the main purposes of the transaction or series is to avoid that portion of the interest and financing expenses being paid or payable to a person or partnership that is tax-indifferent and does not deal at arm’s length with the taxpayer or any eligible group entity in respect of the taxpayer.

Subsection.Text: If two taxpayers are eligible group entities in respect of a third taxpayer, they are deemed to be eligible group entities in respect of each other.
For the purposes of paragraph (a) of the definition eligible group entity in subsection (1)

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: despite subsection 104(1), a reference to a person that is a trust does not include a reference to the trustee or other persons that own or control the trust property; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: a corporation or a trust is deemed not to be related to a taxpayer where the corporation or trust would, but for this paragraph, be related to the taxpayer solely because the taxpayer is controlled by His Majesty in right of Canada, His Majesty in right of a province or an entity referred to in any of paragraphs 149(1)(c) to (d.6).

Subsection.Text: For the purposes of paragraph (b) of the definition eligible group entity in subsection (1), a corporation or a trust is deemed not to be affiliated with a taxpayer where that corporation or trust would, but for this subsection, be affiliated with the taxpayer solely because

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the taxpayer is controlled by His Majesty in right of Canada, His Majesty in right of a province or an entity referred to in any of paragraphs 149(1)(c) to (d.6); or

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: if the corporation or trust is a registered charity or a non-profit organization with whom the taxpayer deals at arm’s length, the corporation or trust is a majority-interest beneficiary (within the meaning of subsection 251.1(3)) of the taxpayer.

Subsection.Text: Each taxpayer shall file with its return of income for the taxation year a prescribed form containing prescribed information for the purpose of determining the deductibility of its interest and financing expenses and determining its exempt interest and financing expenses.

If an amount is paid or payable by a controlled foreign affiliate (referred to in this subsection as the “payer affiliate”) of a taxpayer and received or receivable by a controlled foreign affiliate (referred to in this subsection as the “recipient affiliate”) of the taxpayer, or a taxpayer that is an eligible group entity in respect of the taxpayer, and the amount is relevant inter-affiliate interest of the payer affiliate for an affiliate taxation year (referred to in this subsection as the “payer affiliate year”) and of the recipient affiliate for an affiliate taxation year (referred to in this subsection as the “recipient affiliate year”),

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the amount included, in respect of the relevant inter-affiliate interest, in the payer affiliate’s relevant affiliate interest and financing expenses for the payer affiliate year is the lesser of

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the relevant inter-affiliate interest, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the amount determined by the formula

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the amount determined by the formula

is the total of all amounts, each of which would — if the relevant inter-affiliate interest were not paid or payable — be, in respect of the payer affiliate for the payer affiliate year, the specified participating percentage of

FormulaParagraph.Label: (A)
FormulaParagraph.Text: the taxpayer, or

FormulaParagraph.Label: (B)
FormulaParagraph.Text: another taxpayer that is an eligible group entity in respect of the taxpayer, and

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the total of all amounts, each of which is, in respect of the recipient affiliate for the recipient affiliate year, the specified participating percentage of

FormulaParagraph.Label: (A)
FormulaParagraph.Text: the taxpayer, or

FormulaParagraph.Label: (B)
FormulaParagraph.Text: another taxpayer that is an eligible group entity in respect of the taxpayer, and

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the relevant inter-affiliate interest, and
is the lesser of

FormulaParagraph.Label: (A)
FormulaParagraph.Text: the relevant inter-affiliate interest, and

FormulaParagraph.Label: (B)
FormulaParagraph.Text: the amount determined by the formula

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the payer affiliate’s relevant affiliate interest and financing revenues for the payer affiliate year,

is the amount that would be the payer affiliate’s relevant affiliate interest and financing expenses for the payer affiliate year if the payer affiliate had no relevant inter-affiliate interest for the payer affiliate year,
is the amount determined for E, and

is the total of all amounts, each of which is an amount of relevant inter-affiliate interest of the payer affiliate for the payer affiliate year that would, in the absence of this paragraph, be included in the payer affiliate’s relevant affiliate interest and financing expenses; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the amount included, in respect of the relevant inter-affiliate interest, in the recipient affiliate’s relevant affiliate interest and financing revenues for the recipient affiliate year is the lesser of

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the amount referred to in E, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the amount determined by the formula

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the amount determined for B,
is the amount determined for C, and
is the amount determined for D.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Subsection.Text: The following definitions apply in this section.

Definition.Text: acceptable accounting standards means International Financial Reporting Standards and the generally accepted accounting principles of

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: Canada;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: Australia;

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: Brazil;

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: member states of the European Union;

Paragraph.Label: (e)
Paragraph.Text: member states of the European Economic Area;

Paragraph.Label: (f)
Paragraph.Text: Hong Kong (China);

Paragraph.Label: (g)
Paragraph.Text: Japan;

Paragraph.Label: (h)
Paragraph.Text: Mexico;

Paragraph.Label: (i)
Paragraph.Text: New Zealand;

Paragraph.Label: (j)
Paragraph.Text: the People’s Republic of China;

Paragraph.Label: (k)
Paragraph.Text: the Republic of India;

Paragraph.Label: (l)
Paragraph.Text: the Republic of Korea;

Paragraph.Label: (m)
Paragraph.Text: Singapore;

Paragraph.Label: (n)
Paragraph.Text: Switzerland;

Paragraph.Label: (o)
Paragraph.Text: the United Kingdom; and

Paragraph.Label: (p)
Paragraph.Text: the United States. (principes comptables acceptables)

Definition.Text: consolidated financial statements means financial statements prepared in accordance with a relevant acceptable accounting standard in which the assets, liabilities, income, expenses and cash flows of two or more entities are presented as those of a single economic entity and, for greater certainty, the financial statements include the notes to the financial statements. (états financiers consolidés)

consolidated group means two or more entities, other than an equity-accounted entity but including an ultimate parent, (each such entity referred to in this section as a “member of the consolidated group”) in respect of which consolidated financial statements are required to be prepared for financial reporting purposes or would be so required if the entities were subject to International Financial Reporting Standards. (groupe consolidé)

equity-accounted entity means an entity the net income or loss of which is included in the consolidated financial statements of a consolidated group under the equity method of accounting. (entité comptabilisée à la valeur de consolidation)
equity interest means

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: a share of the capital stock of a corporation;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: an interest as a beneficiary under a trust;

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: an interest as a member of a partnership; or

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: any similar interest in respect of any entity. (participation au capital)

Definition.Text: fair value amount means any amount reflected in the net income or net loss reported in the consolidated financial statements of a consolidated group for a relevant period where

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the carrying value of any asset or liability of the consolidated group is measured using the fair value method of accounting; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the amount reflects a change in the carrying value of the asset or liability during the relevant period and is included in either the description of C or H in the definition group adjusted net book income. (montant de la juste valeur)

Definition.Text: group adjusted net book income, of a consolidated group for a relevant period, means the amount determined by the formula

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the amount determined by the formula
is the amount, if any, of net income reported in the consolidated financial statements of the group for the period,
is the amount, if any, of income tax expense reported in those statements,

is the amount that would be the specified interest expense of the group for the period if the definition specified interest expense were read without reference to paragraph (b) of the description of A,
is the total of all amounts used in determining the amounts reported in those statements each of which is the amount of

FormulaParagraph.Label: (a)
FormulaParagraph.Text: a depreciation or amortization expense in respect of an asset,

FormulaParagraph.Label: (b)
FormulaParagraph.Text: a charge in respect of the impairment or write-off of an asset referred to in paragraph (a),

FormulaParagraph.Label: (c)
FormulaParagraph.Text: a loss on the disposal of an asset referred to in paragraph (a),

FormulaParagraph.Label: (d)
FormulaParagraph.Text: if an election is made under subsection (4) and the net fair value amount for the period is negative, the absolute value of the net fair value amount, and

FormulaParagraph.Label: (e)
FormulaParagraph.Text: an expense, charge, deduction or loss that is similar to any of those referred to in paragraphs (a) to (d), and

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the total of all amounts referred to in the description of D or F that are included in the determination of the net income or loss of an equity-accounted entity, to the extent of the consolidated group’s share of that net income or loss; and
is the amount determined by the formula

Formula.FormulaText: H + I + J + K + L + M + N

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the amount, if any, of net loss reported in those statements,
is the amount, if any, of income tax recoverable reported in those statements,
is the specified interest income of the group for the period,
if an election is made under subsection (4) and the net fair value amount for the period is positive, the net fair value amount,

is the total of all amounts used in determining the amounts reported in those statements each of which is the amount of a gain on the disposal of an asset referred to in paragraph (a) of the description of F, to the extent that the sale proceeds do not exceed the original cost of the asset,

is the total of all amounts referred to in the descriptions of I, K and L that is included in the determination of the net income or loss of an equity-accounted entity, to the extent of the consolidated group’s share of that net income or loss, and

is the total of all amounts, each of which is the portion of net income reported in those statements that can reasonably be considered to be earned by a borrower (within the meaning of the definition exempt interest and financing expenses in subsection 18.2(1)) in respect of a borrowing (within the meaning of the definition exempt interest and financing expenses in subsection 18.2(1)) that results in exempt interest and financing expenses of the borrower. (bénéfice net comptable rajusté du groupe)

Definition.Text: group net interest expense, of a consolidated group for a relevant period, means the amount determined by the formula

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the amount determined by the formula
is the specified interest expense of the group for the period, and
is the specified interest income of the group for the period; and
is the total of all amounts each of which is an amount determined, in respect of a specified non-member of the group, by the formula
is the portion of the amount of the specified interest expense of the group for the period that is paid or payable to the specified non-member, and
is the portion of the amount of the specified interest income of the group for the period that is received or receivable from the specified non-member. (dépenses nettes d’intérêts du groupe)

Definition.Text: group ratio, of a consolidated group for a relevant period, means

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: except where paragraph (b) applies, the percentage determined by the formula

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the group net interest expense of the consolidated group for the relevant period, and
is the group adjusted net book income of the consolidated group for the relevant period; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: if the group adjusted net book income of the consolidated group for the relevant period is nil, nil. (ratio de groupe)

Definition.Text: net fair value amount means the positive or negative amount that is the total of all amounts, each of which is a positive or negative fair value amount in the consolidated financial statements of the consolidated group for a relevant period. (montant de la juste valeur net)
relevant period means a period in respect of which the consolidated financial statements of a consolidated group are presented. (période pertinente)
specified interest expense, of a consolidated group for a relevant period, means the amount determined by the formula

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the total of all amounts (other than amounts that are included in exempt interest and financing expenses), each of which is

FormulaParagraph.Label: (a)
FormulaParagraph.Text: an amount of interest expense used in determining the amounts reported in the consolidated financial statements of the consolidated group for the relevant period,

FormulaParagraph.Label: (b)
FormulaParagraph.Text: an amount of capitalized interest used in determining the amounts reported in those statements,

FormulaParagraph.Label: (c)
FormulaParagraph.Text: the amount of a guarantee fee, standby charge, arrangement fee or similar fee paid or payable that is used in determining the amounts reported in those statements and that is not included in paragraph (a) or (b), or

FormulaParagraph.Label: (d)
FormulaParagraph.Text: an amount referred to in any of paragraphs (a) to (c) that is included in the determination of the net income or loss of an equity-accounted entity, to the extent of the consolidated group’s share of that net income or loss; and

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the total of all amounts each of which is the amount of a dividend included in the determination of an amount referred to in any of paragraphs (a) to (d) of the description of A. (dépenses d’intérêts déterminées)

Definition.Text: specified interest income, of a consolidated group for a relevant period, means the amount determined by the formula

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the total of all amounts, each of which is

FormulaParagraph.Label: (a)
FormulaParagraph.Text: an amount of interest income used in determining the amounts reported in the consolidated financial statements of the consolidated group for the relevant period,

FormulaParagraph.Label: (b)
FormulaParagraph.Text: the amount of a guarantee fee, standby charge, arrangement fee or similar fee received or receivable that is used in determining the amounts reported in those statements and that is not included in paragraph (a), or

FormulaParagraph.Label: (c)
FormulaParagraph.Text: an amount referred to in paragraph (a) or (b) that is included in the determination of the net income or loss of an equity-accounted entity, to the extent of the consolidated group’s share of that income or loss; and

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the total of all amounts each of which is the amount of a dividend included in the determination of an amount referred to in any of paragraphs (a) to (c) of the description of A. (revenus d’intérêts déterminés)

Definition.Text: specified non-member, of a consolidated group for a relevant period, means a particular person or partnership that is not a member of the consolidated group and that, at any time in the period,

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: does not deal at arm’s length with a member of the group;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: alone or together with persons or partnerships with whom the particular person or partnership does not deal at arm’s length owns, or has the right to acquire, one or more equity interests in a member of the group that

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: provide 25% or more of the votes that could be cast at an annual meeting of the shareholders of the member, if the member is a corporation, or

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: have 25% or more of the fair market value of all equity interests in the member; or

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: is a person or partnership in respect of which a member of the group — alone or together with persons or partnerships with whom the member does not deal at arm’s length — owns, or has the right to acquire, one or more equity interests in the particular person or partnership that

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: provide 25% or more of the votes that could be cast at an annual meeting of the shareholders of the particular person, if the particular person is a corporation, or

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: have 25% or more of the fair market value of all equity interests in the particular person or partnership. (non-membre déterminé)

Definition.Text: ultimate parent means a particular entity if

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the particular entity is not His Majesty in right of Canada, His Majesty in right of a province or an entity referred to in any of paragraphs 149(1)(c) to (d.6);

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: it holds directly or indirectly an interest in one or more other entities in respect of which it is required to prepare consolidated financial statements for financial reporting purposes, or would be so required if it was subject to International Financial Reporting Standards; and

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: no entity (other than an entity described in paragraph (a)) holds, directly or indirectly, in the particular entity an interest that is described in paragraph (b). (mère ultime)

Subsection.Text: A taxpayer and each corporation or trust that is, throughout the relevant period, an eligible group entity in respect of that taxpayer and a member of the same consolidated group as the taxpayer (the taxpayer and each of the corporations or trusts being referred to in this subsection and subsection (4) as a “Canadian group member”) may, if the taxpayer is a taxpayer described in subsection (7), elect, and otherwise jointly elect in respect of their taxation years ending in the relevant period (each referred to in this subsection and subsection (4) as a “relevant taxation year”) to allocate amounts in respect of each relevant taxation year and the amount allocated to a member for a relevant taxation year is the amount determined in respect of that member for that relevant taxation year for the purposes of this section and subsection 18.2(2), if

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the consolidated financial statements of the consolidated group for the relevant period are audited financial statements;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the election or amended election

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: specifies the amount allocated to each Canadian group member for each relevant taxation year, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: is filed with the Minister by the taxpayer or a Canadian group member of the taxpayer on or before

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: the latest filing-due date of a Canadian group member for a relevant taxation year, or

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: the day that is 90 days after the sending of

Subclause.Label: (I)
Subclause.Text: a notice of assessment of tax payable under this Part by a Canadian group member for a relevant taxation year, or

Subclause.Label: (II)
Subclause.Text: a notification that no tax is payable under this Part by a Canadian group member for a relevant taxation year;

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: the total of all amounts, each of which is an amount allocated to a Canadian group member for a relevant taxation year, does not exceed the least of

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the total of all amounts in respect of a member each of which is determined by the formula

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the group ratio of the consolidated group for the relevant period, and
is the adjusted taxable income of the member for each relevant taxation year,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the group net interest expense of the consolidated group in respect of the relevant period, and

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: the total of all amounts, each of which would, in the absence of section 257, be the adjusted taxable income of a member for each relevant taxation year;

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: an amended election has not been filed in accordance with this section; and

Paragraph.Label: (e)
Paragraph.Text: where the election is an amended election,

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the following conditions are met:

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: in the absence of any assessment, the condition set out in paragraph (c) would be met in respect of a prior election under this subsection made by the Canadian group members for a relevant taxation year under this subsection, and

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: subsection 18.2(9) does not apply to a tax benefit in respect of a prior election for the relevant period, or

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the Minister grants permission to amend the prior election under subsection (3).

Subsection.Text: The Minister may extend the time for making an election or grant permission to amend or revoke an election under subsection (2) if

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the Canadian group members demonstrate to the satisfaction of the Minister that

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: they made reasonable efforts to determine all amounts that may reasonably be considered relevant in making the election, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the election or amended election, as the case may be, is filed as soon as circumstances permit; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: in the opinion of the Minister, the circumstances are such that it would be just and equitable to permit the election to be made, amended or revoked.

Subsection.Text: For the purposes of calculating group adjusted net book income, the following rules apply:

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: no amounts may be included in paragraph (d) of the description of F or in the description of K in the definition group adjusted net book income for any relevant period unless the Canadian group members jointly elect, for the first relevant taxation year in respect of which the Canadian group members jointly elect under subsection (2), to include net fair value amounts in calculating group adjusted net book income for the relevant period in which the first relevant taxation year ends;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: if an election to include net fair value amounts in the calculation is not made in the first relevant taxation year, each Canadian group member is deemed not to have so elected in that taxation year and any subsequent taxation year; and

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: if an election to include net fair value amounts in the calculation is made in the first relevant taxation year, each Canadian group member is deemed to have so elected in that taxation year and any subsequent taxation year.

Subsection.Text: If an election or amended election has been made under subsection (2), the Minister shall, notwithstanding subsections 152(4) and (5), assess or reassess the tax, interest or penalties payable under this Act by any taxpayer for any relevant taxation year as is necessary to give effect to the election or amended election.

For the purposes of the definitions consolidated financial statements, consolidated group, equity-accounted entity, fair value amount, group adjusted net book income, specified interest expense, specified interest income and ultimate parent in subsection (1), a term that is not defined under this Act has the meaning assigned to the term for financial reporting purposes under the relevant acceptable accounting standards.
For the purposes of this section, if a taxpayer resident in Canada is not a member of a consolidated group for a relevant period,

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the taxpayer is deemed to be an eligible group entity in respect of itself;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the taxpayer is deemed to be

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: a member of a consolidated group that comprises only itself, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the ultimate parent of the group; and

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: the taxpayer’s financial statements are deemed to be consolidated financial statements.

Subsection.Text: A particular person or partnership that is not a member of a consolidated group for a relevant period is deemed to be a specified non-member in respect of the group for the period if a portion of the amount of the specified interest expense of the group is paid or payable by a member of the group to the particular person or partnership as part of a transaction or series of transactions where it can reasonably be considered that one of the main purposes of the transaction or series is to avoid the inclusion of that portion in the determination of the amount for E in the definition group net interest expense in subsection (1).

Subsection.Text: The following definitions apply in this section.

Definition.Text: entity has the same meaning as in subsection 122.1(1). (entité)
equity value has the same meaning as in subsection 122.1(1). (valeur des capitaux propres)
real estate investment trust has the same meaning as in subsection 122.1(1). (fiducie de placement immobilier)
security, of an entity, means

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: a liability of the entity;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: if the entity is a corporation,

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: a share of the capital stock of the corporation, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: a right to control in any manner whatever the voting rights of a share of the capital stock of the corporation if it can reasonably be concluded that one of the reasons that a person or partnership holds the right to control is to avoid the application of subsection (3) or 12.6(3);

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: if the entity is a trust, an income or a capital interest in the trust; and

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: if the entity is a partnership, an interest as a member of the partnership. (titre)

Definition.Text: stapled security, of a particular entity at any time, means a particular security of the particular entity if at that time

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: another security (referred to in this section as the “reference security”)

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: is or may be required to be transferred together or concurrently with the particular security as a term or condition of the particular security, the reference security, or an agreement or arrangement to which the particular entity (or if the reference security is a security of another entity, the other entity) is a party, or

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: is listed or traded with the particular security on a stock exchange or other public market under a single trading symbol;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the particular security or the reference security is listed or traded on a stock exchange or other public market; and

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: any of the following applies:

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the reference security and the particular security are securities of the particular entity and the particular entity is a corporation, SIFT partnership or SIFT trust,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the reference security is a security of another entity, one of the particular entity or the other entity is a subsidiary of the other, and the particular entity or the other entity is a corporation, SIFT partnership or SIFT trust, or

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: the reference security is a security of another entity and the particular entity or the other entity is a real estate investment trust or a subsidiary of a real estate investment trust. (titre agrafé)

Definition.Text: subsidiary, of a particular entity at any time, means

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: an entity in which the particular entity holds at that time securities that have a total fair market value greater than 10% of the equity value of the entity; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: an entity that at that time is a subsidiary of an entity that is a subsidiary of the particular entity. (filiale)

Definition.Text: transition period, of an entity, means

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: if one or more securities of the entity would have been stapled securities of the entity on October 31, 2006 and July 19, 2011 had the definition stapled security in this subsection come into force on October 31, 2006, the period that begins on July 20, 2011 and ends on the earliest of

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: January 1, 2016,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the first day after July 20, 2011 on which any of those securities is materially altered, and

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: the first day after July 20, 2011 on which any security of the entity becomes a stapled security other than by way of

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: a transaction

Subclause.Label: (I)
Subclause.Text: that is completed under the terms of an agreement in writing entered into before July 20, 2011 if no party to the agreement may be excused from completing the transaction as a result of amendments to this Act, and

Subclause.Label: (II)
Subclause.Text: that is not the issuance of a security in satisfaction of a right to enforce payment of an amount by the entity, or

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: the issuance of the security in satisfaction of a right to enforce payment of an amount that became payable by the entity on another security of the entity before July 20, 2011, if the other security was a stapled security on July 20, 2011 and the issuance was made under a term or condition of the other security in effect on July 20, 2011;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: if paragraph (a) does not apply to the entity and one or more securities of the entity would have been stapled securities of the entity on July 19, 2011 had the definition stapled security in this subsection come into force on July 19, 2011, the period that begins on July 20, 2011 and ends on the earliest of

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the first day after July 20, 2011 on which any of those securities is materially altered, and

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: the first day after July 20, 2011 on which any security of the entity becomes a stapled security other than by way of

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: a transaction

Subclause.Label: (I)
Subclause.Text: that is completed under the terms of an agreement in writing entered into before July 20, 2011 if no party to the agreement may be excused from completing the transaction as a result of amendments to this Act, and

Subclause.Label: (II)
Subclause.Text: that is not the issuance of a security in satisfaction of a right to enforce payment of an amount by the entity, or

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: the issuance of the security in satisfaction of a right to enforce payment of an amount that became payable by the entity on another security of the entity before July 20, 2011, if the other security was a stapled security on July 20, 2011 and the issuance was made under a term or condition of the other security in effect on July 20, 2011; and

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: in any other case, if the entity is a subsidiary of another entity on July 20, 2011 and the other entity has a transition period, the period that begins on July 20, 2011 and ends on the earliest of

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the day on which the other entity’s transition period ends,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the first day after July 20, 2011 on which the entity ceases to be a subsidiary of the other entity, and

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: the first day after July 20, 2011 on which any security of the entity becomes a stapled security other than by way of

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: a transaction

Subclause.Label: (I)
Subclause.Text: that is completed under the terms of an agreement in writing entered into before July 20, 2011 if no party to the agreement may be excused from completing the transaction as a result of amendments to this Act, and

Subclause.Label: (II)
Subclause.Text: that is not the issuance of a security in satisfaction of a right to enforce payment of an amount by the entity, or

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: the issuance of the security in satisfaction of a right to enforce payment of an amount that became payable by the entity on another security of the entity before July 20, 2011, if the other security was a stapled security on July 20, 2011 and the issuance was made under a term or condition of the other security in effect on July 20, 2011. (période de transition)

Subsection.Text: For the purpose of determining whether a particular security of an entity is a stapled security, if a receipt or similar property (referred to in this subsection as the “receipt”) represents all or a portion of the particular security and the receipt would be described in paragraphs (a) and (b) of the definition stapled security in subsection (1) if it were a security of the entity, then

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the particular security is deemed to be described in those paragraphs; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: a security that would be a reference security in respect of the receipt is deemed to be a reference security in respect of the particular security.

Subsection.Text: Notwithstanding any other provision of this Act, in computing the income of a particular entity for a taxation year from a business or property, no deduction may be made in respect of an amount

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: that is paid or payable after July 19, 2011, unless the amount is paid or payable in respect of the entity’s transition period; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: that is

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: interest paid or payable on a liability of the particular entity that is a stapled security, unless each reference security in respect of the stapled security is a liability, or

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: if a security of the particular entity, a subsidiary of the particular entity or an entity of which the particular entity is a subsidiary is a reference security in respect of a stapled security of a real estate investment trust or a subsidiary of a real estate investment trust, an amount paid or payable to

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: the real estate investment trust,

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: a subsidiary of the real estate investment trust, or

Clause.Label: (C)
Clause.Text: any person or partnership on condition that any person or partnership pays or makes payable an amount to the real estate investment trust or a subsidiary of the real estate investment trust.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Subsection.Text: The following definitions apply in this section and paragraph 20(1)(yy).

Definition.Text: Canadian ordinary income, of a taxpayer for a taxation year in respect of a payment, means an amount that is

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: if the taxpayer is not a partnership, included in respect of the payment in computing, in the case of a taxpayer resident in Canada, the income of the taxpayer for the purposes of this Part — or, in the case of a taxpayer that is a non-resident person, the taxable income earned in Canada of the taxpayer — for the year, except to the extent that

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the amount is included in the Canadian ordinary income of any taxpayer under paragraph (b) or (c),

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the taxpayer is entitled to a deduction under section 112 or 113 in respect of the payment, or

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: the amount can otherwise reasonably be considered to be excluded, reduced, offset or otherwise effectively sheltered from tax under this Part by reason of any exemption, exclusion, deduction, credit (other than a credit for a tax substantially similar to tax under Part XIII) or other form of relief under this Act that

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: applies specifically in respect of all or a portion of the amount and not in computing income generally, or

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: arises in respect of the payment;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: if the taxpayer is a partnership, determined by the formula

FormulaDefinition.Text: is an amount that is included in respect of the payment in computing the income or loss of the partnership from any source, or from sources in a particular place, for the year, except to the extent that the amount

FormulaParagraph.Label: (i)
FormulaParagraph.Text: is included in the Canadian ordinary income of any taxpayer under paragraph (c), or

FormulaParagraph.Label: (ii)
FormulaParagraph.Text: can reasonably be considered to be excluded, reduced, offset or otherwise sheltered by any reason described in subparagraph (a)(iii),

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the total of all amounts, each of which is, in respect of the partnership’s income or loss from that source or the sources in the particular place for the year,

FormulaParagraph.Label: (i)
FormulaParagraph.Text: the share of a member of the partnership that is a person resident in Canada, or

FormulaParagraph.Label: (ii)
FormulaParagraph.Text: the share of a member of the partnership that is a non-resident person to the extent it is included in computing the non-resident person’s taxable income earned in Canada,

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the income or loss of the partnership from the source, or the sources in the particular place, for the year, and
is the total of all amounts, each of which is an amount deductible, in respect of the payment, by a member of the partnership under section 112 or 113; or

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: determined by the formula

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the amount determined by the formula

is an amount that is included in respect of the payment in computing the foreign accrual property income of a controlled foreign affiliate of the taxpayer for a taxation year (as defined in subsection 95(1)) of the affiliate ending in the year, except to the extent the amount can reasonably be considered to be excluded, reduced, offset or otherwise effectively sheltered for any reason described in subparagraph (a)(iii), and
is the aggregate participating percentage (as defined in subsection 91(1.3)) of the taxpayer in respect of the affiliate for the taxation year of the affiliate, and
is

FormulaParagraph.Label: (i)
FormulaParagraph.Text: if the taxpayer is a partnership, the amount determined by the formula

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the total of all amounts each of which is a share of the amount determined for E of a member of the partnership that is a person resident in Canada, and

FormulaParagraph.Label: (ii)
FormulaParagraph.Text: in any other case, 1. (revenu ordinaire canadien)

Definition.Text: controlled foreign company tax regime means a set of provisions under the tax laws of a particular country other than Canada under which a direct or indirect shareholder of an entity that is located in a country other than the particular country is subject to current taxation in respect of its share of all or part of the income earned by the entity, irrespective of whether that income is distributed currently to the shareholder. (régime fiscal des sociétés étrangères contrôlées)

deductible, in relation to an amount in respect of a payment, in computing relevant foreign income or profits, includes any relief that arises in respect of the payment and is equivalent in effect to a deduction, including

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: an exemption or exclusion in computing the relevant foreign income or profits; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: a refund of, or credit that can be applied to reduce or offset, income or profits tax paid or payable to a government of a country other than Canada in respect of the relevant foreign income or profits. (déductible)

Definition.Text: entity has the same meaning as in subsection 95(1). (entité)
equity interest means any of the following:

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: a share of the capital stock of a corporation;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: an interest as a beneficiary under a trust;

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: an interest as a member of a partnership; or

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: any similar interest in respect of any entity. (participation au capital)

Definition.Text: equity or financing return means a payment that can reasonably be considered to be in respect of, or determined by reference to,

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: revenue, profit, cash flow, commodity price or any other similar criterion;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: dividends paid or payable to shareholders of any class of shares of the capital stock of a corporation, or income or capital paid or payable to any member of a partnership or beneficiary under a trust, or any other distribution in respect of any entity; or

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: an amount that is, or is on account of, in lieu of payment of or in satisfaction of, interest, or that is otherwise compensation for the use of money. (rendement financier ou de capitaux propres)

Definition.Text: exempt dealer compensation payment means a payment that

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: is a dealer compensation payment (as defined in subsection 260(1));

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: is received by a registered securities dealer resident in Canada, as compensation for a taxable dividend paid on a share of the capital stock of a public corporation, from a non-resident corporation (referred to in this definition as the “affiliate”) that, at the time the payment is received,

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: is a controlled foreign affiliate of

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: the registered securities dealer, or

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: another taxpayer that does not deal at arm’s length with the registered securities dealer,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: has a substantial market presence in a particular country other than Canada,

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: makes the payment in the ordinary course of a business of trading in securities, if

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: the business is carried on by the affiliate as a foreign bank (as defined in subsection 95(1)), a trust company, a credit union, an insurance corporation or a trader or dealer in securities,

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: the activities of the business are regulated under the laws of

Subclause.Label: (I)
Subclause.Text: the particular country,

Subclause.Label: (II)
Subclause.Text: another country under the laws of which the affiliate is governed and any of exists, was (unless the affiliate was continued in any jurisdiction) formed or organized, or was last continued and of each country in which the business is carried on through a permanent establishment, or

Subclause.Label: (III)
Subclause.Text: if the affiliate is related to a corporation, another country under the laws of which the related corporation is governed and any of exists, was (unless the related corporation was continued in any jurisdiction) formed or organized, or was last continued, if those regulating laws are recognized under the laws of the country in which the business is principally carried on and all of those countries are members of the European Union, and

Subparagraph.Label: (iv)
Subparagraph.Text: conducts the business, directly or indirectly,

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: principally with persons that

Subclause.Label: (I)
Subclause.Text: deal at arm’s length with the affiliate, and

Subclause.Label: (II)
Subclause.Text: are resident, or carry on business through a permanent establishment, in the particular country, and

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: in competition with other entities that

Subclause.Label: (I)
Subclause.Text: deal at arm’s length with the affiliate, and

Subclause.Label: (II)
Subclause.Text: have a substantial market presence in the particular country; and

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: does not arise under, or in connection with, a structured arrangement. (paiement compensatoire (courtier) exonéré)

Definition.Text: financial instrument means

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: a debt;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: an equity interest or any right that may reasonably be considered to replicate a right to participate in profits or gain of any entity; or

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: any other arrangement that gives rise to an equity or financing return. (instrument financier)

Definition.Text: foreign expense restriction rule means a provision under the tax laws of a country other than Canada that can reasonably be considered to

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: have an effect, or be intended to have an effect, that is substantially similar to subsection 18(4) or 18.2(2); or

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: have been enacted or otherwise brought into effect by the country with the intention of implementing, in whole or in part,

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: any of the recommendations set out in Limiting Base Erosion Involving Interest Deductions and Other Financial Payments, Action 4 – 2016 Update, published by the Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development, or

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the Global Anti-Base Erosion Model Rules set out in Tax Challenges Arising from the Digitalisation of the Economy – Global Anti-Base Erosion Model Rules (Pillar Two), published by the Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development. (règle étrangère de restriction des dépenses)

Definition.Text: foreign hybrid mismatch rule means a provision, under the tax laws of a country other than Canada, that can reasonably be considered to

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: have an effect that is substantially similar to that of a provision under this section, section 12.7 or subsection 113(5); or

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: have been enacted or otherwise brought into effect by the country with the intention of implementing, in whole or in part, Neutralising the Effects of Hybrid Mismatch Arrangements, Action 2 – 2015 Final Report published by the Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development, as amended from time to time. (règle étrangère d’asymétrie hybride)

Definition.Text: foreign ordinary income, of an entity for a foreign taxation year in respect of a payment, means an amount that is determined by the formula

Formula.FormulaText: A − B − C − D − E − F

FormulaDefinition.Text: is an amount (referred to in this definition as the “relevant amount”) that is included in respect of the payment in computing relevant foreign income or profits of the entity for the year (other than income or profits in respect of which the entity is subject to a tax substantially similar to tax under Part XIII, or a tax under a controlled foreign company tax regime or a specified minimum tax regime) because the entity is a recipient of the payment or has a direct or indirect equity interest in a recipient of the payment;
is

FormulaParagraph.Label: (a)
FormulaParagraph.Text: if the relevant amount is included in computing relevant foreign income or profits in respect of which the entity is subject to an income or profits tax that is charged at a nil rate, the relevant amount, or

FormulaParagraph.Label: (b)
FormulaParagraph.Text: in any other case, nil;

FormulaDefinition.Text: is any portion of the relevant amount that is included in computing relevant foreign income or profits of the entity for the year because of any foreign hybrid mismatch rule (other than any rule that is substantially similar in effect to subsection 113(5));

is any portion of the relevant amount that can reasonably be considered to be excluded, reduced, offset or otherwise effectively sheltered from income or profits tax by reason of any exemption, exclusion, deduction, credit (other than a credit for tax payable under Part XIII) or other form of relief that

FormulaParagraph.Label: (a)
FormulaParagraph.Text: applies specifically in respect of all or a portion of the relevant amount and not in computing the entity’s relevant foreign income or profits in general, or

FormulaParagraph.Label: (b)
FormulaParagraph.Text: arises in respect of the payment;

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the amount determined by the formula
is the total of all amounts, each of which is an amount that

FormulaParagraph.Label: (i)
FormulaParagraph.Text: meets the following conditions:

FormulaParagraph.Label: (A)
FormulaParagraph.Text: is repaid or repayable in respect of income or profits tax paid or payable by the entity to the government of a country other than Canada in respect of the relevant foreign income or profits for the year, and

FormulaParagraph.Label: (B)
FormulaParagraph.Text: is not repaid or repayable because a loss is used to reduce or offset the relevant foreign income or profits for the year, or

FormulaParagraph.Label: (ii)
FormulaParagraph.Text: is paid or payable in respect of a credit that can reasonably be considered to reduce or offset, directly or indirectly, the income or profits tax referred to in clause (i)(A), and

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the total amount of the income or profits tax referred to in clause (i)(A) of the description of G; and
is the amount determined by the formula
is the rate at which the income or profits tax referred to in clause (i)(A) in the description of G is charged in respect of the relevant amount, and

is the highest rate at which an income or profits tax imposed by the government of the country is charged in respect of an amount of income in respect of a financial instrument. (revenu ordinaire étranger)
