Paragraph.Text: the effects of the impairment or impairments are such that the individual’s ability to perform more than one basic activity of daily living is significantly restricted where the cumulative effect of those restrictions is equivalent to having a marked restriction in the ability to perform a basic activity of daily living or are such that the individual’s ability to perform a basic activity of daily living is markedly restricted or would be markedly restricted but for therapy that

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: is essential to sustain a vital function of the individual,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: is required to be administered at least two times each week for a total duration averaging not less than 14 hours a week, and

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: cannot reasonably be expected to be of significant benefit to persons who are not so impaired,

Paragraph.Label: (a.2)
Paragraph.Text: in the case of an impairment in physical or mental functions the effects of which are such that the individual’s ability to perform a single basic activity of daily living is markedly restricted or would be so restricted but for therapy referred to in paragraph (a.1), a medical practitioner has certified in prescribed form that the impairment is a severe and prolonged impairment in physical or mental functions the effects of which are such that the individual’s ability to perform a basic activity of daily living is markedly restricted or would be markedly restricted, but for therapy referred to in paragraph (a.1), where the medical practitioner is a medical doctor, a nurse practitioner or, in the case of

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: a sight impairment, an optometrist,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: a speech impairment, a speech-language pathologist,

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: a hearing impairment, an audiologist,

Subparagraph.Label: (iv)
Subparagraph.Text: an impairment with respect to an individual’s ability in feeding or dressing themself, an occupational therapist,

Subparagraph.Label: (v)
Subparagraph.Text: an impairment with respect to an individual’s ability in walking, an occupational therapist, or after February 22, 2005, a physiotherapist, and

Subparagraph.Label: (vi)
Subparagraph.Text: an impairment with respect to an individual’s ability in mental functions necessary for everyday life, a psychologist,

Paragraph.Label: (a.3)
Paragraph.Text: in the case of one or more impairments in physical or mental functions the effects of which are such that the individual’s ability to perform more than one basic activity of daily living is significantly restricted, a medical practitioner has certified in prescribed form that the impairment or impairments are severe and prolonged impairments in physical or mental functions the effects of which are such that the individual’s ability to perform more than one basic activity of daily living is significantly restricted and that the cumulative effect of those restrictions is equivalent to having a marked restriction in the ability to perform a single basic activity of daily living, where the medical practitioner is, in the case of

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: an impairment with respect to the individual’s ability in feeding or dressing themself, or in walking, a medical doctor, a nurse practitioner or an occupational therapist, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: in the case of any other impairment, a medical doctor or nurse practitioner,

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the individual has filed for a taxation year with the Minister the certificate described in paragraph (a.2) or (a.3), and

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: no amount in respect of remuneration for an attendant or care in a nursing home, in respect of the individual, is included in calculating a deduction under section 118.2 (otherwise than because of paragraph 118.2(2)(b.1)) for the year by the individual or by any other person,

ContinuedSectionSubsection.Text: there may be deducted in computing the individual’s tax payable under this Part for the year the amount determined by the formula

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the appropriate percentage for the year,
is $6,000, and
is

FormulaParagraph.Label: (a)
FormulaParagraph.Text: where the individual has not attained the age of 18 years before the end of the year, the amount, if any, by which

FormulaParagraph.Label: (ii)
FormulaParagraph.Text: the amount, if any, by which

FormulaParagraph.Label: (A)
FormulaParagraph.Text: the total of all amounts each of which is an amount paid in the year for the care or supervision of the individual and included in computing a deduction under section 63, 64 or 118.2 for a taxation year

FormulaParagraph.Label: (b)
FormulaParagraph.Text: in any other case, zero.

Subsection.Text: For the purpose of paragraph 118.3(1)(a.1), in determining whether therapy is required to be administered at least two times each week for a total duration averaging not less than an average of 14 hours a week, the time spent on administering therapy

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: includes only time spent on activities that require the individual to take time away from normal everyday activities in order to receive the therapy;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: in the case of therapy that requires

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: a regular dosage of medication that is required to be adjusted on a daily basis, includes time spent on activities that are directly related to the determination of the dosage of the medication, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the daily consumption of a medical food or medical formula to limit intake of a particular compound to levels required for the proper development or functioning of the body, includes the time spent on activities that are directly related to the determination of the amount of the compound that can be safely consumed;

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: in the case of

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: a child who is unable to perform the activities related to the administration of the therapy as a result of the child’s age, includes the time spent by another person to perform or supervise those activities for the child, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: an individual who is unable to perform the activities related to the administration of the therapy because of the effects of an impairment or impairments in physical or mental functions, includes the time required to be spent by another person to assist the individual in performing those activities; and

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: does not include time spent on

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: activities (other than activities described in paragraph (b)) related to dietary or exercise restrictions or regimes,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: travel time,

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: medical appointments (other than medical appointments to receive therapy or to determine the daily dosage of medication, medical food or medical formula),

Subparagraph.Label: (iv)
Subparagraph.Text: shopping for medication, or

Subparagraph.Label: (v)
Subparagraph.Text: recuperation after therapy (other than medically required recuperation).

Subsection.Text: Despite subsection (1.1), an individual who is diagnosed with type 1 diabetes mellitus is deemed to require therapy to be administered at least two times each week for a total duration averaging not less than 14 hours a week.
Where

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: an individual has, in respect of a person (other than a person in respect of whom the person’s spouse or common-law partner deducts for a taxation year an amount under section 118 or 118.8) who is resident in Canada at any time in the year and who is entitled to deduct an amount under subsection (1) for the year,

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: claimed for the year a deduction under subsection 118(1) because of

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: paragraph (b) of the description of B in that subsection, or

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: paragraph (d) of that description where the person is a parent, grandparent, child, grandchild, brother, sister, aunt, uncle, nephew or niece of the individual, or of the individual’s spouse or common-law partner, or

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: could have claimed for the year a deduction referred to in subparagraph (i) in respect of the person if

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: the person had no income for the year and had attained the age of 18 years before the end of the year, and

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: in the case of a deduction referred to in clause (i)(A), the individual were not married or not in a common-law partnership, and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: no amount in respect of remuneration for an attendant, or care in a nursing home, because of that person’s mental or physical impairment, is included in calculating a deduction under section 118.2 (otherwise than under paragraph 118.2(2)(b.1)) for the year by the individual or by any other person,

ContinuedSectionSubsection.Text: there may be deducted, for the purpose of computing the tax payable under this Part by the individual for the year, the amount, if any, by which

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: the amount deductible under subsection 118.3(1) in computing that person’s tax payable under this Part for the year

ContinuedSectionSubsection.Text: exceeds

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: the amount of that person’s tax payable under this Part for the year computed before any deductions under this Division (other than under sections 118 to 118.07 and 118.7).

Subsection.Text: Where more than one individual is entitled to deduct an amount under subsection 118.3(2) for a taxation year in respect of the same person, the total of all amounts so deductible for the year shall not exceed the maximum amount that would be deductible under that subsection for the year by an individual in respect of that person if that individual were the only individual entitled to deduct an amount under that subsection in respect of that person, and where the individuals cannot agree as to what portion of the amount each can deduct, the Minister may fix the portions.
Where a claim under this section or under section 118.8 is made in respect of an individual’s impairment

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: if the Minister requests in writing information with respect to the individual’s impairment, its effects on the individual and, where applicable, the therapy referred to in paragraph (1)(a.1) that is required to be administered, from any person referred to in subsection (1) or (2) or section 118.8 in connection with such a claim, that person shall provide the information so requested to the Minister in writing; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: if the information referred to in paragraph (a) is provided by a person referred to in paragraph (1)(a.2) or (a.3), the information so provided is deemed to be included in a certificate in prescribed form.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Subsection.Text: For the purposes of subsection 6(16), sections 118.2 and 118.3 and this subsection,

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: an impairment is prolonged where it has lasted, or can reasonably be expected to last, for a continuous period of at least 12 months;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: an individual’s ability to perform a basic activity of daily living is markedly restricted only where all or substantially all of the time, even with therapy and the use of appropriate devices and medication, the individual is blind or is unable (or requires an inordinate amount of time) to perform a basic activity of daily living;

Paragraph.Label: (b.1)
Paragraph.Text: an individual is considered to have the equivalent of a marked restriction in a basic activity of daily living only where all or substantially all of the time, even with therapy and the use of appropriate devices and medication, the individual’s ability to perform more than one basic activity of daily living (including for this purpose, the ability to see) is significantly restricted, and the cumulative effect of those restrictions is tantamount to the individual’s ability to perform a basic activity of daily living being markedly restricted;

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: a basic activity of daily living in relation to an individual means

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: mental functions necessary for everyday life,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: feeding oneself or dressing oneself,

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: speaking so as to be understood, in a quiet setting, by another person familiar with the individual,

Subparagraph.Label: (iv)
Subparagraph.Text: hearing so as to understand, in a quiet setting, another person familiar with the individual,

Subparagraph.Label: (v)
Subparagraph.Text: eliminating (bowel or bladder functions), or

Subparagraph.Label: (vi)
Subparagraph.Text: walking;

Paragraph.Label: (c.1)
Paragraph.Text: mental functions necessary for everyday life include

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: attention,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: concentration,

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: memory,

Subparagraph.Label: (iv)
Subparagraph.Text: judgement,

Subparagraph.Label: (v)
Subparagraph.Text: perception of reality,

Subparagraph.Label: (vi)
Subparagraph.Text: problem solving,

Subparagraph.Label: (vii)
Subparagraph.Text: goal setting,

Subparagraph.Label: (viii)
Subparagraph.Text: regulation of behaviour and emotions,

Subparagraph.Label: (ix)
Subparagraph.Text: verbal and non-verbal comprehension, and

Subparagraph.Label: (x)
Subparagraph.Text: adaptive functioning;

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: for greater certainty, no other activity, including working, housekeeping or a social or recreational activity, shall be considered as a basic activity of daily living; and

Paragraph.Label: (e)
Paragraph.Text: feeding oneself does not include

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: any of the activities of identifying, finding, shopping for or otherwise procuring food, or

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the activity of preparing food to the extent that the time associated with the activity would not have been necessary in the absence of a dietary restriction or regime; and

Paragraph.Label: (f)
Paragraph.Text: dressing oneself does not include any of the activities of identifying, finding, shopping for or otherwise procuring clothing.

Subsection.Text: For the purposes of sections 63, 64, 118.2, 118.3 and 118.6, a reference to an audiologist, dentist, medical doctor, medical practitioner, nurse, nurse practitioner, occupational therapist, optometrist, pharmacist, physiotherapist, psychologist or speech-language pathologist is a reference to a person authorized to practise as such,

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: where the reference is used in respect of a service rendered to a taxpayer, pursuant to the laws of the jurisdiction in which the service is rendered;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: where the reference is used in respect of a certificate issued by the person in respect of a taxpayer, pursuant to the laws of the jurisdiction in which the taxpayer resides or of a province; and

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: where the reference is used in respect of a prescription issued by the person for property to be provided to or for the use of a taxpayer, pursuant to the laws of the jurisdiction in which the taxpayer resides, of a province or of the jurisdiction in which the property is provided.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Subsection.Text: Subject to subsection (1.2), for the purpose of computing the tax payable under this Part by an individual for a taxation year, there may be deducted,

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: subject to subsection (1.1), where the individual was during the year a student enrolled at an educational institution in Canada that is

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: a university, college or other educational institution providing courses at a post-secondary school level, or

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: certified by the Minister of Employment and Social Development to be an educational institution providing courses, other than courses designed for university credit, that furnish a person with skills for, or improve a person’s skills in, an occupation,

ContinuedParagraph.Text: an amount equal to the product obtained when the appropriate percentage for the year is multiplied by the amount of any fees for the individual’s tuition paid in respect of the year to the educational institution, except to the extent that those fees

Subparagraph.Label: (ii.1)
Subparagraph.Text: are paid to an educational institution described in subparagraph (i) in respect of courses that are not at the post-secondary school level, if

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: the individual had not attained the age of 16 years before the end of the year, or

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: the purpose of the individual’s enrolment at the institution cannot reasonably be regarded as being to provide the individual with skills, or to improve the individual’s skills, in an occupation,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii.2)
Subparagraph.Text: are paid to an educational institution described in subparagraph (ii) if

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: the individual had not attained the age of 16 years before the end of the year, or

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: the purpose of the individual’s enrolment at the institution cannot reasonably be regarded as being to provide the individual with skills, or to improve the individual’s skills, in an occupation,

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: are paid on behalf of, or reimbursed to, the individual by the individual’s employer and the amount paid or reimbursed is not included in the individual’s income,

Subparagraph.Label: (iii.1)
Subparagraph.Text: are fees in respect of which the individual is or was entitled to receive a reimbursement or any form of assistance under a program of Her Majesty in right of Canada or a province designed to facilitate the entry or re-entry of workers into the labour force, where the amount of the reimbursement or assistance is not included in computing the individual’s income,

Subparagraph.Label: (iv)
Subparagraph.Text: were included as part of an allowance received by the individual’s parent on the individual’s behalf from an employer and are not included in computing the income of the parent by reason of subparagraph 6(1)(b)(ix), or

Subparagraph.Label: (v)
Subparagraph.Text: are paid on the individual’s behalf, or are fees in respect of which the individual is or was entitled to receive a reimbursement, under a program of Her Majesty in right of Canada designed to assist athletes, where the payment or reimbursement is not included in computing the individual’s income;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: where the individual was during the year a student in full-time attendance at a university outside Canada in a course leading to a degree, an amount equal to the product obtained when the appropriate percentage for the year is multiplied by the amount of any fees for the individual’s tuition paid in respect of the year to the university, except any such fees

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: paid in respect of a course of less than three consecutive weeks duration,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: paid on the individual’s behalf by the individual’s employer to the extent that the amount of the fees is not included in computing the individual’s income, or

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: paid on the individual’s behalf by the employer of the individual’s parent, to the extent that the amount of the fees is not included in computing the income of the parent by reason of subparagraph 6(1)(b)(ix);

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: where the individual resided throughout the year in Canada near the boundary between Canada and the United States if the individual

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: was at any time in the year a student enrolled at an educational institution in the United States that is a university, college or other educational institution providing courses at a post-secondary school level, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: commuted to that educational institution in the United States,

ContinuedParagraph.Text: an amount equal to the product obtained when the appropriate percentage for the year is multiplied by the amount of any fees for the individual’s tuition paid in respect of the year to the educational institution if those fees exceeds $100, except to the extent that those fees

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: are paid on the individual’s behalf by the individual’s employer and are not included in computing the individual’s income, or

Subparagraph.Label: (iv)
Subparagraph.Text: were included as part of an allowance received by the individual’s parent on the individual’s behalf from an employer and are not included in computing the income of the parent by reason of subparagraph 6(1)(b)(ix); and

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: subject to subsection (1.1), if the individual has taken an examination (in this section referred to as an “occupational, trade or professional examination”) in the year that is required to obtain a professional status recognized under a federal or provincial statute, or to be licensed or certified as a tradesperson, where that status, licence or certification allows the individual to practise the profession or trade in Canada, an amount equal to the product obtained when the appropriate percentage for the year is multiplied by the amount of any fees paid in respect of the occupational, trade or professional examination to an educational institution referred to in paragraph (a), a professional association, a provincial ministry or other similar institution, except to the extent that the occupational, trade or professional examination fees

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: are paid on behalf of, or reimbursed to, the individual by the individual’s employer and the amount paid or reimbursed is not included in the individual’s income, or

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: are fees in respect of which the individual is or was entitled to receive a reimbursement or any form of assistance under a program of Her Majesty in right of Canada or a province designed to facilitate the entry or re-entry of workers into the labour force, where the amount of the reimbursement or assistance is not included in computing the individual’s income.

Subsection.Text: No amount may be deducted for a taxation year by an individual under paragraph (1)(a) or (d) in respect of any fees paid to a particular institution unless the total of the fees described in those paragraphs and paid to the particular institution in the year by the individual exceeds $100.
The amount that may be deducted for a taxation year by an individual under subsection (1) is to be reduced by the amount determined by the formula

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the appropriate percentage for the taxation year; and
is the amount, if any, deemed to have been paid by the individual under subsection 122.91(1) in respect of the taxation year.

Subsection.Text: Where an individual is deemed by section 250 to be resident in Canada throughout all or part of a taxation year, in applying subsection (1) in respect of the individual for the period when the individual is so deemed to be resident in Canada, paragraph (1)(a) shall be read without reference to the words “in Canada”.

Subsection.MarginalNote: Inclusion of ancillary fees and charges
Subsection.Text: For the purpose of this section, fees for an individual’s tuition includes ancillary fees and charges that are paid

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: to an educational institution referred to in subparagraph 118.5(1)(a)(i), and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: in respect of the individual’s enrolment at the institution in a program at a post-secondary school level,

ContinuedSectionSubsection.Text: but does not include

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: any fee or charge to the extent that it is levied in respect of

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: a student association,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: property to be acquired by students,

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: services not ordinarily provided at educational institutions in Canada that offer courses at a post-secondary school level,

Subparagraph.Label: (iv)
Subparagraph.Text: the provision of financial assistance to students, except to the extent that, if this Act were read without reference to subsection 56(3), the amount of the assistance would be required to be included in computing the income, and not be deductible in computing the taxable income, of the students to whom the assistance is provided, or

Subparagraph.Label: (v)
Subparagraph.Text: the construction, renovation or maintenance of any building or facility, except to the extent that the building or facility is owned by the institution and used to provide

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: courses at the post-secondary school level, or

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: services for which, if fees or charges in respect of the services were required to be paid by all students of the institution, the fees or charges would be included because of this subsection in the fees for an individual’s tuition, and

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: any fee or charge for a taxation year that, but for this paragraph, would be included because of this subsection in the fees for the individual’s tuition and that is not required to be paid by

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: all of the institution’s full-time students, where the individual is a full-time student at the institution, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: all of the institution’s part-time students, where the individual is a part-time student at the institution,

ContinuedParagraph.Text: to the extent that the total for the year of all such fees and charges paid in respect of the individual’s enrolment at the institution exceeds $250.

Subsection.MarginalNote: Ancillary fees and charges for examinations
Subsection.Text: For the purpose of this section, fees paid in respect of the occupational, trade or professional examination of an individual includes ancillary fees and charges, other than fees and charges included in subsection (3), that are paid to an educational institution referred to in subparagraph (1)(a)(i), a professional association, a provincial ministry or other similar institution, in respect of an occupation, trade or professional examination taken by the individual, but does not include any fee or charge to the extent that it is levied in respect of

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: property to be acquired by an individual;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the provision of financial assistance to an individual, except to the extent that, if this Act were read without reference to subsection 56(3), the financial assistance would be required to be included in computing the income, and would not be deductible in computing the taxable income, of the individual;

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: the construction, renovation or maintenance of any building or facility; or

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: any fee or charge for a taxation year that, but for this paragraph, would be included because of this subsection in the fees for the individual’s occupational, trade or professional examination and that is not required to be paid by all the individuals taking the occupational, trade or professional examination to the extent that the total for the year of all such fees and charges paid in respect of the individual’s fees for the occupational, trade or professional examination exceeds $250.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Subsection.Text: For the purposes of sections 63 and 64 and this Subdivision,

Definition.Text: designated educational institution means

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: an educational institution in Canada that is

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: a university, college or other educational institution designated by the lieutenant governor in council of a province as a specified educational institution under the Canada Student Loans Act, designated by an appropriate authority under the Canada Student Financial Assistance Act, or designated, for the purposes of An Act respecting financial assistance for education expenses, R.S.Q, c. A-13.3, by the Minister of the Province of Quebec responsible for the administration of that Act, or

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: certified by the Minister of Employment and Social Development to be an educational institution providing courses, other than courses designed for university credit, that furnish a person with skills for, or improve a person’s skills in, an occupation,

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: a university outside Canada at which the individual referred to in the definition qualifying student in this subsection was enrolled in a course, of not less than three consecutive weeks duration, leading to a degree, or

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: if the individual referred to in the definition qualifying student in this subsection resided, throughout the year referred to in that definition, in Canada near the boundary between Canada and the United States, an educational institution in the United States to which the individual commuted that is a university, college or other educational institution providing courses at a post-secondary school level; (établissement d’enseignement agréé)

Definition.Text: qualifying educational program means a program of not less than three consecutive weeks duration that provides that each student taking the program spend not less than 10 hours per week on courses or work in the program and, in respect of a program at an institution described in the definition designated educational institution (other than an institution described in subparagraph (a)(ii) of that definition), that is a program that does not consist primarily of research (unless the program leads to a diploma from a college or a Collège d’enseignement général et professionnel, or a bachelor, masters, doctoral or equivalent degree) but, in relation to any particular student, does not include a program if the student receives, from a person with whom the student is dealing at arm’s length, any allowance, benefit, grant or reimbursement for expenses in respect of the program other than

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: an amount received by the student as or on account of a scholarship, fellowship or bursary, or a prize for achievement in a field of endeavour ordinarily carried on by the student,

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: a benefit, if any, received by the student because of a loan made to the student in accordance with the requirements of the Canada Student Loans Act, the Apprentice Loans Act or An Act respecting financial assistance for education expenses, R.S.Q., c. A-13.3, or because of financial assistance given to the student in accordance with the requirements of the Canada Student Financial Assistance Act, or

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: an amount that is received by the student in the year under a program referred to in subparagraph 56(1)(r)(ii) or (iii), a program established under the authority of the Department of Employment and Social Development Act or a prescribed program; (programme de formation admissible)

Definition.Text: qualifying student, for a month in a taxation year, means an individual who,

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: in the month,

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: is enrolled in a qualifying educational program as a full-time student at a designated educational institution, or

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: is not described in subparagraph (i) and is enrolled at a designated educational institution in a specified educational program that provides that each student in the program spend not less than 12 hours in the month on courses in the program,

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: if requested by the Minister, proves the enrolment by filing with the Minister a certificate in prescribed form issued by the designated educational institution and containing prescribed information,

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: in the case of an individual who is enrolled in a program (other than a program at the post-secondary school level) at a designated educational institution described in subparagraph (a)(i) of the definition designated educational institution or who is enrolled in a program at a designated educational institution described in subparagraph (a)(ii) of that definition,

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: has attained the age of 16 years before the end of the year, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: is enrolled in the program to obtain skills for, or improve the individual’s skills in, an occupation, and

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: in the case of an individual who is enrolled at a designated educational institution described in paragraph (c) of the definition designated educational institution, is enrolled in a program that is at the post-secondary level; (étudiant admissible)

Definition.Text: specified educational program means a program that would be a qualifying educational program if the definition qualifying educational program were read without reference to the words “that provides that each student taking the program spend not less than 10 hours per week on courses or work in the program”. (programme de formation déterminé)

Subsection.MarginalNote: Students eligible for disability tax credit
Subsection.Text: For the purposes of subparagraph (a)(i) of the definition qualifying student in subsection (1), the reference to “full-time student” is to be read as “student” if

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: an amount may be deducted under section 118.3 in respect of the individual for the year; or

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the individual has in the year a mental or physical impairment the effects of which on the individual have been certified in writing, to be such that the individual cannot reasonably be expected to be enrolled as a full-time student while so impaired, by a medical doctor, a nurse practitioner or, where the impairment is

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: an impairment of sight, by a medical doctor, a nurse practitioner or an optometrist,

Subparagraph.Label: (i.1)
Subparagraph.Text: a speech impairment, by a medical doctor, a nurse practitioner or a speech-language pathologist,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: a hearing impairment, by a medical doctor, a nurse practitioner or an audiologist,

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: an impairment with respect to the individual’s ability in feeding or dressing themself, by a medical doctor, a nurse practitioner or an occupational therapist,

Subparagraph.Label: (iii.1)
Subparagraph.Text: an impairment with respect to the individual’s ability in walking, by a medical doctor, a nurse practitioner, an occupational therapist or a physiotherapist, or

Subparagraph.Label: (iv)
Subparagraph.Text: an impairment with respect to the individual’s ability in mental functions necessary for everyday life (within the meaning assigned by paragraph 118.4(1)(c.1)), by a medical doctor, a nurse practitioner or a psychologist.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Section.MarginalNote: Unused tuition, textbook and education tax credits

Subsection.Text: In this section, an individual’s unused tuition, textbook and education tax credits at the end of a taxation year is the amount determined by the formula

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the amount determined under this subsection in respect of the individual at the end of the preceding taxation year;
is the total of all amounts each of which may be deducted under section 118.5 in computing the individual’s tax payable under this Part for the year;

is the lesser of the value of B and the amount that would be the individual’s tax payable under this Part for the year if no amount were deductible under this Division (other than an amount deductible under this section and any of subsections 118(1) to (10) and sections 118.01 to 118.07, 118.3 and 118.7);
is the amount that the individual may deduct under subsection (2) for the year; and
is the tuition tax credit transferred for the year by the individual to the individual’s spouse, common-law partner, parent or grandparent.

Subsection.Text: For the purpose of computing an individual’s tax payable under this Part for a taxation year, there may be deducted the lesser of

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the amount determined under subsection (1) in respect of the individual at the end of the preceding taxation year, and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the amount that would be the individual’s tax payable under this Part for the year if no amount were deductible under this Division (other than an amount deductible under this section and any of subsections 118(1) to (10) and sections 118.01 to 118.07, 118.3 and 118.7).

Subsection.Text: For the purpose of determining the amount that may be deducted under subsection (2) in computing an individual’s tax payable for a taxation year, in circumstances where the appropriate percentage for the taxation year is different from the appropriate percentage for the preceding taxation year, the individual’s unused tuition, textbook and education tax credits at the end of the preceding taxation year is deemed to be the amount determined by the formula

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the appropriate percentage for the current taxation year;
is the appropriate percentage for the preceding taxation year; and

is the amount that would be the individual’s unused tuition, textbook and education tax credits at the end of the preceding taxation year if this section were read without reference to this subsection.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Section.MarginalNote: Credit for interest on student loan
Section.Text: For the purpose of computing an individual’s tax payable under this Part for a taxation year, there may be deducted the amount determined by the formula

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the appropriate percentage for the year; and

is the total of all amounts (other than any amount paid on account of or in satisfaction of a judgement) each of which is an amount of interest paid in the year (or in any of the five preceding taxation years that are after 1997, to the extent that it was not included in computing a deduction under this section for any other taxation year) by the individual or a person related to the individual on a loan made to, or other amount owing by, the individual under the Canada Student Loans Act, the Canada Student Financial Assistance Act, the Apprentice Loans Act or a law of a province governing the granting of financial assistance to students at the post-secondary school level.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Section.MarginalNote: Credit for EI and QPIP premiums and CPP contributions
Section.Text: For the purpose of computing the tax payable under this Part by an individual for a taxation year, there may be deducted the amount determined by the formula

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the appropriate percentage for the year; and
is the total of

FormulaParagraph.Label: (a)
FormulaParagraph.Text: the total of all amounts each of which is an amount payable by the individual as an employee’s premium or a self-employment premium for the year under the Employment Insurance Act, not exceeding the maximum amount of such premiums payable by the individual for the year under that Act,

FormulaParagraph.Label: (a.1)
FormulaParagraph.Text: the total of all amounts each of which is an amount payable by the individual as an employee’s premium for the year under the Act respecting parental insurance, R.S.Q., c. A-29.011, not exceeding the maximum amount of such premiums payable by the individual for the year under that Act,

FormulaParagraph.Label: (a.2)
FormulaParagraph.Text: the amount, if any, by which the total of all amounts each of which is an amount payable by the individual in respect of self-employed earnings for the year as a premium under the Act respecting parental insurance, R.S.Q., c. A-29.011, (not exceeding the maximum amount of such premiums payable by the individual for the year under that Act) exceeds the amount deductible under paragraph 60(g) in computing the individual’s income for the year,

FormulaParagraph.Label: (b)
FormulaParagraph.Text: the total of all amounts each of which is an amount payable by the individual for the year as an employee’s contribution under subsection 8(1) of the Canada Pension Plan or as a like contribution under a provincial pension plan, as defined in section 3 of that Act, not exceeding the maximum amount of such contributions payable by the individual for the year under the plan, and

FormulaParagraph.Label: (c)
FormulaParagraph.Text: the amount by which

FormulaParagraph.Label: (i)
FormulaParagraph.Text: the total of all amounts each of which is an amount payable by the individual in respect of self-employed earnings for the year as a contribution under the Canada Pension Plan or under a provincial pension plan within the meaning assigned by section 3 of that Act (not exceeding the maximum amount of such contributions payable by the individual for the year under the plan)

FormulaParagraph.Label: (ii)
FormulaParagraph.Text: the amount deductible under paragraph 60(e) in computing the individual’s income for the year.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Section.MarginalNote: Transfer of unused credits to spouse or common-law partner
Section.Text: For the purpose of computing the tax payable under this Part for a taxation year by an individual who, at any time in the year, is a married person or a person who is in a common-law partnership (other than an individual who, by reason of a breakdown of their marriage or common-law partnership, is living separate and apart from the individual’s spouse or common-law partner at the end of the year and for a period of 90 days commencing in the year), there may be deducted an amount determined by the formula

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the tuition tax credit transferred for the year by the spouse or common-law partner to the individual;

is the total of all amounts each of which is deductible under subsection 118(1), because of paragraph (b.1) of the description of B in that subsection, or subsection 118(2) or (3) or 118.3(1) in computing the spouse’s or common-law partner’s tax payable under this Part for the year; and
is the amount, if any, by which

FormulaParagraph.Label: (a)
FormulaParagraph.Text: the amount that would be the spouse’s or common-law partner’s tax payable under this Part for the year if no amount were deductible under this Division (other than an amount deductible under subsection 118(1) because of paragraph (c) of the description of B in that subsection, under subsection 118(10) or under any of sections 118.01 to 118.07, 118.3, 118.61 and 118.7)

FormulaParagraph.Label: (b)
FormulaParagraph.Text: the lesser of

FormulaParagraph.Label: (i)
FormulaParagraph.Text: the total of all amounts that may be deducted under section 118.5 in computing the spouse’s or common-law partner’s tax payable under this Part for the year, and

FormulaParagraph.Label: (ii)
FormulaParagraph.Text: the amount that would be the spouse’s or common-law partner’s tax payable under this Part for the year if no amount were deductible under this Division (other than an amount deductible under any of sections 118 to 118.07, 118.3, 118.61 and 118.7).

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Section.Text: In this Subdivision, the tuition tax credit transferred for a taxation year by a person to an individual is the lesser of

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the amount determined by the formula

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the lesser of

FormulaParagraph.Label: (i)
FormulaParagraph.Text: the total of all amounts that may be deducted under section 118.5 in computing the person’s tax payable under this Part for the year, and

FormulaParagraph.Label: (ii)
FormulaParagraph.Text: the amount determined by the formula

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the appropriate percentage for the taxation year, and

is the amount that would be the person’s tax payable under this Part for the year if no amount were deductible under this Division (other than an amount deductible under any of sections 118 to 118.07, 118.3, 118.61 and 118.7), and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the amount for the year that the person designates in writing for the purpose of section 118.8 or 118.9.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Section.Text: If for a taxation year a parent or grandparent of an individual (other than an individual in respect of whom the individual’s spouse or common-law partner deducts an amount under section 118 or 118.8 for the year) is the only person designated in writing by the individual for the year for the purpose of this section, there may be deducted in computing the tax payable under this Part for the year by the parent or grandparent, as the case may be, the tuition tax credit transferred for the year by the individual to the parent or grandparent, as the case may be.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Section.Text: Notwithstanding sections 118 to 118.9, where an individual is resident in Canada throughout part of a taxation year and throughout another part of the year is non-resident, for the purpose of computing the individual’s tax payable under this Part for the year,

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the amount deductible for the year under each such provision in respect of the part of the year that is not included in the period or periods referred to in paragraph 118.91(b) shall be computed as though such part were the whole taxation year; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the individual shall be allowed only

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: such of the deductions permitted under subsections 118(3) and (10) and sections 118.01 to 118.2, 118.5, 118.62 and 118.7 as can reasonably be considered wholly applicable to the period or periods in the year throughout which the individual is resident in Canada, computed as though that period or those periods were the whole taxation year, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: such part of the deductions permitted under sections 118 (other than subsections 118(3) and (10)), 118.3, 118.8 and 118.9 as can reasonably be considered applicable to the period or periods in the year throughout which the individual is resident in Canada, computed as though that period or those periods were the whole taxation year,

ContinuedSectionSubsection.Text: except that the amount deductible for the year by the individual under each such provision shall not exceed the amount that would have been deductible under that provision had the individual been resident in Canada throughout the year.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Section.Text: In computing an individual’s tax payable under this Part, the following provisions shall be applied in the following order: subsections 118(1) and (2), section 118.7, subsections 118(3) and (10) and sections 118.01, 118.02, 118.04, 118.041, 118.05, 118.06, 118.07, 118.3, 118.61, 118.5, 118.9, 118.8, 118.2, 118.1, 118.62 and 121.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Section.Text: If a separate return of income with respect to a taxpayer is filed under subsection 70(2), 104(23) or 150(4) for a particular period and another return of income under this Part with respect to the taxpayer is filed for a period ending in the calendar year in which the particular period ends, for the purpose of computing the tax payable under this Part by the taxpayer in those returns, the total of all deductions claimed in all those returns under any of subsections 118(3) and (10) and sections 118.01 to 118.7 and 118.9 shall not exceed the total that could be deducted under those provisions for the year with respect to the taxpayer if no separate returns were filed under any of subsections 70(2), 104(23) and 150(4).

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Section.Text: Sections 118 to 118.07 and 118.2, subsections 118.3(2) and (3) and sections 118.8 and 118.9 do not apply for the purpose of computing the tax payable under this Part for a taxation year by an individual who at no time in the year is resident in Canada unless all or substantially all the individual’s income for the year is included in computing the individual’s taxable income earned in Canada for the year.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Section.Text: Notwithstanding sections 118 to 118.9, for the purpose of computing an individual’s tax payable under this Part for a taxation year that ends in a calendar year in which the individual becomes bankrupt, the individual shall be allowed only

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: such of the deductions as the individual is entitled to under any of subsections 118(3) and (10) and sections 118.01 to 118.2, 118.5, 118.62 and 118.7, as can reasonably be considered wholly applicable to the taxation year, and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: such part of the deductions as the individual is entitled to under any of sections 118 (other than subsections 118(3) and (10)), 118.3, 118.8 and 118.9 as can reasonably be considered applicable to the taxation year,

ContinuedSectionSubsection.Text: except that the total of the amounts so deductible for all taxation years of the individual in the calendar year under any of those provisions shall not exceed the amount that would have been deductible under that provision in respect of the calendar year if the individual had not become bankrupt.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Section.MarginalNote: Former resident — credit for tax paid
Section.Text: If at any particular time an individual was deemed by subsection 128.1(4) to have disposed of a capital property that was a taxable Canadian property of the individual throughout the period that began at the particular time and that ends at the first time, after the particular time, at which the individual disposes of the property, there may be deducted in computing the individual’s tax payable under this Part for the taxation year that includes the particular time the lesser of

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: that proportion of the individual’s tax for the year otherwise payable under this Part (within the meaning assigned by paragraph (a) of the definition tax for the year otherwise payable under this Part in subsection 126(7)) that

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the individual’s taxable capital gain from the disposition of the property at the particular time

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the amount determined under paragraph 114(a) in respect of the individual for the year, and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: that proportion of the individual’s tax payable under Part XIII in respect of dividends received during the period by the individual in respect of the property and amounts deemed under Part XIII to have been paid during the period to the individual as dividends from corporations resident in Canada, to the extent that the amounts can reasonably be considered to relate to the property, that

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the amount by which the individual’s loss from the disposition of the property at the end of the period is reduced by subsection 40(3.7)

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the total amount of those dividends.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]
[NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Section.MarginalNote: Income not earned in a province

Subsection.Text: There shall be added to the tax otherwise payable under this Part by an individual for a taxation year the amount that bears the same relation to 48% of the tax otherwise payable under this Part by the individual for the year that

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the individual’s income for the year, other than the individual’s income earned in the year in a province,

ContinuedSectionSubsection.Text: bears to

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the individual’s income for the year.

Subsection.MarginalNote: Amount deemed paid in prescribed manner
Subsection.Text: Each individual is deemed to have paid, in prescribed manner and on prescribed dates, on account of the individual’s tax under this Part for a taxation year an amount that bears the same relation to 3% of the tax otherwise payable under this Part by the individual for the year that

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the individual’s income earned in the year in a province that, on January 1, 1973, was a province providing schooling allowances within the meaning of the Youth Allowances Act, chapter Y-1 of the Revised Statutes of Canada, 1970,

ContinuedSectionSubsection.Text: bears to

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the individual’s income for the year.

Subsection.Text: An individual is deemed to have paid on the last day of a taxation year, on account of the individual’s tax under this Part for the year, an amount equal to the individual’s income tax payable for the year to an Aboriginal government pursuant to a law of that government made in accordance with a tax sharing agreement between that government and the Government of Canada.

Subsection.MarginalNote: Definition of the individual’s income for the year
Subsection.Text: For the purpose of this section, the individual’s income for the year means

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: if section 114 applies to the individual in respect of the year, the amount determined under paragraph 114(a) in respect of the individual for the year;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: if the individual was non-resident throughout the year, the individual’s taxable income earned in Canada for the year determined without reference to paragraphs 115(1)(d) to (f);

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: in the case of an individual who is a specified individual in relation to the year, the individual’s income for the year computed without reference to paragraph 20(1)(ww); and

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: in the case of a SIFT trust, the amount, if any, by which its income for the year determined without reference to this paragraph exceeds its taxable SIFT trust distributions (as defined in subsection 122(3)) for the year.

Subsection.Text: In this section,

Definition.Text: income earned in the year in a province means amounts determined under rules prescribed for the purpose of regulations made on the recommendation of the Minister of Finance; (revenu gagné au cours de l’année dans une province)
tax otherwise payable under this Part by an individual for a taxation year means the total of

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the greater of

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the individual”s minimum amount for the year determined under section 127.51, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the amount that, but for this section, would be the individual’s tax payable under this Part for the year if this Part were read without reference to

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: subsection 117(2.1), section 119, subsection 120.4(2) and sections 126, 127, 127.4 and 127.41, and

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: where the individual is a specified individual in relation to the year, section 121 in its application to dividends included in computing the individual’s split income for the year, and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: where the individual is a specified individual in relation to the year, the amount, if any, by which

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the highest individual percentage for the year multiplied by the individual’s split income for the year

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the total of all amounts each of which is an amount that may be deducted under section 121 and that can reasonably be considered to be in respect of a dividend included in computing the individual’s split income for the year. (impôt qu’il est par ailleurs tenu de payer en vertu de la présente partie ou impôt payable par ailleurs en vertu de la présente partie)

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]
[NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Subsection.Text: There may be deducted from the amount that, but for this section, section 120 and subsection 120.4(2), would be an individual’s tax payable under this Part for a particular taxation year such amount as the individual claims not exceeding the lesser of

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the portion of the total of the individual’s additional taxes determined under subsection 120.2(3) for the 7 taxation years immediately preceding the particular year that was not deducted in computing the individual’s tax payable under this Part for a taxation year preceding the particular year, and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the amount, if any, by which

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the amount that, but for this section, section 120 and subsection 120.4(2), would be the individual’s tax payable under this Part for the particular year if the individual were not entitled to any deduction under section 126

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the individual’s minimum amount for the particular year determined under section 127.51.

Subsection.Text: For the purposes of subsection 120.2(1), additional tax of an individual for a taxation year is the amount, if any, by which

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the individual’s minimum amount for the year determined under section 127.51

ContinuedSectionSubsection.Text: exceeds the total of

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the amount that, if this Act were read without reference to section 120, would be the individual’s tax payable under this Part for the year if the individual were not entitled to any deduction under section 126, and

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: that proportion of the amount, if any, by which

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the individual’s special foreign tax credit for the year determined under section 127.54

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the total of all amounts deductible under section 126 from the individual’s tax for the year

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: the amount of the individual’s foreign taxes for the year within the meaning assigned by subsection 127.54(1)

Subparagraph.Label: (iv)
Subparagraph.Text: the amount that would be the individual’s foreign taxes for the year within the meaning assigned by subsection 127.54(1) if the definition foreign taxes in that subsection were read without reference to “2/3 of”.

Subsection.Text: Subsection (1) does not apply in respect of an individual’s return of income filed under subsection 70(2), paragraph 104(23)(d) or 128(2)(f) or subsection 150(4).

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Section.MarginalNote: CPP/QPP disability benefits for previous years
Section.Text: There shall be added in computing an individual’s tax payable under this Part for a particular taxation year the total of all amounts each of which is the amount, if any, by which

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the amount that would have been the tax payable under this Part by the individual for a preceding taxation year if that portion of any amount not included in computing the individual’s income for the particular year because of subsection 56(8) and that relates to the preceding year had been included in computing the individual’s income for the preceding year

ContinuedSectionSubsection.Text: exceeds

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the tax payable under this Part by the individual for the preceding year.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Subsection.Text: The definitions in subsection 110.2(1) apply in this section.
There shall be added in computing an individual’s tax payable under this Part for a particular taxation year the total of all amounts each of which is the amount, if any, by which

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the individual’s notional tax payable for an eligible taxation year to which a specified portion of a qualifying amount received by the individual relates and in respect of which an amount is deducted under section 110.2 in computing the individual’s taxable income for the particular year

ContinuedSectionSubsection.Text: exceeds

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the individual’s tax payable under this Part for the eligible taxation year.

Subsection.Text: For the purpose of subsection (2), an individual’s notional tax payable for an eligible taxation year, calculated for the purpose of computing the individual’s tax payable under this Part for a taxation year (in this subsection referred to as “the year of receipt”) in which the individual received a qualifying amount, is the total of

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the amount, if any, by which

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the amount that would be the individual’s tax payable under this Part for the eligible taxation year if the total of all amounts, each of which is the specified portion, in relation to the eligible taxation year, of a qualifying amount received by the individual before the end of the year of receipt, were added in computing the individual’s taxable income for the eligible taxation year

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the total of all amounts each of which is an amount, in respect of a qualifying amount received by the individual before the year of receipt, that was included because of this paragraph in computing the individual’s notional tax payable under this Part for the eligible taxation year, and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: if the eligible taxation year ended before the taxation year preceding the year of receipt, an amount equal to the amount that would be calculated as interest payable on the amount, if any, by which the amount determined under paragraph (a) in respect of the eligible taxation year exceeds the taxpayer’s tax payable under this Part for that year, if the amount that would be calculated as interest payable on that excess were calculated

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: for the period that began on May 1 of the year following the eligible taxation year and that ended immediately before the year of receipt, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: at the prescribed rate that is applicable for the purpose of subsection 164(3) with respect to the period.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Subsection.Text: The definitions in this subsection apply in this section.

Definition.Text: arm’s length capital, of a specified individual, means property of the individual if the property, or property for which it is a substitute, was not

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: acquired as income from, or a taxable capital gain or profit from the disposition of, another property that was derived directly or indirectly from a related business in respect of the specified individual;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: borrowed by the specified individual under a loan or other indebtedness; or

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: transferred, directly or indirectly by any means whatever, to the specified individual from a person who was related to the specified individual (other than as a consequence of the death of a person). (capital indépendant)

Definition.Text: excluded amount, in respect of an individual for a taxation year, means an amount that is the individual’s income for the year from, or the individual’s taxable capital gain or profit for the year from the disposition of, a property to the extent that the amount

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: if the individual has not attained the age of 24 years before the year, is from a property that was acquired by, or for the benefit of, the individual as a consequence of the death of a person who is

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: a parent of the individual, or

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: any person, if the individual is

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: enrolled as a full-time student during the year at a post-secondary educational institution (as defined in subsection 146.1(1)), or

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: an individual in respect of whom an amount may be deducted under section 118.3 in computing a taxpayer’s tax payable under this Part for the year;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: is from a property acquired by the individual under a transfer described in subsection 160(4);

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: is a taxable capital gain that arises because of subsection 70(5);

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: is a taxable capital gain for the year from the disposition by the individual of property that is, at the time of the disposition, qualified farm or fishing property or qualified small business corporation shares (as those terms are defined in subsection 110.6(1)), unless the amount would be deemed to be a dividend under subsection 120.4(4) or (5) if this definition were read without reference to this paragraph;

Paragraph.Label: (e)
Paragraph.Text: if the individual has attained the age of 17 years before the year, is

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: not derived directly or indirectly from a related business in respect of the individual for the year, or

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: derived directly or indirectly from an excluded business of the individual for the year;

Paragraph.Label: (f)
Paragraph.Text: if the individual has attained the age of 17 years but not the age of 24 years before the year, is

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: a safe harbour capital return of the individual, or

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: a reasonable return in respect of the individual, having regard only to the contributions of arm’s length capital by the individual; or

Paragraph.Label: (g)
Paragraph.Text: if the individual has attained the age of 24 years before the year, is

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: income from, or a taxable capital gain from the disposition of, excluded shares of the individual, or

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: a reasonable return in respect of the individual. (montant exclu)

Definition.Text: excluded business, of a specified individual for a taxation year, means a business if the specified individual is actively engaged on a regular, continuous and substantial basis in the activities of the business in either

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the taxation year, except in respect of an amount described in paragraph (e) of the definition split income; or

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: any five prior taxation years of the specified individual. (entreprise exclue)

Definition.Text: excluded shares, of a specified individual at any time, means shares of the capital stock of a corporation owned by the specified individual if

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the following conditions are met:

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: less than 90% of the business income of the corporation for the last taxation year of the corporation that ends at or before that time (or, if no such taxation year exists, for the taxation year of the corporation that includes that time) was from the provision of services, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the corporation is not a professional corporation;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: immediately before that time, the specified individual owns shares of the capital stock of the corporation that

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: give the holders thereof 10% or more of the votes that could be cast at an annual meeting of the shareholders of the corporation, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: have a fair market value of 10% or more of the fair market value of all of the issued and outstanding shares of the capital stock of the corporation; and

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: all or substantially all of the income of the corporation for the relevant taxation year in subparagraph (a)(i) is income that is not derived, directly or indirectly, from one or more related businesses in respect of the specified individual other than a business of the corporation. (actions exclues)

Definition.Text: reasonable return, in respect of a specified individual for a taxation year, means a particular amount derived directly or indirectly from a related business in respect of the specified individual that

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: would, if this subsection were read without reference to subparagraph (f)(ii) or (g)(ii) of the definition excluded amount, be an amount described in the definition split income in respect of the specified individual for the year; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: is reasonable having regard to the following factors relating to the relative contributions of the specified individual, and each source individual in respect of the specified individual, in respect of the related business:

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the work they performed in support of the related business,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the property they contributed, directly or indirectly, in support of the related business,

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: the risks they assumed in respect of the related business,

Subparagraph.Label: (iv)
Subparagraph.Text: the total of all amounts that were paid or that became payable, directly or indirectly, by any person or partnership to, or for the benefit of, them in respect of the related business, and

Subparagraph.Label: (v)
Subparagraph.Text: such other factors as may be relevant. (rendement raisonnable)

Definition.Text: related business, in respect of a specified individual for a taxation year, means

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: a business carried on by

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: a source individual in respect of the specified individual at any time in the year, or

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: a partnership, corporation or trust if a source individual in respect of the specified individual at any time in the year is actively engaged on a regular basis in the activities of the partnership, corporation or trust related to earning income from the business;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: a business of a particular partnership, if a source individual in respect of the specified individual at any time in the year has an interest — including directly or indirectly — in the particular partnership; and

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: a business of a corporation, if the following conditions are met at any time in the year:

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: a source individual in respect of the specified individual owns

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: shares of the capital stock of the corporation, or

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: property that derives, directly or indirectly, all or part of its fair market value from shares of the capital stock of the corporation, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: it is the case that

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the total fair market value of all of the issued and outstanding shares of the capital stock of the corporation,
is the total fair market value of property described in clause (i)(A), and
is the portion of the total fair market value of property described in clause (i)(B) that is derived from shares of the capital stock of the corporation. (entreprise liée)

Definition.Text: safe harbour capital return, of a specified individual for a taxation year, means an amount that does not exceed the amount determined by the formula

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the rate equal to the highest rate of interest prescribed under paragraph 4301(c) of the Income Tax Regulations in effect for a quarter in the year; and
is the total of all amounts each of which is determined by the formula
is the fair market value of property contributed by the specified individual in support of a related business at the time it was contributed,

is the number of days in the year that the property (or property substituted for it) is used in support of the related business and has not directly or indirectly, in any manner whatever, been returned to the specified individual, and
is the number of days in the year. (rendement exonéré)

Definition.Text: source individual, in respect of a specified individual for a taxation year, means an individual (other than a trust) who, at any time in the year, is

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: resident in Canada; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: related to the specified individual. (particulier source)

Definition.Text: specified individual, for a taxation year, means an individual (other than a trust) who

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: is resident in Canada

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: in the case where the individual dies in the year, immediately before the death, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: in any other case, at the end of the year; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: if the individual has not attained the age of 17 years before the year, has a parent resident in Canada at any time in the year. (particulier déterminé)

Definition.Text: split income, of a specified individual for a taxation year, means the total of all amounts (other than excluded amounts) each of which is

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: an amount required to be included in computing the individual’s income for the year

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: in respect of taxable dividends received by the individual in respect of shares of the capital stock of a corporation (other than shares of a class listed on a designated stock exchange or shares of the capital stock of a mutual fund corporation), or

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: because of the application of section 15 in respect of the ownership by any person of shares of the capital stock of a corporation (other than shares of a class listed on a designated stock exchange),

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: a portion of an amount included because of the application of paragraph 96(1)(f) in computing the individual’s income for the year, to the extent that the portion

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: is not included in an amount described in paragraph (a), and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: can reasonably be considered to be income derived directly or indirectly from

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: one or more related businesses in respect of the individual for the year, or

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: the rental of property by a particular partnership or trust, if a person who is related to the individual at any time in the year

Subclause.Label: (I)
Subclause.Text: is actively engaged on a regular basis in the activities of the particular partnership or trust related to the rental of property, or

Subclause.Label: (II)
Subclause.Text: in the case of a particular partnership, has an interest in the particular partnership directly or indirectly through one or more other partnerships,

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: a portion of an amount included because of the application of subsection 104(13) or 105(2) in respect of a trust (other than a mutual fund trust or a trust that is deemed to be in existence by subsection 143(1)) in computing the individual’s income for the year, to the extent that the portion

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: is not included in an amount described in paragraph (a), and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: can reasonably be considered

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: to be in respect of taxable dividends received in respect of shares of the capital stock of a corporation (other than shares of a class listed on a designated stock exchange or shares of the capital stock of a mutual fund corporation),

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: to arise because of the application of section 15 in respect of the ownership by any person of shares of the capital stock of a corporation (other than shares of a class listed on a designated stock exchange),

Clause.Label: (C)
Clause.Text: to be income derived directly or indirectly from one or more related businesses in respect of the individual for the year, or

Clause.Label: (D)
Clause.Text: to be income derived from the rental of property by a particular partnership or trust, if a person who is related to the individual at any time in the year is actively engaged on a regular basis in the activities of the particular partnership or trust related to the rental of property,

Paragraph.Label: (d)
