Paragraph.Text: an amount included in computing the individual’s income for the year to the extent that the amount is in respect of a debt obligation that

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: is of a corporation (other than a mutual fund corporation or a corporation shares of a class of the capital stock of which are listed on a designated stock exchange), partnership or trust (other than a mutual fund trust), and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: is not

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: described in paragraph (a) of the definition fully exempt interest in subsection 212(3),

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: listed or traded on a public market, or

Clause.Label: (C)
Clause.Text: a deposit, standing to the credit of the individual,

Subclause.Label: (I)
Subclause.Text: within the meaning assigned by the Canada Deposit Insurance Corporation Act, or

Subclause.Label: (II)
Subclause.Text: with a credit union or a branch in Canada of a bank, and

Paragraph.Label: (e)
Paragraph.Text: an amount in respect of a property, to the extent that

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the amount

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: is a taxable capital gain, or a profit, of the individual for the year from the disposition after 2017 of the property, or

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: is included under subsection 104(13) or 105(2) in computing the individual’s income for the year and can reasonably be considered to be attributable to a taxable capital gain, or a profit, of any person or partnership for the year from the disposition after 2017 of the property, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the property is

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: a share of the capital stock of a corporation (other than a share of a class listed on a designated stock exchange or a share of the capital stock of a mutual fund corporation), or

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: a property in respect of which the following conditions are met:

Subclause.Label: (I)
Subclause.Text: the property is

Subsubclause.Text: an interest in a partnership,
an interest as a beneficiary under a trust (other than a mutual fund trust or a trust that is deemed to be in existence by subsection 143(1)), or
a debt obligation (other than a debt obligation described in any of clauses (d)(ii)(A) to (C)), and

Subclause.Label: (II)
Subclause.Text: either

Subsubclause.Text: in respect of the property an amount is included in the individual’s split income for the year or an earlier taxation year, or

all or any part of the fair market value of the property, immediately before the disposition referred to in clause (i)(A) or (B), as the case may be, is derived, directly or indirectly, from a share described in clause (A). (revenu fractionné)

Subsection.Text: For the purpose of applying this section in respect of a specified individual in respect of a taxation year,

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: an individual is deemed to be actively engaged on a regular, continuous and substantial basis in the activities of a business in a taxation year of the individual if the individual works in the business at least an average of 20 hours per week during the portion of the year in which the business operates;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: if an amount would — if this section were read without reference to this paragraph — be split income of a specified individual who has attained the age of 17 years before the year in respect of a property, and that property was acquired by, or for the benefit of, the specified individual as a consequence of the death of another person, then

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: for the purpose of applying paragraph (b) of the definition reasonable return in subsection (1), to the extent that the particular amount referred to in that paragraph is in respect of the property, then the factors referred to in that paragraph in respect of the other person are to be included for the purpose of determining a reasonable return in respect of the individual,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: for the purposes of this subparagraph and the definition excluded business in subsection (1), if the other person was actively engaged on a regular, substantial and continuous basis in the activities of a business throughout five previous taxation years, then the individual is deemed to have been actively engaged on a regular, substantial and continuous basis in the business throughout those five years, and

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: for the purpose of applying paragraph (g) of the definition excluded amount in subsection (1) in respect of that property, the individual is deemed to have attained the age of 24 years before the year if the other person had attained the age of 24 years before the year;

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: an amount that is a specified individual’s income for a taxation year from, or the specified individual’s taxable capital gain or profit for the year from the disposition of, a property is deemed to be an excluded amount in respect of the specified individual for the taxation year if

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the following conditions are met:

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: the amount would be an excluded amount in respect of the specified individual’s spouse or common-law partner for the year, if the amount were included in computing the spouse or common-law partner’s income for the year, and

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: the spouse or common-law partner has attained the age of 64 years before the year, or

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the amount would have been an excluded amount in respect of an individual who was, immediately before their death, the specified individual’s spouse or common-law partner, if the amount were included in computing the spouse or common-law partner’s income for their last taxation year (determined as if this section applies in respect of that year);

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: for greater certainty, an amount derived directly or indirectly from a business includes

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: an amount that

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: is derived from the provision of property or services to, or in support of, the business, or

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: arises in connection with the ownership or disposition of an interest in the person or partnership carrying on the business, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: an amount derived from an amount described in this paragraph; and

Paragraph.Label: (e)
Paragraph.Text: for the purposes of this section, an individual is deemed not to be related to their spouse or common-law partner at any time in a year if, at the end of the year, the individual is living separate and apart from their spouse or common-law partner because of a breakdown of their marriage or common-law partnership.

Subsection.Text: There shall be added to a specified individual’s tax payable under this Part for a taxation year the highest individual percentage for the year multiplied by the individual’s split income for the year.

Subsection.MarginalNote: Tax payable by a specified individual
Subsection.Text: Notwithstanding any other provision of this Act, if an individual is a specified individual for a taxation year, the individual’s tax payable under this Part for the year shall not be less than the amount, if any, determined by the formula

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the amount added under subsection (2) to the individual’s tax payable under this Part for the year;
is the amount that is the lesser of the amounts determined under paragraphs 117(2.1)(a) and (b) for the individual for the year;
is the amount deducted under section 118.3 in computing the individual’s tax payable under this Part for the year; and
is the total of all amounts each of which is the amount that

FormulaParagraph.Label: (a)
FormulaParagraph.Text: may be deducted under section 121 or 126 in computing the individual’s tax payable under this Part for the year, and

FormulaParagraph.Label: (b)
FormulaParagraph.Text: can reasonably be considered to be in respect of an amount included in computing the individual’s split income for the year.

Subsection.Text: If a specified individual who has not attained the age of 17 years before a taxation year would have for the taxation year, if this Act were read without reference to this section, a taxable capital gain (other than an excluded amount) from a disposition of shares (other than shares of a class listed on a designated stock exchange or shares of a mutual fund corporation) that are transferred, either directly or indirectly, in any manner whatever, to a person with whom the specified individual does not deal at arm’s length, then the amount of that taxable capital gain is deemed not to be a taxable capital gain and twice the amount is deemed to be received by the specified individual in the year as a taxable dividend that is not an eligible dividend.

If a specified individual who has not attained the age of 17 years before a taxation year would be, if this Act were read without reference to this section, required under subsection 104(13) or 105(2) to include an amount in computing the specified individual’s income for the taxation year, then to the extent that the amount can reasonably be considered to be attributable to a taxable capital gain (other than an excluded amount) of a trust from a disposition of shares (other than shares of a class listed on a designated stock exchange or shares of a mutual fund corporation) that are transferred, either directly or indirectly, in any manner whatever, to a person with whom the specified individual does not deal at arm’s length, subsections 104(13) and 105(2) do not apply in respect of the amount and twice the amount is deemed to be received by the specified individual in the year as a taxable dividend that is not an eligible dividend.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Section.Text: There may be deducted from the tax otherwise payable under this Part by an individual for a taxation year the total of

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the product of the amount, if any, that is required by subparagraph 82(1)(b)(i) to be included in computing the individual’s income for the year multiplied by

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: for the 2018 taxation year, 8/11, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: for taxation years after 2018, 9/13, and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the product of the amount, if any, that is required by subparagraph 82(1)(b)(ii) to be included in computing the individual’s income for the year multiplied by

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: for the 2009 taxation year, 11/18,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: for the 2010 taxation year, 10/17,

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: for the 2011 taxation year, 13/23, and

Subparagraph.Label: (iv)
Subparagraph.Text: for taxation years after 2011, 6/11.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Subsection.Text: Notwithstanding section 117, the tax payable under this Part for a taxation year by a trust (other than a graduated rate estate or qualified disability trust) is the total of

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the highest individual percentage for the taxation year multiplied by the trust’s amount taxable for the taxation year,

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: if the trust is a SIFT trust for the taxation year, the positive or negative amount determined by the formula

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the positive or negative decimal fraction determined by the formula
is the net corporate income tax rate in respect of the SIFT trust for the taxation year,
is the provincial SIFT tax rate of the SIFT trust for the taxation year, and
is the decimal fraction equivalent of the percentage rate of tax provided in paragraph (a) for the taxation year, and
is the SIFT trust’s taxable SIFT trust distributions for the taxation year, and

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: if subsection (2) applies to the trust for the taxation year, the amount determined by the formula

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the amount that would be determined for B for the year if

FormulaParagraph.Label: (i)
FormulaParagraph.Text: the rate of tax payable under this Part by the trust for each taxation year referred to in the description of B were the highest individual percentage for the taxation year, and

FormulaParagraph.Label: (ii)
FormulaParagraph.Text: the trust’s taxable income for a particular taxation year referred to in the description of B were reduced by the total of

FormulaParagraph.Label: (A)
FormulaParagraph.Text: the amount, if any, that was paid or distributed in satisfaction of all or part of an individual’s interest as a beneficiary under the trust if

FormulaParagraph.Label: (I)
FormulaParagraph.Text: the individual was an electing beneficiary of the trust for the particular year,

FormulaParagraph.Label: (II)
FormulaParagraph.Text: the payment or distribution can reasonably be considered to be made out of that taxable income, and

FormulaParagraph.Label: (III)
FormulaParagraph.Text: the payment or distribution was made in a taxation year referred to in the description of B,

FormulaParagraph.Label: (B)
FormulaParagraph.Text: the amount that is the portion of the tax payable under this Part by the trust for the particular year that can reasonably be considered to relate to the amount determined under clause (A), and

FormulaParagraph.Label: (C)
FormulaParagraph.Text: the amount that is the portion of the tax payable, under the law of the province in which the trust is resident for the particular year, that can reasonably be considered to relate to the amount determined under clause (A),

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the total of all amounts each of which is the amount of tax payable under this Part by the trust for a taxation year that precedes the year if that preceding taxation year is

FormulaParagraph.Label: (i)
FormulaParagraph.Text: the later of

FormulaParagraph.Label: (A)
FormulaParagraph.Text: the first taxation year for which the trust was a qualified disability trust, and

FormulaParagraph.Label: (B)
FormulaParagraph.Text: the last taxation year, if any, for which subsection (2) applied to the trust, or

FormulaParagraph.Label: (ii)
FormulaParagraph.Text: a taxation year that ends after the taxation year described in subparagraph (i), and

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the total of all amounts each of which is an amount determined for clause (ii)(B) of the description of A in determining the amount for A for the year.

Subsection.Text: No deduction may be made under this Subdivision (other than section 118.1, 120.2 or 121) in computing the tax payable by a trust for a taxation year.
This subsection applies to a trust for a particular taxation year if the trust was a qualified disability trust for a preceding taxation year and

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: none of the beneficiaries under the trust at the end of the particular year was an electing beneficiary of the trust for a preceding year;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the particular year ended immediately before the trust ceased to be resident in Canada; or

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: an amount is paid or distributed in the particular year to a beneficiary under the trust in satisfaction of all or part of the beneficiary’s interest in the trust unless

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the beneficiary is an electing beneficiary of the trust for the particular year or a preceding year,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the amount is deducted under paragraph 104(6)(b) in computing the trust’s income for the particular year, or

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: the amount is paid or distributed in satisfaction of a right to enforce payment of an amount that was deducted under paragraph 104(6)(b) in computing the trust’s income for a preceding year.

Subsection.Text: The following definitions apply in this section.

Definition.Text: beneficiary, under a trust, includes a person beneficially interested in the trust. (bénéficiaire)
electing beneficiary, for a taxation year of a qualified disability trust, means a beneficiary under the trust that for the year

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: makes an election described in clause (a)(iii)(A) of the definition qualified disability trust in this subsection; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: is described in paragraph (b) of that definition. (bénéficiaire optant)

Definition.Text: non-deductible distributions amount for a taxation year has the meaning assigned by subsection 104(16). (montant de distribution non déductible)
qualified disability trust, for a taxation year (in this definition referred to as the “trust year”), means a trust, if

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the trust

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: is, at the end of the trust year, a testamentary trust that arose on and as a consequence of a particular individual’s death,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: is resident in Canada for the trust year, and

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: includes in its return of income under this Part for the trust year

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: an election, made jointly with one or more beneficiaries under the trust in prescribed form, to be a qualified disability trust for the trust year, and

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: the Social Insurance Number of each of those beneficiaries;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: each of those beneficiaries is an individual, named as a beneficiary by the particular individual in the instrument under which the trust was created,

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: in respect of whom paragraphs 118.3(1)(a) to (b) apply for the individual’s taxation year (in this definition referred to as the “beneficiary year”) in which the trust year ends, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: who does not jointly elect with any other trust, for a taxation year of the other trust that ends in the beneficiary year, to be a qualified disability trust; and

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: subsection (2) does not apply to the trust for the trust year. (fiducie admissible pour personne handicapée)

Definition.Text: taxable SIFT trust distributions, of a SIFT trust for a taxation year, means the lesser of

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: its amount taxable for the taxation year, and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the amount determined by the formula

FormulaDefinition.Text: is its non-deductible distributions amount for the taxation year,
is the net corporate income tax rate in respect of the SIFT trust for the taxation year, and
is the provincial SIFT tax rate of the SIFT trust for the taxation year. (montant de distribution imposable)

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Subsection.Text: The following definitions apply in this section and in sections 104 and 122.

Definition.Text: eligible resale property, of an entity, means real or immovable property (other than capital property) of the entity

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: that is contiguous to a particular real or immovable property that is capital property or eligible resale property, held by

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the entity, or

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: another entity affiliated with the entity; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the holding of which is ancillary to the holding of the particular property. (bien de revente admissible)

Definition.Text: entity means a corporation, trust or partnership. (entité)
equity, of an entity, means

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: if the entity is a corporation, a share of the capital stock of the corporation;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: if the entity is a trust, an income or capital interest in the trust;

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: if the entity is a partnership, an interest as a member of the partnership;

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: a liability of the entity (and, for purposes of the definition publicly-traded liability in this section, a security of the entity that is a liability of another entity) if

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the liability is convertible into, or exchangeable for, equity of the entity or of another entity, or

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: any amount paid or payable in respect of the liability is contingent or dependent on the use of or production from property, or is computed by reference to revenue, profit, cash flow, commodity price or any other similar criterion or by reference to dividends paid or payable to shareholders of any class of shares of the capital stock of a corporation, or to income or capital paid or payable to any member of a partnership or beneficiary under a trust; and

Paragraph.Label: (e)
Paragraph.Text: a right to, or to acquire, anything described in this paragraph and any of paragraphs (a) to (d). (capitaux propres)

Definition.Text: equity value, of an entity at any time, means the total fair market value at that time of

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: if the entity is a corporation, all of the issued and outstanding shares of the capital stock of the corporation;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: if the entity is a trust, all of the income or capital interests in the trust; or

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: if the entity is a partnership, all of the interests in the partnership. (valeur des capitaux propres)

Definition.Text: excluded subsidiary entity, for a taxation year, means an entity none of the equity of which is at any time in the taxation year

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: listed or traded on a stock exchange or other public market; nor

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: held by any person or partnership other than

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: a real estate investment trust,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: a taxable Canadian corporation,

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: a SIFT trust (determined without reference to subsection (2)),

Subparagraph.Label: (iv)
Subparagraph.Text: a SIFT partnership (determined without reference to subsection 197(8)),

Subparagraph.Label: (v)
Subparagraph.Text: a person or partnership that does not have, in connection with the holding of a security of the entity, property the value of which is determined, all or in part, by reference to a security that is listed or traded on a stock exchange or other public market, or

Subparagraph.Label: (vi)
Subparagraph.Text: an excluded subsidiary entity for the taxation year. (filiale exclue)

Definition.Text: gross REIT revenue, of an entity for a taxation year, means the amount, if any, by which the total of all amounts received or receivable in the year (depending on the method regularly followed by the entity in computing the entity’s income) by the entity exceeds the total of all amounts each of which is the cost to the entity of a property disposed of in the year. (revenu brut de FPI)
investment, in a trust or partnership,

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: means

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: a property that is a security of the trust or partnership, or

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: a right which may reasonably be considered to replicate a return on, or the value of, a security of the trust or partnership; but

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: does not include

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: an unaffiliated publicly-traded liability of the trust or partnership, nor

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: regulated innovative capital. (placement)

Definition.Text: non-portfolio earnings, of a SIFT trust for a taxation year, means the total of

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the amount, if any, by which

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the total of all amounts each of which is the SIFT trust’s income for the taxation year from a business carried on by it in Canada or from a non-portfolio property, other than income that is a taxable dividend received by the SIFT trust,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the total of all amounts each of which is the SIFT trust’s loss for the taxation year from a business carried on by it in Canada or from a non-portfolio property, and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the amount, if any, by which

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the total of

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: all taxable capital gains of the SIFT trust from dispositions of non-portfolio properties during the taxation year, and

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: one-half of the total of all amounts each of which is deemed under subsection 131(1) to be a capital gain of the SIFT trust for the taxation year in respect of a non-portfolio property of the SIFT trust for the taxation year

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the total of the allowable capital losses of the SIFT trust for the taxation year from dispositions of non-portfolio properties during the taxation year. (gains hors portefeuille)

Definition.Text: non-portfolio property, of a particular entity for a taxation year, means a property, held by the particular entity at any time in the taxation year, that is

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: a security of a subject entity (other than a portfolio investment entity), if at that time the particular entity holds

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: securities of the subject entity that have a total fair market value that is greater than 10% of the equity value of the subject entity, or

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: securities of the subject entity that, together with all the securities that the particular entity holds of entities affiliated with the subject entity, have a total fair market value that is greater than 50% of the equity value of the particular entity;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: a Canadian real, immovable or resource property, if at any time in the taxation year the total fair market value of all properties held by the particular entity that are Canadian real, immovable or resource properties is greater than 50% of the equity value of the particular entity; or

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: a property that the particular entity, or a person or partnership with whom the particular entity does not deal at arm’s length, uses at that time in the course of carrying on a business in Canada. (bien hors portefeuille)

Definition.Text: portfolio investment entity at any time means an entity that does not at that time hold any non-portfolio property. (entité de placement de portefeuille)

publicly-traded liability, of an entity, means a liability that is a security of the entity, that is not equity of the entity and that is listed or traded on a stock exchange or other public market. (dette transigée publiquement)

public market includes any trading system or other organized facility on which securities that are qualified for public distribution are listed or traded, but does not include a facility that is operated solely to carry out the issuance of a security or its redemption, acquisition or cancellation by its issuer. (marché public)
qualified REIT property, of a trust at any time, means a property that, at that time, is held by the trust and is

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: a real or immovable property that is capital property, an eligible resale property, an indebtedness of a Canadian corporation represented by a bankers’ acceptance, a property described by paragraph (a) or (b) of the definition qualified investment in section 204 or a deposit with a credit union;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: a security of a subject entity all or substantially all of the gross REIT revenue of which, for its taxation year that ends in the trust’s taxation year that includes that time, is from maintaining, improving, leasing or managing real or immovable properties that are capital properties of the trust or of an entity of which the trust holds a share or an interest, including real or immovable properties that the trust, or an entity of which the trust holds a share or an interest, holds together with one or more other persons or partnerships;

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: a security of a subject entity, if the entity holds no property other than

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: legal title to real or immovable property of the trust or of another subject entity all of the securities of which are held by the trust (including real or immovable property that the trust or the other subject entity holds together with one or more other persons or partnerships), and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: property described in paragraph (d); or

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: ancillary to the earning by the trust of amounts described in subparagraphs (b)(i) and (iii) of the definition real estate investment trust, other than

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: an equity of an entity, or

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: a mortgage, hypothecary claim, mezzanine loan or similar obligation. (bien admissible de FPI)

Definition.Text: real estate investment trust, for a taxation year, means a trust that is resident in Canada throughout the taxation year, if

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: at each time in the taxation year the total fair market value at that time of all non-portfolio properties that are qualified REIT properties held by the trust is at least 90% of the total fair market value at that time of all non-portfolio properties held by the trust;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: not less than 90% of the trust’s gross REIT revenue for the taxation year is from one or more of the following:

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: rent from real or immovable properties,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: interest,

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: dispositions of real or immovable properties that are capital properties,

Subparagraph.Label: (iv)
Subparagraph.Text: dividends,

Subparagraph.Label: (v)
Subparagraph.Text: royalties, and

Subparagraph.Label: (vi)
Subparagraph.Text: dispositions of eligible resale properties;

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: not less than 75% of the trust’s gross REIT revenue for the taxation year is from one or more of the following:

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: rent from real or immovable properties,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: interest from mortgages, or hypothecs, on real or immovable properties, and

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: dispositions of real or immovable properties that are capital properties;

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: at each time in the taxation year an amount, that is equal to 75% or more of the equity value of the trust at that time, is the amount that is the total fair market value of all properties held by the trust each of which is a real or immovable property that is capital property, an eligible resale property, an indebtedness of a Canadian corporation represented by a bankers’ acceptance, a property described by paragraph (a) or (b) of the definition qualified investment in section 204 or a deposit with a credit union; and

Paragraph.Label: (e)
Paragraph.Text: investments in the trust are, at any time in the taxation year, listed or traded on a stock exchange or other public market. (fiducie de placement immobilier)

Definition.Text: real or immovable property, of a taxpayer,

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: includes

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: a security held by the taxpayer, if the security is a security of a trust that satisfies (or of any other entity that would, if it were a trust, satisfy) the conditions set out in paragraphs (a) to (d) of the definition real estate investment trust, or

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: an interest in real property or a real right in immovables (other than a right to a rental or royalty described in paragraph (d) or (e) of the definition “Canadian resource property” in subsection 66(15)); but

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: does not include any depreciable property, other than

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: a property included, otherwise than by an election permitted by regulation, in Class 1, 3 or 31 of Schedule II to the Income Tax Regulations,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: a property ancillary to the ownership or utilization of a property described in subparagraph (i), or

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: a lease in, or a leasehold interest in respect of, land or property described in subparagraph (i). (bien immeuble ou réel)

Definition.Text: regulated innovative capital means equity of a trust, where

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: since November 2006, the equity has been authorized, by the Superintendent of Financial Institutions or by a provincial regulatory authority having powers similar to those of the Superintendent, as Tier 1 or Tier 2 capital of a financial institution (as defined by subsection 181(1));

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the terms and conditions of the equity have not changed after August 1, 2008;

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: the trust has not issued any equity after October 31, 2006; and

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: the trust does not hold any non-portfolio property other than

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: liabilities of the financial institution, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: shares of the capital stock of the financial institution that were acquired by the trust for the sole purpose of satisfying a right to require the trust to accept, as demanded by a holder of the equity, the surrender of the equity. (capital innovateur réglementé)

Text.DefinedTermEn: rent from real or immovable properties

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: includes

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: rent or similar payments for the use of, or right to use, real or immovable properties, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: payment for services ancillary to the rental of real or immovable properties and customarily supplied or rendered in connection with the rental of real or immovable properties; but

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: does not include

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: payment for services supplied or rendered, other than those described in subparagraph (a)(ii), to the tenants of such properties,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: fees for managing or operating such properties,

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: payment for the occupation of, use of, or right to use a room in a hotel or other similar lodging facility, or

Subparagraph.Label: (iv)
Subparagraph.Text: rent based on profits. (loyer de biens immeubles ou réels)

Definition.Text: security of a particular entity means any right, whether absolute or contingent, conferred by the particular entity or by an entity that is affiliated with the particular entity, to receive, either immediately or in the future, an amount that can reasonably be regarded as all or any part of the capital, of the revenue or of the income of the particular entity, or as interest paid or payable by the particular entity, and for greater certainty includes

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: a liability of the particular entity;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: if the particular entity is a corporation,

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: a share of the capital stock of the corporation, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: a right to control in any manner whatever the voting rights of a share of the capital stock of the corporation;

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: if the particular entity is a trust, an income or a capital interest in the trust;

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: if the particular entity is a partnership, an interest as a member of the partnership; and

Paragraph.Label: (e)
Paragraph.Text: a right to, or to acquire, anything described in this paragraph and any of paragraphs (a) to (d). (titre)

Definition.Text: SIFT trust, being a specified investment flow-through trust, for a taxation year means a trust (other than an excluded subsidiary entity, or a real estate investment trust, for the taxation year) that meets the following conditions at any time during the taxation year:

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the trust is resident in Canada;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: investments in the trust are listed or traded on a stock exchange or other public market; and

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: the trust holds one or more non-portfolio properties. (fiducie intermédiaire de placement déterminée)

Definition.Text: subject entity means a person or partnership that is

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: a corporation resident in Canada;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: a trust resident in Canada;

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: a Canadian resident partnership; or

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: a non-resident person, or a partnership that is not described in paragraph (c), the principal source of income of which is one or any combination of sources in Canada. (entité déterminée)

Definition.Text: unaffiliated publicly-traded liability, of an entity at any time means a publicly-traded liability of the entity if, at that time the total fair market value of all publicly-traded liabilities of the entity that are held at that time by persons or partnerships that are not affiliated with the entity is at least 90% of the total fair market value of all publicly-traded liabilities of the entity. (dette non affiliée transigée publiquement)

Subsection.Text: Subsection (1.2) applies to an entity for a taxation year in respect of an amount and another entity (referred to in this subsection and subsection (1.2) as the “parent entity”, “specified amount” and “source entity”, respectively), if

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: at any time in the taxation year the parent entity

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: is affiliated with the source entity, or

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: holds securities of the source entity that

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: are described by any of paragraphs (a) to (c) of the definition equity in subsection (1), and

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: have a total fair market value that is greater than 10% of the equity value of the source entity;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the specified amount is included in computing the parent entity’s gross REIT revenue for the taxation year in respect of a security of the source entity held by the parent entity; and

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: in the case of a source entity that is a subject entity described in paragraph (b) of the definition qualified REIT property in subsection (1) in respect of the parent entity at each time during the taxation year at which the parent entity holds securities of the source entity, the specified amount cannot reasonably be considered to be derived from the source entity’s gross REIT revenue from maintaining, improving, leasing or managing real or immovable properties that are capital properties of the parent entity or of an entity of which the parent entity holds a share or an interest, including real or immovable properties that the parent entity, or an entity of which the parent entity holds a share or an interest, holds together with one or more other persons or partnerships.

Subsection.Text: If this subsection applies to a parent entity for a taxation year in respect of a specified amount and a source entity, then for the purposes of the definition real estate investment trust in subsection (1), to the extent that the specified amount can reasonably be considered to be derived from gross REIT revenue of the source entity having a particular character, the specified amount is deemed to be gross REIT revenue of the parent entity having the same character and not having any other character.
For the purposes of the definition real estate investment trust in subsection (1),

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: if an amount is included in gross REIT revenue of a trust for a taxation year and it results from an agreement that can reasonably be considered to have been made by the trust to reduce its risk from fluctuations in interest rates in respect of debt incurred by the trust to acquire or refinance real or immovable property, the amount is deemed to have the same character as gross REIT revenue in respect of the real or immovable property and not any other character; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: if a real or immovable property is situated in a country other than Canada and an amount included in gross REIT revenue of a trust for a taxation year

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: is a gain from fluctuations in the value of the currency of that country relative to Canadian currency recognized on

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: revenue in respect of the real or immovable property, or

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: debt incurred by the trust for the purpose of earning revenue in respect of the real or immovable property, or

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: results from an agreement that

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: provides for the purchase, sale or exchange of currency, and

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: can reasonably be considered to have been made by the trust to reduce its risk from currency fluctuations described in subparagraph (i),

ContinuedParagraph.Text: the amount is deemed to have the same character as gross REIT revenue in respect of the real or immovable property and not any other character.

Subsection.Text: The definition SIFT trust applies to a trust for a taxation year of the trust that ends after 2006, except that if the trust would have been a SIFT trust on October 31, 2006 had that definition been in force and applied to the trust as of that date, that definition does not apply to the trust for a taxation year of the trust that ends before the earlier of

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the first day after December 15, 2006 on which the trust exceeds normal growth as determined by reference to the normal growth guidelines issued by the Department of Finance on December 15, 2006, as amended from time to time, unless that excess arose as a result of a prescribed transaction.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]
[NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Subsection.Text: If an individual is resident in Canada in a taxation year and, throughout any period of more than six consecutive months that began before the end of the year and included any part of the year (in this section referred to as the “qualifying period”)

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: was employed by a person who was a specified employer, other than for the performance of services under a prescribed international development assistance program of the Government of Canada, and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: performed all or substantially all the duties of the individual’s employment outside Canada

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: in connection with a contract under which the specified employer carried on business outside Canada with respect to

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: the exploration for or exploitation of petroleum, natural gas, minerals or other similar resources,

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: any construction, installation, agricultural or engineering activity, or

Clause.Label: (C)
Clause.Text: any prescribed activity, or

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: for the purpose of obtaining, on behalf of the specified employer, a contract to undertake any of the activities referred to in clause 122.3(1)(b)(i)(A), 122.3(1)(b)(i)(B) or 122.3(1)(b)(i)(C),

ContinuedSectionSubsection.Text: there may be deducted, from the amount that would, but for this section, be the individual’s tax payable under this Part for the year, an amount equal to that proportion of the tax otherwise payable under this Part for the year by the individual that the lesser of

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: an amount equal to that proportion of the specified amount for the year that the number of days

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: in that portion of the qualifying period that is in the year, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: on which the individual was resident in Canada

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: the specified percentage for the year of the individual’s income for the year from that employment that is reasonably attributable to duties performed on the days referred to in paragraph (c)

ContinuedSectionSubsection.Text: is of

Paragraph.Label: (e)
Paragraph.Text: the amount, if any, by which

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: if the individual is resident in Canada throughout the year, the individual’s income for the year, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: if the individual is non-resident at any time in the year, the amount determined under paragraph 114(a) in respect of the taxpayer for the year

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: the total of all amounts each of which is an amount deducted under section 110.6 or paragraph 111(1)(b), or deductible under paragraph 110(1)(d.2), (d.3), (f) or (g), in computing the individual’s taxable income for the year.

Subsection.Text: For the purposes of paragraph (1)(c), the specified amount for a taxation year of an individual is

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: for the 2013 to 2015 taxation years, the amount determined by the formula

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the individual’s income described in paragraph (1)(d) for the taxation year that is earned in connection with a contract that was committed to in writing before March 29, 2012 by a specified employer of the individual,
is the individual’s income described in paragraph (1)(d) for the taxation year, other than income included in the description of A, and
is

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: for the 2013 taxation year, $60,000,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: for the 2014 taxation year, $40,000, and

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: for the 2015 taxation year, $20,000; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: for the 2016 and subsequent taxation years, nil.

Subsection.Text: For the purposes of paragraph (1)(d), the specified percentage for a taxation year of an individual is

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: for the 2013 to 2015 taxation years, the amount determined by the formula

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the value of A in subsection (1.01),
is the value of B in subsection (1.01), and
is

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: for the 2013 taxation year, 60%,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: for the 2014 taxation year, 40%, and

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: for the 2015 taxation year, 20%; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: for the 2016 and subsequent taxation years, 0%.

Subsection.Text: No amount may be included under paragraph (1)(d) in respect of an individual’s income for a taxation year from the individual’s employment by an employer

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: if

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the employer carries on a business of providing services and does not employ in the business throughout the year more than five full-time employees,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the individual

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: does not deal at arm’s length with the employer, or is a specified shareholder of the employer, or

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: where the employer is a partnership, does not deal at arm’s length with a member of the partnership, or is a specified shareholder of a member of the partnership, and

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: but for the existence of the employer, the individual would reasonably be regarded as being an employee of a person or partnership that is not a specified employer; or

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: if at any time in that portion of the qualifying period that is in the taxation year

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the employer provides the services of the individual to a corporation, partnership or trust with which the employer does not deal at arm’s length, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the fair market value of all the issued shares of the capital stock of the corporation or of all interests in the partnership or trust, as the case may be, that are held, directly or indirectly, by persons who are resident in Canada is less than 10% of the fair market value of all those shares or interests.

Subsection.Text: In subsection 122.3(1),

Definition.Text: specified employer means

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: a person resident in Canada,

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: a partnership in which interests that exceed in total value 10% of the fair market value of all interests in the partnership are owned by persons resident in Canada or corporations controlled by persons resident in Canada, or

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: a corporation that is a foreign affiliate of a person resident in Canada; (employeur déterminé)

Definition.Text: tax otherwise payable under this Part for the year means the amount that, but for this section, sections 120 and 120.2, subsection 120.4(2) and sections 121, 126, 127 and 127.4, would be the tax payable under this Part for the year. (impôt qu’il est par ailleurs tenu de payer pour l’année en vertu de la présente partie)

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Subsection.Text: The following definitions apply in this section.

Definition.Text: adjusted income, of an individual for a taxation year in relation to a month specified for the taxation year, means the total of the individual’s income for the taxation year and the income for the taxation year of the individual’s qualified relation, if any, in relation to the specified month, both calculated as if in computing that income no amount were

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: included

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: under paragraph 56(1)(q.1) or subsection 56(6),

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: in respect of any gain from a disposition of property to which section 79 applies, or

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: in respect of a gain described in subsection 40(3.21); or

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: deductible under paragraph 20(1)(ww) or 60(y) or (z). (revenu rajusté)

Definition.Text: cohabiting spouse or common-law partner of an individual at any time has the meaning assigned by section 122.6. (époux ou conjoint de fait visé)
eligible individual, in relation to a month specified for a taxation year, means an individual (other than a trust) who

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: has, before the specified month, attained the age of 19 years; or

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: was, at any time before the specified month,

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: a parent who resided with their child, or

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: married or in a common-law partnership. (particulier admissible)

Definition.Text: qualified dependant of an individual, in relation to a month specified for a taxation year, means a person who at the beginning of the specified month

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: is the individual’s child or is dependent for support on the individual or on the individual’s cohabiting spouse or common-law partner;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: resides with the individual;

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: is under the age of 19 years;

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: is not an eligible individual in relation to the specified month; and

Paragraph.Label: (e)
Paragraph.Text: is not a qualified relation of any individual in relation to the specified month. (personne à charge admissible)

Subsection.MarginalNote: Persons not eligible individuals, qualified relations or qualified dependants
Subsection.Text: Notwithstanding subsection (1), a person is not an eligible individual, is not a qualified relation and is not a qualified dependant, in relation to a month specified for a taxation year, if the person

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: died before the specified month;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: is confined to a prison or similar institution for a period of at least 90 days that includes the first day of the specified month;

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: is at the beginning of the specified month a non-resident person, other than a non-resident person who

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: is at that time the cohabiting spouse or common-law partner of a person who is deemed under subsection 250(1) to be resident in Canada throughout the taxation year that includes the first day of the specified month, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: was resident in Canada at any time before the specified month;

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: is at the beginning of the specified month a person described in paragraph 149(1)(a) or (b); or

Paragraph.Label: (e)
Paragraph.Text: is a person in respect of whom a special allowance under the Children’s Special Allowances Act is payable for the specified month.

Subsection.Text: Subsection (3.2) applies in respect of an eligible individual in relation to a particular month specified for a taxation year, and each subsequent month specified for the taxation year, if

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the amount deemed by that subsection to have been paid by the eligible individual during the particular month specified for the taxation year is less than $50; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: it is reasonable to conclude that the amount deemed by that subsection to have been paid by the eligible individual during each subsequent month specified for the taxation year will be less than $50.

Subsection.Text: If this subsection applies, the total of the amounts that would otherwise be deemed by subsections (3) and (3.005) to have been paid on account of the eligible individual’s tax payable under this Part for the taxation year during the particular month specified for the taxation year, and during each subsequent month specified for the taxation year, is deemed to have been paid by the eligible individual on account of their tax payable under this Part for the taxation year during the particular specified month for the taxation year, and the amount deemed by subsections (3) and (3.005) to have been paid by the eligible individual during those subsequent months specified for the taxation year is deemed, except for the purpose of this subsection, not to have been paid to the extent that it is included in an amount deemed to have been paid by this subsection.

For the purposes of this section, the months specified for a taxation year are July and October of the immediately following taxation year and January and April of the second immediately following taxation year.

Notwithstanding subsection (4) and for the purposes of this section, the month specified in subsection (3.001) is May 2020 (or an earlier month designated by the Minister) and the taxation year is the 2018 taxation year.
Notwithstanding subsection (4) and for the purposes of this section, the month specified in subsection (3.002) is October 2022 and the taxation year is the 2021 taxation year.
Notwithstanding subsection (4) and for the purposes of this section, the month specified in subsection (3.003) is January 2023 and the taxation year is the 2021 taxation year.
Notwithstanding subsection (4) and for the purposes of this section, the month specified in subsection (3.004) is January 2026 and the taxation year is the 2024 taxation year.

Notwithstanding subsection (4) and for the purposes of this section, the months specified in subsection (3.005) are July 2026, October 2026, January 2027, April 2027, July 2027, October 2027, January 2028, April 2028, July 2028, October 2028, January 2029, April 2029, July 2029, October 2029, January 2030, April 2030, July 2030, October 2030, January 2031 and April 2031, and if the month specified is July or October, the taxation year for the month specified is the immediately preceding taxation year and if the month specified is January or April, the taxation year for the month specified is the second preceding taxation year.

Subsection.MarginalNote: Subsection (3) does not apply — month specified
Subsection.Text: Notwithstanding subsection (3), the amount that an eligible individual in relation to a month specified in subsection (4.5) is deemed to have paid during the specified month on account of their tax payable under this Part for the taxation year under subsection (3) is deemed to be nil for that specified month.

If an individual is a qualified relation of another individual in relation to a month specified for a taxation year and both those individuals would be, but for this subsection, eligible individuals in relation to the specified month, only the individual that the Minister designates is the eligible individual in relation to the specified month.
If a person would, if this Act were read without reference to this subsection, be the qualified dependant of two or more individuals, in relation to a month specified for a taxation year,

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the person is deemed to be a qualified dependant, in relation to that month, of the one of those individuals on whom those individuals agree;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: in the absence of an agreement referred to in paragraph (a), the person is deemed to be, in relation to that month, a qualified dependant of the individuals, if any, who are, at the beginning of that month, eligible individuals (within the meaning assigned by section 122.6, but with the words qualified dependant in that section having the meaning assigned by subsection (1)) in respect of that person; and

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: in any other case, the person is deemed to be, in relation to that month, a qualified dependant only of the individual that the Minister designates.

Subsection.Text: An individual shall notify the Minister of the occurrence of any of the following events before the end of the month following the month in which the event occurs:

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the individual ceases to be an eligible individual;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: a person becomes or ceases to be the individual’s qualified relation; and

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: a person ceases to be a qualified dependant of the individual, otherwise than because of attaining the age of 19 years.

Subsection.Text: For the purpose of this section, the income of a person who is non-resident at any time in a taxation year is deemed to be equal to the amount that would, if the person were resident in Canada throughout the year, be the person’s income for the year.

For the purpose of this section, if in a taxation year an individual becomes bankrupt, the individual’s income for the taxation year shall include the individual’s income for the taxation year that begins on January 1 of the calendar year that includes the date of bankruptcy.

Section.Text: In this Subdivision,

Definition.Text: adjusted income, of an individual for a taxation year, means the total of all amounts each of which would be the income for the year of the individual or of the person who was the individual’s cohabiting spouse or common-law partner at the end of the year if in computing that income no amount were

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: included

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: under paragraph 56(1)(q.1) or subsection 56(6),

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: in respect of any gain from a disposition of property to which section 79 applies, or

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: in respect of a gain described in subsection 40(3.21), or

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: deductible under paragraph 20(1)(ww) or 60(y) or (z); (revenu modifié)

Definition.Text: base taxation year in relation to a month means

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: where the month is any of the first 6 months of a calendar year, the taxation year that ended on December 31 of the second preceding calendar year, and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: where the month is any of the last 6 months of a calendar year, the taxation year that ended on December 31 of the preceding calendar year; (année de base)

Definition.Text: cohabiting spouse or common-law partner of an individual at any time means the person who at that time is the individual’s spouse or common-law partner and who is not at that time living separate and apart from the individual and, for the purpose of this definition, a person shall not be considered to be living separate and apart from an individual at any time unless they were living separate and apart at that time, because of a breakdown of their marriage or common-law partnership, for a period of at least 90 days that includes that time; (époux ou conjoint de fait visé)
eligible individual in respect of a qualified dependant at any time means a person who at that time

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: resides with the qualified dependant,

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: is a parent of the qualified dependant who

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: is the parent who primarily fulfils the responsibility for the care and upbringing of the qualified dependant and who is not a shared-custody parent in respect of the qualified dependant, or

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: is a shared-custody parent in respect of the qualified dependant,

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: is resident in Canada or, where the person is the cohabiting spouse or common-law partner of a person who is deemed under subsection 250(1) to be resident in Canada throughout the taxation year that includes that time, was resident in Canada in any preceding taxation year,

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: is not described in paragraph 149(1)(a) or 149(1)(b), and

Paragraph.Label: (e)
Paragraph.Text: is, or whose cohabiting spouse or common-law partner is, a Canadian citizen or a person who

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: is a permanent resident within the meaning of subsection 2(1) of the Immigration and Refugee Protection Act,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: is a temporary resident within the meaning of the Immigration and Refugee Protection Act, who was resident in Canada throughout the 18 month period preceding that time,

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: is a protected person within the meaning of the Immigration and Refugee Protection Act,

Subparagraph.Label: (iv)
Subparagraph.Text: was determined before that time to be a member of a class defined in the Humanitarian Designated Classes Regulations made under the Immigration Act, or

Subparagraph.Label: (v)
Subparagraph.Text: is an Indian within the meaning of the Indian Act,

ContinuedDefinition.Text: and for the purposes of this definition,

Paragraph.Label: (f)
Paragraph.Text: where the qualified dependant resides with the dependant’s female parent, the parent who primarily fulfils the responsibility for the care and upbringing of the qualified dependant is presumed to be the female parent,

Paragraph.Label: (g)
Paragraph.Text: the presumption referred to in paragraph 122.6 eligible individual (f) does not apply in prescribed circumstances,

Paragraph.Label: (h)
Paragraph.Text: prescribed factors shall be considered in determining what constitutes care and upbringing, and

Paragraph.Label: (i)
Paragraph.Text: an individual shall not fail to qualify as a parent (within the meaning assigned by section 252) of another individual solely because of the receipt of a social assistance amount that is payable under a program of the Government of Canada, the government of a province or an Indigenous governing body (as defined in section 2 of the Children’s Special Allowances Act) for the benefit of the other individual; (particulier admissible)

Definition.Text: qualified dependant at any time means a person who at that time

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: has not attained the age of 18 years,

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: is not a person in respect of whom an amount was deducted under paragraph (a) of the description of B in subsection 118(1) in computing the tax payable under this Part by the person’s spouse or common-law partner for the base taxation year in relation to the month that includes that time, and

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: is not a person in respect of whom a special allowance under the Children’s Special Allowances Act is payable for the month that includes that time; (personne à charge admissible)

Definition.Text: return of income filed by an individual for a taxation year means

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: where the individual was resident in Canada throughout the year, the individual’s return of income (other than a return of income filed under subsection 70(2) or 104(23), paragraph 128(2)(e) or subsection 150(4)) that is filed or required to be filed under this Part for the year, and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: in any other case, a prescribed form containing prescribed information, that is filed with the Minister; (déclaration de revenu)

Definition.Text: shared-custody parent in respect of a qualified dependant at a particular time means, where the presumption referred to in paragraph (f) of the definition eligible individual does not apply in respect of the qualified dependant, an individual who is one of the two parents of the qualified dependant who

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: are not at that time cohabiting spouses or common-law partners of each other,

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: reside with the qualified dependant either

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: at least 40% of the time in the month in which the particular time occurs, or

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: on an approximately equal basis, and

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: primarily fulfil the responsibility for the care and upbringing of the qualified dependant when residing with the qualified dependant, as determined in consideration of prescribed factors. (parent ayant la garde partagée)

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Subsection.Text: If a person and, if the Minister so demands, the person’s cohabiting spouse or common-law partner at the end of a taxation year have filed a return of income for the year, an overpayment on account of the person’s liability under this Part for the year is deemed to have arisen during a month in relation to which the year is the base taxation year, equal to the amount determined by the formula

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the amount determined by the formula
is the total of

FormulaParagraph.Label: (a)
FormulaParagraph.Text: the product obtained by multiplying $6,400 by the number of qualified dependants in respect of whom the person was an eligible individual at the beginning of the month who have not reached the age of six years at the beginning of the month, and

FormulaParagraph.Label: (b)
FormulaParagraph.Text: the product obtained by multiplying $5,400 by the number of qualified dependants, other than those qualified dependants referred to in paragraph (a), in respect of whom the person was an eligible individual at the beginning of the month, and

FormulaDefinition.Text: is

FormulaParagraph.Label: (a)
FormulaParagraph.Text: if the person’s adjusted income for the year is less than or equal to $30,000, nil,

FormulaParagraph.Label: (b)
FormulaParagraph.Text: if the person’s adjusted income for the year is greater than $30,000 but less than or equal to $65,000, and if the person is, at the beginning of the month, an eligible individual in respect of

FormulaParagraph.Label: (i)
FormulaParagraph.Text: only one qualified dependant, 7% of the person’s adjusted income for the year in excess of $30,000,

FormulaParagraph.Label: (ii)
FormulaParagraph.Text: only two qualified dependants, 13.5% of the person’s adjusted income for the year in excess of $30,000,

FormulaParagraph.Label: (iii)
FormulaParagraph.Text: only three qualified dependants, 19% of the person’s adjusted income for the year in excess of $30,000, or

FormulaParagraph.Label: (iv)
FormulaParagraph.Text: more than three qualified dependants, 23% of the person’s adjusted income for the year in excess of $30,000, and

FormulaParagraph.Label: (c)
FormulaParagraph.Text: if the person’s adjusted income for the year is greater than $65,000, and if the person is, at the beginning of the month, an eligible individual in respect of

FormulaParagraph.Label: (i)
FormulaParagraph.Text: only one qualified dependant, the total of $2,450 and 3.2% of the person’s adjusted income for the year in excess of $65,000,

FormulaParagraph.Label: (ii)
FormulaParagraph.Text: only two qualified dependants, the total of $4,725 and 5.7% of the person’s adjusted income for the year in excess of $65,000,

FormulaParagraph.Label: (iii)
FormulaParagraph.Text: only three qualified dependants, the total of $6,650 and 8% of the person’s adjusted income for the year in excess of $65,000, or

FormulaParagraph.Label: (iv)
FormulaParagraph.Text: more than three qualified dependants, the total of $8,050 and 9.5% of the person’s adjusted income for the year in excess of $65,000,

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the amount determined by the formula
is the product obtained by multiplying $2,730 by the number of qualified dependants in respect of whom both

FormulaParagraph.Label: (a)
FormulaParagraph.Text: an amount may be deducted under section 118.3 for the taxation year that includes the month, and

FormulaParagraph.Label: (b)
FormulaParagraph.Text: the person is an eligible individual at the beginning of the month, and

FormulaDefinition.Text: is

FormulaParagraph.Label: (a)
FormulaParagraph.Text: if the person’s adjusted income for the year is less than or equal to $65,000, nil, and

FormulaParagraph.Label: (b)
FormulaParagraph.Text: if the person’s adjusted income for the year is greater than $65,000,

FormulaParagraph.Label: (i)
FormulaParagraph.Text: where the person is an eligible individual in respect of only one qualified dependant described in N, 3.2% of the person’s adjusted income for the year in excess of $65,000, and

FormulaParagraph.Label: (ii)
FormulaParagraph.Text: where the person is an eligible individual in respect of two or more qualified dependants described in N, 5.7% of the person’s adjusted income for the year in excess of $65,000.

Subsection.Text: If the month referred to in subsection (1) is May 2020, each amount expressed in dollars referred to in paragraphs (a) and (b) of the description of E in subsection (1) is deemed, for that month, to be equal to that amount (as adjusted under subsection (5)) plus an additional amount of $3,600. For greater certainty, the adjustment in subsection (5) shall not take into account this additional amount.

Notwithstanding subsection (1), if an eligible individual is a shared-custody parent in respect of one or more qualified dependants at the beginning of a month, the overpayment deemed by subsection (1) to have arisen during the month is equal to the amount determined by the formula

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the amount determined by the formula in subsection (1), calculated without reference to this subsection, and
is the amount determined by the formula in subsection (1), calculated without reference to this subsection and subparagraph (b)(ii) of the definition eligible individual in section 122.6.

Subsection.Text: If the Minister determines before 2024 that an overpayment (for greater certainty, in an amount greater than nil) on account of a person’s liability under this Part for a taxation year is deemed to have arisen during a month under subsection (1), or would be so deemed if this section were read without reference to subsection (2), then an overpayment on account of the person’s liability under this Part for the year is deemed to have arisen during the month, equal to the total of all amounts each of which is an amount in respect of a qualified dependant — in respect of whom the person was an eligible individual at the beginning of the month who has not reached the age of six years at the beginning of the month — determined by the formula

FormulaDefinition.Text: is

FormulaParagraph.Label: (a)
FormulaParagraph.Text: 0.5, if the person is a shared-custody parent in respect of the qualified dependant, and

FormulaParagraph.Label: (b)
FormulaParagraph.Text: 1, in any other case; and

FormulaDefinition.Text: is

FormulaParagraph.Label: (a)
FormulaParagraph.Text: if the month is January 2021 or April 2021,

FormulaParagraph.Label: (i)
FormulaParagraph.Text: $300, if the person’s adjusted income for 2019 is less than or equal to $120,000, and

FormulaParagraph.Label: (ii)
FormulaParagraph.Text: $150 in any other case,

FormulaParagraph.Label: (b)
FormulaParagraph.Text: if the month is July 2021 or October 2021,

FormulaParagraph.Label: (i)
FormulaParagraph.Text: $300, if the person’s adjusted income for 2020 is less than or equal to $120,000, and

FormulaParagraph.Label: (ii)
FormulaParagraph.Text: $150 in any other case, and

FormulaParagraph.Label: (c)
FormulaParagraph.Text: in any other case, nil.

Subsection.Text: Notwithstanding subsection (1), if a particular month is the first month during which an overpayment that is less than $20 (or such other amount as is prescribed) is deemed under that subsection to have arisen on account of a person’s liability under this Part for the base taxation year in relation to the particular month, any such overpayment that would, but for this subsection, reasonably be expected at the end of the particular month to arise during another month in relation to which the year is the base taxation year is deemed to arise under that subsection during the particular month and not during the other month.

For the purposes of this section, if a person was non-resident at any time in a taxation year, the person’s income for the year is, for greater certainty, deemed to be the amount that would have been the person’s income for the year had the person been resident in Canada throughout the year.
For the purposes of this Subdivision, where in a taxation year an individual becomes bankrupt,

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the individual’s income for the year shall include the individual’s income for the taxation year that begins on January 1 of the calendar year that includes the date of bankruptcy; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the total of all amounts deducted under section 63 in computing the individual’s income for the year shall include the amount deducted under that section for the individual’s taxation year that begins on January 1 of the calendar year that includes the date of bankruptcy.

Subsection.MarginalNote: Amount not to be charged, etc.
Subsection.Text: A refund of an amount deemed by this section to be an overpayment on account of a person’s liability under this Part for a taxation year

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: shall not be subject to the operation of any law relating to bankruptcy or insolvency;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: cannot be assigned, charged, attached or given as security;

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: does not qualify as a refund of tax for the purposes of the Tax Rebate Discounting Act;

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: cannot be retained by way of deduction or set-off under the Financial Administration Act; and

Paragraph.Label: (e)
Paragraph.Text: is not garnishable moneys for the purposes of the Family Orders and Agreements Enforcement Assistance Act.

Subsection.Text: Each amount expressed in dollars in subsection (1) shall be adjusted so that, where the base taxation year in relation to a particular month is after 2016, the amount to be used under that subsection for the month is the total of

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the amount that would, but for subsection (7), be the relevant amount used under subsection (1) for the month that is one year before the particular month, and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the product obtained by multiplying

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the amount referred to in paragraph (a)

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the amount, adjusted in such manner as is prescribed and rounded to the nearest one-thousandth or, where the result obtained is equidistant from 2 such consecutive one-thousandths, to the higher thereof, that is determined by the formula

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the Consumer Price Index (within the meaning assigned by subsection 117.1(4)) for the 12-month period that ended on September 30 of the base taxation year, and
is the Consumer Price Index for the 12 month period preceding the period referred to in the description of A.

Subsection.MarginalNote: Additions to NCB supplement — July 2005 and 2006
Subsection.Text: Each amount referred to in the description of F in subsection (1) that is to be used for the purpose of determining the amount deemed to be an overpayment arising during months that are

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: after June 2005 and before July 2006, is to be replaced with the amount that is the total of $185 and the amount otherwise determined under subsection (5) for those months; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: after June 2006 and before July 2007, is to be replaced with the amount that is the total of $185 and the amount otherwise determined, for those months, by applying subsection (5) to the amount determined under paragraph (a).

Subsection.Text: Notwithstanding subsection (5), for the purposes of any agreement referred to in section 122.63 with respect to overpayments deemed to arise during months that are after June 2001 and before July 2002, the amount determined under subparagraph (5)(b)(ii) for a month referred to in paragraph (6)(b) is deemed to be 0.012.

If an amount referred to in subsection (1), when adjusted as provided in subsection (5), is not a multiple of one dollar, it shall be rounded to the nearest multiple of one dollar or, where it is equidistant from 2 such consecutive multiples, to the higher thereof.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]
