Subsection.Text: For the purposes of this Subdivision, a person may be considered to be an eligible individual in respect of a particular qualified dependant at the beginning of a month only if the person has, no later than 11 months after the end of the month, filed with the Minister a notice in prescribed form containing prescribed information.
The Minister may, on or before the day that is 10 years after the beginning of the month referred to in subsection (1), extend the time for filing a notice under that subsection.

Where at the beginning of 1993 a person is an eligible individual in respect of a qualified dependant, subsection 122.62(1) does not apply to the person in respect of the qualified dependant if the qualified dependant was an eligible child (within the meaning assigned by subsection 122.2(2) because of subparagraph (a)(i) of the definition eligible child in that subsection) of the individual for the 1992 taxation year.

Subsection.MarginalNote: Person ceasing to be an eligible individual
Subsection.Text: Where during a particular month a person ceases to be an eligible individual in respect of a particular qualified dependant (otherwise than because of the qualified dependant attaining the age of 18 years), the person shall notify the Minister of that fact before the end of the first month following the particular month.
If the cohabiting spouse or common-law partner of an eligible individual in respect of a qualified dependant dies,

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the eligible individual shall notify the Minister in prescribed form of that event before the end of the first calendar month that begins after that event; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: subject to subsection (8), for the purpose of determining the amount deemed under subsection 122.61(1) or (1.2) to be an overpayment arising in that first month and any subsequent month on account of the eligible individual’s liability under this Part for the base taxation year in relation to that first month, the eligible individual’s adjusted income for the year is deemed to be equal to the eligible individual’s income for the year.

Subsection.Text: If a person ceases to be an eligible individual’s cohabiting spouse or common-law partner,

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the eligible individual shall notify the Minister in prescribed form of that event before the end of the first calendar month that begins after that event; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: subject to subsection (8), for the purpose of determining the amount deemed under subsection 122.61(1) or (1.2) to be an overpayment arising in that first month and any subsequent month on account of the eligible individual’s liability under this Part for the base taxation year in relation to that first month, the eligible individual’s adjusted income for the year is deemed to be equal to the eligible individual’s income for the year.

Subsection.Text: If a taxpayer becomes the cohabiting spouse or common-law partner of an eligible individual,

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the eligible individual shall notify the Minister in prescribed form of that event before the end of the first calendar month that begins after that event; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: subject to subsection (8), for the purpose of determining the amount deemed under subsection 122.61(1) or (1.2) to be an overpayment arising in that first month and any subsequent month on account of the eligible individual’s liability under this Part for the base taxation year in relation to that first month, the taxpayer is deemed to have been the eligible individual’s cohabiting spouse or common-law partner at the end of the base taxation year in relation to that month.

Subsection.Text: If more than one event referred to in subsections (5) to (7) occur in a calendar month, only the subsection relating to the last of those events to have occurred applies.
For the purposes of this Subdivision (other than subsection (4)), a person is deemed to be a qualified dependant at the beginning of a month if

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the person died in any of the six preceding months;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the person’s date of birth was not 18 years or more prior to the beginning of the month; and

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: the person was a qualified dependant immediately prior to their death.

Subsection.Text: For the purposes of this Subdivision (other than subsection (4)), a person is deemed to be an eligible individual in respect of a qualified dependant at the beginning of a month if

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: that qualified dependant is a qualified dependant at the beginning of that month because of subsection (9);

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the person was an eligible individual in respect of the qualified dependant immediately before the qualified dependant’s death; and

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: at the beginning of the month, the person satisfied the conditions set out in paragraphs (c) to (e) of the definition eligible individual in section 122.6.

Subsection.Text: For the purposes of paragraphs (a) and (b) of the description of E in subsection 122.61(1), if a person is deemed to be a qualified dependant at the beginning of a month because of subsection (9), the person is deemed to be the age at the beginning of that month that the person would have been at the beginning of that month had the person not died.

Subsection.MarginalNote: Death of child — disability tax credit
Subsection.Text: For the purposes of paragraph (a) of the description of N in subsection 122.61(1), if a person died on or after July 1 of a particular taxation year and an amount could have been deducted in respect of that person under section 118.3 for that taxation year, an amount is deemed to be deductible under section 118.3 in respect of that person for the immediately following taxation year.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Subsection.Text: The Minister of Finance may enter into an agreement with the government of a province whereby the amounts determined under the description of E in subsection 122.61(1) with respect to persons resident in the province shall, for the purpose of calculating overpayments deemed to arise under that subsection, be replaced by amounts determined in accordance with the agreement.

The amounts determined under the description of E in subsection 122.61(1) for a base taxation year because of any agreement entered into with a province and referred to in subsection (1) shall be based on the age of qualified dependants of eligible individuals, or on the number of such qualified dependants, or both, and shall result in an amount in respect of a qualified dependant that is not less, in respect of that qualified dependant, than 85% of the amount that would otherwise be determined under that description in respect of that qualified dependant for that year.

Any agreement entered into with a province and referred to in subsection (1) shall provide that, where the operation of the agreement results in a total of all amounts, each of which is an amount deemed under subsection 122.61(1) to be an overpayment on account of the liability under this Part for a taxation year of a person subject to the agreement, that exceeds 101% of the total of such overpayments that would have otherwise been deemed to have arisen under subsection 122.61(1), the excess shall be reimbursed by the government of the province to the Government of Canada.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]
[NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Subsection.Text: The following definitions apply in this Subdivision.

Definition.Text: adjusted net income of an individual for a taxation year means the amount that would be the individual’s income for the taxation year if

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: in computing that income, no amount were included under paragraph 56(1)(q.1) or subsection 56(6), in respect of any gain from a disposition of property to which section 79 applies or in respect of a gain described in subsection 40(3.21); and

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: in computing that income, no amount were deductible under paragraph 20(1)(ww) or 60(y) or (z). (revenu net rajusté)

Definition.Text: cohabiting spouse or common-law partner of an individual at any time has the meaning assigned by section 122.6. (conjoint visé)
designated educational institution has the meaning assigned by subsection 118.6(1). (établissement d’enseignement agréé)
eligible dependant of an individual for a taxation year means a child of the individual who, at the end of the year,

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: resided with the individual;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: was under the age of 19 years; and

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: was not an eligible individual. (personne à charge admissible)

Definition.Text: eligible individual for a taxation year means an individual (other than an ineligible individ-ual) who was resident in Canada throughout the taxation year and who was, at the end of the taxation year,

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: 19 years of age or older;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the cohabiting spouse or common-law partner of another individual; or

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: the parent of a child with whom the individual resides. (particulier admissible)

Definition.Text: eligible spouse of an eligible individual for a taxation year means an individual (other than an ineligible individual) who was resident in Canada throughout the taxation year and who was, at the end of the taxation year, the cohabiting spouse or common-law partner of the eligible individual. (conjoint admissible)
ineligible individual for a taxation year means an individual

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: who is described in paragraph 149(1)(a) or (b) at any time in the taxation year;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: who, except where the individual has an eligible dependant for the taxation year, was enrolled as a full-time student at a designated educational institution for a total of more than 13 weeks in the taxation year; or

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: who was confined to a prison or similar institution for a period of at least 90 days during the taxation year. (particulier non admissible)

Definition.Text: return of income filed by an individual for a taxation year means a return of income (other than a return of income filed under subsection 70(2) or 104(23), paragraph 128(2)(e) or subsection 150(4)) that is required to be filed for the taxation year or that would be required to be filed if the individual had tax payable under this Part for the taxation year. (déclaration de revenu)
working income, of an individual for a taxation year, means the total of

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the total of all amounts each of which would, if this Act were read without reference to section 8, be the individual’s income for the taxation year from an office or employment,

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: all amounts that are included because of paragraph 56(1)(n) or (o) or subparagraph 56(1)(r)(v) in computing the individual’s income for a period in the taxation year, and

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: the total of all amounts each of which is the individual’s income for the taxation year from a business carried on by the individual otherwise than as a specified member of a partnership. (revenu de travail)

Subsection.Text: An individual may determine the total amount for the definition working income for both the individual and the individual’s eligible spouse, if applicable, for a taxation year as if the Act were read without reference to paragraph 81(1)(a) and subsection 81(4) and if so, the individual shall determine the total amount for the definition adjusted net income for both the individual and the individual’s eligible spouse, if applicable, for the taxation year as if the Act were read without reference to paragraph 81(1)(a) and subsection 81(4).

For the purposes of applying the definitions eligible dependant and eligible individual in subsection (1) for a taxation year, an individual shall not fail to qualify as a parent (within the meaning assigned by section 252) of another individual solely because of the receipt of a social assistance amount that is payable under a program of the Government of Canada, the government of a province or an Indigenous governing body (as defined in section 2 of the Children’s Special Allowances Act) for the benefit of the other individual, unless the amount is a special allowance under the Children’s Special Allowances Act in respect of the other individual in the taxation year.
For the purposes of subsections (2) and (3),

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: if an eligible individual had an eligible spouse for a taxation year and the working income for the year of the eligible individual was less than the working income for the year of the eligible spouse, the eligible individual’s adjusted net income for the year is deemed to be the amount, if any, by which the eligible individual’s adjusted net income for the year (determined without reference to this subsection) exceeds the lesser of

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the eligible individual’s working income for the year, and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: if an eligible individual had an eligible spouse for a taxation year and the working income for the year of the eligible individual was greater than or equal to the working income for the year of the eligible spouse, the eligible spouse’s adjusted net income for the year is deemed to be the amount, if any, by which the eligible spouse’s adjusted net income for the year (determined without reference to this subsection) exceeds the lesser of

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the eligible spouse’s working income for the year, and

Subsection.MarginalNote: Deemed payment on account of tax
Subsection.Text: Subject to subsection (5), an eligible individual for a taxation year who files a return of income for the taxation year is deemed to have paid, at the end of the taxation year, on account of tax payable under this Part for the taxation year, an amount equal to the amount, if any, determined by the formula

FormulaDefinition.Text: is

FormulaParagraph.Label: (a)
FormulaParagraph.Text: if the individual had neither an eligible spouse nor an eligible dependant, for the taxation year, the lesser of $1,395 and 27% of the amount, if any, by which the individual’s working income for the taxation year exceeds $3,000, and

FormulaParagraph.Label: (b)
FormulaParagraph.Text: if the individual had an eligible spouse or an eligible dependant, for the taxation year, the lesser of $2,403 and 27% of the amount, if any, by which the total of the working incomes of the individual and, if applicable, of the eligible spouse, for the taxation year, exceeds $3,000; and

FormulaDefinition.Text: is

FormulaParagraph.Label: (a)
FormulaParagraph.Text: if the individual had neither an eligible spouse nor an eligible dependant, for the taxation year, 15% of the amount, if any, by which the adjusted net income of the individual for the taxation year exceeds $22,944, and

FormulaParagraph.Label: (b)
FormulaParagraph.Text: if the individual had an eligible spouse or an eligible dependant, for the taxation year, 15% of the amount, if any, by which the total of the adjusted net incomes of the individual and, if applicable, of the eligible spouse, for the taxation year, exceeds $26,177.

Subsection.MarginalNote: Deemed payment on account of tax — disability supplement
Subsection.Text: An eligible individual for a taxation year who files a return of income for the taxation year and who may deduct an amount under subsection 118.3(1) in computing tax payable under this Part for the taxation year is deemed to have paid, at the end of the taxation year, on account of tax payable under this Part for the taxation year, an amount equal to the amount, if any, determined by the formula

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the lesser of $720 and 27% of the amount, if any, by which the individual’s working income for the taxation year exceeds $1,150; and
is

FormulaParagraph.Label: (a)
FormulaParagraph.Text: if the individual had neither an eligible spouse nor an eligible dependant, for the taxation year, 15% of the amount, if any, by which the individual’s adjusted net income for the taxation year exceeds $32,244,

FormulaParagraph.Label: (b)
FormulaParagraph.Text: if the individual had an eligible spouse for the taxation year who was not entitled to deduct an amount under subsection 118.3(1) for the taxation year, or had an eligible dependant for the taxation year, 15% of the amount, if any, by which the total of the adjusted net incomes of the individual and, if applicable, of the eligible spouse, for the taxation year, exceeds $42,197, and

FormulaParagraph.Label: (c)
FormulaParagraph.Text: if the individual had an eligible spouse for the taxation year who was entitled to deduct an amount under subsection 118.3(1) for the taxation year, 7.5% of the amount, if any, by which the total of the adjusted net incomes of the individual and of the eligible spouse, for the taxation year, exceeds $42,197.

Subsection.Text: If an eligible individual has an eligible spouse for a taxation year and both those individuals would be, but for this subsection, eligible individuals for the purposes of subsection (2) in respect of the taxation year,

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: if the individuals agree on which individual is the eligible individual for the taxation year, only that individual shall be an eligible individual for the purposes of subsection (2) in respect of the taxation year; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: in any other case, only the individual that the Minister designates is the eligible individual for the purposes of subsection (2) in respect of the taxation year.

Subsection.Text: For the purpose of applying subsections (2) and (3), if an individual (referred to in this subsection as the “child”) would be, but for this subsection, an eligible dependant of more than one eligible individual for a taxation year, the child is deemed only to be an eligible dependant of

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: if the individuals agree, the agreed upon individual; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: in any other case, the individual designated by the Minister.

Subsection.Text: For the purpose of this Subdivision, if an individual becomes bankrupt in a particular calendar year

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: notwithstanding subsection 128(2), any reference to the taxation year of the individual (other than in this subsection) is deemed to be a reference to the particular calendar year; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the individual’s working income and adjusted net income for the taxation year ending on December 31 of the particular calendar year is deemed to include the individual’s working income and adjusted net income for the taxation year that begins on January 1 of the particular calendar year.

Subsection.MarginalNote: Special rules in the event of death
Subsection.Text: For the purpose of this Subdivision, if an individual dies after June 30 of a calendar year

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the individual is deemed to be resident in Canada from the time of death until the end of the year and to reside at the same place in Canada as the place where the individual resided immediately before death;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the individual is deemed to be the same age at the end of the year as the individual would have been if the individual were alive at the end of the year;

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: the individual is deemed to be the cohabiting spouse or common-law partner of another individual (referred to in this paragraph as the “surviving spouse”) at the end of the year if,

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: immediately before death, the individual was the cohabiting spouse or common-law partner of the surviving spouse, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the surviving spouse is not the cohabiting spouse or common-law partner of another individual at the end of the year; and

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: any return of income filed by a legal representative of the individual is deemed to be a return of income filed by the individual.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Section.MarginalNote: Modification for purposes of provincial program
Section.Text: The Minister of Finance may enter into an agreement with the government of a province whereby the amounts determined under subsections 122.7(2) and (3) with respect to an eligible individual resident in the province at the end of the taxation year shall, for the purpose of calculating amounts deemed to be paid on account of the tax payable of an individual under those subsections, be replaced by amounts determined in accordance with the agreement.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Subsection.Text: Subject to subsection (5), an individual in relation to a month specified for a taxation year who is an eligible individual for the preceding taxation year who files a return of income for the preceding taxation year on or before the first day of November of the taxation year is deemed to have paid during the specified month on account of their tax payable under this Part for the taxation year an amount equal to 1/6 of the total of the amounts, if any, determined for the individual for the preceding taxation year under subsections 122.7(2) and (3).
Subsection (3) applies in respect of an individual in relation to a particular month specified for a taxation year, and each subsequent month specified for the taxation year, if absent subsection (3)

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the amount deemed by subsection (1) to have been paid by the individual during the particular month specified for the taxation year would be less than $33; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: it is reasonable to conclude that the amount deemed by subsection (1) to have been paid by the individual during each subsequent month specified for the taxation year would be less than $33.

Subsection.Text: If this subsection applies

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the total of all amounts that would otherwise be deemed by subsection (1) to have been paid on account of the individual’s tax payable under this Part for the taxation year during the particular month specified for the taxation year, and during each subsequent month specified for the taxation year, is deemed to have been paid by the individual on account of their tax payable under this Part for the taxation year during the particular specified month for the taxation year; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the amount deemed by subsection (1) to have been paid by the eligible individual during those subsequent months specified for the taxation year is deemed, except for the purpose of this subsection, not to have been paid to the extent that it is included in an amount deemed to have been paid by this subsection.

Subsection.Text: For the purposes of this section, the months specified for a taxation year are July and October of the taxation year and January of the immediately following taxation year.
For the purposes of subsection (1), an individual is not an eligible individual for the preceding taxation year in relation to a month specified for a taxation year if the individual

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: dies in the taxation year before the first day of July;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: is confined to a prison or similar institution for a period in the taxation year of at least 90 days that begins on or before the first day of the specified month; or

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: ceases to be resident in Canada on a day in the taxation year that is on or before the first day of the specified month.

Subsection.Text: If, in the absence of subsection (5), an individual or their cohabiting spouse or common-law partner at the end of the preceding taxation year would be deemed in a taxation year to have paid an amount on account of tax payable for the taxation year under this section, the individual (or, in the case of a deceased individual, their legal representative) shall notify the Minister of the occurrence of any of the following events before the end of the month following the month in which the event occurs:

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the individual dies in the taxation year;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the individual ceases to be resident in Canada in the taxation year; or

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: the individual is confined to a prison or similar institution for a period of at least 90 days in the taxation year.

Subsection.Text: Subsection (1) is to be applied to a particular individual in relation to a month specified for a taxation year as if section 122.7 applied to the particular individual for the preceding taxation year on the basis that the particular individual had no eligible spouse for the preceding taxation year, if

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: another individual was, for the purposes of section 122.7, the eligible spouse of the particular individual for the preceding taxation year; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the other individual is not, for the purposes of subsection (1), an eligible individual for the preceding taxation year in relation to the month specified for the taxation year because of subsection (5).

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Subsection.Text: The following definitions apply in this section.

Definition.Text: cohabiting spouse or common-law partner, of an individual at any time, has the same meaning as in section 122.6. (époux ou conjoint de fait visé)
eligible individual, in relation to a month specified for a taxation year, means an individual (other than a trust) who

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: has, before the specified month, attained the age of 19 years; or

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: was, at any time before the specified month,

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: a parent who resided with their child, or

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: married or in a common-law partnership. (particulier admissible)

Definition.Text: qualified dependant, of an individual in relation to a month specified for a taxation year, means a person who at the beginning of the specified month

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: is the individual’s child or is dependent for support on the individual or on the individual’s cohabiting spouse or common-law partner;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: resides with the individual;

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: is under the age of 19 years;

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: is not an eligible individual in relation to the specified month; and

Paragraph.Label: (e)
Paragraph.Text: is not a qualified relation of any individual in relation to the specified month. (personne à charge admissible)

Definition.Text: qualified relation, of an individual in relation to a month specified for a taxation year, means the person, if any, who, at the beginning of the specified month, is the individual’s cohabiting spouse or common-law partner. (proche admissible)
relevant census means

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: for the 2023 and 2024 taxation years, the 2016 census published by Statistics Canada; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: in any other case, the last census published by Statistics Canada before the taxation year. (recensement pertinent)

Definition.Text: return of income, in respect of a person for a taxation year, means the person’s return of income (other than a return of income under subsection 70(2) or 104(23), paragraph 128(2)(e) or subsection 150(4)) that is required to be filed for the taxation year or that would be required to be filed if the person had tax payable under this Part for the taxation year. (déclaration de revenu)

Subsection.Text: Despite subsection (1), a person is not an eligible individual, is not a qualified relation and is not a qualified dependant, in relation to a month specified for a taxation year, if the person

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: died before the specified month;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: is confined to a prison or similar institution for a period of at least 90 days that includes the first day of the specified month;

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: is at the beginning of the specified month a non-resident person, other than a non-resident person who

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: is at that time the cohabiting spouse or common-law partner of a person who is deemed under subsection 250(1) to be resident in Canada throughout the taxation year that includes the first day of the specified month, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: was resident in Canada at any time before the specified month;

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: is at the beginning of the specified month a person described in paragraph 149(1)(a) or (b); or

Paragraph.Label: (e)
Paragraph.Text: is a person in respect of whom a special allowance under the Children’s Special Allowances Act is payable for the specified month.

Subsection.Text: For the purposes of this section, an individual is considered to reside at any time only at their principal place of residence.

Subsection.MarginalNote: Deemed payment on account of tax
Subsection.Text: An eligible individual in relation to a month specified for a taxation year who files a return of income for the taxation year is deemed to have paid, during the specified month, on account of their tax payable under this Part for the taxation year, an amount equal to the amount, if any, determined by the formula

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the amount specified by the Minister of Finance for an eligible individual in relation to the specified month for the province (in this subsection and subsection (6) referred to as the “relevant province”) in which the eligible individual resides at the beginning of the specified month;
is

FormulaParagraph.Label: (a)
FormulaParagraph.Text: the amount specified by the Minister of Finance for a qualified relation in relation to the specified month for the relevant province, if

FormulaParagraph.Label: (i)
FormulaParagraph.Text: the eligible individual has a qualified relation at the beginning of the specified month, or

FormulaParagraph.Label: (ii)
FormulaParagraph.Text: subparagraph (i) does not apply and the eligible individual has a qualified dependant at the beginning of the specified month, and

FormulaParagraph.Label: (b)
FormulaParagraph.Text: in any other case, nil;

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the amount specified by the Minister of Finance for a qualified dependant in relation to the specified month for the relevant province;

is the number of qualified dependants of the eligible individual at the beginning of the specified month, other than a qualified dependant in respect of whom an amount is included because of subparagraph (a)(ii) of the description of B in relation to the specified month; and
is

FormulaParagraph.Label: (a)
FormulaParagraph.Text: 1.2, if there is a census metropolitan area, as determined in the relevant census, in the relevant province and the individual does not reside in a census metropolitan area at the beginning of the specified month, and

FormulaParagraph.Label: (b)
FormulaParagraph.Text: 1, in any other case.

Subsection.Text: Despite subsection (4), if an eligible individual is a shared-custody parent (as defined in section 122.6, but the definition qualified dependent in that section having the meaning assigned by subsection (1)) in respect of one or more qualified dependants at the beginning of a month, the amount deemed by subsection (4) to have been paid during a specified month is equal to the amount determined by the formula

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the amount determined under subsection (4), calculated without reference to this subsection; and
is the amount determined under subsection (4), calculated without reference to this subsection and subparagraph (b)(ii) of the definition eligible individual in section 122.6.

Subsection.Text: For the purposes of this section, the months specified for a taxation year are April, July and October of the immediately following taxation year and January of the second immediately following taxation year.

The Minister of Finance may specify amounts for a province in relation to a month specified for a taxation year for the purposes of this section. If the Minister of Finance does not specify a particular amount that is relevant for the purposes of this section, that particular amount is deemed to be nil for the purpose of applying this section.

Subsection.MarginalNote: Deemed rebate in respect of fuel charges
Subsection.Text: The amount deemed by this section to have been paid during a specified month on account of tax payable for a taxation year is deemed to have been paid during the specified month as a rebate in respect of charges levied under Part 1 of the Greenhouse Gas Pollution Pricing Act in respect of the relevant province.

If an individual is a qualified relation of another individual in relation to a month specified for a taxation year and both those individuals would be, but for this subsection, eligible individuals in relation to the specified month, only the individual that the Minister designates is the eligible individual in relation to the specified month.
If a person would, if this Act were read without reference to this subsection, be the qualified dependant of two or more individuals, in relation to a month specified for a taxation year,

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the person is deemed to be a qualified dependant, in relation to that month, of the one of those individuals on whom those individuals agree;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: in the absence of an agreement referred to in paragraph (a), the person is deemed to be, in relation to that month, a qualified dependant of the individuals, if any, who are, at the beginning of that month, eligible individuals (as defined in section 122.6, but the definition qualified dependant in that section having the meaning assigned by subsection (1)) in respect of that person; and

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: in any other case, the person is deemed to be, in relation to that month, a qualified dependant only of the individual that the Minister designates.

Subsection.Text: An individual shall notify the Minister of the occurrence of any of the following events before the end of the month following the month in which the event occurs:

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the individual ceases to be an eligible individual;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: a person becomes or ceases to be the individual’s qualified relation; and

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: a person ceases to be a qualified dependant of the individual, otherwise than because of attaining the age of 19 years.

Subsection.Text: For the purposes of this section, if an individual becomes bankrupt in a particular calendar year, notwithstanding subsection 128(2), any reference to the taxation year of the individual (other than in this subsection) is deemed to be a reference to the particular calendar year.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Subsection.Text: The following definitions apply in this section.

Definition.Text: eligible educator, in respect of a taxation year, means an individual who, at any time during the taxation year,

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: is employed in Canada as a teacher or an early childhood educator at

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: an elementary or secondary school, or

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: a regulated child care facility; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: holds a valid and recognized (in the province or territory in which the individual is employed)

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: teaching certificate, licence, permit or diploma, or

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: certificate or diploma in early childhood education. (éducateur admissible)

Definition.Text: eligible supplies expense, of an eligible educator for a taxation year, means an amount (other than any amount deducted in computing any person’s income for any taxation year or any amount otherwise included in computing a deduction from any person’s tax payable under this Act for any taxation year) paid by the eligible educator in the taxation year for teaching supplies to the extent that

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the teaching supplies were

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: purchased by the eligible educator for the purpose of teaching or facilitating students’ learning, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: directly consumed or used in the performance of the duties of the eligible educator’s employment; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the eligible educator is not entitled to receive a reimbursement, allowance or any other form of assistance (other than an amount that is included in computing the income for any taxation year of the eligible educator and that is not deductible in computing the taxable income of the eligible educator) in respect of the amount paid. (dépense admissible)

Definition.Text: return of income filed by an eligible educator for a taxation year means a return of income (other than a return of income filed under subsection 70(2) or 104(23), paragraph 128(2)(e) or subsection 150(4)) that is required to be filed for the year or that would be required to be filed if the eligible educator had tax payable under this Part for the year. (déclaration de revenu)
teaching supplies means

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: consumable supplies; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: prescribed durable goods. (fournitures scolaires)

Subsection.Text: An eligible educator who files a return of income for a taxation year and who makes a claim under this subsection is deemed to have paid, at the end of the year, on account of tax payable under this Part for the year, an amount equal to 25% of the least of

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the total of all amounts each of which is an eligible supplies expense of the eligible educator for the year; and

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: if the eligible educator fails to provide the certificate referred to in subsection (3) in respect of the year, as and when requested by the Minister, nil.

Subsection.Text: If the Minister so demands, an eligible educator making a claim under this section in respect of a taxation year shall provide to the Minister a written certificate from their employer, or a delegated official of the employer, attesting to the eligible supplies expenses of the eligible educator for the year.

For the purposes of this Subdivision, if an eligible educator becomes bankrupt in a particular calendar year, notwithstanding subsection 128(2), any reference to the taxation year of the eligible educator (other than in this subsection) is deemed to be a reference to the particular calendar year.

If an eligible educator is resident in Canada throughout part of a taxation year and is non-resident throughout another part of the year, the total of the amounts that are deemed to be paid by the eligible educator under subsection (2) for the year cannot exceed the lesser of

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the total of

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the amounts deemed to be paid under subsection (2) that can reasonably be considered as wholly applicable to the period or periods in the year throughout which the eligible educator is not resident in Canada, computed as though that period or those periods were the whole taxation year, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the amounts deemed to be paid under subsection (2) that can reasonably be considered as wholly applicable to the period or periods in the year throughout which the eligible educator is resident in Canada, computed as though that period or those periods were the whole taxation year; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the total of the amounts that would have been deemed to have been paid under subsection (2) for the year had the eligible educator been resident in Canada throughout the year.

Subsection.Text: Subsection (2) does not apply in respect of a taxation year of an eligible educator if the eligible educator is, at no time in the year, resident in Canada, unless all or substantially all the eligible educator’s income for the year is included in computing the eligible educator’s taxable income earned in Canada for the year.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Subsection.Text: An individual who is resident in Canada throughout a taxation year, files a return of income for the taxation year and makes a claim under this subsection is deemed to have paid, at the end of the taxation year, on account of tax payable under this Part for the taxation year, an amount claimed by the individual that does not exceed the lesser of

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the training amount limit of the individual for the taxation year, and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: 50% of the amount that would be deductible under paragraph 118.5(1)(a) or (d) in computing the individual’s tax payable under this Part for the taxation year if

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: this Act were read without reference to subsections 118.5(1.2) and (2), and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the appropriate percentage for the taxation year were 100%.

Subsection.Text: For the purposes of this section, the training amount limit of an individual for a taxation year is

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: if the taxation year is after 2019 and the individual has attained the age of 26 years, and has not attained the age of 66 years, before the end of the taxation year, the lesser of

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the amount determined by the formula

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the individual’s training amount limit for the preceding taxation year,
is

FormulaParagraph.Label: (I)
FormulaParagraph.Text: the individual has filed a return of income for the preceding taxation year,

FormulaParagraph.Label: (II)
FormulaParagraph.Text: the individual was resident in Canada throughout the preceding taxation year,

FormulaParagraph.Label: (III)
FormulaParagraph.Text: the total of the following amounts is greater than or equal to $10,000:

the amount that would be the individual’s working income (as defined in subsection 122.7(1)) for the preceding taxation year, if this Act were read without reference to paragraph 81(1)(a) and subsection 81(4),
the total of all amounts each of which is an amount payable to the individual under subsection 22(1), 23(1), 152.04(1) or 152.05(1) of the Employment Insurance Act in the preceding taxation year, and

the amount that would be included in the individual’s income because of subparagraph 56(1)(a)(vii) in computing the individual’s income for the preceding taxation year, if this Act were read without reference to paragraph 81(1)(a), and

FormulaParagraph.Label: (IV)
FormulaParagraph.Text: the individual’s income for the preceding taxation year under this Part does not exceed the higher dollar amount referred to in paragraph 117(2)(c), as adjusted under this Act for the preceding taxation year, and

FormulaParagraph.Label: (B)
FormulaParagraph.Text: nil, in any other case, and

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the amount deemed to have been paid by the individual under subsection (1) in respect of the preceding taxation year, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the amount determined by the formula

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the total of all amounts deemed to have been paid by the individual under subsection (1) in respect of a preceding taxation year; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: nil, in any other case.

Subsection.Text: For the purpose of this Subdivision, if an individual becomes bankrupt in a particular calendar year,

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: notwithstanding subsection 128(2), any reference to the taxation year of the individual (other than in this subsection) is deemed to be a reference to the particular calendar year; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the individual’s working income and income under this Part for the taxation year ending on December 31 of the particular calendar year is deemed to include the individual’s working income and the income under this Part for the taxation year that begins on January 1 of the particular calendar year.

Subsection.MarginalNote: Special rules in the event of death
Subsection.Text: For the purposes of this section, if an individual dies in a calendar year,

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the individual is deemed to be resident in Canada from the time of death until the end of the year;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the individual is deemed to be the same age at the end of the year as the individual would have been if the individual were alive at the end of the year; and

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: any return of income filed by a legal representative of the individual is deemed to be a return of income filed by the individual.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Subsection.Text: The following definitions apply in this section.

Definition.Text: eligible dwelling, of a qualifying individual, for a renovation period taxation year, means a housing unit (including the land subjacent to the housing unit and the immediately contiguous land, but not including the portion of that land that exceeds the greater of ½ hectare and the portion of that land that is necessary for the use and enjoyment of the housing unit as a residence) located in Canada if

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the qualifying individual or a qualifying relation of the qualifying individual (or a trust under which the qualifying individual or a qualifying relation is a beneficiary) owns — whether jointly with another person or otherwise — at any time in the renovation period taxation year, the housing unit; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the housing unit is ordinarily inhabited, or is reasonably expected to be ordinarily inhabited, within 12 months after the end of the renovation period

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: by the qualifying individual, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: by a qualifying relation of the qualifying individual. (logement admissible)

Definition.Text: eligible individual, in respect of an eligible dwelling for a renovation period taxation year, means

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: an individual who ordinarily resides, or intends to ordinarily reside, in the eligible dwelling within 12 months after the end of the renovation period in respect of a qualifying renovation of the eligible dwelling and who is

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: a qualifying individual,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the cohabiting spouse or common-law partner (as defined in section 122.6) of a qualifying individual at any time in the renovation period taxation year, or

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: a qualifying relation of a qualifying individual; or

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: an individual who

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: is a qualifying relation of a qualifying individual, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: owns the eligible dwelling or is the beneficiary of a trust that owns the eligible dwelling. (particulier admissible)

Definition.Text: individual does not include a trust. (particulier)
qualifying expenditure, of an individual, means a reasonable outlay or expense that

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: is directly attributable to a qualifying renovation of an eligible dwelling in respect of which the individual is an eligible individual;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: is made or incurred by the individual before the end of the renovation period in respect of the qualifying renovation referred to in paragraph (a);

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: is the cost of goods acquired or services received, including an outlay or expense for permits required for, or for the rental of equipment used in the course of, the qualifying renovation; and

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: is not an outlay or expense

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: for the cost of annual, recurring or routine repair or maintenance,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: to acquire a household appliance,

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: to acquire an electronic home-entertainment device,

Subparagraph.Label: (iv)
Subparagraph.Text: that is the cost of housekeeping, security monitoring, gardening, outdoor maintenance or similar services,

Subparagraph.Label: (v)
Subparagraph.Text: for financing costs in respect of the qualifying renovation,

Subparagraph.Label: (vi)
Subparagraph.Text: in respect of goods or services provided by a person not dealing at arm’s length with the individual, unless the person is registered for the purposes of Part IX of the Excise Tax Act, or

Subparagraph.Label: (vii)
Subparagraph.Text: that can reasonably be considered to have been reimbursed. (dépense admissible)

Definition.Text: qualifying individual, in respect of a renovation period taxation year, means an individual who has attained the age of

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: 65 years before the end of the renovation period taxation year; or

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: 18 years before the end of the renovation period taxation year and in respect of whom an amount is deductible, or would be deductible if this Act were read without reference to paragraph 118.3(1)(c), under section 118.3 in computing a taxpayer’s tax payable under this Part for the renovation period taxation year. (particulier déterminé)

Definition.Text: qualifying relation, of a qualifying individual for a renovation period taxation year, means an individual who

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: has attained the age of 18 years before the end of the renovation period taxation year; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: at any time in the renovation period taxation year, is a parent, grandparent, child, grandchild, brother, sister, aunt, uncle, niece or nephew of either the qualifying individual or the cohabiting spouse or common-law partner (as defined in section 122.6) of the qualifying individual. (proche admissible)

Definition.Text: qualifying renovation means a renovation or alteration of, or addition to, an eligible dwelling of a qualifying individual that

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: is of an enduring nature and integral to the eligible dwelling; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: is undertaken to enable the qualifying individual to reside in the dwelling with a qualifying relation of the qualifying individual by establishing a secondary unit within the dwelling for occupancy by the qualifying individual or the qualifying relation. (travaux de rénovation admissibles)

Definition.Text: renovation period, for a qualifying renovation of an eligible dwelling, means a period that

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: begins at the time that the first qualifying expenditure is made or incurred in respect of the qualifying renovation, and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: ends at the time of the completion of the qualifying renovation. (période de rénovation)

Definition.Text: renovation period taxation year means the taxation year in which the renovation period in respect of a qualifying renovation ends. (année d’imposition de la période de rénovation)

return of income, in respect of an eligible individual for a taxation year, means the eligible individual’s return of income (other than a return of income under subsection 70(2) or 104(23), paragraph 128(2)(e) or subsection 150(4)) that is required to be filed for the taxation year or that would be required to be filed if the eligible individual had tax payable under this Part for the taxation year. (déclaration de revenu)
secondary unit means a self-contained housing unit that

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: has a private entrance, kitchen, bathroom and sleeping area,

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: if applicable, meets any local requirements to qualify as a secondary dwelling unit, and

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: meets prescribed conditions, if any. (logement secondaire)

Subsection.Text: For the purposes of this section, a qualifying expenditure of a particular individual who is an eligible individual in respect of an eligible dwelling includes an outlay or expense made or incurred by a trust of which the particular individual is a beneficiary, in respect of the eligible dwelling, to the extent of the share of that outlay or expense that is reasonably attributable to the eligible dwelling, having regard to the amount of the outlays or expenses made or incurred in respect of the eligible dwelling, if

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the outlay or expense would be a qualifying expenditure of the particular individual if the outlay or expense had been made or incurred by that individual; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the trust has notified the particular individual of the amount of the outlay or expenses that are attributable to the eligible dwelling.

Subsection.Text: An eligible individual who files a return of income for a renovation period taxation year and who makes a claim under this subsection in that return of income is deemed to have paid, at the end of the taxation year, on account of tax payable under this Part for the taxation year, an amount equal to the amount determined by the formula

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the appropriate percentage for the taxation year; and
is the least of

FormulaParagraph.Label: (b)
FormulaParagraph.Text: the total of all amounts, each of which is a qualifying expenditure of the individual in respect of a qualifying renovation that ended in the taxation year, and

FormulaParagraph.Label: (c)
FormulaParagraph.Text: if the individual is not resident in Canada throughout the taxation year, nil.

Subsection.Text: For the purpose of this section,

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: in respect of a qualifying individual, there may only be one qualifying renovation for the purpose of a claim under subsection (3) by all taxpayers during the lifetime of the qualifying individual;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: a maximum of $50,000 of qualifying expenditures may be claimed by all taxpayers in respect of the same qualifying renovation; and

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: if more than one taxpayer is entitled to a deduction under subsection (3) in respect of the same qualifying individual or the same qualifying renovation and the taxpayers cannot agree as to what portion of the amount each can so deduct, the Minister may fix the portions.

Subsection.Text: For the purpose of this Subdivision, if an eligible individual becomes bankrupt in a particular calendar year, despite subsection 128(2), any reference to the taxation year of the eligible individual is deemed to be a reference to the particular calendar year.

Subsection.MarginalNote: Special rules in the event of death
Subsection.Text: For the purpose of this section, if an eligible individual or a qualifying individual dies in a calendar year,

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the deceased individual is deemed to be resident in Canada from the time of death until the end of the year if, immediately before death, the deceased individual was resident in Canada;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the deceased individual is deemed to be the same age at the end of the year as the individual would have been if the individual were alive at the end of the year;

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: the deceased individual is deemed to be the cohabiting spouse or common-law partner of another individual (referred to in this paragraph as the “surviving spouse”) at the end of the year if,

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: immediately before death, the deceased individual was the cohabiting spouse or common-law partner (as defined in section 122.6) of the surviving spouse, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the surviving spouse is not the cohabiting spouse or common-law partner (as defined in section 122.6) of another individual at the end of the year; and

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: any return of income filed by a legal representative of the deceased individual is deemed to be a return of income filed by the individual.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Subsection.Text: The following definitions apply in this section.

Definition.Text: eligible health care establishment means a hospital, nursing care facility, residential care facility, community care facility for the elderly, home health care establishment and similar regulated health care establishments. (établissement de soins de santé admissible)
eligible personal support worker, for a taxation year, means an individual

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: who performs duties of employment in the capacity of a personal support worker for an eligible health care establishment during the taxation year (in this definition referred to as the “duties for the year”);

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: who, in the course of performing the duties for the year, ordinarily provides one-on-one care and essential support to optimize and maintain another individual’s health, well-being, safety, autonomy and comfort consistent with that other individual’s health care needs as directed by a regulated health care professional or a provincial or community health organization; and

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: whose main duties of employment, in respect of the duties for the year, include assisting individuals with activities of daily living and mobilization. (préposé aux services de soutien à la personne admissible)

Definition.Text: return of income, filed by an eligible personal support worker for a taxation year, means a return of income (other than a return of income under subsection 70(2) or 104(23), paragraph 128(2)(e) or subsection 150(4)) that is required to be filed for the taxation year or that would be required to be filed if the eligible personal support worker had tax payable under this Part for the taxation year. (déclaration de revenu)
yearly eligible remuneration of an individual for a taxation year means the total of all amounts, each of which

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: would be, in the absence of section 8 and paragraph 81(1)(a), the individual’s income for the taxation year from an office or employment as an eligible personal support worker for an eligible health care establishment in a province, other than duties performed in Newfoundland and Labrador, the Northwest Territories and British Columbia; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: is certified by the individual’s employer in the prescribed form and manner to be an amount that satisfies the description under paragraph (a). (rémunération annuelle admissible)

Subsection.Text: An eligible personal support worker, for a taxation year that begins after 2025 and that ends before 2031, who files a return of income for the taxation year and makes a claim under this subsection, is deemed to have paid, at the end of the taxation year, on account of tax payable under this Part for the taxation year, an amount equal to the lesser of

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: 5% of the eligible personal support worker’s yearly eligible remuneration for the taxation year.

Subsection.Text: For the purpose of this Subdivision, if an individual becomes bankrupt in a particular calendar year

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: despite subsection 128(2), any reference to a taxation year of the individual (other than in this subsection) is deemed to be a reference to the particular calendar year; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the individual’s yearly eligible remuneration for the taxation year ending on December 31 of the particular calendar year is deemed to include the individual’s yearly eligible remuneration for the taxation year that begins on January 1 of the particular calendar year.

Subsection.MarginalNote: Special rules in the event of death
Subsection.Text: For the purpose of this Subdivision, if an individual dies before the end of a calendar year, any return of income filed by a legal representative of the individual is deemed to be a return of income filed by the individual.

Subsection.MarginalNote: Requirement — certification of yearly eligible remuneration
Subsection.Text: Every employer who pays an amount described in paragraph (a) of the definition yearly eligible remuneration in subsection (1) to an individual in a taxation year must provide the certification described in paragraph (b) of that definition in respect of the total amount described in paragraph (a) of that definition for that individual for that year.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Subsection.Text: The tax payable under this Part for a taxation year by a corporation on its taxable income or taxable income earned in Canada, as the case may be, (in this section referred to as its “amount taxable”) for the year is, except where otherwise provided,

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: 38% of its amount taxable for the year.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Section.Text: There shall be added to the tax otherwise payable under this Part for each taxation year by a corporation (other than a corporation that was throughout the year an investment corporation or a non-resident-owned investment corporation) an amount equal to that proportion of 5% of the amount, if any, by which

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the tax payable under this Part by the corporation for the year determined without reference to this section, sections 123.2 and 126 (except for the purposes of subsection 125(1) and section 125.1), subsections 127(3) and (5), 127.2(1) and 127.3(1) of this Act and paragraph 123(1)(b) and subsection 127(13) of the Income Tax Act, chapter 148 of the Revised Statutes of Canada, 1952, and as if subsection 124(1) of this Act were read without reference to the words “in a province” in that subsection

ContinuedSectionSubsection.Text: exceeds

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: in the case of a Canadian-controlled private corporation to which subsection 125(1) applies, the amount, if any, by which

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: 15% of the least of the amounts, if any, determined under paragraphs 125(1)(a) to (c) in respect of the corporation for the year

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the amount, if any, determined under paragraph 125.1(1)(b) in respect of the corporation for the year,

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: in the case of a mutual fund corporation, the least of the amounts that would be determined under paragraphs (a) to (c) of the description of A in the definition refundable capital gains tax on hand in subsection 131(6) in respect of the corporation for the year if this Act were read without reference to this section, and

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: in any other case, nil

ContinuedSectionSubsection.Text: that the number of days in that portion of the year that is after June 30, 1985 and before 1987 is of the number of days in the year.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]
[NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Section.MarginalNote: Refundable tax — CCPC or substantive CCPC
Section.Text: There shall be added to the tax otherwise payable under this Part for each taxation year by a corporation that is a Canadian-controlled private corporation throughout the year — or a substantive CCPC at any time in the year — an amount equal to 10 2/3% of the lesser of

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the corporation’s aggregate investment income for the year (within the meaning assigned by subsection 129(4)), and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the amount, if any, by which its taxable income for the year exceeds the least of the amounts determined in respect of it for the year under paragraphs 125(1)(a) to (c).

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Subsection.Text: The definitions in this subsection apply in this section.

Definition.Text: full rate taxable income of a corporation for a taxation year is

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: if the corporation is not a corporation described in paragraph (b) or (c) for the year, the amount by which that portion of the corporation’s taxable income for the year (or, for greater certainty, if the corporation is non-resident, that portion of its taxable income earned in Canada for the year) that is subject to tax under subsection 123(1) exceeds the total of

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: if an amount is deducted under subsection 125.1(1) from the corporation’s tax otherwise payable under this Part for the year, the amount obtained by dividing the amount so deducted by the corporation’s general rate reduction percentage for the taxation year,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: if an amount is deducted under subsection 125.1(2) from the corporation’s tax otherwise payable under this Part for the year, the amount determined, in respect of the deduction, by the formula in that subsection,

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: the corporation’s income for the year from a personal services business, and

Subparagraph.Label: (iv)
Subparagraph.Text: if the corporation is a credit union throughout the year and the corporation deducted an amount for the year under subsection 125(1) (because of the application of subsections 137(3) and (4)), the amount, if any, that is the product of the amount, if any, determined for B in subsection 137(3) multiplied by the amount determined for C in subsection 137(3) in respect of the corporation for the year;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: if the corporation is a Canadian-controlled private corporation throughout the year or a substantive CCPC at any time in the year, the amount by which that portion of the corporation’s taxable income for the year that is subject to tax under subsection 123(1) exceeds the total of

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the amounts that would, if paragraph (a) applied to the corporation, be determined under subparagraphs (a)(i) to (iv) in respect of the corporation for the year,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the least of the amounts, if any, determined under paragraphs 125(1)(a) to (c) in respect of the corporation for the year, and

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: except for a corporation that is, throughout the year, a cooperative corporation (within the meaning assigned by subsection 136(2)) or a credit union, the corporation’s aggregate investment income for the year, within the meaning assigned by subsection 129(4); and

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: if the corporation is throughout the year an investment corporation, a mortgage investment corporation or a mutual fund corporation, nil. (revenu imposable au taux complet)

Definition.Text: general rate reduction percentage of a corporation for a taxation year is the total of

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: that proportion of 7% that the number of days in the taxation year that are before 2008 is of the number of days in the taxation year,

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: that proportion of 8.5% that the number of days in the taxation year that are in 2008 is of the number of days in the taxation year,

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: that proportion of 9% that the number of days in the taxation year that are in 2009 is of the number of days in the taxation year,

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: that proportion of 10% that the number of days in the taxation year that are in 2010 is of the number of days in the taxation year,

Paragraph.Label: (e)
Paragraph.Text: that proportion of 11.5% that the number of days in the taxation year that are in 2011 is of the number of days in the taxation year, and

Paragraph.Label: (f)
Paragraph.Text: that proportion of 13% that the number of days in the taxation year that are after 2011 is of the number of days in the taxation year. (pourcentage de réduction du taux général)

Subsection.Text: There may be deducted from a corporation’s tax otherwise payable under this Part for a taxation year the product obtained by multiplying the corporation’s general rate reduction percentage for the year by the corporation’s full rate taxable income for the year.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Section.MarginalNote: Tax on personal services business income
Section.Text: There shall be added to the tax otherwise payable under this Part for each taxation year by a corporation an amount equal to 5% of the corporation’s taxable income for the year from a personal services business.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Heading.TitleText: Additional Tax on Banks and Life Insurers

Subsection.Text: The following definition applies in this section.

Definition.Text: bank or life insurer group member means a corporation that is

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: a bank;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: a life insurance corporation that carries on business in Canada; or

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: a financial institution (as defined in subsection 190(1)) that is related to any corporation described in paragraph (a) or (b). (membre d’un groupe de banques ou d’assureurs-vie)

Subsection.Text: There shall be added to the tax otherwise payable under this Part for a taxation year, by a corporation that is a bank or life insurer group member at any time during the taxation year, an amount determined by the formula

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the corporation’s taxable income for the taxation year (or the corporation’s taxable income earned in Canada if the corporation is non-resident in the taxation year); and
is

FormulaParagraph.Label: (a)
FormulaParagraph.Text: if the corporation is not related to another bank or life insurer group member at the end of the taxation year of the corporation,

FormulaParagraph.Label: (i)
FormulaParagraph.Text: where the corporation’s taxation year is not less than 51 weeks, $100 million, and

FormulaParagraph.Label: (ii)
FormulaParagraph.Text: in any other case, the amount determined by the formula

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the number of days in the taxation year, and

FormulaParagraph.Label: (b)
FormulaParagraph.Text: in any other case, subject to subsection (5), nil.

Subsection.Text: For the purposes of this section, a corporation that is described in paragraph (a) or (b) of the definition bank or life insurer group member in subsection (1) at any time during a taxation year and that was related to another bank or life insurer group member at the end of the year (in this section, the corporation and each such bank or life insurer group member are referred to together as the “related group”) may file with the Minister, with the corporation’s return of income, an agreement in prescribed form on behalf of the related group under which an amount that does not exceed $100 million is allocated among the related group for all taxation years of members of the related group ending in the same calendar year.

The Minister may request a corporation that is a member of a related group at any time during a taxation year to file with the Minister an agreement referred to in subsection (3) and, if the corporation does not file the agreement within 30 days after receiving the request, the Minister may allocate the amount referred to in subsection (3) among the related group for the taxation years of the bank or life insurer group members ending in the same calendar year.

For the purposes of this section, the least amount allocated for a taxation year to each bank or life insurer group member under an agreement described in subsection (3) or by the Minister under subsection (4) is the amount determined for B in subsection (2) for the taxation year of that member, but, if no such allocation is made, the amount determined for B in subsection (2) of each bank or life insurer group member for that year is nil.

If an amount has been deducted in computing the income of a corporation, the amount is deemed not to have been deducted in computing the corporation’s taxable income, or taxable income earned in Canada, as the case may be, for the purpose of computing the tax payable by the corporation under subsection (2), if

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the deduction is in respect of an amount that can reasonably be considered to have been paid or payable (in this subsection referred to as “the payment”), directly or indirectly, to a person or partnership that was not dealing at arm’s length with the corporation;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the person or partnership was not a bank or life insurer group member; and

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: it can reasonably be considered that one of the purposes of the payment was to reduce the tax payable by the corporation under subsection (2).

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Subsection.Text: There may be deducted from the tax otherwise payable by a corporation under this Part for a taxation year an amount equal to 10% of the corporation’s taxable income earned in the year in a province.

Notwithstanding subsection 124(1), no deduction may be made under this section from the tax otherwise payable under this Part for a taxation year by a corporation in respect of any taxable income of the corporation for the year that is not, because of an Act of Parliament, subject to tax under this Part or by a prescribed federal Crown corporation that is an agent of Her Majesty.
In this section,

Definition.Text: province includes the Newfoundland offshore area and the Nova Scotia offshore area; (province)

taxable income earned in the year in a province means the amount determined under rules prescribed for the purpose by regulations made on the recommendation of the Minister of Finance. (revenu imposable gagné au cours de l’année dans une province)

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Subsection.Text: There may be deducted from the tax otherwise payable under this Part for a taxation year by a corporation that was, throughout the taxation year, a Canadian-controlled private corporation, an amount equal to the corporation’s small business deduction rate for the taxation year multiplied by the least of

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the amount, if any, by which the total of

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the total of all amounts each of which is the amount of income of the corporation for the year from an active business carried on in Canada, other than an amount that is

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: described in paragraph (a) of the description of A in the definition specified partnership income in subsection (7) for the year,

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: described in subparagraph (a)(i) of the definition specified corporate income in subsection (7) for the year, or

Clause.Label: (C)
Clause.Text: paid or payable to the corporation by another corporation with which it is associated, that is deemed by subsection 129(6) to be income for the year from an active business carried on by the corporation in circumstances where the associated corporation is not a Canadian-controlled private corporation or is a Canadian-controlled private corporation that has made an election under subsection 256(2) in respect of its taxation year in which the amount was paid or payable,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the specified partnership income of the corporation for the year, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii.1)
Subparagraph.Text: the specified corporate income of the corporation for the year

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: the total of all amounts each of which is a loss of the corporation for the year from an active business carried on in Canada (other than a loss of the corporation for the year from a business carried on by it as a member of a partnership), and

Subparagraph.Label: (iv)
Subparagraph.Text: the specified partnership loss of the corporation for the year,

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the amount, if any, by which the corporation’s taxable income for the year exceeds the total of

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: 100/28 of the total of the amounts that would be deductible under subsection 126(1) from the tax for the year otherwise payable under this Part by it if those amounts were determined without reference to sections 123.3 and 123.4,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the amount determined by multiplying the total of the amounts that would be deductible under subsection 126(2) from the tax for the year otherwise payable under this Part by it, if those amounts were determined without reference to section 123.4, by the relevant factor for the year, and

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: the amount, if any, of the corporation’s taxable income for the year that is not, because of an Act of Parliament, subject to tax under this Part, and

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: the corporation’s business limit for the year.
