Paragraph.Text: if the project is intended to produce clean ammonia, the taxpayer has demonstrated

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: that the project can reasonably be expected to have sufficient hydrogen production capacity to satisfy the needs of the taxpayer’s ammonia production facility, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: if the taxpayer’s hydrogen production facility and its ammonia production facility are not co-located, the feasibility of transporting hydrogen between the facilities. (projet admissible pour l’hydrogène propre)

Definition.Text: qualified validation firm means, in respect of a clean hydrogen project of a taxpayer, an engineer or engineering firm that

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: is registered and in good standing with a professional association that has the authority or recognition by law of a jurisdiction in Canada to regulate the profession of engineering in

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the jurisdiction where the project is located, or

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: if there is no professional association in the jurisdiction described in subparagraph (i), a jurisdiction in Canada where a professional association regulates the profession of engineering;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: has appropriate insurance coverage;

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: has expertise in modelling using the Fuel LCA Model and engineering expertise in production processes for hydrogen and, if applicable, ammonia;

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: at all times, is independent of, deals at arm’s length with and is not an employee of the taxpayer; and

Paragraph.Label: (e)
Paragraph.Text: meets the requirements described in guidelines published by the Minister of Natural Resources, including the Clean Hydrogen Investment Tax Credit – Validation and Verification Guidance Document. (firme admissible de validation)

Definition.Text: qualified verification firm means, in respect of a clean hydrogen project of a taxpayer, an individual or firm that

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: is either

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: an engineer or an engineering firm that is registered and in good standing with a professional association that has the authority or recognition by law of a jurisdiction in Canada to regulate the profession of engineering in

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: the jurisdiction where the project is located, or

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: if there is no professional association in the jurisdiction described in clause (A), a jurisdiction in Canada where a professional association regulates the profession of engineering, or

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: a verification body accredited and in good standing under the Clean Fuel Regulations;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: has appropriate insurance coverage;

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: has expertise in life-cycle analysis of greenhouse gas emissions;

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: at all times, is independent of, deals at arm’s length with and is not an employee of the taxpayer;

Paragraph.Label: (e)
Paragraph.Text: is not a qualified validation firm in respect of the project; and

Paragraph.Label: (f)
Paragraph.Text: meets the requirements described in guidelines published by the Minister of Natural Resources, including the Clean Hydrogen Investment Tax Credit – Validation and Verification Guidance Document. (firme admissible de vérification)

Definition.Text: qualifying taxpayer means a taxable Canadian corporation. (contribuable admissible)
specified greenhouse gas means

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: carbon dioxide;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: methane;

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: nitrous oxide;

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: sulphur hexafluoride; and

Paragraph.Label: (e)
Paragraph.Text: any other greenhouse gases listed in the Fuel LCA Model and included in the Clean Hydrogen Investment Tax Credit – Carbon Intensity Modelling Guidance Document published by the Government of Canada at the time that a taxpayer files its most recent clean hydrogen project plan with the Minister of Natural Resources. (gaz à effet de serre déterminé)

Definition.Text: specified percentage means

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: in respect of the capital cost of an eligible clean hydrogen property (other than equipment described in paragraph (b)) that is acquired by a qualifying taxpayer for use in a clean hydrogen project,

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: if the expected carbon intensity of the hydrogen to be produced by the project is less than 0.75 and the property is acquired

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: before 2034, 40%,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: if the expected carbon intensity of the hydrogen to be produced by the project is 0.75 or greater and less than two and the property is acquired

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: before 2034, 25%,

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: if the expected carbon intensity of the hydrogen to be produced by the project is two or greater and less than four and the property is acquired

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: before 2034, 15%,

Clause.Label: (C)
Clause.Text: after 2034, 0%, and

Subparagraph.Label: (iv)
Subparagraph.Text: if the expected carbon intensity of the hydrogen to be produced by the project is four or greater, 0%; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: in respect of the capital cost of eligible clean hydrogen property that is clean ammonia equipment or equipment described in any of subparagraphs (c)(iv) to (vi) of the definition eligible clean hydrogen property in this subsection that is used solely in connection with clean ammonia equipment acquired by a qualifying taxpayer for use in a clean hydrogen project,

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: subject to subparagraph (ii), if the equipment is acquired

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: before 2034, 15%,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: if the expected carbon intensity of the hydrogen to be produced by the project and used in the production of ammonia is four or greater, 0%. (pourcentage déterminé)

Subsection.Text: If a qualifying taxpayer files with its return of income for a taxation year a prescribed form containing prescribed information, the taxpayer is deemed to have paid on its balance-due day for the year an amount on account of the taxpayer’s tax payable under this Part for the year equal to the taxpayer’s clean hydrogen tax credit for the year.

For the purposes of this section, paragraph 12(1)(t), subsection 13(7.1), the description of I in the definition undepreciated capital cost in subsection 13(21), subsection 53(2) and sections 127.44, 127.45, 127.49, 127.491 and 129, the amount deemed under subsection (2) to have been paid by a taxpayer for a taxation year is deemed to have been deducted from the taxpayer’s tax otherwise payable under this Part for the year.

A payment on account of tax payable shall not be deemed to be paid under subsection (2) if the taxpayer does not file with the Minister the prescribed form containing prescribed information referred to in subsection (2) in respect of the amount on or before the later of December 31, 2026 and the day that is one year after the taxpayer’s filing-due date for the year and, if the prescribed form is filed after the taxpayer’s filing-due date for the year, no payment by the taxpayer is deemed to arise under that subsection until the prescribed form containing prescribed information has been filed with the Minister.

For the purpose of this section, eligible clean hydrogen property is deemed not to have been acquired before the property becomes available for use by the taxpayer, determined without reference to paragraphs 13(27)(c) and (28)(d).
For the purposes of calculating the carbon intensity of hydrogen produced and to be produced by a clean hydrogen project of a taxpayer,

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the most recent Fuel LCA Model at the time of filing by the taxpayer of the most recent related clean hydrogen project plan with the Minister of Natural Resources shall be used, unless, at the time of filing any compliance report under subsection (16), the taxpayer elects to use a subsequent version of the Fuel LCA Model in calculating the actual carbon intensity of the project;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: subject to paragraph (j), in applying the Fuel LCA Model, an assessment of emissions from the production of hydrogen by the project and upstream emissions from the production of inputs to the hydrogen-production process shall be taken into account;

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: the quantity of hydrogen produced by the project is to be adjusted to take into account any hydrogen that is consumed in the production process;

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: if the taxpayer produces hydrogen from eligible hydrocarbons,

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: any captured carbon that is subject to an ineligible use is deemed not to be captured, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: any captured carbon that is subject to an eligible use (as defined in subsection 127.44(1)) is deemed to be permanently stored;

Paragraph.Label: (e)
Paragraph.Text: if, in connection with hydrogen production, the taxpayer generates or purchases, or proposes to generate or purchase, electricity that is

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: generated, or to be generated, by the taxpayer from

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: an eligible electricity generation source, the contribution of the electricity to carbon intensity is to correspond with the input carbon intensity of the technology-specific electricity in the Fuel LCA Model,

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: on-site generation equipment that is used solely to convert any one or a combination of hydrogen, heat described in subparagraph (i)(i) or (ii) or eligible hydrocarbons (with carbon dioxide captured using a CCUS process) into electricity that supports the production of hydrogen from eligible hydrocarbons, the contribution of the electricity to carbon intensity is to be modelled as part of the project,

Clause.Label: (C)
Clause.Text: a generator used for startup or emergency backup operations, the contribution of the electricity to carbon intensity is to be modelled as part of the project, and

Clause.Label: (D)
Clause.Text: a generation source other than as described in any of clauses (A) to (C), the carbon intensity of the project is deemed to be greater than 4.5,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: purchased, or to be purchased, pursuant to an eligible power purchase agreement,

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: the contribution of the electricity to carbon intensity is to correspond with the input carbon intensity of the technology-specific electricity in the Fuel LCA Model, and

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: the contribution of the electricity to expected carbon intensity is to be calculated in proportion to the number of years for which the agreement will be in place during the first 20 years of the project’s operations, and

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: otherwise sourced, or to be sourced, from a provincial grid, the contribution to carbon intensity of the net positive quantity of the electricity (after subtracting any electricity purchased by the taxpayer under an eligible power purchase agreement or generated by the taxpayer in respect of the project that is, in either case, transmitted to the grid by the taxpayer) is to be based on the input carbon intensity of the provincial grid in the Fuel LCA Model;

Paragraph.Label: (f)
Paragraph.Text: in calculating the quantity of electricity described in paragraph (e), if the sum of the quantities of electricity from sources described in subparagraphs (e)(i) and (ii) exceeds the total electricity consumed or to be consumed by the project, then the electricity consumed or to be consumed by the project is deemed to be generated

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: first, from the source described in subparagraph (e)(i), and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: second, from the source described in subparagraph (e)(ii) to the extent of any excess;

Paragraph.Label: (g)
Paragraph.Text: if the project uses, or proposes to use, eligible hydrocarbons for the purpose of producing hydrogen,

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: where the eligible hydrocarbon is an eligible renewable hydrocarbon in respect of the taxpayer,

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: the contribution of that eligible renewable hydrocarbon to carbon intensity is to be based on the most recent CFR carbon intensity that is determined under the Clean Fuel Regulations, adjusted as necessary, and

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: the contribution of that eligible renewable hydrocarbon to expected carbon intensity is to be calculated in proportion to the number of years for which that hydrocarbon will be used during the first 20 years of the project’s operations, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: in any other case, the input carbon intensity of the relevant eligible hydrocarbon is to be taken into account in applying the Fuel LCA Model;

Paragraph.Label: (h)
Paragraph.Text: if the taxpayer disposes of any environmental attributes associated with any electricity described in subparagraph (e)(i) or (ii) or any eligible renewable hydrocarbon described in subparagraph (g)(i), the carbon intensity of the project is deemed to be greater than 4.5;

Paragraph.Label: (i)
Paragraph.Text: if, in connection with hydrogen production or electricity production in support of hydrogen production, the taxpayer uses heat energy

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: recovered from hydrogen production, recovered from electricity production by the taxpayer in support of hydrogen production or produced by the taxpayer from the combustion of hydrogen or eligible hydrocarbons (with carbon dioxide captured using a CCUS process), the contribution of the heat to carbon intensity is to be modelled as part of the project,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: recovered from a non-hydrogen production process of the taxpayer, or purchased from a vendor that produced the heat from eligible hydrocarbons or recovered the waste heat from a production process, the contribution of the heat to carbon intensity is to correspond with the input carbon intensity of purchased steam in the Fuel LCA Model, and

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: from a source other than as described in subparagraph (i) or (ii), the carbon intensity of the project is deemed to be greater than 4.5;

Paragraph.Label: (j)
Paragraph.Text: the contribution to carbon intensity of the following may be disregarded:

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: delivering, collecting, recovering, treating or recirculating water, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: energy used to compress hydrogen beyond 30 bar;

Paragraph.Label: (k)
Paragraph.Text: emissions related to the production of the following substances or types of energy produced in conjunction with hydrogen shall be attributed to hydrogen production:

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: off-gas (including tail gas and other fuel gas),

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: oxygen,

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: nitrogen, if the nitrogen is not used by the taxpayer in another production process or sold for commercial use, and

Subparagraph.Label: (iv)
Subparagraph.Text: heat from hydrogen production;

Paragraph.Label: (l)
Paragraph.Text: emissions related to heat produced in conjunction with electricity production by the taxpayer in support of hydrogen production shall be attributed to hydrogen production, if the heat is not used by the taxpayer in another production process or sold for commercial use;

Paragraph.Label: (m)
Paragraph.Text: emissions associated with energy used in the purification of hydrogen shall be attributed to hydrogen production; and

Paragraph.Label: (n)
Paragraph.Text: the Clean Hydrogen Investment Tax Credit – Carbon Intensity Modelling Guidance Document published by the Government of Canada is to apply conclusively with respect to the calculation of carbon intensity, except as otherwise required under this section.

Subsection.Text: Subsection (8) applies in respect of a qualified clean hydrogen project of a taxpayer if, before the first day of the compliance period of the project,

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the Minister of Natural Resources determines that there has been a material change to the project design and requests that the taxpayer file a revised project plan for the project;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the taxpayer

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: does not file the final detailed engineering designs with the Minister of Natural Resources in accordance with paragraph (9)(d),

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: changes the project’s eligible pathway, or

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: reasonably expects that there will be an increase (as compared to the most recent project plan for the project) of more than 0.5 kilograms of carbon dioxide equivalent per kilogram of hydrogen to be produced by the project;

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: any eligible power purchase agreement referenced in the most recent clean hydrogen project plan of the taxpayer

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: has not been finalized and executed so as to become legally binding, or

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: has been materially modified or terminated; or

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: any environmental attributes associated with the agreement have been disposed of by the taxpayer.

Subsection.MarginalNote: Rules relating to revised project plan
Subsection.Text: If this subsection applies,

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the taxpayer shall file, within 180 days, a revised clean hydrogen project plan in respect of the project with the Minister of Natural Resources, in the form and manner determined by the Minister of Natural Resources;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: if the Minister of Natural Resources is satisfied that the project will meet the requirements in paragraphs (a) to (c) of the definition qualified clean hydrogen project,

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the Minister of Natural Resources shall confirm, with all due dispatch, the revised plan,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the taxpayer’s clean hydrogen tax credit shall be redetermined, as of the date of the filing of the revised plan, based on the expected carbon intensity set out in the revised plan, and

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: if the taxpayer previously deducted an amount in respect of a clean hydrogen tax credit, subsection (18) applies as if the compliance period ended on that date and the average actual carbon intensity of the project was equal to the expected carbon intensity set out in the revised plan;

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: if the Minister of Natural Resources is not satisfied in accordance with paragraph (b) and does not issue a confirmation described in subparagraph (b)(i) within one year after the filing of the taxpayer’s revised plan, then, as of the expiry of that period,

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the project is deemed not to be a qualified clean hydrogen project,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the average actual carbon intensity of the project is deemed to be greater than 4.5, and

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: subsection (18) applies as if the compliance period of the project ended on the expiry date of that period; and

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: if the taxpayer fails to file a revised clean hydrogen project plan in accordance with paragraph (a), then, as of the expiry of the 180-day period described in paragraph (a),

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: subject to subparagraph (ii),

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: the project is deemed not to be a qualified clean hydrogen project,

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: the average actual carbon intensity of the project is deemed to be greater than 4.5, and

Clause.Label: (C)
Clause.Text: subsection (18) applies as if the compliance period of the project ended on the expiry date of that period, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: once the taxpayer has filed the revised clean hydrogen project plan, subparagraph (i) is deemed never to have applied.

Subsection.MarginalNote: Clean hydrogen project determination and rules
Subsection.Text: For the purposes of this section,

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the Minister may, in consultation with the Minister of Natural Resources, determine that one or more clean hydrogen projects is one project or multiple projects

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: at any time before the Minister of Natural Resources confirms the expected carbon intensity of the hydrogen to be produced by a clean hydrogen project, or

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: if a taxpayer files or is required to file a revised clean hydrogen project plan in accordance with subsection (8), at any time before the Minister of Natural Resources confirms the revised plan;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: any determination under paragraph (a) is deemed to result in the clean hydrogen project or clean hydrogen projects, as the case may be, being one project or multiple projects, as the case may be;

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: for each project determined under paragraph (a), a taxpayer shall file a separate clean hydrogen project plan with the Minister of Natural Resources (in the form and manner determined by the Minister of Natural Resources) on or before the day that is 180 days after the determination is made;

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: in respect of each clean hydrogen project, the taxpayer shall file final detailed engineering designs with the Minister of Natural Resources by the earlier of the day on which hydrogen is first produced by the project and the day that is 60 days after the final detailed engineering designs are prepared; and

Paragraph.Label: (e)
Paragraph.Text: the Minister of Natural Resources may request from the taxpayer all documentation and information necessary for the Minister of Natural Resources to fulfill a responsibility under this section and may refuse to confirm the taxpayer’s clean hydrogen project plan or revised clean hydrogen project plan if such documentation or information is not provided by the taxpayer on or before the day that is 180 days after it was requested.

Subsection.MarginalNote: Capital cost of clean hydrogen property
Subsection.Text: For the purposes of this section, the capital cost of eligible clean hydrogen property to a taxpayer shall

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: not include any amount

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: in respect of which an amount was previously deducted under this section by any person,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: in respect of which any other clean economy tax credit (as defined in subsection 127.47(1)) was deducted by any person, or

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: that has, by virtue of section 21, been added to the cost of a property;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: be determined without reference to subsections 13(7.1) and (7.4);

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: be reduced by the total of all amounts, each of which can reasonably be considered to be in respect of the property and is

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: an amount of any government assistance or non-government assistance received by the taxpayer in or before the taxation year in which the property was acquired, or

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: an amount not described in subparagraph (i) that, in the taxation year, the taxpayer is entitled to or can reasonably be expected to receive and that would be government assistance or non-government assistance if it were received by the taxpayer;

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: be determined with reference to subsections 127(11.6) to (11.8) in respect of an expenditure or cost to a taxpayer except that

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the reference in subsection 127(11.6) to subsection 127(11.5) is to be read as a reference to section 127.48,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the reference in subsection 127(11.6) to subsection 127(26) is to be read as a reference to subsection 127.48(13), and

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: the term “qualified expenditure” is to be read as an expenditure eligible to be added to the capital cost of an eligible clean hydrogen property;

Paragraph.Label: (e)
Paragraph.Text: not include any amount in respect of an expenditure incurred for a preliminary clean hydrogen work activity;

Paragraph.Label: (f)
Paragraph.Text: if the property is dual-use electricity and heat equipment, project support equipment or equipment described in any of subparagraphs (c)(iv) to (vi) of the definition eligible clean hydrogen property in subsection (1), excluding equipment used all or substantially all to support a qualified clean hydrogen project, be equal to the proportion of the capital cost of the equipment that

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: if the equipment is described in paragraph (a) of the definition dual-use electricity and heat equipment in subsection (1), the quantity of energy expected to be produced for use in the project over the first 20 years of the project’s operations is of the total quantity of energy expected to be produced by the equipment in that period (determined without regard to energy produced and consumed by the equipment in the process of producing energy), based on the project’s most recent clean hydrogen project plan,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: if the equipment is described in paragraph (b) of the definition dual-use electricity and heat equipment in subsection (1) or paragraph (a) of the definition project support equipment in subsection (1), the quantity of electrical energy expected to be transmitted by the equipment for use in the project over the first 20 years of the project’s operations is of the total quantity of electrical energy expected to be transmitted by the equipment in that period (determined without regard to electrical energy consumed by the equipment in the process of transmission), based on the project’s most recent clean hydrogen project plan,

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: if the equipment is described in paragraph (b) of the definition project support equipment in subsection (1), the quantity of electrical or heat energy expected to be distributed by the equipment (or if it is equipment that expands the capacity of existing equipment, the electrical or heat energy expected to be distributed by the existing and new equipment) for use in the project over the first 20 years of the project’s operations is of the total quantity of electrical or heat energy expected to be distributed by the equipment (or the existing and new equipment) in that period (determined without regard to energy consumed by the equipment in the process of distribution), based on the project’s most recent clean hydrogen project plan,

Subparagraph.Label: (iv)
Subparagraph.Text: if the equipment is described in paragraph (c) of the definition project support equipment in subsection (1), the mass of water expected to be supplied to the project over the first 20 years of the project’s operations is of the total mass of water expected to be processed by the equipment in that period, based on the project’s most recent clean hydrogen project plan, and

Subparagraph.Label: (v)
Subparagraph.Text: if the equipment is described in any of subparagraphs (c)(iv) to (vi) of the definition eligible clean hydrogen property in subsection (1) and supports equipment described in any of subparagraphs (i) to (iv), is determined under that subparagraph; and

Paragraph.Label: (g)
Paragraph.Text: after applying paragraph (f), if the property is dual-use hydrogen and ammonia equipment, dual-use electricity and heat equipment, project support equipment or equipment described in any of subparagraphs (c)(iv) to (vi) of the definition eligible clean hydrogen property in subsection (1) and that property is used in the production of hydrogen and ammonia, be allocated between two separate capital cost amounts, with each amount determined based on the percentage of the expected use of the equipment that is attributable to hydrogen production and ammonia production, and

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the capital cost amount that is attributable to hydrogen production is deemed to be in respect of property described in paragraph (a) of the definition specified percentage in subsection (1) and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the capital cost amount that is attributable to ammonia production is deemed to be in respect of property described in paragraph (b) of the definition specified percentage in subsection (1).

Subsection.Text: Where a taxpayer has, in a particular taxation year, repaid (or has not received and can no longer reasonably be expected to receive) an amount of government assistance or non-government assistance that was applied to reduce the capital cost of a particular eligible clean hydrogen property under paragraph (10)(c) for a preceding taxation year, the amount repaid (or no longer expected to be received) is to be added to the cost to the taxpayer of a separate eligible clean hydrogen property that is deemed to be acquired in the particular year for the purposes of this section, provided that a transaction or event described in paragraph (21)(c) has not occurred in respect of the particular property.

Subject to section 127.47, where, in a particular taxation year of a qualifying taxpayer who is a member of a partnership, an amount would be determined under subsection (2) in respect of the partnership, for its taxation year that ends in the particular year, if the partnership were a taxable Canadian corporation and its fiscal period were its taxation year, the portion of that amount that can reasonably be considered to be the taxpayer’s share thereof shall be added in computing the clean hydrogen tax credit of the taxpayer at the end of the particular year.

For the purposes of this section, where any part of the capital cost of a taxpayer’s particular eligible clean hydrogen property is unpaid on the day that is 180 days after the end of the taxation year in which a deduction in respect of a clean hydrogen tax credit would otherwise be available in respect of the particular property, such amount is to be

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: excluded from the capital cost of the particular property in the year; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: added to the capital cost of a separate eligible clean hydrogen property that is deemed to be acquired by the taxpayer at the time the amount is paid, provided that a transaction or event described in paragraph (21)(c) has not occurred in respect of the particular property.

Subsection.MarginalNote: Property deemed in respect of qualified project
Subsection.Text: A property is deemed to have been acquired in respect of a qualified clean hydrogen project if

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the property was acquired in respect of a clean hydrogen project that was not a qualified clean hydrogen project because the Minister of Natural Resources was not accepting the filing of clean hydrogen project plans during the taxation year in which the property was acquired; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: in a subsequent taxation year, the project becomes a qualified clean hydrogen project.

Subsection.Text: Subsection (2) does not apply if an eligible clean hydrogen property – or an interest in a person or partnership that has, directly or indirectly, an interest in, or for civil law, a right in, such property – is a tax shelter investment for the purpose of section 143.2.

If a clean hydrogen tax credit was deducted in any taxation year by a taxpayer in respect of a qualified clean hydrogen project, the taxpayer shall file, with its return of income for each taxation year that begins or ends during the compliance period in respect of the project, a prescribed form containing prescribed information in respect of the operations of the project.

If a clean hydrogen tax credit was deducted by a taxpayer in respect of a qualified clean hydrogen project, the taxpayer shall file with the Minister and the Minister of Natural Resources, within 180 days after the end of each operating year, a compliance report in prescribed form and manner including

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the actual carbon intensity of the hydrogen produced by the project during the year;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the quantity, in kilograms, of hydrogen that is produced by the project during the year;

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: any shutdown time of the project in respect of the year;

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: for the compliance report in respect of the fifth operating year, a report that verifies the actual carbon intensity of the hydrogen produced during each operating year of the compliance period, prepared by a qualified verification firm in respect of the project; and

Paragraph.Label: (e)
Paragraph.Text: any information required in guidelines published by the Minister of Natural Resources, including the Clean Hydrogen Investment Tax Credit – Validation and Verification Guidance Document.

Subsection.Text: If more than one person is required by this section to file any documentation or information with the Minister or the Minister of Natural Resources in respect of a clean hydrogen project (including, but not limited to, a revised clean hydrogen project plan, a form described in subsection (15) or a compliance report described in subsection (16)), the filing with full and accurate disclosure by any one of such persons of the documentation or information is deemed to have been made by each person to whom the relevant requirement applies.

Each taxpayer that fails to file a compliance report for a project as described in subsection (16) is liable to a penalty, for each such failure, in an amount, not exceeding the total of all clean hydrogen tax credits deducted by the taxpayer in respect of the project, equal to the amount determined by the formula

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the total of all amounts, each of which is the amount of a clean hydrogen tax credit in respect of the project deducted by the taxpayer for a taxation year that ended before the applicable date in subsection (16); and
is the number of days during which the failure continues.

Subsection.Text: In the taxation year of a taxpayer in which the compliance period of the taxpayer’s qualified clean hydrogen project ends, if the average actual carbon intensity of the hydrogen produced is greater than the most recent expected carbon intensity that was used to determine a clean hydrogen tax credit in respect of the project, there shall be added to the taxpayer’s tax otherwise payable under this Part for the taxation year an amount equal to the total of all amounts, each of which is determined by the formula

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the specified percentage that was applied to the capital cost of the eligible clean hydrogen property forming part of the project in determining a clean hydrogen tax credit of the taxpayer;
is the specified percentage that would have applied to the capital cost of the property if the expected carbon intensity were equal to the average actual carbon intensity of the project; and
is the capital cost of the property on which the clean hydrogen tax credit was deducted.

Subsection.Text: For the purpose of subsection (18), the Minister of Natural Resources shall review each of the taxpayer’s compliance reports described in subsection (16) and the Minister may, in consultation with the Minister of Natural Resources, make a determination or redetermination of the actual carbon intensity of the hydrogen produced by a taxpayer’s clean hydrogen project for any operating year during the compliance period of the project.

Subsection (18) does not apply to a taxpayer if the difference between the average actual carbon intensity of the taxpayer’s qualified clean hydrogen project and the expected carbon intensity of the project is 0.5 or less.

Subsection.MarginalNote: Recapture of clean hydrogen tax credit — application
Subsection.Text: Subsection (22) applies in a taxation year if

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: a taxpayer acquired an eligible clean hydrogen property in the year or any of the preceding 20 calendar years;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the taxpayer became entitled to a clean hydrogen tax credit in respect of the capital cost, or a portion of the capital cost, of the property; and

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: in the year, the property is converted to a non-hydrogen or ammonia use, is exported from Canada or is disposed of without having been previously exported or converted to a non-hydrogen or ammonia use.

Subsection.MarginalNote: Recapture of clean hydrogen tax credit
Subsection.Text: If this subsection applies for a taxation year in respect of an eligible clean hydrogen property, there shall be added to the taxpayer’s tax otherwise payable under this Part for the year an amount determined by the formula

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the amount of the taxpayer’s clean hydrogen tax credit in respect of the property;
is the total of all amounts, each of which can reasonably be considered to be the portion of any amount previously paid by the taxpayer because of subsection (18) in respect of the property;
is an amount, not exceeding the amount determined for D, equal to

FormulaParagraph.Label: (a)
FormulaParagraph.Text: if the property is disposed of to a person or partnership who deals at arm’s length with the taxpayer, the proceeds of disposition of the property, and

FormulaParagraph.Label: (b)
FormulaParagraph.Text: in any other case, the fair market value of the property; and

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the capital cost of the property on which the clean hydrogen tax credit was deducted.

Subsection.MarginalNote: Election — sale of clean hydrogen project
Subsection.Text: If at any time a qualifying taxpayer (referred to in this subsection as the “vendor”) disposes of all or substantially all of its property comprising a qualified clean hydrogen project of the taxpayer to another taxable Canadian corporation (referred to in this subsection as the “purchaser”), and the vendor and the purchaser jointly elect in prescribed form, on or before the day that is the earliest of the days on or before which any taxpayer making the election is required to file a return of income pursuant to section 150 for the taxation year in which the transaction occurred, to have this subsection apply, the following rules apply:

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the purchaser is deemed to have acquired any eligible clean hydrogen property of the vendor at the times acquired by the vendor;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the provisions of this Act that applied to the vendor in respect of the property that are relevant to the application of the Act in respect of the property after that time are deemed to have applied to the purchaser and, for greater certainty, the purchaser is deemed to have claimed the clean hydrogen tax credits determined under subsection (2) that could have been claimed by the vendor, before that time, in respect of the project;

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: any clean hydrogen project plans that were filed by the vendor in respect of the project before that time are deemed to have been filed by the purchaser;

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: the purchaser is or will be liable for amounts in respect of the property for which the vendor would be liable under this section in respect of actions, transactions or events that occur after that time as if the vendor had undertaken them or otherwise participated in them; and

Paragraph.Label: (e)
Paragraph.Text: subsection (22) does not apply to the vendor in respect of the disposition of property to the purchaser.

Subsection.Text: If subsection (22) applies to a taxpayer or partnership for a particular year, the taxpayer or partnership, as the case may be, shall notify the Minister in prescribed form and manner on or before the taxpayer’s filing-due date for the year or the day when a return is required by section 229 of the Income Tax Regulations to be filed in respect of the fiscal period of the partnership.

Subject to section 127.47, if subsection (12) has at any time applied to add an amount in computing the clean hydrogen tax credit of a current or former member of a partnership, subsections (18) to (23) apply to determine amounts in respect of the partnership as if the partnership was a taxable Canadian corporation, its fiscal period were its taxation year and it had deducted all of the clean hydrogen tax credits that were previously added in computing the clean hydrogen tax credit of any member of the partnership because of the application of subsection (12) in respect of its partnership interest.

Subsection.MarginalNote: Member’s share of recovery or recapture
Subsection.Text: Unless subsection (27) applies, if, in a taxation year, a taxpayer is a member of a partnership, the amount that can reasonably be considered to be the taxpayer’s share of any amount of tax determined because of subsection (25) in respect of the partnership shall be added to the taxpayer’s tax otherwise payable under this Part for the year.

A taxable Canadian corporation that is a member of a partnership during a fiscal period of the partnership may elect, in prescribed form and manner, to add to its tax payable under this Part for its taxation year that includes the end of the fiscal period the total amount of tax determined for that fiscal period because of subsection (25) in respect of the partnership.

Subsection.MarginalNote: Joint and several, or solidary, liability
Subsection.Text: Each current or former member of a partnership is jointly and severally, or solidarily, liable for any portion of the amount of tax — determined because of subsection (25) in respect of the partnership for a fiscal period — that is not added to the tax payable

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: of a qualifying taxpayer under subsection (26); or

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: of a taxable Canadian corporation because of subsection (27) and paid by the corporation by its filing-due date for its taxation year that includes the end of the fiscal period.

Subsection.Text: If a particular taxpayer was, at the time that an amount is determined because of subsection (25) in respect of the partnership for a taxation year, no longer a member of the partnership, the particular taxpayer’s liability for tax because of subsection (28) is limited to the total of all amounts each of which is an amount determined for the particular taxpayer under subsection (2) because of its membership in the partnership.

For the purpose of applying subsection 161(1) to an amount of tax payable because of subsection (18) (other than an amount payable because of subsection (8)), the balance-due day of a taxpayer is deemed to be the balance-due day of the taxation year for the related clean hydrogen tax credit under subsection (2).

For the purpose of applying subsection (2) in respect of a property acquired after the compliance period of a qualified clean hydrogen project of the taxpayer, the expected carbon intensity of the project is deemed to be the greater of the expected carbon intensity otherwise determined and the average actual carbon intensity for the compliance period of the project.
The purpose of this section is to encourage the investment of capital in the production of clean hydrogen and clean ammonia in Canada.

Subsection.MarginalNote: Authority of the Minister of Natural Resources
Subsection.Text: For the purpose of determining whether a property is an eligible clean hydrogen property, the Clean Hydrogen Investment Tax Credit – Technical and Equipment Guidance Document published by the Department of Natural Resources is to apply conclusively with respect to engineering and scientific matters.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Subsection.Text: The following definitions apply in this section.

Definition.Text: CTM investment tax credit of a qualifying taxpayer for a taxation year means

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the total of all amounts each of which is the specified percentage of the capital cost to the taxpayer of CTM property acquired by the taxpayer in the year for a CTM use; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the total of all amounts required by subsection (8) to be added in computing the taxpayer’s CTM investment tax credit at the end of the year. (crédit d’impôt à l’investissement pour la FTP)

Definition.Text: CTM property means property of a taxpayer, other than excluded property,

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: situated in Canada and intended for use exclusively in Canada;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: that has not been used, or acquired for use or lease, for any purpose whatever before it was acquired by the taxpayer;

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: that, if it is to be leased by the taxpayer to another person or a partnership, is

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: leased to a qualifying taxpayer or a partnership all the members of which are qualifying taxpayers, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: leased in the ordinary course of carrying on a business in Canada by the taxpayer whose principal business is selling or servicing property of that type, or whose principal business is leasing property, lending money, purchasing conditional sales contracts, accounts receivable, bills of sale, chattel mortgages or hypothecary claims on movables, bills of exchange or other obligations representing all or part of the sale price of merchandise or services, or any combination thereof; and

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: described in Schedule II to the Income Tax Regulations that

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: is included in

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: paragraph (a) or (c) of Class 8,

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: paragraph (a) of Class 43,

Clause.Label: (C)
Clause.Text: Class 43.1 that would otherwise be included in any of clauses (A), (B) and (E),

Clause.Label: (D)
Clause.Text: Class 43.2 that would otherwise be included in clause (C), or

Clause.Label: (E)
Clause.Text: Class 53,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: is included in

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: paragraph (b) of Class 8, or would be included in paragraph (b) of Class 8 if that paragraph were read without reference to the word “solely” and if the word “building” were read as “structure”,

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: Class 43.1 that would otherwise be included in clause (A), or

Clause.Label: (C)
Clause.Text: Class 43.2 that would otherwise be included in clause (B),

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: is included in

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: subparagraph (k)(i) of Class 10, provided that the property would otherwise be in paragraph (a) or (c) of Class 8,

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: subparagraph (k)(ii) of Class 10,

Clause.Label: (C)
Clause.Text: paragraph (b) of Class 41, or in paragraph (b) of Class 41.2, that would otherwise be included in clauses (A) or (B),

Clause.Label: (D)
Clause.Text: paragraph (b) of Class 43,

Clause.Label: (E)
Clause.Text: Class 43.1 that would otherwise be included in any of clauses (A) to (D), or

Clause.Label: (F)
Clause.Text: Class 43.2 that would otherwise be included in clause (E),

Subparagraph.Label: (iv)
Subparagraph.Text: is included in paragraph (d) or (j) of Class 12,

Subparagraph.Label: (v)
Subparagraph.Text: is included in

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: paragraph (a) or (e) of Class 10 or Class 38, but excluding any property that is designed or adapted for use on streets and highways, or

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: Class 56,

Subparagraph.Label: (vi)
Subparagraph.Text: would be described in any of subparagraphs (i) to (v) if the word “mine” in Schedule II of the Income Tax Regulations were read as “mine, well or tailing pond”; or

Subparagraph.Label: (vii)
Subparagraph.Text: is incorporated into another property described in any of subparagraphs (i) to (vi), as part of a refurbishment of the other property provided that on completion of the refurbishment the other property is still described in any of subparagraphs (i) to (vi). (bien de FTP)

Definition.Text: CTM use means the use of a property all or substantially all in

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: activities described in paragraph (a) or (c) of the definition qualified zero emission technology manufacturing activities in section 5202 of the Income Tax Regulations;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: activities described in paragraph (a) or (b) of the definition qualifying mineral activity if the property is used to produce primarily qualifying materials, determined based on the value of all commercial outputs in accordance with subsection (2.2); or

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: activities described in any of paragraphs (c) to (f) of the definition qualifying mineral activity if the property is used to produce all or substantially all qualifying materials, determined based on the value of all commercial outputs in accordance with subsection (2.2). (utilisation pour la FTP)

Definition.Text: excluded property means any property used in the production of battery cells or modules if the production has benefitted from, or can reasonably be expected to benefit from, support under a contribution agreement with the Government of Canada referred to in section 7300 of the Income Tax Regulations. (bien exclu)
government assistance has the same meaning as in subsection 127(9). (aide gouvernementale)
independent engineer or geoscientist means an individual who

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: is a qualified professional engineer or professional geoscientist as defined in subsection 127(9); and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: is at all times at arm’s length with, independent of, and not employed by, each taxpayer claiming a related CTM investment tax credit. (ingénieur ou géoscientifique indépendant)

Definition.Text: non-CTM use means a use of a property other than a CTM use. (utilisation autre que pour la FTP)
non-government assistance has the same meaning as in subsection 127(9). (aide non gouvernementale)
permitted element means hydrogen, carbon, nitrogen, oxygen, phosphorus, sulfur, selenium, sodium, potassium, a halogen or a noble gas. (élément autorisé)
qualifying material means

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: lithium;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: cobalt;

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: nickel;

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: copper;

Paragraph.Label: (e)
Paragraph.Text: rare earth elements;

Paragraph.Label: (f)
Paragraph.Text: graphite;

Paragraph.Label: (g)
Paragraph.Text: antimony;

Paragraph.Label: (h)
Paragraph.Text: gallium;

Paragraph.Label: (i)
Paragraph.Text: germanium;

Paragraph.Label: (j)
Paragraph.Text: indium; and

Paragraph.Label: (k)
Paragraph.Text: scandium. (matériau admissible)

Definition.Text: qualifying mineral activity means

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the extraction of resources from a mineral deposit or from a tailing pond;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: a specified mineral processing activity that is performed at a mine site or well site;

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: a specified mineral processing activity that is performed at a location other than a location described in paragraph (b);

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: a recycling activity that is

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: sorting, disassembly or shredding of a recyclable material, or

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: a material processing activity substantially similar to a specified mineral processing activity;

Paragraph.Label: (e)
Paragraph.Text: a synthetic graphite activity that is

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: performed during or after the graphitization stage, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: a material processing activity substantially similar to a specified mineral processing activity; or

Paragraph.Label: (f)
Paragraph.Text: spheronization of graphite or coating of spheronized graphite. (activité minière admissible)

Definition.Text: qualifying taxpayer means a taxable Canadian corporation. (contribuable admissible)
refurbishment means significant alterations, renovations, improvements or additions to a property to substantially

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: extend its useful life;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: increase its capacity; or

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: improve its efficiency. (remise en état)

Definition.Text: safe harbour price of a commercial output means the five-year historical average spot price, determined at the end of the taxation year of a taxpayer in which a CTM investment tax credit is deducted in respect of a CTM property, of that output calculated

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: using prices from a recognized commodities exchange; or

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: if prices referred to in paragraph (a) are not available in respect of the output, in accordance with normal and accepted commercial practices in the industry. (prix au titre de la règle d’exonération)

Definition.Text: safe harbour price method, in respect of a CTM property of a taxpayer, means the determination, on an annual basis, of the value of all commercial outputs from the property based on

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the safe harbour price of the expected commercial outputs from the property if the year for which the determination is made is prior to a year in which the property was used by the taxpayer in commercial production; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the safe harbour price of the actual commercial outputs from the property in a year in which the property was used by the taxpayer in commercial production. (méthode de détermination du prix au titre de la règle d’exonération)

Definition.Text: specified fair market value method, in respect of a CTM property, means the determination, on an annual basis, of the value of all the commercial outputs from the property based on

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the fair market value, determined at the end of the relevant taxation year, of the expected commercial outputs from the property if the year for which the determination is made is prior to a year in which the property was used by the taxpayer in commercial production; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the fair market value, determined at the end of the relevant taxation year, of the actual commercial outputs from the property in a year in which the property was used by the taxpayer in commercial production. (méthode de détermination de la juste valeur marchande déterminée)

Definition.Text: specified mineral processing activity means a mineral processing activity (including crushing, grinding, milling, separation, sieving, screening, froth floatation, leaching, recrystallization, precipitation, drying, evaporation, heating, calcinating, roasting, smelting, casting of ingots, refining, purification, distillation, electrodeposition and surface roughening of electrodeposited foil) that occurs prior to or as part of a process intended to

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: increase the purity of at least one qualifying material; or

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: produce a material with non-trace amounts of a single qualifying material, and without non-trace amounts of any elements other than permitted elements. (activité de traitement des minéraux déterminée)

Definition.Text: specified percentage means in respect of a CTM property of the taxpayer that is acquired

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: before January 1, 2024, determined without reference to subsection (4), nil;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: subject to paragraph (a)

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: after December 31, 2023 and before January 1, 2032, 30%,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: after December 31, 2031 and before January 1, 2033, 20%,

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: after December 31, 2032 and before January 1, 2034, 10%, and

Subparagraph.Label: (iv)
Subparagraph.Text: after December 31, 2033 and before January 1, 2035, 5%; and

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: after December 31, 2034, nil. (pourcentage déterminé)

Subsection.Text: If a qualifying taxpayer files with its return of income for a taxation year a prescribed form containing prescribed information, the taxpayer is deemed to have paid on its balance-due day for the year an amount on account of the taxpayer’s tax payable under this Part for the year equal to the taxpayer’s CTM investment tax credit for the year.

Notwithstanding subsection (2), a CTM investment tax credit in respect of property used, or to be used, by the taxpayer or by a partnership of which the taxpayer is a member, in any activity described in paragraph (a) or (b) of the definition qualifying mineral activity in subsection (1), is deemed to be nil unless a taxpayer files with the Minister, together with the form and information described in subsection (2), a certification by an independent engineer or geoscientist in respect of the taxpayer in the prescribed form attesting that the property is being used, or is to be used,

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: at a particular mine site or well site of the taxpayer or of a partnership of which the taxpayer is a member, as the case may be; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: in accordance with a plan that primarily targets qualifying materials, determined based on the value of all commercial outputs expected to be produced in accordance with subsection (2.2).

Subsection.MarginalNote: Valuation of qualifying mineral activity outputs
Subsection.Text: In the prescribed form referred to in subsection (2) that is filed by a taxpayer for a taxation year, the taxpayer must elect, in respect of each CTM property of the taxpayer for which the taxpayer claims a CTM investment tax credit for that year, that the determination of the value of all commercial outputs from that property is to be based on either

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the specified fair market value method, or

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the safe harbour price method.

Subsection.Text: A payment on account of tax payable shall not be deemed to be paid under subsection (2) if the taxpayer does not file with the Minister the prescribed form containing prescribed information referred to in subsection (2) in respect of the amount on or before the later of December 31, 2026 and the day that is one year after the taxpayer’s filing-due date for the year and, if the prescribed form is filed after the taxpayer’s filing-due date for the year, no payment by the taxpayer is deemed to arise under that subsection until the prescribed form containing the prescribed information has been filed with the Minister.

For the purpose of this section, CTM property is deemed not to have been acquired by a taxpayer before the property is considered to have become available for use by the taxpayer, determined without reference to paragraphs 13(27)(c) and (28)(d).
For the purpose of this section, the capital cost of CTM property to a taxpayer shall

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: not include any amount

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: in respect of which an amount was previously deducted under this section by any person,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: in respect of which any other clean economy tax credit (as defined in subsection 127.47(1)) was deducted by any person,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii.1)
Subparagraph.Text: in respect of any part of the capital cost of a property if a CCUS tax credit (as defined in subsection 127.44(1)) or a clean hydrogen tax credit (as defined in subsection 127.48(1)) was deducted by any person in respect of that property, or

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: that has, by virtue of section 21, been added to the cost of a property;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: be determined without reference to subsections 13(7.1) and (7.4);

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: be reduced by the total of all amounts, each of which can reasonably be considered to be in respect of the property and is

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: an amount of any government assistance or non-government assistance received by the taxpayer in or before the taxation year in which the property was acquired, or

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: an amount not described in subparagraph (i) that, in the taxation year, the taxpayer is entitled to or can reasonably be expected to receive and that would be government assistance or non-government assistance if it were received by the taxpayer; and

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: be determined with reference to subsections 127(11.6) to (11.8) in respect of an expenditure or cost to a taxpayer except that

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the reference in subsection 127(11.6) to subsection 127(11.5) is to be read as a reference to section 127.49,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the reference in subsection 127(11.6) to subsection 127(26) is to be read as a reference to subsection 127.49(9), and

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: the term “qualified expenditure” is to be read as an expenditure eligible to be added to the capital cost of a CTM property.

Subsection.Text: For the purposes of this section, paragraph 12(1)(t), subsection 13(7.1), the description of I in the definition undepreciated capital cost in subsection 13(21) and subsection 53(2) and sections 127.44, 127.45, 127.48, 127.491 and 129, the amount deemed under subsection (2) to have been paid by a taxpayer for a taxation year is deemed to have been deducted from the taxpayer’s tax otherwise payable under this Part for the year.

Where a taxpayer has, in a particular taxation year, repaid (or has not received and can no longer reasonably be expected to receive) an amount of government assistance or non-government assistance that was applied to reduce the cost of a particular property under paragraph (5)(c) for a preceding taxation year, the amount repaid (or no longer expected to be received) is to be added to the cost to the taxpayer of a separate CTM property that is deemed to be acquired in the particular year for the purposes of this section, provided that a transaction or event described in paragraph (11)(c) has not occurred in respect of the particular property.

Subject to section 127.47, where, in a particular taxation year of a qualifying taxpayer that is a member of a partnership, an amount would be determined under subsection (2) in respect of the partnership, for its taxation year that ends in the particular year, if the partnership were a qualifying taxpayer and its fiscal period were its taxation year, the portion of that amount that can reasonably be considered to be the taxpayer’s share thereof shall be added in computing the CTM investment tax credit of the taxpayer at the end of the particular year.

For the purposes of this section, where any part of the capital cost of a taxpayer’s particular CTM property is unpaid on the day that is 180 days after the end of the taxation year in which a deduction in respect of a CTM investment tax credit would otherwise be available in respect of the particular property, such amount is to be

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: excluded from the capital cost of the particular property in the year; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: added to the capital cost of a separate CTM property that is deemed to be acquired at the time the amount is paid, provided that a transaction or event described in paragraph (11)(c) has not occurred in respect of the particular property.

Subsection.Text: Subsection (2) does not apply if a CTM property – or an interest in a person or partnership that has, directly or indirectly, an interest in, or for civil law, a right in, such property – is a tax shelter investment for the purpose of section 143.2.
Subsection (12) applies in a taxation year if

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: a taxpayer acquired a CTM property in the year or any of the preceding 10 calendar years;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the taxpayer became entitled to a CTM investment tax credit in respect of the capital cost, or a portion of the capital cost, of the property; and

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: in the year, the property (or another property that incorporates the property) is converted to a non-CTM use, is exported from Canada or is disposed of without having been previously exported or converted to a non-CTM use.

Subsection.Text: If this subsection applies, there shall be added to the taxpayer’s tax otherwise payable under this Part for the year the lesser of

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the amount of the taxpayer’s CTM investment tax credit in respect of the property, and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the amount determined by the formula

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the amount of the taxpayer’s CTM investment tax credit in respect of the property,
is

FormulaParagraph.Label: (i)
FormulaParagraph.Text: in the case where the property is disposed of to a person or partnership who deals at arm’s length with the taxpayer, the proceeds of disposition of the property, or

FormulaParagraph.Label: (ii)
FormulaParagraph.Text: in the case where the property is disposed of to a person or partnership who does not deal at arm’s length with the taxpayer, is converted to a non-CTM use or is exported from Canada, the fair market value of the property, and

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the capital cost of the property on which the CTM investment tax credit was deducted.

Subsection.Text: Subsections (11) and (12) do not apply to a taxpayer (in this subsection referred to as the “transferor”) that disposes of a property to a qualifying taxpayer (in this subsection referred to as the “purchaser”) related to the transferor, if the purchaser acquired the property in circumstances where the property would be CTM property to the purchaser (but for paragraph (b) of the definition CTM property in subsection (1)) and is used by the purchaser for a CTM use.

Subsection.MarginalNote: Certain non-arm’s length transfers — recapture deferred
Subsection.Text: If subsections (11) and (12) do not apply because of subsection (13), subsection 127(34) applies with such modifications as the circumstances require, including that the reference to subsection 127(33) be read as subsection 127.49(13).
If subsection (12) or (13) applies to a taxpayer for a taxation year, the taxpayer shall notify the Minister in prescribed form and manner on or before the taxpayer’s filing-due date for the year.
Subsection (17) applies in a fiscal period of a partnership if

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the partnership acquired a CTM property in the fiscal period or in any of the 10 preceding calendar years;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the cost, or a portion of the cost, of the property is included in an amount, a percentage of which can reasonably be considered to have been included in computing the amount determined under subsection (8) in respect of the partnership at the end of a fiscal period; and

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: in the fiscal period, the property (or another property that incorporates the property) is converted to a non-CTM use, is exported from Canada or is disposed of without having been previously exported or converted to a non-CTM use.

Subsection.Text: If this subsection applies to a fiscal period of a partnership, where a taxpayer is a member of the partnership during the fiscal period, there shall be added to the taxpayer’s tax otherwise payable under this Part for the taxpayer’s taxation year in which the fiscal period ends the amount that can reasonably be considered to be the taxpayer’s share of the amount, if any, equal to the lesser of

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the amount that can reasonably be considered to have been included in respect of the property in computing the amount determined under subsection (8) in respect of the partnership, and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the percentage described in paragraph (16)(b) of

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: where the property (or the other property) is disposed of to a person who deals at arm’s length with the partnership, the proceeds of disposition of the property, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: in any other case, the fair market value of the property (or the other property) at the time of the conversion, export or disposition.

Subsection.Text: If subsections (16) and (17) apply with respect to the property of a partnership for a fiscal period, the partnership shall notify the Minister in prescribed form and manner on or before the day when a return is required by section 229 of the Income Tax Regulations to be filed in respect of the period.

Subsection.MarginalNote: Election by member to pay tax
Subsection.Text: A qualifying taxpayer that is a member of a partnership during a fiscal period of the partnership may elect, in prescribed form and manner, to add to its tax payable under this Part for its taxation year that includes the end of the fiscal period the total amount of tax determined for that fiscal period because of subsections (16) and (17) in respect of the partnership.

Subsection.MarginalNote: Joint and several, or solidary, liability
Subsection.Text: Each current or former member of a partnership is jointly and severally, or solidarily, liable for any portion of the amount of tax — determined because of subsections (16) and (17) in respect of the partnership for a fiscal period — that is not added to the tax payable

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: of a qualifying taxpayer under subsection (17); or

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: of a qualifying taxpayer because of subsection (18.1) and paid by the qualifying taxpayer by its filing-due date for its taxation year that includes the end of the fiscal period.

Subsection.Text: If a particular taxpayer was, at the time that an amount is determined because of subsections (16) and (17) in respect of a property of the partnership for a taxation year, no longer a member of the partnership, the particular taxpayer’s liability for tax because of subsection (18.2) is limited to the total of all amounts each of which is an amount determined for the particular taxpayer under subsection (2) in respect of the property because of its membership in the partnership.
The purpose of this section is to encourage the investment of capital in Canada for a CTM use.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Subsection.Text: The following definitions apply in this section.

Definition.Text: actual emission intensity means the emission intensity of a specified natural gas energy system of a qualifying entity, based on the actual carbon dioxide emissions from the production of electrical energy by the system. (intensité des émissions réelle)
average actual emission intensity means, for the compliance period of a qualified natural gas energy system, the number determined by the formula

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the actual emission intensity of the system for the first operating year of the compliance period;
is the quantity, in gigawatt hours, of electrical energy produced by the system in the first operating year of the compliance period;
is the actual emission intensity of the system for the second operating year of the compliance period;
is the quantity, in gigawatt hours, of electrical energy produced by the system in the second operating year of the compliance period;
is the actual emission intensity of the system for the third operating year of the compliance period;
is the quantity, in gigawatt hours, of electrical energy produced by the system in the third operating year of the compliance period;
is the actual emission intensity of the system for the fourth operating year of the compliance period;
is the quantity, in gigawatt hours, of electrical energy produced by the system in the fourth operating year of the compliance period;
is the actual emission intensity of the system for the fifth operating year of the compliance period;
is the quantity, in gigawatt hours, of electrical energy produced by the system in the fifth operating year of the compliance period; and
is the total quantity, in gigawatt hours, of electrical energy produced by the system during the compliance period. (intensité des émissions réelle moyenne)

Definition.Text: clean electricity investment tax credit of a qualifying entity for a taxation year means the total of all amounts each of which is

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the specified percentage of the capital cost to the qualifying entity of clean electricity property that is acquired by the entity in the year; or

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: an amount required by subsection (12) to be added in computing the entity’s clean electricity investment tax credit at the end of the year. (crédit d’impôt à l’investissement pour l’électricité propre)

Definition.Text: clean electricity property means property of a qualifying entity

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: that is not part of a project the construction of which started before March 28, 2023 (and for this purpose, construction does not include obtaining permits or regulatory approval, conducting environmental assessments, community consultations or impact assessment studies or similar activities);

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: that is situated in Canada (including property described in subparagraph (d)‍(v) or (xiv) of Class 43.‍1 in Schedule II to the Income Tax Regulations that is installed in the exclusive economic zone of Canada) and intended for use exclusively in Canada;

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: that has not been used, or acquired for use or lease, for any purpose whatever before it was acquired by the entity;

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: that, if it is to be leased by a qualifying entity to another person or partnership, is

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: leased to a qualifying entity or a partnership all the members of which are qualifying entities, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: leased in the ordinary course of carrying on a business in Canada by the qualifying entity whose principal business is selling or servicing property of that type, or whose principal business is leasing property, lending money, purchasing conditional sales contracts, accounts receivable, bills of sale, chattel mortgages or hypothecary claims on movables, bills of exchange or other obligations representing all or part of the sale price of merchandise or services, or any combination thereof; and

Paragraph.Label: (e)
Paragraph.Text: that is

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: property that would be described in subparagraph (d)(ii) of Class 43.1 in Schedule II to the Income Tax Regulations, if that subparagraph were read without reference to its clause (A),

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: described in subparagraph (d)(v), (vi) or (xiv) of Class 43.1 in Schedule II to the Income Tax Regulations, but excluding a test wind turbine (within the meaning assigned by subsection 1219(3) of the Income Tax Regulations),

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: concentrated solar energy equipment, as defined in subsection 127.45(1), that is part of a system used solely for the purpose of generating electrical energy, exclusively from concentrated sunlight,

Subparagraph.Label: (iv)
Subparagraph.Text: nuclear energy property,

Subparagraph.Label: (v)
Subparagraph.Text: equipment that

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: is part of a system that

Subclause.Label: (I)
Subclause.Text: exports more electrical energy than heat energy on a net basis, as determined on an annual basis, and

Subclause.Label: (II)
Subclause.Text: does not extract fossil fuels for sale,

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: is used exclusively for the purpose of generating electrical energy, or a combination of electrical energy and heat energy, solely from geothermal energy, and

Clause.Label: (C)
Clause.Text: is described in subparagraph (d)(vii) of Class 43.1 in Schedule II to the Income Tax Regulations,

Subparagraph.Label: (vi)
Subparagraph.Text: waste biomass electricity generation equipment, as defined in subsection 127.45(1), that is part of a system that exports more electrical energy than heat energy on a net basis, as determined on an annual basis,

Subparagraph.Label: (vii)
Subparagraph.Text: described in subparagraph (d)(xviii) or (xix) of Class 43.1 in Schedule II to the Income Tax Regulations, but excluding equipment that uses any fossil fuel in operation,

Subparagraph.Label: (viii)
Subparagraph.Text: qualified natural gas energy equipment,

Subparagraph.Label: (ix)
Subparagraph.Text: qualified interprovincial transmission equipment, or

Subparagraph.Label: (x)
Subparagraph.Text: incorporated into another property described in any of subparagraphs (i) to (ix), as part of a refurbishment of the other property provided that on completion of the refurbishment the other property is still described in any of subparagraphs (i) to (ix). (bien pour l’électricité propre)

Definition.Text: compliance period in respect of a specified natural gas energy system of a taxpayer, means the period beginning on the start-up date of the system and ending on the last day of the fifth operating year of the system. (période de conformité)
dedicated geological storage has the same meaning as in subsection 127.44(1). (stockage géologique dédié)
designated provincial Crown corporation means a corporation

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: not less than 90% of the shares (except directors’ qualifying shares) or of the capital of which is owned by one or more persons each of which is His Majesty in right of a province;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: that is Northwest Territories Power Corporation, Qulliq Energy Corporation or Yukon Energy Corporation; or

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: all of the shares (except directors’ qualifying shares) or of the capital of which is owned by one or more persons each of which is a corporation described in paragraph (a) or (b). (société d’État provinciale désignée)

Definition.Text: emission intensity in respect of a qualified natural gas energy system, means the tonnes of carbon dioxide emissions released into the atmosphere for each gigawatt hour of electrical energy produced as determined by the formula

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the number determined by the formula
