is the quantity of carbon dioxide emissions, expressed in tonnes, during an operating year, from the combustion of fuel in the system, as determined in a manner that is acceptable to the Minister of Natural Resources,

is the quantity of carbon dioxide emissions, expressed in tonnes, attributable to the production of useful thermal energy exported by the system, during the operating year, as determined in a manner that is acceptable to the Minister of Natural Resources, and

is the quantity of carbon dioxide captured from the system and stored in dedicated geological storage, expressed in tonnes, during the operating year, as determined in a manner that is acceptable to the Minister of Natural Resources; and

is the quantity of electrical energy produced by the system during the operating year, expressed in gigawatt hours, as determined in a manner that is acceptable to the Minister of Natural Resources. (intensité des émissions)

Definition.Text: government assistance has the same meaning as in subsection 127(9). (aide gouvernementale)
ineligible use means

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: in respect of a property other than qualified natural gas energy equipment, use of the property at a time that would, if the property were acquired at that time, result in the property not being a clean electricity property, determined without reference to paragraph (c) of the definition clean electricity property; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: in respect of a property that is qualified natural gas energy equipment,

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: use of the property at a time that would, if the property were acquired at that time, result in the property not being a clean electricity property, determined without reference to subparagraph (a)(vi) of the definition qualified natural gas energy equipment and paragraph (c) of the definition clean electricity property, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: any use of the system described in paragraph (a) of the definition qualified natural gas energy equipment, if the actual emission intensity of the system in an operating year is greater than 65 tonnes of carbon dioxide per gigawatt hour of electrical energy, for an operating year that begins after the fifth operating year but before the twenty-first operating year of the system. (utilisation non admissible)

Definition.Text: non-government assistance has the same meaning as in subsection 127(9). (aide non gouvernementale)
nuclear energy property means property that

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: is part of a fixed location system that

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: is used all or substantially all to generate electrical energy, or a combination of electrical energy and heat energy, from nuclear fission, as determined on an annual basis, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: exports more electrical energy than heat energy on a net basis, as determined on an annual basis;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: is

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: a reactor,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: a reactor vessel,

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: a reactor control rod,

Subparagraph.Label: (iv)
Subparagraph.Text: a moderator,

Subparagraph.Label: (v)
Subparagraph.Text: cooling equipment,

Subparagraph.Label: (vi)
Subparagraph.Text: heat generating equipment,

Subparagraph.Label: (vii)
Subparagraph.Text: nuclear fission fuel handling equipment,

Subparagraph.Label: (viii)
Subparagraph.Text: a containment structure,

Subparagraph.Label: (ix)
Subparagraph.Text: electrical generating equipment,

Subparagraph.Label: (x)
Subparagraph.Text: equipment for the distribution of heat energy within the system, or

Subparagraph.Label: (xi)
Subparagraph.Text: equipment that is physically and functionally integrated with property described in any of subparagraphs (i) to (x) and that is ancillary equipment (such as control equipment) used solely to support the functioning of property described in any of subparagraphs (i) to (x); and

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: is not

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: nuclear fission fuel,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: property used in nuclear waste disposal or storage,

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: transmission equipment,

Subparagraph.Label: (iv)
Subparagraph.Text: distribution equipment,

Subparagraph.Label: (v)
Subparagraph.Text: a vehicle,

Subparagraph.Label: (vi)
Subparagraph.Text: property that would be included in Class 17 in Schedule II to the Income Tax Regulations if that Class were read without reference to its paragraph (a.‍1),

Subparagraph.Label: (vii)
Subparagraph.Text: equipment used to export heat energy from the system, or

Subparagraph.Label: (viii)
Subparagraph.Text: a building or other structure. (bien pour l’énergie nucléaire)

Definition.Text: operating year of a specified natural gas energy system, means each cumulative 365-day period, the first of which begins on the start-up date of a qualifying entity’s specified natural gas energy system, disregarding any period during which the system is not operating.‍ (année d’exploitation)

preliminary work activity has the same meaning as in subsection 127.45(1), except that the reference to “clean technology property” in paragraph (c) shall be read as “clean electricity property”. (travaux préliminaires)

qualified interprovincial transmission equipment means property that is primarily used, as determined on an annual basis, to transmit or manage electrical energy that originates in, or is destined for, a province other than the province in which the property is located and

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: that is

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: equipment for the transmission of electrical energy, including cables and switches, that is rated for voltages of at least 69 kilovolts,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: electrical transmission structures, including towers and lattices, or

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: related equipment used to manage electrical energy, including transformers, electric power conditioning equipment and control equipment, that is directly connected to equipment described in subparagraph (i) or (ii); and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: that is not a building or distribution equipment. (matériel de transmission interprovinciale admissible)

Definition.Text: qualified natural gas energy equipment means property

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: that is part of a system that meets the following conditions:

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the system

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: is fuelled all or substantially all by the combustion of natural gas, as determined on an annual basis, and

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: is not fuelled by anything other than the combustion of gaseous fuels,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the system is used solely for the purpose of generating electrical energy, or a combination of electrical energy and heat energy, determined without reference to capturing carbon dioxide,

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: the system exports more electrical energy than heat energy on a net basis as determined on an annual basis,

Subparagraph.Label: (iv)
Subparagraph.Text: the system is physically and functionally integrated with equipment that captures and prepares or compresses carbon dioxide for transportation,

Subparagraph.Label: (v)
Subparagraph.Text: less than 50% of the gross electrical energy generated by the system is used to power the equipment referred to in subparagraph (iv) as determined on an annual basis,

Subparagraph.Label: (vi)
Subparagraph.Text: the system is not expected to exceed an emission intensity of 65 tonnes of carbon dioxide per gigawatt hour of gross electrical energy generated, and

Subparagraph.Label: (vii)
Subparagraph.Text: a system evaluation has been issued for the system by the Minister of Natural Resources, in the form and manner determined by the Minister of Natural Resources;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: that is

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: electrical generating equipment,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: heat generating equipment used primarily for the purpose of producing heat energy to operate the electrical generating equipment described in subparagraph (i),

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: equipment that generates both electrical and heat energy,

Subparagraph.Label: (iv)
Subparagraph.Text: equipment that is to be used solely

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: for capturing carbon dioxide that is generated by the system, or

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: to prepare or compress for transportation carbon dioxide captured from the system,

Subparagraph.Label: (v)
Subparagraph.Text: heat recovery equipment used primarily for the purpose of conserving energy, or reducing the requirement to acquire energy, by extracting for reuse thermal waste that is generated by equipment referred to in any of subparagraphs (i) to (iv) or (vi),

Subparagraph.Label: (vi)
Subparagraph.Text: equipment for the distribution of heat energy within the system,

Subparagraph.Label: (vii)
Subparagraph.Text: equipment that is physically and functionally integrated with equipment described in any of subparagraphs (i) to (vi) and that is ancillary equipment (such as control equipment) used solely to support the functioning of equipment described in any of those subparagraphs, or

Subparagraph.Label: (viii)
Subparagraph.Text: described in any of subparagraphs (i) to (vii) that is incorporated into a system that would not otherwise be described in paragraph (a) if the incorporation causes the system to satisfy the description in paragraph (a);

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: in the case of equipment that is acquired before the start-up date of the system referred to in paragraph (a), that is verified by the Minister of Natural Resources as being equipment described in paragraph (b); and

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: that is not

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: a building or other structure,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: transmission equipment,

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: distribution equipment,

Subparagraph.Label: (iv)
Subparagraph.Text: equipment used to export heat energy from the system,

Subparagraph.Label: (v)
Subparagraph.Text: fuel storage or fuel handling equipment, or

Subparagraph.Label: (vi)
Subparagraph.Text: pollution abatement equipment. (matériel d’énergie alimenté au gaz naturel admissible)

Definition.Text: qualified natural gas energy system means a system that is described in paragraph (a) of the definition qualified natural gas energy equipment. (système énergétique alimenté au gaz naturel admissible)
qualified validation firm, in respect of a specified natural gas energy system of a taxpayer, means an engineer or engineering firm that

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: is registered and in good standing with a professional association that has the authority or recognition by law of a jurisdiction in Canada to regulate the profession of engineering in

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the jurisdiction where the system is located, or

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: if there is no professional association in the jurisdiction described in subparagraph (i), a jurisdiction in Canada where a professional association regulates the profession of engineering;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: has appropriate insurance coverage;

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: at all times, is independent of, deals at arm’s length with and is not an employee of the taxpayer; and

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: meets the requirements described in guidelines published by the Minister of Natural Resources. (firme admissible de validation)

Definition.Text: qualified verification firm, in respect of a specified natural gas energy system of a taxpayer, means an individual or firm that

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: is either

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: an engineer or an engineering firm that is registered and in good standing with a professional association that has the authority or recognition by law of a jurisdiction in Canada to regulate the profession of engineering in

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: the jurisdiction where the system is located, or

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: if there is no professional association in the jurisdiction described in clause (A), a jurisdiction in Canada where a professional association regulates the profession of engineering, or

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: a verification body accredited and in good standing under the Clean Fuel Regulations;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: has appropriate insurance coverage;

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: at all times, is independent of, deals at arm’s length with and is not an employee of

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the taxpayer, or

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the qualified validation firm in respect of the system;

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: meets the requirements described in guidelines published by the Minister of Natural Resources; and

Paragraph.Label: (e)
Paragraph.Text: has expertise in auditing natural gas systems to demonstrate compliance with the Regulations Limiting Carbon Dioxide Emissions from Natural Gas-fired Generation of Electricity. (firme admissible de vérification)

Definition.Text: qualifying corporation means

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: a taxable Canadian corporation;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: a designated provincial Crown corporation;

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: a corporation described in paragraph 149(1)(d.5) not less than 90% of the shares or the capital of which are owned by one or more entities each of which is

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: a municipality in Canada, or

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: an aboriginal government (as defined in subsection 241(10)) — or a similar Indigenous governing body — described in paragraph 149(1)(c);

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: a corporation described in paragraph 149(1)(d.6) all of the shares (except directors’ qualifying shares) or the capital of which are owned by one or more of

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: a municipality in Canada,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: an aboriginal government (as defined in subsection 241(10)) — or a similar Indigenous governing body — described in paragraph 149(1)(c), or

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: a corporation described in paragraph 149(1)(d.5);

Paragraph.Label: (e)
Paragraph.Text: a corporation all of the shares (except directors’ qualifying shares) or of the capital of which are owned by one or more municipalities in Canada in combination with one or more persons each of which is described in the definition designated provincial Crown corporation;

Paragraph.Label: (f)
Paragraph.Text: a corporation to which paragraph 149(1)(o.2) applies;

Paragraph.Label: (g)
Paragraph.Text: the Canada Infrastructure Bank;

Paragraph.Label: (h)
Paragraph.Text: Canada Growth Fund Inc. and any corporation that is a subsidiary wholly-owned corporation of Canada Growth Fund Inc.; or

Paragraph.Label: (i)
Paragraph.Text: a prescribed entity. (société admissible)

Definition.Text: qualifying entity means a qualifying corporation or a qualifying trust. (entité admissible)
qualifying trust means, at all relevant times, a trust

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: each beneficiary of which is a corporation described in paragraph 149(1)(o.2);

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: that is a limited partner of a partnership; and

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: the sole undertaking of which is the holding of its interest in the partnership together with any ancillary activities. (fiducie admissible)

Definition.Text: refurbishment means significant alterations, renovations, improvements or additions to a property to substantially

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: extend its useful life;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: increase its capacity; or

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: improve its efficiency. (remise en état)

Definition.Text: specified natural gas energy system means a system that is, or was at any time, a qualified natural gas energy system. (système énergétique alimenté au gaz naturel déterminé)
specified percentage means, in respect of a clean electricity property of a qualifying entity that is acquired

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: before April 16, 2024, determined without reference to subsection (7), nil;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: subject to paragraph (a), on or after April 16, 2024 and before January 1, 2035, 15%; and

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: after December 31, 2034, nil. (pourcentage déterminé)

Definition.Text: start-up date of a specified natural gas energy system means the first day on which the system generates electrical energy for sale. (jour du début du projet)
system plan means a plan for a qualified natural gas energy system of a qualifying entity that

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: has been prepared by a qualified validation firm;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: includes a front-end engineering design study (or an equivalent study as determined by the Minister of Natural Resources) for the system;

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: sets out

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: an expected emission intensity of the electrical energy to be produced by the system that is below 65 tonnes carbon dioxide per gigawatt hour,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: an expected ratio of net electrical energy to net heat energy exported that is above 1, and

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: an expected ratio of electrical energy used to power equipment that captures and prepares or compresses carbon dioxide to gross electrical energy produced that is below 0.5;

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: contains any information required in guidelines published by the Minister of Natural Resources; and

Paragraph.Label: (e)
Paragraph.Text: is filed by the entity with the Minister of Natural Resources, in the form and manner determined by the Minister of Natural Resources. (plan du système)

Subsection.Text: If a qualifying entity files a prescribed form containing prescribed information with the Minister on or before its filing-due date for its taxation year,

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: in the case of an entity that is a taxable Canadian corporation or a qualifying trust, the entity is deemed to have paid on its balance-due day for the year an amount on account of the entity’s tax payable under this Part for the year equal to the entity’s clean electricity investment tax credit for the year; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: subject to subsection (3), in the case of an entity that is described in any of paragraphs (b) to (i) of the definition qualifying corporation in subsection (1), the Minister shall, with all due dispatch, pay to the entity an amount equal to its clean electricity investment tax credit for the year.

Subsection.Text: Subsection (2) does not apply to an entity that is described in any of paragraphs (b) to (i) of the definition qualifying corporation in subsection (1) unless the entity agrees in writing with the Minister to be subject to the provisions of this Act in respect of the entity’s clean electricity investment tax credit, with any modifications to those provisions that the circumstances require.
For the purpose of this section, where a qualifying entity has a leasehold interest in a nuclear energy property

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: subject to subsection (7), the entity is deemed to acquire the property when it acquires the leasehold interest in the property;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the capital cost of the leasehold interest in the property to the entity is deemed to be its capital cost of the property; and

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: the property is deemed to be disposed of by the entity when it ceases to hold the leasehold interest in the property for proceeds of disposition equal to the fair market value of the property at the time it ceases to hold the leasehold interest.

Subsection.Text: Any amount payable by a qualifying entity under this section is deemed to be payable as a tax or as a payment in lieu of tax, as the case may be.

If the qualifying entity files with the Minister the prescribed form containing prescribed information referred to in subsection (2) after its filing-due date for the year but on or before the later of the day that is one year after that date and December 31, 2026, subsection (2) applies to the entity except that no payment is deemed to arise under that subsection until the prescribed form containing prescribed information has been filed with the Minister.

For the purpose of this section, clean electricity property is deemed not to have been acquired by a qualifying entity before the property is considered to have become available for use by the entity, determined without reference to paragraphs 13(27)(c) and (28)(d).

Subsection.MarginalNote: Qualified natural gas energy system evaluation
Subsection.Text: The Minister of Natural Resources may request from a qualifying entity all documentation and information necessary for the Minister of Natural Resources to complete a qualified natural gas energy system evaluation, including a system plan, and may refuse to complete the evaluation if such documentation or information is not provided by the entity.
For the purpose of the definition clean electricity investment tax credit in subsection (1), the capital cost of a clean electricity property to a qualifying entity shall

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: not include any amount

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: in respect of which an amount was previously deducted under this section by any person,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: in respect of which any other clean economy tax credit (as defined in subsection 127.47(1)) was deducted by any person,

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: that has, by virtue of section 21, been added to the cost of a property,

Subparagraph.Label: (iv)
Subparagraph.Text: in respect of a qualified natural gas energy system, if a CCUS tax credit (as defined in subsection 127.44(1)) was deducted by any person in respect of any property that is part of the system,

Subparagraph.Label: (v)
Subparagraph.Text: in respect of an expenditure incurred for a preliminary work activity, or

Subparagraph.Label: (vi)
Subparagraph.Text: if a CCUS tax credit (as defined in subsection 127.44(1)) or a clean hydrogen tax credit (as defined in subsection 127.48(1)) was deducted in respect of any part of the capital cost of the property by any person;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: be determined without reference to subsections 13(7.‍1) and (7.‍4);

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: be reduced by the total of all amounts (other than an amount received or receivable from an entity that is described in paragraph (g) or (h) of the definition qualifying corporation in subsection (1)) each of which can reasonably be considered to be in respect of the property and is

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: an amount of any government assistance or non-government assistance received by the qualifying entity in or before the taxation year in which the property was acquired, or

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: an amount not described in subparagraph (i) that, in the taxation year, the qualifying entity is entitled to or can reasonably be expected to receive and that would be government assistance or non-government assistance if it were received by the entity; and

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: be determined with reference to subsections 127(11.‍6) to (11.‍8) in respect of an expenditure or cost to a person except that

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the reference in subsection 127(11.‍6) to subsection 127(11.‍5) is to be read as a reference to section 127.‍491,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the reference in subsection 127(11.‍6) to subsection 127(26) is to be read as a reference to subsection 127.‍491(14), and

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: the term “a qualified expenditure” is to be read as “an expenditure eligible to be added to the capital cost of a clean electricity property”.

Subsection.Text: For the purposes of this section, paragraph 12(1)(t), subsection 13(7.1), the description of I in the definition undepreciated capital cost in subsection 13(21), subsection 53(2) and sections 127.44, 127.45, 127.48, 127.49 and 129, the amount determined under subsection (2) for a qualifying entity for a taxation year is deemed to have been deducted from its tax otherwise payable under this Part for the year.

Where a qualifying entity has, in a particular taxation year, repaid (or has not received and can no longer reasonably be expected to receive) an amount of government assistance or non-government assistance that was applied to reduce the capital cost of a particular property under paragraph (9)‍(c) for a preceding taxation year, the amount repaid (or no longer expected to be received) is to be added to the capital cost to the entity of a separate clean electricity property that is deemed to be acquired in the particular year for the purposes of this section, provided that a transaction or event described in paragraph (16)(c) has not occurred in respect of the particular property.

Subject to section 127.47, where, in a particular taxation year of a qualifying entity that is a member of a partnership, an amount would be determined under subsection (2) in respect of the partnership, for its taxation year that ends in the particular year, if the partnership were a taxable Canadian corporation and its fiscal period were its taxation year, the portion of that amount that can reasonably be considered to be the qualifying entity’s share thereof shall be added in computing the clean electricity investment tax credit of the qualifying entity at the end of the particular year.

For the purposes of computing a clean electricity investment tax credit, where at a particular time a qualifying corporation described in paragraph (a) of the definition qualifying trust is a beneficiary of a qualifying trust, and the beneficiary or the trust has received, is entitled to receive or can reasonably be expected to receive government assistance or non-government assistance, the amount of that assistance that may reasonably be considered to be in respect of a clean electricity property for which a clean electricity investment tax credit is allocated by a partnership to the trust shall be deemed to have been received by the partnership as government assistance or non-government assistance, as the case may be, in respect of the property.

For the purposes of this section, where any part of the capital cost of a qualifying entity’s particular clean electricity property is unpaid on the day that is 180 days after the end of the taxation year in which a deduction in respect of a clean electricity investment tax credit would otherwise be available in respect of the particular property, such amount is deemed to be

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: excluded from the capital cost of the particular property in the year; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: added to the capital cost of a separate clean electricity property that is deemed to be acquired by the qualifying entity at the time the amount is paid, provided that a transaction or event described in paragraph (16)(c) has not occurred in respect of the particular property.

Subsection.Text: Subsection (2) does not apply if a clean electricity property — or an interest in a person or partnership that has, directly or indirectly, an interest in, or for civil law, a right in, such property — is a tax shelter investment for the purpose of section 143.2.
Subsection (17) applies in a taxation year of a taxpayer if

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the taxpayer acquired a particular property that is

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: a clean electricity property, other than qualified natural gas energy equipment, in the year or any of the preceding 10 calendar years, or

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: a clean electricity property that is qualified natural gas energy equipment, in the year or any of the preceding 20 calendar years;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the taxpayer became entitled to a clean electricity investment tax credit in respect of the capital cost, or a portion of the capital cost, of the particular property; and

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: in the year, the particular property (or another property that incorporates the particular property) is converted to an ineligible use, is exported from Canada or is disposed of without having been previously exported or converted to an ineligible use.

Subsection.Text: If this subsection applies in a taxation year of a taxpayer in respect of a particular property, the taxpayer is liable to pay an amount for the year, on or before its balance-due day for the year, determined by the formula

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the amount of the taxpayer’s clean electricity investment tax credit in respect of the particular property;
is the total of all amounts each of which can reasonably be considered to be the portion of any amount previously paid by the taxpayer because of subsection (18) in respect of the property;
is an amount, not exceeding the amount determined for D, equal to

FormulaParagraph.Label: (a)
FormulaParagraph.Text: if the particular property is disposed of to a person who deals at arm’s length with the taxpayer, the proceeds of disposition of the property, and

FormulaParagraph.Label: (b)
FormulaParagraph.Text: in any other case, the fair market value of the property; and

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the capital cost of the particular property on which the clean electricity investment tax credit was deducted.

Subsection.MarginalNote: Recovery — qualified natural gas energy systems
Subsection.Text: In the taxation year of a taxpayer in which the compliance period of the taxpayer’s specified natural gas energy system ends, if the average actual emission intensity of the electrical energy produced is greater than 68.5 tonnes of carbon dioxide per gigawatt hour of electrical energy, the taxpayer is liable to pay an amount for the year, on or before its balance-due day for the year, determined by the formula

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the total amount of clean electricity investment tax credits received in respect of qualified natural gas energy equipment that was part of the system; and

is the total of all amounts each of which can reasonably be considered to be the portion of any amount previously paid by the taxpayer in respect of the equipment described in A because of subsection (17).

Subsection.Text: If a clean electricity investment tax credit was deducted by a taxpayer in respect of a qualified natural gas energy system, the taxpayer shall file with the Minister and the Minister of Natural Resources, within 180 days after the end of each of the first 20 operating years, a compliance report in prescribed form and manner including the following information:

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the actual emission intensity of the electrical energy produced by the system during the year;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the quantity, in gigawatt hours, of electrical energy produced by the system during the year;

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: any shutdown time of the system in respect of the year;

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: for the compliance report in respect of the fifth operating year, a report that verifies the actual emission intensity of the electrical energy that is produced during each operating year of the compliance period, prepared by a qualified verification firm in respect of the system; and

Paragraph.Label: (e)
Paragraph.Text: any information required in guidelines published by the Minister of Natural Resources.

Subsection.Text: For the purpose of subsection (18), the Minister of Natural Resources shall review each of the compliance reports of a qualifying entity described in subsection (19) and the Minister may, in consultation with the Minister of Natural Resources, make a determination or redetermination of the actual emission intensity of the electrical energy produced by an entity’s qualified natural gas energy system for any operating year during the compliance period of the system.

Each taxpayer that fails to file a compliance report as required by subsection (19) is liable to a penalty, for each such failure, in an amount, not exceeding the total of all clean electricity investment tax credits deducted by the taxpayer in respect of the system, equal to the amount determined by the formula

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the total of all amounts, each of which is the amount of a clean electricity investment tax credit in respect of the system deducted by the taxpayer for a taxation year that ended before the applicable date in subsection (19); and
is the number of days during which the failure continues.

Subsection.Text: Subsections (16) and (17) do not apply to a qualifying entity (in this subsection referred to as the “transferor”) that disposes of a property to another qualifying entity (in this subsection referred to as the “purchaser”) that is related to the transferor if the purchaser acquired the property in circumstances where the property would be clean electricity property to the purchaser but for paragraph (c) of that definition.

Subsection.MarginalNote: Certain related party transfers — recapture deferred
Subsection.Text: If subsection (22) applies, subsection 127(34) applies with such modifications as the circumstances require, including that the reference to subsection 127(33) be read as a reference to subsection 127.‍491(22).

If subsection (16) or (22) applies to a qualifying entity for a particular year, the entity shall notify the Minister in prescribed form and manner on or before the entity’s filing-due date for the year.

If subsections (26) and (27) apply with respect to the property of a partnership for a particular fiscal period, the partnership shall notify the Minister in prescribed form and manner on or before the day when a return is required by section 229 of the Income Tax Regulations to be filed in respect of the period.

Subject to section 127.47, if subsection (12) has at any time applied to add an amount in computing the clean electricity investment tax credit of a current or former member of a partnership, then for the purposes of this Part, subsections (16) to (18) and (23) shall apply to determine amounts in respect of the partnership as if the partnership were a taxable Canadian corporation, its fiscal period were its taxation year and it had deducted all of the clean electricity investment tax credits that were previously added in computing the clean electricity investment tax credit of any member of the partnership under subsection (2) because of the application of subsection (12) in respect of its partnership interest.

Unless subsection (28) applies, if, in a taxation year, a taxpayer is a member of a partnership, the amount that can reasonably be considered to be the taxpayer’s share of any amount of tax determined because of subsection (26) in respect of the partnership for its fiscal period ending in the taxation year shall be added to the taxpayer’s tax otherwise payable under this Part for the taxation year.

Subsection.MarginalNote: Election by member to pay tax
Subsection.Text: A taxable Canadian corporation that is a member of a partnership during a fiscal period of the partnership may elect, in prescribed form and manner, to add to its tax payable under this Part for its taxation year that includes the end of the fiscal period the total amount of tax determined for that fiscal period because of subsection (26) in respect of the partnership.

Subsection.MarginalNote: Joint and several, or solidary, liability
Subsection.Text: Each current or former member of a partnership is jointly and severally, or solidarily, liable for any portion of the amount of tax determined because of subsection (26) in respect of the partnership for a fiscal period that is not added to the tax payable

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: of a qualifying entity under subsection (27), other than a qualifying entity that is exempt from tax under this Part and has not agreed under subsection (3) to be subject to the provisions of this Act in respect of the entity’s clean electricity investment tax credit; or

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: of a taxable Canadian corporation because of subsection (28) and paid by the corporation by its filing-due date for its taxation year that includes the end of the fiscal period.

Subsection.Text: If a taxpayer was, at the time that an amount is determined because of subsection (26) in respect of the partnership for a taxation year, no longer a member of the partnership, the taxpayer’s liability for tax because of subsection (29) is limited to the total of all amounts each of which is an amount determined for the taxpayer under subsection (2) because of its membership in the partnership.

For the purpose of applying subsection 161(1) to an amount of tax payable because of subsection (18), the balance-due day of a qualifying entity is deemed to be the balance-due day of the taxation year for the related clean electricity investment tax credit under subsection (2).

A property that would otherwise be a clean electricity property of a qualifying entity is deemed not to be a clean electricity property of the entity if, at the time the property becomes available for use by the entity, there is substantial non-compliance by the entity with the requirements of any environmental law, by-law or regulation of Canada, a province, a municipality or a municipal or public body performing a function of government in Canada that is applicable in respect of the property.
The following rules apply in respect of a qualifying entity’s property described in subparagraph (e)(vi), (viii) or (ix) of the definition clean electricity property in subsection (1):

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: where the property is temporarily operated in a manner that is an ineligible use solely because of a deficiency, failing or shutdown of the system of which it is a part, and that deficiency, failing or shutdown is beyond the control of the entity, the property is deemed, for the purposes of subsections (16) and (17), not to be operated in a manner that is an ineligible use during the period of the deficiency, failing or shutdown, if the entity makes all reasonable efforts to rectify the circumstances within a reasonable time; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: for the purpose of paragraph (a), the system referred to in that paragraph may include property of another person or partnership if

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the property would reasonably be considered to be part of the system if the property were owned by the entity,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the property

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: utilizes electrical energy or heat energy obtained from the system,

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: transports or stores carbon dioxide obtained from the system, or

Clause.Label: (C)
Clause.Text: generates or stores electricity that is transmitted by the system,

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: the operation of the property is necessary for the system to avoid operation in a manner that is an ineligible use, and

Subparagraph.Label: (iv)
Subparagraph.Text: at the time the system first became operational, the deficiency, failing or shutdown in the operation of the property could not reasonably have been anticipated to occur within five calendar years after that time.

Subsection.Text: If a major project is undertaken in discrete phases for bona fide business or engineering reasons, the Minister may determine that each phase is a separate project for the purposes of applying paragraph (a) of the definition clean electricity property in subsection (1).

Subsection.MarginalNote: Authority of the Minister of Natural Resources
Subsection.Text: For the purpose of determining whether a property is a clean electricity property, any technical guide published by the Department of Natural Resources, and as amended from time to time, is to apply conclusively with respect to engineering and scientific matters.

Subsection.MarginalNote: Clean electricity investment tax credit — purpose
Subsection.Text: The purpose of this section is to encourage the investment of capital in the deployment of clean electricity property in Canada.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Section.Text: Notwithstanding any other provision of this Act but subject to subsection 120.4(3) and section 127.55, where the amount that, but for section 120, would be determined under Division E to be an individual’s tax payable for a taxation year is less than the amount determined under paragraph (a) in respect of the individual for the year, the individual’s tax payable under this Part for the year is the total of

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the amount, if any, by which

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the individual’s minimum amount for the year determined under section 127.51

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the individual’s special foreign tax credit determined under section 127.54 for the year, and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the amount, if any, required by section 120 to be added to the individual’s tax otherwise payable under this Part for the year.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Section.Text: An individual’s minimum amount for a taxation year is the amount determined by the formula

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the individual’s adjusted taxable income for the year determined under section 127.52;
is

FormulaParagraph.Label: (a)
FormulaParagraph.Text: the first dollar amount for the year referred to in paragraph 117(2)(d), in the case of an individual (other than a trust) or a qualified disability trust (as defined in subsection 122(3)); and

FormulaParagraph.Label: (b)
FormulaParagraph.Text: nil, in any other case; and

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the individual’s basic minimum tax credit for the year determined under section 127.531.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Subsection.Text: Subject to subsection 127.52(2), an individual’s adjusted taxable income for a taxation year is the amount that would be the individual’s taxable income for the year or the individual’s taxable income earned in Canada for the year, as the case may be, if it were computed on the assumption that

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the total of all amounts each of which is an amount deductible under paragraph 20(1)(a) or any of paragraphs 20(1)(c) to 20(1)(f) in computing the individual’s income for the year in respect of a rental or leasing property (other than an amount included in the individual’s share of a loss referred to in paragraph 127.52(1)(c.1)) were the lesser of the total of all amounts otherwise so deductible and the amount, if any, by which the total of

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the total of all amounts each of which is the individual’s income for the year from the renting or leasing of a rental or leasing property owned by the individual or by a partnership, computed without reference to paragraphs 20(1)(a) and 20(1)(c) to 20(1)(f), and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the amount, if any, by which

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: the total of all amounts each of which is the individual’s taxable capital gain for the year from the disposition of a rental or leasing property owned by the individual or by a partnership

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: the total of all amounts each of which is the individual’s allowable capital loss for the year from the disposition of a rental or leasing property owned by the individual or by a partnership

ContinuedSubparagraph.Text: exceeds the total of all amounts each of which is the individual’s loss for the year from the renting or leasing of a rental or leasing property owned by the individual or by a partnership (other than an amount included in the individual’s share of a loss referred to in paragraph 127.52(1)(c.1)), computed without reference to paragraphs 20(1)(a) and 20(1)(c) to 20(1)(f);

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: the total of all amounts each of which is an amount deductible under paragraph 20(1)(a) or any of paragraphs 20(1)(c) to 20(1)(f) in computing the individual’s income for the year in respect of a film property referred to in paragraph 127.52(1)(w) of Class 10 of Schedule II to the Income Tax Regulations (other than an amount included in the individual’s share of a loss referred to in paragraph 127.52(1)(c.1)) were the lesser of the total of all amounts otherwise so deductible by the individual for the year and the amount, if any, by which the total of

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the total of all amounts each of which is the individual’s income for the year from the renting or leasing of a film property owned by the individual or by a partnership, computed without reference to paragraphs 20(1)(a) and 20(1)(c) to 20(1)(f), and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the amount, if any, by which

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: the total of all amounts each of which is the individual’s taxable capital gain for the year from the disposition of such a film property owned by the individual or by a partnership

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: the total of all amounts each of which is the individual’s allowable capital loss for the year from the disposition of such a film property owned by the individual or by a partnership

ContinuedSubparagraph.Text: exceeds the total of all amounts each of which is the individual’s loss for the year from such a film property owned by the individual or by a partnership (other than amounts included in the individual’s share of a loss referred to in paragraph 127.52(1)(c.1)), computed without reference to paragraphs 20(1)(a) and 20(1)(c) to 20(1)(f);

Paragraph.Label: (c.1)
Paragraph.Text: if, during a partnership’s fiscal period that ends in the year (other than a fiscal period that ends because of subsection 99(1)), the individual’s interest in the partnership is an interest for which an identification number is required to be, or has been, obtained under section 237.1,

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the individual’s share of allowable capital losses of the partnership for the fiscal period were the lesser of

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: the total of all amounts each of which is the individual’s

Subclause.Label: (I)
Subclause.Text: share of a taxable capital gain for the fiscal period from the disposition of property (other than property acquired by the partnership in a transaction to which subsection 97(2) applied), or

Subclause.Label: (II)
Subclause.Text: taxable capital gain for the year from the disposition of the individual’s interest in the partnership if the individual, or a person who does not deal at arm’s length with the individual, does not have an interest in the partnership (otherwise than because of the application of paragraph 98(1)(a) or 98.1(1)(a)) throughout the following taxation year, and

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: the individual’s share of allowable capital losses of the partnership for the fiscal period,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the individual’s share of each loss from a business of the partnership for the fiscal period were the lesser of

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: the individual’s share of the loss, and

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: the amount, if any, by which

Subclause.Label: (I)
Subclause.Text: the total of all amounts each of which is the individual’s

Subsubclause.Text: share of a taxable capital gain for the fiscal period from the disposition of property used by the partnership in the business (other than property acquired by the partnership in a transaction to which subsection 97(2) applied), or

taxable capital gain for the year from the disposition of the individual’s interest in the partnership if the individual, or a person who does not deal at arm’s length with the individual, does not have an interest in the partnership (otherwise than because of the application of paragraph 98(1)(a) or 98.1(1)(a)) throughout the following taxation year

Subclause.Label: (II)
Subclause.Text: the total of all amounts each of which is the individual’s share of an allowable capital loss for the fiscal period, and

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: the individual’s share of losses from property of the partnership for the fiscal period were the lesser of

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: the total of

Subclause.Label: (I)
Subclause.Text: the individual’s share of incomes for the fiscal period from properties of the partnership, and

Subclause.Label: (II)
Subclause.Text: the amount, if any, by which the total of all amounts each of which is the individual’s

Subsubclause.Text: share of a taxable capital gain for the fiscal period from the disposition of property held by the partnership for the purpose of earning income from property (other than property acquired by the partnership in a transaction to which subsection 97(2) applied), or

taxable capital gain for the year from the disposition of the individual’s interest in the partnership if the individual, or a person who does not deal at arm’s length with the individual, does not have an interest in the partnership (otherwise than because of the application of paragraph 98(1)(a) or 98.1(1)(a)) throughout the following taxation year,

ContinuedSubclause.Text: exceeds the total of all amounts each of which is the individual’s share of an allowable capital loss for the fiscal period, and

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: the individual’s share of losses from property of the partnership for the fiscal period;

Paragraph.Label: (c.2)
Paragraph.Text: where, during a fiscal period of a partnership that ends in the year (other than a fiscal period that ends because of the application of subsection 99(1)),

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the individual is a limited partner of the partnership, or is a member of the partnership who was a specified member of the partnership at all times since becoming a member of the partnership, or

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the partnership owns a rental or leasing property or a film property and the individual is a member of the partnership,

ContinuedParagraph.Text: the total of all amounts each of which is an amount deductible under any of paragraphs 20(1)(c) to 20(1)(f) in computing the individual’s income for the year in respect of the individual’s acquisition of the partnership interest were the lesser of

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: the total of all amounts otherwise so deductible, and

Subparagraph.Label: (iv)
Subparagraph.Text: the total of all amounts each of which is the individual’s share of any income of the partnership for the fiscal period, determined in accordance with subsection 96(1);

Paragraph.Label: (c.3)
Paragraph.Text: the total of all amounts each of which is an amount deductible in computing the individual’s income for the year in respect of a property for which an identification number is required to be, or has been, obtained under section 237.1 (other than an amount to which any of paragraphs 127.52(1)(b) to 127.52(1)(c.2) applies) were nil;

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: except in respect of dispositions of property occurring before 1986 or to which section 79 applies,

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the references to the fraction applicable to the individual for the year in each of paragraphs 38(a) and (b) and section 41 were read as a reference to “1/1”, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: each amount that is designated by a trust for a particular year of the trust in respect of the individual and deemed by subsection 104(21) to be a taxable capital gain for the year of the individual were equal to the amount obtained by the formula

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the amount so deemed to be a taxable capital gain for the year of the individual, and
is the fraction in paragraph 38(a) applicable to the trust for the particular year of the trust for which the designation is made;

Paragraph.Label: (d.1)
Paragraph.Text: in respect of a disposition to which paragraph 38(a.1) applies (other than a disposition of a property that is included in a flow-through share class of property, as defined in section 54), the portion of that paragraph before subparagraph (i) were read as “a taxpayer’s taxable capital gain for a taxation year from the disposition of a property is equal to 3/10 of the taxpayer’s capital gain for the year from the disposition of the property if”;

Paragraph.Label: (d.2)
Paragraph.Text: in respect of a disposition of a property that is included in a flow-through share class of property (as defined in section 54) to which paragraph 38(a.1) applies, the portion of that paragraph before subparagraph (i) were read as “a taxpayer’s taxable capital gain for a taxation year from the disposition of a flow-through share class of property is equal to 3/10 of the amount, if any, by which the taxpayer’s capital gain for the year from the disposition of the flow-through share class of property, exceeds the amount deemed to be a capital gain of the taxpayer from the disposition of another capital property because of the application of subsection 40(12) in respect of the disposition of the flow-through share class of property”;

Paragraph.Label: (e)
Paragraph.Text: the total of all amounts deductible under section 65, 66, 66.1, 66.2, 66.21 or 66.4 or under subsection 29(10) or (12) of the Income Tax Application Rules in computing the individual’s income for the year were the lesser of the amounts otherwise so deductible by the individual for the year and the total of

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the individual’s income for the year from royalties in respect of, and such part of the individual’s income, other than royalties, for the year as may reasonably be considered as attributable to, the production of petroleum, natural gas and minerals, determined before deducting those amounts,

Subparagraph.Label: (i.1)
Subparagraph.Text: the individual’s income for the year from property, or from the business of selling the product of property, described in Class 43.1 or 43.2 in Schedule II to the Income Tax Regulations, determined before deducting those amounts, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: all amounts included in computing the individual’s income for the year under section 59;

Paragraph.Label: (e.1)
Paragraph.Text: the total of all amounts each of which is an amount deductible under any of paragraphs 20(1)(c) to 20(1)(f) in computing the individual’s income for the year in respect of a property that is a flow-through share (if the individual is the person to whom the share was issued under an agreement referred to in the definition flow-through share in subsection 66(15)), a Canadian resource property or a foreign resource property were the lesser of the total of the amounts otherwise so determined for the year and the amount, if any, by which

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the total of all amounts each of which is an amount described in subparagraph 127.52(1)(e)(i) or 127.52(1)(e)(ii), determined without reference to paragraphs 20(1)(c) to 20(1)(f),

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the total of all amounts each of which is an amount deductible under section 65, 66, 66.1, 66.2, 66.21 or 66.4 or under subsection 29(10) or (12) of the Income Tax Application Rules in computing the individual’s income for the year;

Paragraph.Label: (f)
Paragraph.Text: subsection 82(1) were read without reference to paragraph 82(1)(b);

Paragraph.Label: (g)
Paragraph.Text: the total of all amounts deductible under section 104 in computing the income of a trust for the year were equal to the total of

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the total of all amounts otherwise deductible under that section, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the total of all amounts each of which is

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: an amount designated by the trust under subsection 104(21) for the year, or

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: that portion of a net taxable capital gain of the trust that may reasonably be considered to

Subclause.Label: (I)
Subclause.Text: be part of an amount included, by virtue of subsection 104(13) or section 105, in computing the income for the year of a non-resident beneficiary of the trust, or

Subclause.Label: (II)
Subclause.Text: have been paid in the year by a trust governed by an employee benefit plan to a beneficiary thereunder;

Paragraph.Label: (h)
Paragraph.Text: the only amounts deductible under sections 110 to 110.7 in computing the individual’s taxable income for the year or taxable income earned in Canada for the year, as the case may be, were

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the amounts deducted under subsection 110(2),

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: 7/5 of the amounts deducted under any of paragraph 110(1)(d.01) and subsections 110.6(2) and (2.1),

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: the amount that would be deductible under paragraph 110(1)(f) if the individual deducted 1/2 of the amount the individual deducted for the year under subparagraph 110(1)(f)(v),

Subparagraph.Label: (iv)
Subparagraph.Text: 1/2 of the amount deducted for the year under subsection 110.7(1),

Subparagraph.Label: (v)
Subparagraph.Text: the amount deducted under paragraph 110(1)(g), and

Subparagraph.Label: (vi)
Subparagraph.Text: twice the amount deducted under subsection 110.61(2) or 110.62(2);

Paragraph.Label: (h.1)
Paragraph.Text: the formula in paragraph 110.6(21)(a) were read as

Paragraph.Label: (i)
Paragraph.Text: in computing the individual’s taxable income for the year or the individual’s taxable income earned in Canada for the year, as the case may be, the only amounts deductible under

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: paragraphs 111(1)(a), 111(1)(c), 111(1)(d) and 111(1)(e) were the lesser of

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: 1/2 of all amounts deducted for the year under paragraphs 111(1)(a), (c), (d) and (e), and

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: the total of all amounts that would be deductible under those paragraphs for the year if the amount that would be deductible under paragraphs 111(1)(a), (c), (d) and (e) was 1/2 of the amount that would otherwise be deductible under those paragraphs and if

Subclause.Label: (I)
Subclause.Text: paragraphs (b), (c) and (e) of this subsection, as they read in respect of taxation years that began after 1985 and before 1995, applied in computing the individual’s non-capital loss, restricted farm loss, farm loss and limited partnership loss for any of those years,

Subclause.Label: (II)
Subclause.Text: paragraphs (b) to (c.3), (e) and (e.1) of this subsection, as they read in respect of taxation years that began after 1994 and ended before 2012, applied in computing the individual’s non-capital loss, restricted farm loss, farm loss and limited partnership loss for any of those years, and

Subclause.Label: (III)
Subclause.Text: paragraphs (b) to (c.3), (e) and (e.1) of this subsection applied in computing the individual’s non-capital loss, restricted farm loss, farm loss and limited partnership loss for any taxation year that ends after 2011, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: paragraph 111(1)(b) were the lesser of

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: the total of all amounts deducted under paragraph 111(1)(b), and

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: the total of all amounts that would be deductible under that paragraph for the year if

Subclause.Label: (I)
Subclause.Text: paragraph (d) of this subsection applied in computing the individual’s net capital loss for any taxation year that began before 1995,

Subclause.Label: (II)
Subclause.Text: paragraphs (c.1) and (d) of this subsection, as they read in respect of taxation years that began after 1994 and ended before 2012, applied in computing the individual’s net capital loss for any of those years,

Subclause.Label: (III)
Subclause.Text: paragraphs (c.1) and (d) of this subsection applied in computing the individual’s net capital loss for any taxation year that ends after 2011 and begins before 2024, and

Subclause.Label: (IV)
Subclause.Text: paragraph (c.1) of this subsection applied in computing the individual’s net capital loss for any taxation year that begins after 2023; and

Paragraph.Label: (j)
Paragraph.Text: in computing the individual’s income for the year, the individual deducted 1/2 of the amount deducted for the year under

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: paragraphs 8(1)(c) to (e), (g) to (l.2) and (p) to (t),

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: paragraphs 20(1)‍(c) to (f) and (bb) in respect of an amount borrowed or paid to earn income from property for the year, other than an amount described under any of paragraphs (b), (c), (c.‍2), (c.‍3) and (e.1),

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: paragraphs 60(e), (e.1) and (g),

Subparagraph.Label: (iv)
Subparagraph.Text: subsections 62(1) and (2),

Subparagraph.Label: (v)
Subparagraph.Text: subsections 63(1) and (2.2), and

Subparagraph.Label: (vi)
Subparagraph.Text: section 64.

Subsection.Text: For the purposes of subsection 127.52(1) and this subsection, any amount deductible under a provision of this Act in computing the income or loss of a partnership for a fiscal period is, to the extent of a member’s share of the partnership’s income or loss, deemed to be deductible by the member under that provision in computing the member’s income for the taxation year in which the fiscal period ends.

Where it can reasonably be considered that one of the main reasons that a member of a partnership was not a specified member of the partnership at all times since becoming a member of the partnership is to avoid the application of this section to the member’s interest in the partnership, the member is deemed for the purpose of this section to have been a specified member of the partnership at all times since becoming a member of the partnership.
For the purposes of this section,

Definition.Text: film property means a property described in paragraph (n) of Class 12, or paragraph (w) of Class 10, of Schedule II to the Income Tax Regulations; (production cinématographique)

limited partner has the meaning that would be assigned by subsection 96(2.4) if that subsection were read without reference to “if the member’s partnership interest is not an exempt interest (within the meaning assigned by subsection 127.52(2.5)) at that time and”; (commanditaire)
rental or leasing property means a property that is a rental property or a leasing property for the purpose of section 1100 of the Income Tax Regulations. (bien de location)

Section.Text: An individual’s basic minimum tax credit for a taxation year is the total of all amounts each of which is

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: 1/2 of an amount deducted under any of subsections 118(1), (2), (3) and (10), sections 118.01 to 118.07, subsections 118.3(1), (2) and (3) and sections 118.5 to 118.9 in computing the individual’s tax payable for the year under this Part;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: 1/2 of the amount that was claimed under section 118.2 in computing the individual’s tax payable for the year under this Part, determined without reference to this Division, to the extent that the amount claimed does not exceed the maximum amount deductible under that section in computing the individual’s tax payable for the year under this Part, determined without reference to this Division;

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: 4/5 of the amount that was claimed under section 118.1 in computing the individual’s tax payable for the year under this Part, determined without reference to this Division, to the extent that the amount claimed does not exceed the maximum amount deductible under that section in computing the individual’s tax payable for the year under this Part, determined without reference to this Division; and

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: an amount deducted under section 119 or subsection 127(1) in computing the individual’s tax payable for the year under this Part.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Subsection.Text: In this section,

Definition.Text: foreign income of an individual for a taxation year means the total of

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the individual’s incomes for the year from businesses carried on by the individual in countries other than Canada, and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the individual’s incomes for the year (as would be determined if paragraph 127.52(1)(d) were applicable) from sources in countries other than Canada in respect of which the individual has paid non-business-income taxes, as defined in subsection 126(7), to governments of countries other than Canada; (revenu de source étrangère)

Definition.Text: foreign taxes of an individual for a taxation year means the total of the business-income taxes, as defined in subsection 126(7), paid by the individual for the year in respect of businesses carried on by the individual in countries other than Canada and 2/3 of the non-business-income taxes, as defined in that subsection, paid by the individual for the year to the governments of countries other than Canada. (impôts payés à l’étranger)

Subsection.Text: For the purposes of section 127.5, an individual’s special foreign tax credit for a taxation year is the greater of

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the total of all amounts deductible under section 126 from the individual’s tax for the year, and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the lesser of

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the individual’s foreign taxes for the year, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the amount determined by the formula

FormulaDefinition.Text: is 20.5%, and
is the individual’s foreign income for the year.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Section.Text: Section 127.5 does not apply in respect of

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: a return of income of an individual filed under subsection 70(2), paragraph 104(23)(d) or 128(2)(e) or subsection 150(4);

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: an individual for the taxation year in which the individual dies;

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: an individual for the 1986 taxation year if the individual dies in 1987;

Paragraph.Label: (e)
Paragraph.Text: a trust described in paragraph 104(4)(a) or (a.1) for its taxation year that includes the day determined in respect of the trust under that paragraph; and

Paragraph.Label: (f)
Paragraph.Text: a taxation year of a trust throughout which the trust is

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: a trust referred to in paragraph 150(1.2)(f), (g), (i), (j), (l) or (n),

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: an investment fund (as defined in subsection 251.2(1)) unless the trust qualifies as an investment fund because of or in connection with a transaction or event or series of transactions or events one of the main purposes of which is to avoid tax under this Division,

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: a trust

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: all of the beneficiaries of which are any combination of

Subclause.Label: (I)
Subclause.Text: persons exempt from tax under this Division, and

Subclause.Label: (II)
Subclause.Text: trusts described in this subparagraph,

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: under which no person (other than a person described in subclause (A)(I) or (II)) can be added as a beneficiary,

Clause.Label: (C)
Clause.Text: in which all interests are fixed interests (as defined in subsection 94(1)), and

Clause.Label: (D)
Clause.Text: that is irrevocable,

Subparagraph.Label: (iv)
Subparagraph.Text: a trust that is exempt from tax under this Part,

Subparagraph.Label: (v)
Subparagraph.Text: a trust described in subsection 143(1),

Subparagraph.Label: (vi)
Subparagraph.Text: a unit trust if the total fair market value of the units of the trust that are listed on a designated stock exchange represents all or substantially all of the total fair market value of all the units of the trust,

Subparagraph.Label: (vii)
Subparagraph.Text: an employee ownership trust,

Subparagraph.Label: (viii)
Subparagraph.Text: a trust if

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: it is established

Subclause.Label: (I)
Subclause.Text: under a law of Canada or a province and is for the benefit of an Indigenous group, community or people that holds rights recognized and affirmed by section 35 of the Constitution Act, 1982, or

Subclause.Label: (II)
Subclause.Text: under a treaty, or a settlement agreement, between His Majesty in right of Canada, or His Majesty in right of a province, and an Indigenous group, community or people described in subclause (I), and

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: all or substantially all of the contributions to the trust before the end of the taxation year are amounts paid under the law, treaty or settlement agreement described in subclause (A)(I) or (II) or are reasonably traceable to those amounts, or

Subparagraph.Label: (ix)
Subparagraph.Text: a trust, all of the beneficiaries of which are any combination of

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: all of the members of an Indigenous group, community or people that holds rights recognized and affirmed by section 35 of the Constitution Act, 1982,

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: a public body performing a function of government in Canada within the meaning of paragraph 149(1)(c) in relation to an Indigenous group, community or people that holds rights recognized and affirmed by section 35 of the Constitution Act, 1982,

Clause.Label: (C)
Clause.Text: a person described under paragraph 149(1)(f) or (l) that is organized and operated primarily for health, education, social welfare or community improvement for the benefit of the members of an Indigenous group, community or people that holds rights recognized and affirmed by section 35 of the Constitution Act, 1982,

Clause.Label: (D)
Clause.Text: a corporation all of the shares (except directors’ qualifying shares) or of the capital of which are owned by a person described in clause (B) or clause (C), a trust described in subparagraph (viii), another corporation that is described in this clause or a combination of those persons, and

Clause.Label: (E)
Clause.Text: a trust described in subparagraph (viii).

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Heading.Label: DIVISION F
Heading.TitleText: Special Rules Applicable in Certain Circumstances

Subsection.Text: Where a corporation has become a bankrupt, the following rules are applicable:

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the trustee in bankruptcy shall be deemed to be the agent of the bankrupt for all purposes of this Act;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the estate of the bankrupt shall be deemed not to be a trust or an estate for the purposes of this Act;

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: the income and the taxable income of the corporation for any taxation year of the corporation during which it was a bankrupt and for any subsequent year shall be calculated as if

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the property of the bankrupt did not pass to and vest in the trustee in bankruptcy on the bankruptcy order being made or the assignment filed but remained vested in the bankrupt, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: any dealing in the estate of the bankrupt or any act performed in the carrying on of the business of the bankrupt estate by the trustee was done as agent on behalf of the bankrupt and any income of the trustee from such dealing or carrying on is income of the bankrupt and not of the trustee;

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: a taxation year of the corporation shall be deemed to have commenced on the day the corporation became a bankrupt and a taxation year of the corporation that would otherwise have ended after the corporation became a bankrupt shall be deemed to have ended on the day immediately before the day on which the corporation became a bankrupt;

Paragraph.Label: (e)
Paragraph.Text: if, in the case of any taxation year of the corporation ending during the period the corporation is a bankrupt, the corporation fails to pay any tax payable by it under this Act for any such year, the corporation and the trustee in bankruptcy are jointly and severally, or solidarily, liable to pay the tax, except that

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the trustee is only liable to the extent of the property of the bankrupt in the trustee’s possession, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: payment by either of them discharges the liability to the extent of the amount paid;

Paragraph.Label: (f)
Paragraph.Text: in the case of any taxation year of the corporation ending during the period the corporation is a bankrupt, the corporation shall be deemed not to be associated with any other corporation in the year; and

Paragraph.Label: (g)
Paragraph.Text: where an absolute order of discharge is granted in respect of the corporation, for the purposes of section 111 any loss of the corporation for any taxation year preceding the year in which the order of discharge was granted is not deductible by the corporation in computing its taxable income for the taxation year of the corporation in which the order was granted or any subsequent year.

Subsection.Text: Where an individual has become a bankrupt, the following rules are applicable:

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the trustee in bankruptcy shall be deemed to be the agent of the bankrupt for all purposes of this Act;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the estate of the bankrupt shall be deemed not to be a trust or an estate for the purposes of this Act;

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: the income and the taxable income of the individual for any taxation year during which the individual was a bankrupt and for any subsequent year shall be calculated as if

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the property of the bankrupt did not pass to and vest in the trustee in bankruptcy on the bankruptcy order being made or the assignment filed but remained vested in the bankrupt, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: any dealing in the estate of the bankrupt or any act performed in the carrying on of the business of the bankrupt estate by the trustee was done as agent on behalf of the bankrupt and any income of the trustee from such dealing or carrying on is income of the bankrupt and not of the trustee;

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: except for the purposes of subsections 146(1), 146.01(4) and 146.02(4) and Part X.1,

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: a taxation year of the individual is deemed to have begun at the beginning of the day on which the individual became a bankrupt, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the individual’s last taxation year that began before that day is deemed to have ended immediately before that day;

Paragraph.Label: (d.1)
Paragraph.Text: where, by reason of paragraph (d), a taxation year of the individual is not a calendar year,

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: paragraph 146(5)(b) shall, for the purpose of the application of subsection 146(5) to the taxation year, be read as follows:

Paragraph.Label: “(b)
Paragraph.Text: the amount, if any, by which

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the amount, if any, by which the taxpayer’s RRSP deduction limit for the particular calendar year in which the taxation year ends exceeds the total of all contributions made by an employer in the particular calendar year to a pooled registered pension plan in respect of the taxpayer

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the total of the amounts deducted under this subsection and subsection (5.1) in computing the taxpayer’s income for any preceding taxation year that ends in the particular calendar year.”,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: paragraph 146(5.1)(b) shall, for the purpose of the application of subsection 146(5.1) to the taxation year, be read as follows:

Paragraph.Label: “(b)
Paragraph.Text: the amount, if any, by which

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the amount, if any, by which the taxpayer’s RRSP deduction limit for the particular calendar year in which the taxation year ends exceeds the total of all contributions made by an employer in the particular calendar year to a pooled registered pension plan in respect of the taxpayer

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the total of the amount deducted under subsection (5) in computing the taxpayer’s income for the year and the amounts deducted under this subsection and subsection (5) in computing the taxpayer’s income for any preceding taxation year that ends in the particular calendar year.”;

Paragraph.Label: (d.2)
Paragraph.Text: where, by reason of paragraph 128(2)(d), the individual has two taxation years ending in a calendar year, each amount deducted in computing the individual’s income for either of the taxation years shall be deemed, for the purposes of the definition unused RRSP deduction room in subsection 146(1) and Part X.1, to have been deducted in computing the individual’s income for the calendar year;

Paragraph.Label: (d.3)
Paragraph.Text: where, by reason of paragraph (d), a taxation year of the individual is not a calendar year,

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: for the purposes of the application of subsection 146.6(1) and the definition excess FHSA amount in subsection 207.01(1) to each taxation year ending in the calendar year, references to “taxation year” are to be read as references to “calendar year”, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: for the purposes of the application of subsection 146.6(5) to each taxation year ending in the calendar year, the description of A in paragraph 146.6(5)(a) is to be read as follows:

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the total of all amounts each of which is the taxpayer’s annual FHSA limit for the calendar year that includes the taxation year and each preceding calendar year, and”

Paragraph.Label: (e)
