Paragraph.Text: where the individual was a bankrupt at any time in a calendar year the trustee shall, within 90 days from the end of the year, file a return with the Minister, in prescribed form, on behalf of the individual of the individual’s income for any taxation year occurring in the calendar year computed as if

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the only income of the individual for that taxation year was the income for the year, if any, arising from dealings in the estate of the bankrupt or acts performed in the carrying on of the business of the bankrupt by the trustee,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: in computing the individual’s taxable income for that taxation year, no deduction were permitted by Division C, other than

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: an amount under any of paragraphs 110(1)(d) to (d.3) and sections 110.6, 110.61 and 110.62 to the extent that the amount is in respect of an amount included in income under subparagraph (i) for that taxation year, and

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: an amount under section 111 to the extent that the amount was in respect of a loss of the individual for any taxation year that ended before the individual was discharged absolutely from bankruptcy,

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: in computing the individual’s tax payable under this Part for that taxation year, no deduction were allowed

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: under section 118.1 with respect to a gift made by the individual on or after the day the individual became bankrupt,

Clause.Label: (B.1)
Clause.Text: under section 118.62 with respect to interest paid on or after the day on which the individual became bankrupt, and

Clause.Label: (C)
Clause.Text: under subsection 127(5) with respect to an expenditure incurred or property acquired by the individual in any taxation year that ends after the individual was discharged absolutely from bankruptcy,

ContinuedSubparagraph.Text: and the trustee is liable to pay any tax so determined for that taxation year;

Paragraph.Label: (f)
Paragraph.Text: notwithstanding paragraph 128(2)(e), the individual shall file a separate return of the individual’s income for any taxation year during which the individual was a bankrupt, computed as if

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the income required to be reported in respect of the year by the trustee under paragraph 128(2)(e) was not the income of the individual,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: in computing income, the individual was not entitled to deduct any loss sustained by the trustee in the year in dealing with the estate of the bankrupt or in carrying on the business of the bankrupt,

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: in computing the individual’s taxable income for the year, no amount were deductible under any of paragraphs 110(1)(d) to (d.3) and sections 110.6, 110.61 and 110.62 in respect of an amount included in income under subparagraph (e)(i), and no amount were deductible under section 111, and

Subparagraph.Label: (iv)
Subparagraph.Text: in computing the individual’s tax payable under this Part for the year, no amount were deductible under

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: section 118.1 in respect of a gift made before the day on which the individual became bankrupt,

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: section 118.62 in respect of interest paid before the day on which the individual became bankrupt, or

Clause.Label: (C)
Clause.Text: section 118.61 or 120.2 or subsection 127(5),

ContinuedSubparagraph.Text: and the individual is liable to pay any tax so determined for that taxation year;

Paragraph.Label: (g)
Paragraph.Text: notwithstanding subparagraphs 128(2)(e)(ii) and 128(2)(e)(iii) and 128(2)(f)(iii) and 128(2)(f)(iv), where at any time an individual was discharged absolutely from bankruptcy,

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: in computing the individual’s taxable income for any taxation year that ends after that time, no amount shall be deducted under section 111 in respect of losses for taxation years that ended before that time,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: in computing the individual’s tax payable under this Part for any taxation year that ends after that time,

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: no amount shall be deducted under section 118.61 or 120.2 in respect of an amount for any taxation year that ended before that time,

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: no amount shall be deducted under section 118.1 in respect of a gift made before the individual became bankrupt,

Clause.Label: (B.1)
Clause.Text: no amount shall be deducted under section 118.62 in respect of interest paid before the day on which the individual became bankrupt, and

Clause.Label: (C)
Clause.Text: no amount shall be deducted under subsection 127(5) in respect of an expenditure incurred or a property acquired by the individual in any taxation year that ended before that time, and

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: the individual’s unused tuition, textbook and education tax credits (as determined under subsection 118.61(1)) at the end of the last taxation year that ended before that time is deemed to be nil;

Paragraph.Label: (h)
Paragraph.Text: where, in a taxation year commencing after an order of discharge has been granted in respect of the individual, the trustee deals in the estate of the individual who was a bankrupt or performs any act in the carrying on of the business of the individual, paragraphs 128(2)(e), 128(2)(f) and 128(2)(g) shall apply as if the individual were a bankrupt in the year; and

Paragraph.Label: (i)
Paragraph.Text: the portion of the individual’s non-capital loss for a particular taxation year in which paragraph 128(2)(e) applied in respect of the individual and any preceding taxation year that does not exceed the lesser of

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the amount of the individual’s allowable business investment losses for the particular taxation year, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: any portion of the individual’s non-capital loss for that particular year that was not deducted in computing the individual’s taxable income for any taxation year in which paragraph 128(2)(e) applied in respect of the individual or any preceding taxation year,

ContinuedParagraph.Text: shall, for the purpose of determining the individual’s cumulative gains limit under section 110.6 for taxation years following the taxation year in which paragraph 128(2)(e) was last applicable in respect of the individual, be deemed not to have been an allowable business investment loss.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Subsection.Text: For the purposes of this Act, where at a particular time a taxpayer becomes resident in Canada,

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: where the taxpayer is a corporation or a trust,

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the taxpayer’s taxation year that would otherwise include the particular time shall be deemed to have ended immediately before the particular time and a new taxation year of the taxpayer shall be deemed to have begun at the particular time, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: for the purpose of determining the taxpayer’s fiscal period after the particular time, the taxpayer shall be deemed not to have established a fiscal period before the particular time;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the taxpayer is deemed to have disposed, at the time (in this subsection referred to as the “time of disposition”) that is immediately before the time that is immediately before the particular time, of each property owned by the taxpayer, other than, if the taxpayer is an individual,

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: property that is a taxable Canadian property,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: property that is described in the inventory of a business carried on by the taxpayer in Canada at the time of disposition,

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: property included in Class 14.1 of Schedule II to the Income Tax Regulations, in respect of a business carried on by the taxpayer in Canada at the time of disposition, and

Subparagraph.Label: (iv)
Subparagraph.Text: an excluded right or interest of the taxpayer, other than an interest described in paragraph (k) of the definition excluded right or interest in subsection (10),

ContinuedParagraph.Text: for proceeds equal to its fair market value at the time of disposition;

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: the taxpayer shall be deemed to have acquired at the particular time each property deemed by paragraph 128.1(1)(b) to have been disposed of by the taxpayer, at a cost equal to the proceeds of disposition of the property;

Paragraph.Label: (c.1)
Paragraph.Text: if the taxpayer is a particular corporation that immediately before the time of disposition owned a share of the capital stock of another corporation resident in Canada, a dividend is deemed to have been paid by the other corporation, and received by the particular corporation, immediately before the time of disposition, equal to the amount, if any, by which the fair market value of the share immediately before the time of disposition exceeds the total of

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the paid-up capital in respect of the share immediately before the time of disposition, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: if the share immediately before the time of disposition was taxable Canadian property that is not treaty-protected property, the amount by which, at the time of disposition, the fair market value of the share exceeds its cost amount;

Paragraph.MarginalNote: Deemed dividend to shareholder of immigrating corporation
Paragraph.Label: (c.2)
Paragraph.Text: if the taxpayer is a corporation and an amount has been added to the paid-up capital in respect of a class of shares of the corporation’s capital stock because of paragraph (2)(b),

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the corporation is deemed to have paid, immediately before the time of disposition, a dividend on the issued shares of the class equal to the amount of the paid-up capital adjustment in respect of the class, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: a dividend is deemed to have been received, immediately before the time of disposition, by each person (other than a person in respect of whom the corporation is a foreign affiliate) who held any of the issued shares of the class equal to that proportion of the dividend so deemed to have been paid that the number of shares of the class held by the person immediately before the time of disposition is of the number of issued shares of the class outstanding immediately before the time of disposition;

Paragraph.Label: (c.3)
Paragraph.Text: if the taxpayer is a corporation that was, immediately before the particular time, controlled by one non-resident person or, if no single non-resident person controlled the CRIC, a group of non-resident persons not dealing with each other at arm’s length (in this section, that one non-resident person, or each member of the group of non-resident persons, as the case may be, is referred to as a “parent”, and the group of non-resident persons, if any, is referred to as the “group of parents”) and the taxpayer owned, immediately before the particular time, one or more shares of one or more non-resident corporations (each of which is in this paragraph referred to as a “subject affiliate”) that, immediately after the particular time, were — or that became, as part of a transaction or event or series of transactions or events that includes the taxpayer having become resident in Canada — foreign affiliates of the taxpayer, then

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: in computing the paid-up capital, at any time after the time that is immediately after the particular time, of any particular class of shares of the capital stock of the taxpayer there is to be deducted the amount determined by the formula

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the lesser of

FormulaParagraph.Label: (A)
FormulaParagraph.Text: the paid-up capital in respect of all of the shares of the capital stock of the taxpayer at the time that is immediately after the particular time, and

FormulaParagraph.Label: (B)
FormulaParagraph.Text: the total of all amounts each of which is the fair market value at the particular time of

FormulaParagraph.Label: (I)
FormulaParagraph.Text: a share of the capital stock of a subject affiliate owned by the taxpayer at the particular time, or

FormulaParagraph.Label: (II)
FormulaParagraph.Text: an amount owing by the subject affiliate to the taxpayer at the particular time,

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the paid-up capital in respect of the particular class of shares of the capital stock of the taxpayer at the time that is immediately after the particular time, and
is the paid-up capital in respect of all the shares of the capital stock of the taxpayer at the time that is immediately after the particular time, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: for the purposes of Part XIII, the taxpayer is deemed, immediately after the particular time, to have paid to each parent, and each parent is deemed, immediately after the particular time, to have received from the taxpayer, a dividend in an amount determined by the formula

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the amount determined under clause (B) of the description of A in subparagraph (i),
is the amount determined under clause (A) of the description of A in subparagraph (i),
is the fair market value, immediately after the particular time, of the shares of the capital stock of the taxpayer that are held, directly or indirectly, by the parent, and

is the total of all amounts each of which is the fair market value, immediately after the particular time, of the shares of the capital stock of the taxpayer that are held, directly or indirectly, by a parent.

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: where the taxpayer was, immediately before the particular time, a foreign affiliate of another taxpayer that is resident in Canada,

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the affiliate is deemed to have been a controlled foreign affiliate of the other taxpayer immediately before the particular time, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the prescribed amount is to be included in the foreign accrual property income of the affiliate for its taxation year that ends immediately before the particular time.

Subsection.Text: Paragraph (1)(b) does not apply, at a time in a trust’s particular taxation year, to the trust if the trust is resident in Canada for the particular taxation year for the purpose of computing its income.

For the purposes of this subsection and paragraph (1)(c.1), if at any time shares of the capital stock of a corporation resident in Canada are owned by a trust or a partnership (each referred to in this subsection as a “conduit”), each person or partnership with an interest as a beneficiary under the conduit or that is a member of the conduit (each referred to in this subsection as a “holder”), as the case may be, is deemed to own the shares of each class of the capital stock of the corporation that are owned by the conduit the number of which is determined by the formula

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the total number of shares of the class of the capital stock of the corporation that is owned by the conduit at that time;
is the fair market value, at that time, of the holder’s interest in the conduit; and
is the total fair market value, at that time, of all interests in the conduit.

Subsection.Text: If a corporation becomes resident in Canada at a particular time,

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: for the purposes of subsection (1) and this subsection, the paid-up capital adjustment in respect of a particular class of shares of the corporation’s capital stock in respect of that acquisition of residence is the positive or negative amount determined by the formula

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the amount, if any, by which

FormulaParagraph.Label: (i)
FormulaParagraph.Text: the total of all amounts each of which is an amount deemed by paragraph (1)(c) to be the cost to the corporation of property deemed under that paragraph to have been acquired by the corporation at the particular time

FormulaParagraph.Label: (ii)
FormulaParagraph.Text: the total of all amounts each of which is the amount of a debt owing by the corporation, or any other obligation of the corporation to pay an amount, that is outstanding at the particular time,

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the fair market value at the particular time of all of the shares of the particular class,
is the total of all amounts each of which is the fair market value at the particular time of all of the shares of a class of shares of the corporation’s capital stock, and
is the paid-up capital at the particular time, determined without reference to this subsection, in respect of the particular class; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: for the purposes of this Act, in computing the paid-up capital in respect of a class of shares of the corporation’s capital stock at any time after the particular time and before the time, if any, at which the corporation next becomes resident in Canada, there shall be

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: added the amount of the paid-up capital adjustment in respect of the particular class, if that amount is positive and the corporation so elects for all such classes in respect of that acquisition of residence by notifying the Minister in writing within 90 days after the particular time, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: deducted, if the amount of the paid-up capital adjustment in respect of the particular class is negative, the absolute value of that amount.

Subsection.Text: In computing the paid-up capital at any time in respect of a class of shares of the capital stock of a corporation

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: there is to be deducted an amount equal to the lesser of A and B, and added an amount equal to the lesser of A and C, where

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the absolute value of the difference between

FormulaParagraph.Label: (i)
FormulaParagraph.Text: the total of all amounts deemed by subsection 84(3), (4) or (4.1) to be a dividend on shares of the class paid before that time by the corporation, and

FormulaParagraph.Label: (ii)
FormulaParagraph.Text: the total that would be determined under subparagraph (i) if this Act were read without reference to subsection (2),

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the total of all amounts required by subsection (2) to be added in computing the paid-up capital in respect of the class before that time, and
is the total of all amounts required by subsection (2) to be deducted in computing the paid-up capital in respect of the class before that time; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: there is to be added an amount equal to the lesser of

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the amount, if any, by which

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: the total of all amounts deemed by subsection 84(3), (4) or (4.1) to be a dividend on shares of the class paid after March 28, 2012 and before that time by the corporation

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: the total that would be determined under clause (A) if this Act were read without reference to subparagraph (c.3)(i), and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the total of all amounts required by subparagraph (c.3)(i) to be deducted in computing the paid-up capital in respect of the class before that time.

Subsection.Text: For the purposes of this Act, where at a particular time a taxpayer ceases to be resident in Canada,

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: where the taxpayer is a corporation or a trust,

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the taxpayer’s taxation year that would otherwise include the particular time shall be deemed to have ended immediately before the particular time and a new taxation year of the taxpayer shall be deemed to have begun at the particular time, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: for the purpose of determining the taxpayer’s fiscal period after the particular time, the taxpayer shall be deemed not to have established a fiscal period before the particular time;

Paragraph.Label: (a.1)
Paragraph.Text: if the taxpayer is an individual (other than a trust) and carries on a business at the particular time, otherwise than through a permanent establishment (as defined by regulation) in Canada,

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the fiscal period of the business is deemed to have ended immediately before the particular time and a new fiscal period of the business is deemed to have begun at the particular time, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: for the purpose of determining the fiscal period of the business after the particular time, the taxpayer is deemed not to have established a fiscal period of the business before the particular time;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the taxpayer is deemed to have disposed, at the time (in this paragraph and paragraph (d) referred to as the “time of disposition”) that is immediately before the time that is immediately before the particular time, of each property owned by the taxpayer other than, if the taxpayer is an individual,

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: real or immovable property situated in Canada, a Canadian resource property or a timber resource property,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: capital property used in, property included in Class 14.1 of Schedule II to the Income Tax Regulations in respect of or property described in the inventory of, a business carried on by the taxpayer through a permanent establishment (as defined by regulation) in Canada at the particular time,

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: an excluded right or interest of the taxpayer,

Subparagraph.Label: (iv)
Subparagraph.Text: if the taxpayer is not a trust and was not, during the 120-month period that ends at the particular time, resident in Canada for more than 60 months, property that was owned by the taxpayer at the time the taxpayer last became resident in Canada or that was acquired by the taxpayer by inheritance or bequest after the taxpayer last became resident in Canada, and

Subparagraph.Label: (v)
Subparagraph.Text: any property in respect of which the taxpayer elects under paragraph (6)(a) for the taxation year that includes the first time, after the particular time, at which the taxpayer becomes resident in Canada,

ContinuedParagraph.Text: for proceeds equal to its fair market value at the time of disposition, which proceeds are deemed to have become receivable and to have been received by the taxpayer at the time of disposition;

Paragraph.Label: (b.1)
Paragraph.Text: notwithstanding paragraph (b), if the taxpayer is or was at any time an employee life and health trust,

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the taxpayer is deemed

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: to have disposed, at the time (in this paragraph referred to as the “time of disposition”) that is immediately before the time that is immediately before the particular time, of each property owned by the taxpayer for proceeds equal to its fair market value at the time of disposition, which proceeds are deemed to have become receivable and to have been received by the taxpayer at the time of disposition, and

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: to have carried on a business at the time of disposition, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: each property of the taxpayer is deemed

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: to have been described in the inventory of the business referred to in clause (i)(B), and

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: to have a cost of nil at the time of disposition;

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: the taxpayer is deemed to have reacquired, at the particular time, each property deemed by paragraph (b) or (b.1) to have been disposed of by the taxpayer, at a cost equal to the proceeds of disposition of the property;

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: notwithstanding paragraphs (b) to (c), if the taxpayer is an individual (other than a trust) and so elects in prescribed form and manner in respect of a property described in subparagraph (b)(i) or (ii),

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the taxpayer is deemed to have disposed of the property at the time of disposition for proceeds equal to its fair market value at that time and to have reacquired the property at the particular time at a cost equal to those proceeds,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the taxpayer’s income for the taxation year that includes the particular time is deemed to be the greater of

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: that income determined without reference to this subparagraph, and

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: the lesser of

Subclause.Label: (I)
Subclause.Text: that income determined without reference to this subsection, and

Subclause.Label: (II)
Subclause.Text: that income determined without reference to subparagraph (i), and

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: each of the taxpayer’s non-capital loss, net capital loss, restricted farm loss, farm loss and limited partnership loss for the taxation year that includes the particular time is deemed to be the lesser of

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: that amount determined without reference to this subparagraph, and

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: the greater of

Subclause.Label: (I)
Subclause.Text: that amount determined without reference to this subsection, and

Subclause.Label: (II)
Subclause.Text: that amount determined without reference to subparagraph (i); and

Paragraph.Label: (d.1)
Paragraph.Text: if the taxpayer is deemed by paragraph (b) to have disposed of a share that was acquired before February 28, 2000 under circumstances to which subsection 7(1.1) applied, there shall be deducted from the taxpayer’s proceeds of disposition the amount that would, if section 7 were read without reference to subsection 7(1.6), be added under paragraph 53(1)(j) in computing the adjusted cost base to the taxpayer of the share as a consequence of the deemed disposition.

Subsection.Text: If an individual is deemed by subsection (4) to have disposed of a property in a taxation year, in applying sections 155 and 156 and subsections 156.1(1) to (3) and 161(2), (4) and (4.01) and any regulations made for the purposes of those provisions, the individual’s total tax payable under this Part for the year is deemed to be the lesser of

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the individual’s total tax payable under this Part for the year, determined before taking into consideration the specified future tax consequences for the year, and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the amount that would be determined under paragraph (a) if subsection (4) did not apply to the individual for the year.

Subsection.Text: If an individual (other than a trust) becomes resident in Canada at a particular time in a taxation year and the last time (in this subsection referred to as the “emigration time”), before the particular time, at which the individual ceased to be resident in Canada was after October 1, 1996,

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: subject to paragraph (b), if the individual so elects in writing and files the election with the Minister on or before the individual’s filing-due date for the year, paragraphs (4)(b) and (c) do not apply to the individual’s cessation of residence at the emigration time in respect of all properties that were taxable Canadian properties of the individual throughout the period that began at the emigration time and that ends at the particular time;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: where, if a property in respect of which an election under paragraph (a) is made had been acquired by the individual at the emigration time at a cost equal to its fair market value at the emigration time and had been disposed of by the individual immediately before the particular time for proceeds of disposition equal to its fair market value immediately before the particular time, the application of subsection 40(3.7) would reduce the amount that would, but for that subsection and this subsection, be the individual’s loss from the disposition,

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the individual is deemed to have disposed of the property at the time of disposition (within the meaning assigned by paragraph (4)(b)) in respect of the emigration time for proceeds of disposition equal to the total of

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: the adjusted cost base to the individual of the property immediately before the time of disposition, and

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: the amount, if any, by which that reduction exceeds the lesser of

Subclause.Label: (I)
Subclause.Text: the adjusted cost base to the individual of the property immediately before the time of disposition, and

Subclause.Label: (II)
Subclause.Text: the amount, if any, that the individual specifies for the purposes of this paragraph in the election under paragraph (a) in respect of the property,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the individual is deemed to have reacquired the property at the emigration time at a cost equal to the amount, if any, by which the amount determined under clause (i)(A) exceeds the lesser of that reduction and the amount specified by the individual under subclause (i)(B)(II), and

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: for the purpose of section 119, the individual is deemed to have disposed of the property immediately before the particular time;

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: if the individual so elects in writing and files the election with the Minister on or before the individual’s filing-due date for the year, in respect of each property that the individual owned throughout the period that began at the emigration time and that ends at the particular time and that is deemed by paragraph (1)(b) to have been disposed of because the individual became resident in Canada, notwithstanding paragraphs (1)(c) and (4)(b) the individual’s proceeds of disposition at the time of disposition (within the meaning assigned by paragraph (4)(b)), and the individual’s cost of acquiring the property at the particular time, are deemed to be those proceeds and that cost, determined without reference to this paragraph, minus the least of

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the amount that would, but for this paragraph, have been the individual’s gain from the disposition of the property deemed by paragraph (4)(b) to have occurred,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the fair market value of the property at the particular time, and

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: the amount that the individual specifies for the purposes of this paragraph in the election; and

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: notwithstanding subsections 152(4) to (5), any assessment of tax that is payable under this Act by the individual for any taxation year that is before the year that includes the particular time and that is not before the year that includes the emigration time shall be made that is necessary to take an election under this subsection into account, except that no such assessment shall affect the computation of

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: interest payable under this Act to or by a taxpayer in respect of any period that is before the day on which the taxpayer’s return of income for the taxation year that includes the particular time is filed, or

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: any penalty payable under this Act.

Subsection.Text: For the purposes of paragraph (6)(a), a property is deemed to be taxable Canadian property of the individual throughout the period that began at the emigration time and that ends at the particular time if

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the emigration time is before March 5, 2010; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the property was taxable Canadian property of the individual on March 4, 2010.

Subsection.Text: If an individual (other than a trust)

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: becomes resident in Canada at a particular time in a taxation year,

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: owns at the particular time a property that the individual last acquired on a trust distribution to which subsection 107(2) would, but for subsection 107(5), have applied and at a time (in this subsection referred to as the “distribution time”) that was after October 1, 1996 and before the particular time, and

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: was a beneficiary of the trust at the last time, before the particular time, at which the individual ceased to be resident in Canada,

ContinuedSectionSubsection.Text: the following rules apply:

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: subject to paragraphs (e) and (f), if the individual and the trust jointly so elect in writing and file the election with the Minister on or before the earlier of their filing-due dates for their taxation years that include the particular time, subsection 107(2.1) does not apply to the distribution in respect of all properties acquired by the individual on the distribution that were taxable Canadian properties of the individual throughout the period that began at the distribution time and that ends at the particular time,

Paragraph.Label: (e)
Paragraph.Text: paragraph (f) applies in respect of the individual, the trust and a property in respect of which an election under paragraph (d) is made where, if the individual

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: had been resident in Canada at the distribution time,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: had acquired the property at the distribution time at a cost equal to its fair market value at that time,

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: had ceased to be resident in Canada immediately after the distribution time, and

Subparagraph.Label: (iv)
Subparagraph.Text: had, immediately before the particular time, disposed of the property for proceeds of disposition equal to its fair market value immediately before the particular time,

ContinuedSectionSubsection.Text: the application of subsection 40(3.7) would reduce the amount that would, but for that subsection and this subsection, have been the individual’s loss from the disposition,

Paragraph.Label: (f)
Paragraph.Text: where this paragraph applies in respect of an individual, a trust and a property,

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: notwithstanding paragraph 107(2.1)(a), the trust is deemed to have disposed of the property at the distribution time for proceeds of disposition equal to the total of

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: the cost amount to the trust of the property immediately before the distribution time, and

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: the amount, if any, by which the reduction under subsection 40(3.7) described in paragraph (e) exceeds the lesser of

Subclause.Label: (I)
Subclause.Text: the cost amount to the trust of the property immediately before the distribution time, and

Subclause.Label: (II)
Subclause.Text: the amount, if any, which the individual and the trust jointly specify for the purposes of this paragraph in the election under paragraph (d) in respect of the property, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: notwithstanding paragraph 107(2.1)(b), the individual is deemed to have acquired the property at the distribution time at a cost equal to the amount, if any, by which the amount otherwise determined under paragraph 107(2)(b) exceeds the lesser of the reduction under subsection 40(3.7) described in paragraph (e) and the amount specified under subclause (i)(B)(II),

Paragraph.Label: (g)
Paragraph.Text: if the individual and the trust jointly so elect in writing and file the election with the Minister on or before the later of their filing-due dates for their taxation years that include the particular time, in respect of each property that the individual owned throughout the period that began at the distribution time and that ends at the particular time and that is deemed by paragraph (1)(b) to have been disposed of because the individual became resident in Canada, notwithstanding paragraphs 107(2.1)(a) and (b), the trust’s proceeds of disposition under paragraph 107(2.1)(a) at the distribution time, and the individual’s cost of acquiring the property at the particular time, are deemed to be those proceeds and that cost determined without reference to this paragraph, minus the least of

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the amount that would, but for this paragraph, have been the trust’s gain from the disposition of the property deemed by paragraph 107(2.1)(a) to have occurred,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the fair market value of the property at the particular time, and

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: the amount that the individual and the trust jointly specify for the purposes of this paragraph in the election,

Paragraph.Label: (h)
Paragraph.Text: if the trust ceases to exist before the individual’s filing-due date for the individual’s taxation year that includes the particular time,

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: an election or specification described in this subsection may be made by the individual alone in writing if the election is filed with the Minister on or before that filing-due date, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: if the individual alone makes such an election or specification, the individual and the trust are jointly and severally, or solidarily, liable for any amount payable under this Act by the trust as a result of the election or specification, and

Paragraph.Label: (i)
Paragraph.Text: notwithstanding subsections 152(4) to (5), such assessment of tax payable under the Act by the trust or the individual for any year that is before the year that includes the particular time and that is not before the year that includes the distribution time shall be made as is necessary to take an election under this subsection into account, except that no such assessment shall affect the computation of

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: interest payable under this Act to or by the trust or the individual in respect of any period that is before the individual’s filing-due date for the taxation year that includes the particular time, or

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: any penalty payable under this Act.

Subsection.Text: If an individual (other than a trust)

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: was deemed by paragraph (4)(b) to have disposed of a capital property at any particular time after October 1, 1996,

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: has disposed of the property at a later time at which the property was a taxable Canadian property of the individual, and

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: so elects in writing in the individual’s return of income for the taxation year that includes the later time,

ContinuedSectionSubsection.Text: there shall, except for the purpose of paragraph (4)(c), be deducted from the individual’s proceeds of disposition of the property at the particular time, and added to the individual’s proceeds of disposition of the property at the later time, an amount equal to the least of

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: the amount specified in respect of the property in the election,

Paragraph.Label: (e)
Paragraph.Text: the amount that would, but for the election, be the individual’s gain from the disposition of the property at the particular time, and

Paragraph.Label: (f)
Paragraph.Text: the amount that would be the individual’s loss from the disposition of the property at the later time, if the loss were determined having reference to every other provision of this Act including, for greater certainty, subsection 40(3.7) and section 112, but without reference to the election.

Subsection.Text: An individual who ceases at a particular time in a taxation year to be resident in Canada, and who owns immediately after the particular time one or more reportable properties the total fair market value of which at the particular time is greater than $25,000, shall file with the Minister in prescribed form, on or before the individual’s filing-due date for the year, a list of all the reportable properties that the individual owned immediately after the particular time.
The definitions in this subsection apply in this section.

Definition.Text: excluded right or interest of a taxpayer who is an individual means

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: a right of the individual under, or an interest of the individual in a trust governed by,

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: a registered retirement savings plan or a plan referred to in subsection 146(12) as an “amended plan”,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: a registered retirement income fund,

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: a registered education savings plan,

Subparagraph.Label: (iii.1)
Subparagraph.Text: a registered disability savings plan,

Subparagraph.Label: (iii.2)
Subparagraph.Text: a TFSA,

Subparagraph.Label: (iii.3)
Subparagraph.Text: a FHSA,

Subparagraph.Label: (iv)
Subparagraph.Text: a deferred profit sharing plan or a plan referred to in subsection 147(15) as a “revoked plan”,

Subparagraph.Label: (v)
Subparagraph.Text: an employees profit sharing plan,

Subparagraph.Label: (vi)
Subparagraph.Text: an employee benefit plan (other than a plan described in subparagraph (b)(i) or (ii)),

Subparagraph.Label: (vi.1)
Subparagraph.Text: an employee life and health trust,

Subparagraph.Label: (vii)
Subparagraph.Text: a plan or arrangement (other than an employee benefit plan) under which the individual has a right to receive in a year remuneration in respect of services rendered by the individual in the year or a prior year,

Subparagraph.Label: (viii)
Subparagraph.Text: a superannuation or pension fund or plan (other than an employee benefit plan),

Subparagraph.Label: (ix)
Subparagraph.Text: a retirement compensation arrangement,

Subparagraph.Label: (x)
Subparagraph.Text: a foreign retirement arrangement, or

Subparagraph.Label: (xi)
Subparagraph.Text: a registered supplementary unemployment benefit plan;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: a right of the individual to a benefit under an employee benefit plan that is

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: a plan or arrangement described in paragraph (j) of the definition salary deferral arrangement in subsection 248(1) that would, but for paragraphs (j) and (k) of that definition, be a salary deferral arrangement, or

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: a plan or arrangement that would, but for paragraph 6801(c) of the Income Tax Regulations, be a salary deferral arrangement,

ContinuedParagraph.Text: to the extent that the benefit can reasonably be considered to be attributable to services rendered by the individual in Canada;

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: a right of the individual under an agreement referred to in subsection 7(1);

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: a right of the individual to a retiring allowance;

Paragraph.Label: (e)
Paragraph.Text: a right of the individual under, or an interest of the individual in, a trust that is

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: an employee trust,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: an amateur athlete trust,

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: a cemetery care trust, or

Subparagraph.Label: (iv)
Subparagraph.Text: a trust governed by an eligible funeral arrangement;

Paragraph.Label: (f)
Paragraph.Text: a right of the individual to receive a payment under

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: an annuity contract, or

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: an income-averaging annuity contract;

Paragraph.Label: (g)
Paragraph.Text: a right of the individual to a benefit under

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the Canada Pension Plan or a provincial pension plan as defined in section 3 of that Act,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the Old Age Security Act, or

Subparagraph.Label: (iv)
Subparagraph.Text: a plan or arrangement instituted by the social security legislation of a country other than Canada or of a state, province or other political subdivision of such a country;

Paragraph.Label: (h)
Paragraph.Text: a right of the individual to a benefit described in any of subparagraphs 56(1)(a)(iii) to (vi);

Paragraph.Label: (i)
Paragraph.Text: a right of the individual to a payment out of a NISA Fund No. 2;

Paragraph.Label: (j)
Paragraph.Text: an interest of the individual in a personal trust resident in Canada if the interest was never acquired for consideration and did not arise as a consequence of a qualifying disposition by the individual (within the meaning that would be assigned by subsection 107.4(1) if that subsection were read without reference to paragraphs 107.4(1)(h) and (i));

Paragraph.Label: (k)
Paragraph.Text: an interest of the individual in a non-resident testamentary trust that is an estate that arose on and as a consequence of a death if

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the interest was never acquired for consideration, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the estate has been in existence for no more than 36 months; or

Paragraph.Label: (l)
Paragraph.Text: an interest of the individual in a life insurance policy in Canada, except for that part of the policy in respect of which the individual is deemed by paragraph 138.1(1)(e) to have an interest in a related segregated fund trust. (droit, participation ou intérêt exclu)

Definition.Text: reportable property of an individual at a particular time means any property other than

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: money that is legal tender in Canada and deposits of such money;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: property that would be an excluded right or interest of the individual if the definition excluded right or interest in this subsection were read without reference to paragraphs (c), (j) and (l) of that definition;

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: if the individual is not a trust and was not, during the 120-month period that ends at the particular time, resident in Canada for more than 60 months, property described in subparagraph (4)(b)(iv) that is not taxable Canadian property; and

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: any item of personal-use property the fair market value of which, at the particular time, is less than $10,000. (bien à déclarer)

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Subsection.Text: Where a corporation formed at a particular time by the amalgamation or merger of, or by a plan of arrangement or other corporate reorganization in respect of, 2 or more corporations (each of which is referred to in this section as a “predecessor”) is at the particular time resident in Canada, a predecessor that was not immediately before the particular time resident in Canada shall be deemed to have become resident in Canada immediately before the particular time.

Where a corporation formed at a particular time by the amalgamation or merger of, or by a plan of arrangement or other corporate reorganization in respect of, 2 or more corporations is at the particular time not resident in Canada, a predecessor that was immediately before the particular timeresident in Canada shall be deemed to have ceased to be resident in Canada immediately before the particular time.

For greater certainty, subsections 128.2(1) and (2) do not apply to reorganizations occurring solely because of the acquisition of property of one corporation by another corporation, pursuant to the purchase of the property by the other corporation or because of the distribution of the property to the other corporation on the winding-up of the corporation.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Section.Text: If, in a transaction to which section 51, subparagraphs 85.1(1)(a)(i) and (ii), subsection 85.1(8) or section 86 or 87 applies, a person acquires a share (in this section referred to as the “new share”) in exchange for another share or equity in a SIFT wind-up entity (in this section referred to as the “old share”), for the purposes of section 119, subsections 126(2.21) to (2.23), subparagraph 128.1(4)(b)(iv) and subsections 128.1(6) to (8), 180.1(1.4) and 220(4.5) and (4.6), the person is deemed not to have disposed of the old share, and the new share is deemed to be the same share as the old share.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Subsection.Text: Where a return of a corporation’s income under this Part for a taxation year is made within 3 years after the end of the year, the Minister

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: may, on sending the notice of assessment for the year, refund without application an amount (in this Act referred to as its “dividend refund” for the year) in respect of taxable dividends paid by the corporation on shares of its capital stock in the year, and at a time when it was a private corporation, equal to the total of

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: in respect of eligible dividends, an amount equal to the lesser of

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: 38 1/3% of the total of all eligible dividends paid by it in the year, and

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: its eligible refundable dividend tax on hand at the end of the year, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: in respect of taxable dividends (other than eligible dividends), an amount equal to the total of

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: the lesser of

Subclause.Label: (I)
Subclause.Text: 38 1/3% of the total of all taxable dividends (other than eligible dividends) paid by it in the year, and

Subclause.Label: (II)
Subclause.Text: its non-eligible refundable dividend tax on hand at the end of the year, and

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: either

Subclause.Label: (I)
Subclause.Text: if the amount determined under subclause (A)(I) exceeds the amount determined under subclause (A)(II), the lesser of

Subsubclause.Text: the amount of the excess, and
the amount by which the corporation’s eligible refundable dividend tax on hand at the end of the year exceeds the amount, if any, determined under subparagraph (i) for the year, and

Subclause.Label: (II)
Subclause.Text: in any other case, nil; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: shall, with all due dispatch, make the dividend refund after sending the notice of assessment if an application for it has been made in writing by the corporation within the period within which the Minister would be allowed

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: under subsection 152(4) to assess tax payable under this Part by the corporation for the year if that subsection were read without reference to paragraph 152(4)(a), or

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: under subsection 152(4.31) to assess tax payable under Part IV by the corporation for the year if the Minister has assessed the corporation’s tax payable under that Part for the year under subsection 152(4.31).

Subsection.MarginalNote: Dividends paid to bankrupt controlling corporation
Subsection.Text: In determining the dividend refund for a taxation year ending after 1977 of a particular corporation, no amount may be included under clause (1)(a)(i)(A), subclause (1)(a)(ii)(A)(I) or sub-subclause (1)(a)(ii)(B)(I)1 in respect of a taxable dividend paid to a shareholder that

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: was a corporation that controlled (within the meaning assigned by subsection 186(2)) the particular corporation at the time the dividend was paid; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: was a bankrupt at any time during that taxation year of the particular corporation.

Subsection.MarginalNote: Dividends deemed not to be taxable dividends
Subsection.Text: Where a dividend is paid on a share of the capital stock of a corporation and the share (or another share for which the share was substituted) was acquired by its holder in a transaction or as part of a series of transactions one of the main purposes of which was to enable the corporation to obtain a dividend refund, the dividend shall, for the purpose of subsection 129(1), be deemed not to be a taxable dividend.

Instead of making a refund that might otherwise be made under subsection 129(1), the Minister may, where the corporation is liable or about to become liable to make any payment under this Act, apply the amount that would otherwise be refundable to that other liability and notify the corporation of that action.

Where a dividend refund for a taxation year is paid to, or applied to a liability of, a corporation, the Minister shall pay or apply interest on the refund at the prescribed rate for the period beginning on the day that is the later of

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the day that is 120 days after the end of the year, and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the day that is 30 days after the day on which the corporation’s return of income under this Part for the year was filed under section 150, unless the return was filed on or before the day on or before which it was required to be filed,

ContinuedSectionSubsection.Text: and ending on the day on which the refund is paid or applied.

Subsection.Text: Where, at any particular time, interest has been paid to, or applied to a liability of, a corporation under subsection 129(2.1) in respect of a dividend refund and it is determined at a subsequent time that the dividend refund was less than that in respect of which interest was so paid or applied,

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the amount by which the interest that was so paid or applied exceeds the interest, if any, computed in respect of the amount that is determined at the subsequent time to be the dividend refund shall be deemed to be an amount (in this subsection referred to as the “amount payable”) that became payable under this Part by the corporation at the particular time;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the corporation shall pay to the Receiver General interest at the prescribed rate on the amount payable, computed from the particular time to the day of payment; and

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: the Minister may at any time assess the corporation in respect of the amount payable and, where the Minister makes such an assessment, the provisions of Divisions I and J apply, with such modifications as the circumstances require, in respect of the assessment as though it had been made under section 152.

Subsection.Text: Where, in a taxation year that begins after November 12, 1981, a corporation that last became a private corporation on or before that date and that was throughout the year a private corporation, other than a Canadian-controlled private corporation, has included in its income for the year an amount in respect of property that the corporation

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: disposed of before November 13, 1981,

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: was obligated to dispose of under the terms of an agreement in writing entered into before November 13, 1981, or

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: is deemed by subsection 44(2) to have disposed of at any time after November 12, 1981 because of an event referred to in paragraph (b), (c) or (d) of the definition proceeds of disposition in section 54 in respect of the disposition that occurred before November 13, 1981,

ContinuedSectionSubsection.Text: paragraph 3(a) shall apply as if the corporation were a Canadian-controlled private corporation throughout the year, except that the total of the amounts determined under that paragraph in respect of the corporation for the year shall not exceed the amount that would be so determined if the only income of the corporation for the year were the amount included in respect of the disposition of such property.

Subsection.Text: The definitions in this subsection apply in this section.

Definition.Text: aggregate investment income of a corporation for a taxation year means the amount, if any, by which the total of all amounts, each of which is

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the amount, if any, by which

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the eligible portion of the corporation’s taxable capital gains for the year

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the eligible portion of its allowable capital losses for the year, and

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: the amount, if any, deducted under paragraph 111(1)(b) in computing its taxable income for the year, or

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the corporation’s income for the year from a source that is a property, other than

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: exempt income,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: an amount included under subsection 12(10.2) in computing the corporation’s income for the year,

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: the portion of any dividend that was deductible in computing the corporation’s taxable income for the year, and

Subparagraph.Label: (iv)
Subparagraph.Text: income that, but for paragraph 108(5)(a), would not be income from a property,

ContinuedDefinition.Text: exceeds the total of all amounts, each of which is the corporation’s loss for the year from a source that is a property. (revenu de placement total)

Definition.Text: eligible portion of a corporation’s taxable capital gains or allowable capital losses for a taxation year is the total of all amounts each of which is the portion of a taxable capital gain or an allowable capital loss, as the case may be, of the corporation for the year from a disposition of a property that, except where the property was a designated property (within the meaning assigned by subsection 89(1)), cannot reasonably be regarded as having accrued while the property, or a property for which it was substituted, was property of a corporation other than a Canadian-controlled private corporation, a substantive CCPC, an investment corporation, a mortgage investment corporation or a mutual fund corporation. (fraction admissible)
eligible refundable dividend tax on hand, of a particular corporation at the end of a taxation year, means the amount, if any, by which the total of

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the total of the taxes payable under Part IV by the particular corporation for the year in respect of

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: eligible dividends received by the particular corporation in the year from corporations other than corporations with which the particular corporation is connected (in this paragraph, within the meaning assigned by subsection 186(4) on the assumption that the other corporation is at that time a payer corporation within the meaning of that subsection),

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: taxable dividends received by the particular corporation in the year from corporations that are connected with the particular corporation to the extent that such dividends caused a dividend refund to those corporations from their eligible refundable dividend tax on hand, and

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: eligible dividends received by the particular corporation in a taxation year that began after 2018 from corporations (referred to in this subparagraph as “payer corporations”) that are connected with the particular corporation to the extent that such dividends

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: caused a dividend refund to those payer corporations from their refundable dividend tax on hand at the end of their first taxation year that ended after 2018, and

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: are not otherwise included in determining the particular corporation’s eligible refundable dividend tax on hand, and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: where the particular corporation was a private corporation at the end of its preceding taxation year, the particular corporation’s eligible refundable dividend tax on hand at the end of that preceding year

ContinuedDefinition.Text: exceeds

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: the total of all amounts each of which is the portion, if any, of the particular corporation’s dividend refund from its eligible refundable dividend tax on hand determined, for its preceding taxation year, under

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: subparagraph (1)(a)(i), and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: clause (1)(a)(ii)(B). (impôt en main remboursable au titre de dividendes déterminés)

Definition.Text: foreign investment income of a corporation for a taxation year is the amount that would be its aggregate investment income for the year if

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: every amount of its income, loss, capital gain or capital loss for the year that can reasonably be regarded as being from a source in Canada were nil,

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: no amount were deducted under paragraph 111(1)(b) in computing its taxable income for the year, and

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: this Act were read without reference to paragraph (a) of the definition income or loss in this subsection. (revenu de placement étranger)

Definition.Text: income or loss of a corporation for a taxation year from a source that is a property

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: includes the income or loss from a specified investment business carried on by it in Canada other than income or loss from a source outside Canada, but

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: does not include

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the income or loss from any property that is incident to or pertains to an active business carried on by it,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the income or loss from any property that is used or held principally for the purpose of gaining or producing income from an active business carried on by it, or

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: for each election made for the year under subsection 93.4(2) by the corporation or by a partnership of which the corporation is a member (or of which the corporation is deemed to be a member under subsection 93.1(3)),

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: the portion of the FABI amount (within the meaning of subsection 93.4(2)(a)) in respect of the election that is included in computing the corporation’s income under subsection 91(1) for the year or, if the election was made by a partnership of which the corporation is a member, the portion of the FABI amount included in the partnership’s income under subsection 91(1) that is included in the corporation’s income for the year in accordance with subsection 96(1), or

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: the portion of the amount deducted under subsection 91(4) that is determined under subparagraph 93.4(2)(b)(i) to be in respect of the FABI amount to which the election relates. (revenu ou perte)

Definition.Text: non-eligible refundable dividend tax on hand, of a corporation at the end of a taxation year, means the amount, if any, by which the total of

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: if the corporation was a Canadian-controlled private corporation throughout the year or a substantive CCPC at any time in the year, the least of

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the amount determined by the formula

FormulaDefinition.Text: is 30 2/3% of the corporation’s aggregate investment income for the year, and
is the amount, if any, by which

FormulaParagraph.Label: (A)
FormulaParagraph.Text: the amount deducted under subsection 126(1) from the tax for the year otherwise payable by it under this Part

FormulaParagraph.Label: (B)
FormulaParagraph.Text: 8% of its foreign investment income for the year,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: 30 2/3% of the amount, if any, by which the corporation’s taxable income for the year exceeds the total of

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: the least of the amounts determined under paragraphs 125(1)(a) to (c) in respect of the corporation for the year,

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: 100/(38 2/3) of the total of amounts deducted under subsection 126(1) from its tax for the year otherwise payable under this Part, and

Clause.Label: (C)
Clause.Text: the amount determined by multiplying the total of amounts deducted under subsection 126(2) from its tax for the year otherwise payable under this Part, by the relevant factor for the year, and

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: the corporation’s tax for the year payable under this Part,

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the total of the taxes payable under Part IV by the corporation for the year less the amount determined under paragraph (a) of the definition eligible refundable dividend tax on hand in respect of the corporation for the year, and

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: if the corporation was a private corporation at the end of its preceding taxation year, the corporation’s non-eligible refundable dividend tax on hand at the end of that preceding year

ContinuedDefinition.Text: exceeds

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: the portion, if any, of the corporation’s dividend refund from its non-eligible refundable dividend tax on hand determined, for its preceding taxation year, under clause (1)(a)(ii)(A). (impôt en main remboursable au titre de dividendes non déterminés)

Subsection.Text: Subsection (4.2) applies in respect of a particular taxation year of a particular corporation if the following conditions are met:

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the particular corporation has an amount of tax payable for the year under Part IV;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the particular corporation has claimed amounts under paragraph 186(1)(c) or (d) in respect of the year; and

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: the particular corporation would, in the absence of paragraphs 186(1)(c) and (d), have an amount determined, at the end of the year, under both paragraph (a) of the definition eligible refundable dividend tax on hand and paragraph (b) of the definition non-eligible refundable dividend tax on hand in subsection (4).

Subsection.MarginalNote: Part IV tax — allocation of losses
Subsection.Text: If this subsection applies in respect of a particular taxation year of a corporation, for the purpose of determining the amount under paragraph (a) of the definition eligible refundable dividend tax on hand in subsection (4), in respect of the corporation at the end of the year, the amount determined under subsection 186(1) in respect of the corporation for the year is deemed to be the amount determined by the formula

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the amount determined under paragraph 186(1)(a) in respect of the corporation for the year in respect of eligible dividends;

is the amount determined under paragraph 186(1)(b) in respect of the corporation for the year in respect of dividends that resulted in dividend refunds from the eligible refundable dividend tax on hand of other corporations; and
is the amount determined by the formula
is the amount claimed by the corporation under paragraph 186(1)(c) for the year,
is the amount claimed by the corporation under paragraph 186(1)(d) for the year,
is the amount determined under paragraph 186(1)(a) in respect of the corporation for the year in respect of taxable dividends (other than eligible dividends), and

is the amount determined under paragraph 186(1)(b) in respect of the corporation for the year in respect of dividends that resulted in dividend refunds from the non-eligible refundable dividend tax on hand of other corporations.

Subsection.Text: The following rules apply to a corporation’s first taxation year in respect of which the definition eligible refundable dividend tax on hand in subsection (4) applies:

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: if the corporation is a Canadian-controlled private corporation throughout the taxation year and its preceding taxation year and is not a corporation in respect of which an election under subsection 89(11) applies to the taxation year or the preceding taxation year,

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: for the purpose of applying paragraph (b) of the definition eligible refundable dividend tax on hand in respect of the corporation at the end of the taxation year, the corporation’s eligible refundable dividend tax on hand at the end of its preceding taxation year is deemed to be the amount, if any, that is the lesser of

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: the amount determined by the formula

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the corporation’s refundable dividend tax on hand at the end of its preceding taxation year, and
is the corporation’s dividend refund for its preceding taxation year, and

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: the amount determined by the formula

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the corporation’s general rate income pool at the end of its preceding taxation year,
is the amount, if any, by which

FormulaParagraph.Label: (I)
FormulaParagraph.Text: the total of all amounts each of which is an eligible dividend paid by the corporation in its preceding taxation year

FormulaParagraph.Label: (II)
FormulaParagraph.Text: the total of all amounts each of which is an excessive eligible dividend designation made by the corporation in its preceding taxation year, and

FormulaDefinition.Text: is 38 1/3%, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: for the purpose of applying paragraph (c) of the definition non-eligible refundable dividend tax on hand in respect of the corporation at the end of the taxation year, the corporation’s non-eligible refundable dividend tax on hand at the end of its preceding taxation year is deemed to be the amount determined by the formula

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the amount determined under clause (a)(i)(A) in respect of the corporation at the end of the preceding taxation year, and
is the amount determined under clause (a)(i)(B) in respect of the corporation at the end of the preceding taxation year; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: in any other case, for the purpose of applying paragraph (b) of the definition eligible refundable dividend tax on hand in respect of the corporation at the end of the taxation year, the corporation’s eligible refundable dividend tax on hand at the end of its preceding taxation year is deemed to be the amount that would be determined for clause (a)(i)(A) if paragraph (a) applied to the corporation in respect of the taxation year.

Subsection.Text: Subsection (5) applies with such modifications as are necessary for the purpose of applying paragraph 87(2)(aa) in respect of a corporation if

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the corporation is a predecessor corporation (within the meaning assigned by subsection 87(1)) in respect of an amalgamation (within the meaning assigned by subsection 87(1));

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the corporation has an amount of refundable dividend tax on hand at the end of its taxation year that ends because of paragraph 87(2)(a); and

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: the first taxation year of the new corporation (within the meaning assigned by subsection 87(1)) in respect of the amalgamation is one to which the definition eligible refundable dividend tax on hand in subsection (4) applies.

Subsection.MarginalNote: Investment income from associated corporation deemed to be active business income
Subsection.Text: Where any particular amount paid or payable to a corporation (in this subsection referred to as the “recipient corporation”) by another corporation (in this subsection referred to as the “associated corporation”) with which the recipient corporation was associated in any particular taxation year commencing after 1972, would otherwise be included in computing the income of the recipient corporation for the particular year from a source in Canada that is a property, the following rules apply:

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: for the purposes of subsection 129(4), in computing the recipient corporation’s income for the year from a source in Canada that is a property,

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: there shall not be included any portion (in this subsection referred to as the “deductible portion”) of the particular amount that was or may be deductible in computing the income of the associated corporation for any taxation year from an active business carried on by it in Canada, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: no deduction shall be made in respect of any outlay or expense, to the extent that that outlay or expense may reasonably be regarded as having been made or incurred by the recipient corporation for the purpose of gaining or producing the deductible portion; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: for the purposes of this subsection and section 125,

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the deductible portion shall be deemed to be income of the recipient corporation for the particular year from an active business carried on by it in Canada, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: any outlay or expense, to the extent described in subparagraph 129(6)(a)(ii), shall be deemed to have been made or incurred by the recipient corporation for the purpose of gaining or producing that income.

Subsection.Text: For the purposes of this section, taxable dividend does not include a capital gains dividend within the meaning assigned by subsection 131(1).
Expressions used in this section and not otherwise defined for the purposes of this section have the same meanings as in section 125.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Subsection.Text: A corporation that was, throughout a taxation year, an investment corporation may deduct from the tax otherwise payable by it under this Part for the year an amount equal to 20% of the amount, if any, by which its taxable income for the year exceeds its taxed capital gains for the year.

Where a corporation was an investment corporation throughout a taxation year (other than a corporation that was a mutual fund corporation throughout the year), subsections 131(1) to (3.2), (4.1) and (6) apply in respect of the corporation for the year

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: as if the corporation had been a mutual fund corporation throughout that and all previous taxation years ending after 1971 throughout which it was an investment corporation; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: as if its capital gains redemptions for that and all previous taxation years ending after 1971, throughout which it would, but for the assumption made by paragraph 130(2)(a), not have been a mutual fund corporation, were nil.

Subsection.MarginalNote: Meaning of expressions investment corporation and taxed capital gains
Subsection.Text: For the purposes of this section,

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: a corporation is an investment corporation throughout any taxation year in respect of which the expression is being applied if it complied with the following conditions:

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: it was throughout the year a Canadian corporation that was a public corporation,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: at least 80% of its property throughout the year consisted of shares, bonds, marketable securities or cash,

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: not less than 95% of its income (determined without reference to subsection 49(2)) for the year was derived from, or from dispositions of, investments described in subparagraph 130(3)(a)(ii),

Subparagraph.Label: (iv)
Subparagraph.Text: not less than 85% of its gross revenue for the year was from sources in Canada,

Subparagraph.Label: (v)
Subparagraph.Text: not more than 25% of its gross revenue for the year was from interest,

Subparagraph.Label: (vi)
Subparagraph.Text: at no time in the year did more than 10% of its property consist of shares, bonds or securities of any one corporation or debtor other than Her Majesty in right of Canada or of a province or a Canadian municipality,

Subparagraph.Label: (vii)
Subparagraph.Text: no person would have been a specified shareholder of the corporation in the year if

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: the portion of the definition specified shareholder in subsection 248(1) before paragraph (a) were read as follows:

Definition.Text: “specified shareholder of a corporation in a taxation year means a taxpayer who owns, directly or indirectly, at any time in the year, more than 25% of the issued shares of any class of the capital stock of the corporation and, for the purposes of this definition,”

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: paragraph (a) of that definition were read as follows:

Paragraph.Label: “(a)
Paragraph.Text: a taxpayer is deemed to own each share of the capital stock of a corporation owned at that time by a person related to the taxpayer,”

Clause.Label: (C)
Clause.Text: that definition were read without reference to paragraph (d) of that definition,

Clause.Label: (D)
Clause.Text: paragraph 251(2)(a) were read as follows:

Paragraph.Label: “(a)
Paragraph.Text: an individual and

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the individual’s child (as defined in subsection 70(10)) who is under 19 years of age, or

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the individual’s spouse or common-law partner;”

Subparagraph.Label: (viii)
Subparagraph.Text: an amount not less than 85% of the total of

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: 2/3 of the amount, if any, by which its taxable income for the year exceeds its taxed capital gains for the year, and

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: the amount, if any, by which all taxable dividends received by it in the year to the extent of the amount thereof deductible under section 112 or 113 from its income for the year exceeds the amount that the corporation’s non-capital loss for the year would be if the amount determined in respect of the corporation for the year under paragraph 3(b) was nil,

ContinuedSubparagraph.Text: (less any dividends or interest received by it in the form of shares, bonds or other securities that had not been sold before the end of the year) was distributed, otherwise than by way of capital gains dividends, to its shareholders before the end of the year; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the amount of the taxed capital gains of a taxpayer for a taxation year is the amount, if any, by which

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: its taxable capital gains for the year from dispositions of property

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the total of its allowable capital losses for the year from dispositions of property and the amount, if any, deducted under paragraph 111(1)(b) for the purpose of computing its taxable income for the year.
