Subsection.Text: Where a corporation so elects in its return of income under this Part for a taxation year, each of the corporation’s properties that is a share or indebtedness of another Canadian corporation that is at any time in the year a subsidiary wholly owned corporation of the corporation shall, for the purposes of subparagraphs 130(3)(a)(ii) and (vi), be deemed not to be owned by the corporation at any such time in the year, and each property owned by the other corporation at that time shall, for the purposes of those subparagraphs, be deemed to be owned by the corporation at that time.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Subsection.Text: In computing the income for a taxation year of a corporation that was, throughout the year, a mortgage investment corporation,

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: there may be deducted the total of

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: all taxable dividends, other than capital gains dividends, paid by the corporation during the year or within 90 days after the end of the year to the extent that those dividends were not deductible by the corporation in computing its income for the preceding year, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: 1/2 of all capital gains dividends paid by the corporation during the period commencing 91 days after the commencement of the year and ending 90 days after the end of the year; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: no deduction may be made under section 112 in respect of taxable dividends received by it from other corporations.

Subsection.Text: For the purposes of this Act, any amount received from a mortgage investment corporation by a shareholder of the corporation as or on account of a taxable dividend, other than a capital gains dividend, shall be deemed to have been received by the shareholder as interest payable on a bond issued by the corporation after 1971.

Subsection 130.1(2) applies where the taxable dividend (other than a capital gains dividend) described in that subsection was paid during a taxation year throughout which the paying corporation was a mortgage investment corporation or within 90 days thereafter.

Where at any particular time during the period that begins 91 days after the beginning of a taxation year of a corporation that was, throughout the year, a mortgage investment corporation and ends 90 days after the end of the year, a dividend is paid by the corporation to shareholders of the corporation, if the corporation so elects in respect of the full amount of the dividend in prescribed manner and at or before the earlier of the particular time and the first day on which any part of the dividend was paid,

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the dividend shall be deemed to be a capital gains dividend to the extent that it does not exceed the amount, if any, by which

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: twice the taxed capital gains of the corporation for the year

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the total of all dividends, and parts of dividends, paid by the corporation during the period and before the particular time that are deemed by this paragraph to be capital gains dividends; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: notwithstanding any other provision of this Act, if an amount is received by a taxpayer in a taxation year as, on account of, in lieu of payment of or in satisfaction of, the dividend, the amount

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: shall not be included in computing the taxpayer’s income for the year as income from a share of the capital stock of the corporation, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: is deemed to be a capital gain of the taxpayer from the disposition of capital property in the year.

Subsection.Text: Where at any particular time a mortgage investment corporation paid a dividend to its shareholders and subsection 130.1(4) would have applied to the dividend except that the corporation did not make an election under that subsection on or before the day on or before which it was required by that subsection to be made, subsections 131(1.1) to 131(1.4) apply with such modifications as the circumstances require.
Notwithstanding any other provision of this Act, a mortgage investment corporation shall be deemed to be a public corporation.
For the purposes of this section, a corporation is a mortgage investment corporation throughout a taxation year if, throughout the year,

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: it was a Canadian corporation;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: its only undertaking was the investing of funds of the corporation and it did not manage or develop any real or immovable property;

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: none of the property of the corporation consisted of

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: debts owing to the corporation that were secured on real or immovable property situated outside Canada,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: debts owing to the corporation by non-resident persons, except any such debts that were secured on real or immovable property situated in Canada,

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: shares of the capital stock of corporations not resident in Canada, or

Subparagraph.Label: (iv)
Subparagraph.Text: real or immovable property situated outside Canada, or any leasehold interest in such property;

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: there were 20 or more shareholders of the corporation and no person would have been a specified shareholder of the corporation at any time in the year if

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the portion of the definition specified shareholder in subsection 248(1) before paragraph (a) were read as follows:

Definition.Text: “specified shareholder of a corporation at any time means a taxpayer who owns, directly or indirectly, at that time, more than 25% of the issued shares of any class of the capital stock of the corporation and, for the purposes of this definition,”

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: paragraph (a) of that definition were read as follows:

Paragraph.Label: “(a)
Paragraph.Text: a taxpayer is deemed to own each share of the capital stock of a corporation owned at that time by a person related to the taxpayer,”

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: that definition were read without reference to paragraph (d) of that definition, and

Subparagraph.Label: (iv)
Subparagraph.Text: paragraph 251(2)(a) were read as follows:

Paragraph.Label: “(a)
Paragraph.Text: an individual and

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the individual’s child (as defined in subsection 70(10)) who is under 18 years of age, or

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the individual’s spouse or common-law partner;”

Paragraph.Label: (e)
Paragraph.Text: any holders of preferred shares of the corporation had a right, after payment to them of their preferred dividends, and payment of dividends in a like amount per share to the holders of the common shares of the corporation, to participate pari passu with the holders of the common shares in any further payment of dividends;

Paragraph.Label: (f)
Paragraph.Text: the cost amount to the corporation of such of its property as consisted of

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: debts owing to the corporation that were secured, whether by mortgages, hypothecs or in any other manner, on houses (as defined in section 2 of the National Housing Act) or on property included within a housing project (as defined in that section as it read on June 16, 1999), and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: amounts of any deposits standing to the corporation’s credit in the records of

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: a bank or other corporation any of whose deposits are insured by the Canada Deposit Insurance Corporation or the Régie de l’assurance-dépôts du Québec, or

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: a credit union,

ContinuedParagraph.Text: plus the amount of any money of the corporation was at least 50% of the cost amount to it of all its property;

Paragraph.Label: (g)
Paragraph.Text: the cost amount to the corporation of all real or immovable property of the corporation, including leasehold interests in such property (except real or immovable property acquired by the corporation by foreclosure or otherwise after default made on a mortgage, hypothec or agreement of sale of real or immovable property) did not exceed 25% of the cost amount to it of all its property;

Paragraph.Label: (h)
Paragraph.Text: its liabilities did not exceed 3 times the amount by which the cost amount to it of all its property exceeded its liabilities, where at any time in the year the cost amount to it of such of its property as consisted of property described in subparagraphs 130.1(6)(f)(i) and 130.1(6)(f)(ii) plus the amount of any money of the corporation was less than 2/3 of the cost amount to it of all of its property; and

Paragraph.Label: (i)
Paragraph.Text: its liabilities did not exceed 5 times the amount by which the cost amount to it of all its property exceeded its liabilities, where paragraph 130.1(6)(h) is not applicable.

Subsection.Text: In paragraph (6)(d), a trust governed by a registered pension plan or deferred profit sharing plan by which shares of the capital stock of a corporation are held shall be counted as four shareholders of the corporation for the purpose of determining the number of shareholders of the corporation, but as one shareholder for the purpose of determining whether any person is a specified shareholder (as defined for the purpose of that paragraph).

For the purposes of subsection 130.1(6), a corporation that was incorporated after 1971 shall be deemed to have complied with paragraph 130.1(6)(d) throughout the first taxation year of the corporation in which it carried on business if it complied with that paragraph on the last day of that taxation year.
In this section,

Definition.Text: liabilities of a corporation at any particular time means the total of all debts owing by the corporation, and all other obligations of the corporation to pay an amount, that were outstanding at that time; (passif)
taxed capital gains has the meaning assigned by paragraph 130(3)(b). (gains en capital imposés)

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Subsection.Text: Where at any particular time a dividend became payable by a corporation, that was throughout the taxation year in which the dividend became payable a mutual fund corporation, to shareholders of any class of its capital stock, if the corporation so elects in respect of the full amount of the dividend in prescribed manner and at or before the earlier of the particular time and the first day on which any part of the dividend was paid,

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the dividend shall be deemed to be a capital gains dividend payable out of the corporation’s capital gains dividend account to the extent that it does not exceed the corporation’s capital gains dividend account atthe particular time; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: notwithstanding any other provision of this Act (other than paragraph (5.1)(b)), if an amount is received by a taxpayer in a taxation year as, on account of, in lieu of payment of or in satisfaction of, the dividend, the amount

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: shall not be included in computing the taxpayer’s income for the year as income from a share of the capital stock of the corporation, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: is deemed to be a capital gain of the taxpayer from the disposition of capital property in the year.

Subsection.Text: Where at any particular time a dividend has become payable by a mutual fund corporation to shareholders of any class of shares of its capital stock and subsection 131(1) would have applied to the dividend except that the election referred to in that subsection was not made on or before the day on or before which the election was required by that subsection to be made, the election shall be deemed to have been made at the particular time or on the first day on which any part of the dividend was paid, whichever is the earlier, if

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the election is thereafter made in prescribed manner and prescribed form;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: an estimate of the penalty in respect of the election is paid by the corporation when the election is made; and

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: the directors or other person or persons legally entitled to administer the affairs of the corporation have, before the time the election is made, authorized the election to be made.

Subsection.Text: The Minister may at any time, by written request served personally or by registered mail, request that an election referred to in paragraph 131(1.1)(a) be made by a mutual fund corporation and where the mutual fund corporation on which such a request is served does not comply therewith within 90 days after service of the request, subsection 131(1.1) does not apply to such an election made thereafter by it.
For the purposes of this section, the penalty in respect of an election referred to in paragraph 131(1.1)(b) is an amount equal to the lesser of

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: 1% per annum of the amount of the dividend referred to in the election for each month or part of a month during the period commencing with the time that the dividend became payable, or the first day on which any part of the dividend was paid if that day is earlier, and ending with the day on which the election was made, and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the product obtained when $500 is multiplied by the proportion that the number of months or parts of months during the period referred to in paragraph 131(1.3)(a) bears to 12.

Subsection.Text: The Minister shall, with all due dispatch, examine each election referred to in paragraph 131(1.1)(a), assess the penalty payable and send a notice of assessment to the mutual fund corporation and the corporation shall pay forthwith to the Receiver General, the amount, if any, by which the penalty so assessed exceeds the total of all amounts previously paid on account of that penalty.

Subsection.MarginalNote: Capital gains refund to mutual fund corporation
Subsection.Text: Where a corporation was, throughout a taxation year, a mutual fund corporation and a return of its income for the year has been made within 3 years from the end of the year, the Minister

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: may, on sending the notice of assessment for the year, refund an amount (in this subsection referred to as its “capital gains refund” for the year) equal to the lesser of

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the total of

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: 14% of the total of

Subclause.Label: (I)
Subclause.Text: all capital gains dividends paid by the corporation in the period commencing 60 days after the beginning of the year and ending 60 days after the end of the year, and

Subclause.Label: (II)
Subclause.Text: its capital gains redemptions for the year, and

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: the amount, if any, that the Minister determines to be reasonable in the circumstances, after giving consideration to the percentages applicable in determining the corporation’s capital gains refund for the year and preceding taxation years and the percentages applicable in determining the corporation’s refundable capital gains tax on hand at the end of the year, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the corporation’s refundable capital gains tax on hand at the end of the year; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: shall, with all due dispatch, make that capital gains refund after sending the notice of assessment if an application for it has been made in writing by the corporation within the period within which the Minister would be allowed under subsection 152(4) to assess tax payable under this Part by the corporation for the year if that subsection were read without reference to paragraph 152(4)(a).

Subsection.Text: Instead of making a refund that might otherwise be made under subsection 131(2), the Minister may, where the corporation is liable or about to become liable to make any payment under this Act, apply the amount that would otherwise be refunded to that other liability and notify the corporation of that action.

Where a capital gains refund for a taxation year is paid to, or applied to a liability of, a corporation, the Minister shall pay or apply interest on the refund at the prescribed rate for the period beginning on the day that is the later of

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the day that is 120 days after the end of the year, and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the day that is 30 days after the day on which the corporation’s return of income under this Part for the year was filed under section 150, unless the return was filed on or before the day on or before which it was required to be filed,

ContinuedSectionSubsection.Text: and ending on the day the refund is paid or applied.

Subsection.MarginalNote: Excess interest on capital gains refund
Subsection.Text: Where at any particular time interest has been paid to, or applied to a liability of, a corporation under subsection 131(3.1) in respect of a capital gains refund and it is determined at a subsequent time that the capital gains refund was less than that in respect of which interest was so paid or applied,

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the amount by which the interest that was so paid or applied exceeds the interest, if any, computed in respect of the amount that is determined at the subsequent time to be the capital gains refund shall be deemed to be an amount (in this subsection referred to as the “amount payable”) that became payable under this Part by the corporation at the particular time;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the corporation shall pay to the Receiver General interest at the prescribed rate on the amount payable, computed from the particular time to the day of payment; and

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: the Minister may at any time assess the corporation in respect of the amount payable and, where the Minister makes such an assessment, the provisions of Divisions I and J apply, with such modifications as the circumstances require, in respect of the assessment as though it had been made under section 152.

Subsection.Text: Section 84 does not apply to deem a dividend to have been paid by a corporation to any of its shareholders, or to deem any of the shareholders of a corporation to have received a dividend on any shares of the capital stock of the corporation, if at the time the dividend would, but for this subsection, be deemed by that section to have been so paid or received, as the case may be, the corporation was a mutual fund corporation.

Sections 51, 85, 85.1, 86 and 87 do not apply to a taxpayer that holds a share (in this subsection referred to as the old share) of a class of shares, that is recognized under securities legislation as or as part of an investment fund, of a mutual fund corporation if the taxpayer exchanges or otherwise disposes of the old share for another share (in this subsection referred to as the new share) of a mutual fund corporation, unless

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: if the exchange or disposition occurs in the course of a transaction, event or series of transactions or events described in subsections 86(1) or 87(1),

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: all shares of the class (determined without reference to subsection 248(6)) that includes the old share at the time of the exchange or disposition are exchanged for shares of the class that includes the new share,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the old share and the new share derive their value in the same proportion from the same property or group of properties, and

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: the transaction, event or series was undertaken solely for bona fide purposes and not to cause this paragraph to apply;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: if the old share and the new share are shares of the same class (determined without reference to subsection 248(6)) of shares of the same mutual fund corporation,

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the old share and the new share derive their value in the same proportion from the same property or group of properties held by the corporation that is allocated to that class, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: that class is recognized under securities legislation as or as part of a single investment fund; or

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: if the old share and the new share are not shares of the same class but are shares of Capital régional et coopératif Desjardins,

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the old share and the new share derive their value in the same proportion from the same property or group of properties, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the shares are recognized under securities legislation as or as part of the same investment fund.

Subsection.MarginalNote: Dividend refund to mutual fund corporation
Subsection.Text: A corporation that was a mutual fund corporation throughout a taxation year

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: is deemed for the purposes of paragraph 87(2)(aa) and section 129 to have been a private corporation throughout the year, except that its non-eligible refundable dividend tax on hand (as defined in subsection 129(4)) at the end of the year shall be determined without reference to paragraph (a) of that definition; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: where it was not an investment corporation throughout the year, is deemed for the purposes of Part IV to have been a private corporation throughout the year except that, in applying subsection 186(1) to the corporation in respect of the year, that subsection shall be read without reference to paragraph 186(1)(b).

Subsection.Text: If a mutual fund corporation elects under subsection (1) to treat a dividend as a capital gains dividend, for the purposes of this Part and Part XIII,

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: each shareholder to whom the dividend is paid is deemed to receive from the corporation, at the time the dividend is paid, a TCP gains distribution equal to the lesser of the amount of the dividend and the shareholder’s pro rata portion at that time of the mutual fund corporation’s TCP gains balance; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: where the dividend is paid to a shareholder who is a non-resident person or a partnership that is not a Canadian partnership,

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: subparagraph (1)(b)(ii) does not apply in respect of the dividend, to the extent of the TCP gains distribution, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the TCP gains distribution is a taxable dividend that, except for the purpose of the definition of capital gains dividend account in subsection (6), is not a capital gains dividend.

Subsection.Text: Subsection (5.1) applies to a dividend paid by a mutual fund corporation in a taxation year only if more than 5% of the dividend is received by or on behalf of shareholders each of whom is a non-resident person or is a partnership that is not a Canadian partnership.
In this section,

Definition.Text: capital gains dividend account of a mutual fund corporation at any time means the amount, if any, by which

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the total of

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: its capital gains, for all taxation years that began more than 60 days before that time, from dispositions of property after 1971 and before that time while it was a mutual fund corporation, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: all amounts each of which is an amount in respect of a distribution made by a trust to the corporation, at a time that is after its 2004 taxation year and at which it is a mutual fund corporation, in respect of capital gains of the trust equal to twice the amount determined by the following formula:

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the amount of the distribution, and
is the amount designated under subsection 104(21) by the trust in respect of the net taxable capital gains of the trust attributable to those capital gains

ContinuedDefinition.Text: exceeds

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the total of

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: its capital losses, for all taxation years that began more than 60 days before that time, from dispositions of property after 1971 and before that time while it was a mutual fund corporation,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: all capital gains dividends that became payable by the corporation before that time and more than 60 days after the end of the last taxation year that ended more than 60 days before that time, and

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: an amount equal to 100/14 of its capital gains refund for any taxation year throughout which it was a mutual fund corporation where the year ended more than 60 days before that time; (compte de dividendes sur les gains en capital)

Definition.Text: capital gains redemptions of a mutual fund corporation for a taxation year means the amount determined by the formula

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the sum of

FormulaParagraph.Label: (a)
FormulaParagraph.Text: the total of all amounts paid by the corporation in the year on the redemption of shares of its capital stock, and

FormulaParagraph.Label: (b)
FormulaParagraph.Text: the total of all amounts each of which is an amount equal to the fair market value of the shares of the corporation’s capital stock that were exchanged in the year for other shares of the corporation’s capital stock if

FormulaParagraph.Label: (i)
FormulaParagraph.Text: paragraph (4.1) applies to the exchange, and

FormulaParagraph.Label: (ii)
FormulaParagraph.Text: the amount is not included in the amount determined for paragraph (a),

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the total of the fair market value at the end of the year of all the issued shares of its capital stock and the amount determined for A in respect of the corporation for the year,
is 100/14 of the corporation’s refundable capital gains tax on hand at the end of the year, and
is the amount determined by the formula
is the amount of the fair market value at the end of the year of all the issued shares of the corporation’s capital stock,
is the total of all amounts each of which is the amount of any debt owing by the corporation, or of any other obligation of the corporation to pay an amount, that was outstanding at that time,
is the total of the cost amounts to the corporation at that time of all its properties, and
is the amount of any money of the corporation on hand at that time; (rachats au titre des gains en capital)

Text.DefinedTermEn: non-qualifying real property capital gains dividend account

Definition.Text: pro rata portion, of a shareholder at any time, of a mutual fund corporation’s TCP gains balance, in respect of a dividend paid by the mutual fund corporation on a class of shares of its capital stock, means the amount determined by the formula

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the mutual fund corporation’s TCP gains balance immediately before that time,
is the amount received in respect of the dividend by the shareholder, and
is the total amount of the dividend; (partie proportionnelle)

Definition.Text: refundable capital gains tax on hand of a mutual fund corporation at the end of a taxation year means the amount determined by the formula

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the total of all amounts each of which is an amount in respect of that or any previous taxation year throughout which the corporation was a mutual fund corporation, equal to the least of

FormulaParagraph.Label: (a)
FormulaParagraph.Text: 28% of its taxable income for the year,

FormulaParagraph.Label: (b)
FormulaParagraph.Text: 28% of its taxed capital gains for the year, and

FormulaParagraph.Label: (c)
FormulaParagraph.Text: the tax payable by it under this Part for the year determined without reference to section 123.2, and

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the total of all amounts each of which is an amount in respect of any previous taxation year throughout which the corporation was a mutual fund corporation, equal to its capital gains refund for the year; (impôt en main remboursable au titre des gains en capital)

Definition.Text: TCP gains balance, of a mutual fund corporation at any time, means the amount, if any, by which

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the total of

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the mutual fund corporation’s capital gains from dispositions, after March 22, 2004 and at or before that time, of taxable Canadian properties, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the TCP gains distributions (including those defined in section 132) received by the mutual fund corporation at or before that time

ContinuedDefinition.Text: exceeds

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the total of

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the mutual fund corporation’s capital losses from dispositions, after March 22, 2004 and at or before that time, of taxable Canadian properties, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the total of all amounts deemed, in respect of dividends paid by the mutual fund corporation before that time, to be TCP gains distributions received by shareholders from the mutual fund corporation; (solde des gains provenant de BCI)

Definition.Text: TCP gains distribution means a TCP gains distribution described in subsection (5.1). (distribution de gains provenant de BCI)

Subsection.Text: In subsection 131(6), taxed capital gains of a taxpayer for a taxation year has the meaning assigned by subsection 130(3).

Subject to subsections (8.1) to (8.3), a corporation is, for the purposes of this section, a mutual fund corporation at any time in a taxation year if, at that time, it was a prescribed labour-sponsored venture capital corporation or

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: it was a Canadian corporation that was a public corporation;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: its only undertaking was

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the investing of its funds in property (other than real property or an interest in real property or an immovable or a real right in an immovable),

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the acquiring, holding, maintaining, improving, leasing or managing of any real property (or interest in real property) or of any immovable (or real right in immovables) that is capital property of the corporation, or

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: any combination of the activities described in subparagraphs 131(8)(b)(i) and 131(8)(b)(ii), and

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: the issued shares of the capital stock of the corporation included shares

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: having conditions attached thereto that included conditions requiring the corporation to accept, at the demand of the holder thereof and at prices determined and payable in accordance with the conditions, the surrender of the shares, or fractions or parts thereof, that are fully paid, or

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: qualified in accordance with prescribed conditions relating to the redemption of the shares,

ContinuedParagraph.Text: and the fair market value of such of the issued shares of its capital stock as had conditions attached thereto that included such conditions or as were so qualified, as the case may be, was not less than 95% of the fair market value of all of the issued shares of the capital stock of the corporation (such fair market values being determined without regard to any voting rights attaching to shares of the capital stock of the corporation).

Subsection.MarginalNote: Election to be a mutual fund corporation
Subsection.Text: A corporation is deemed to be a mutual fund corporation, from the date it was incorporated until the earlier of the date the corporation meets the conditions to qualify as a mutual fund corporation under subsection (8) and December 31, 2017, if the corporation

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: was incorporated after 2014 and before March 22, 2016;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: would have been a mutual fund corporation on March 22, 2016 if it could have elected on or before that date to be a public corporation under paragraph (b) of the definition public corporation in subsection 89(1), had the conditions prescribed in paragraph 4800(1)(b) of the Income Tax Regulations been satisfied;

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: on March 22, 2016, had at least one class of shares that was recognized under securities legislation as an investment fund; and

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: elects to have this subsection apply in the corporation’s return of income for the corporation’s first taxation year that ends after March 21, 2016.

Subsection.Text: Where, at any time, it can reasonably be considered that a corporation, having regard to all the circumstances, including the terms and conditions of the shares of its capital stock, was established or is maintained primarily for the benefit of non-resident persons, the corporation shall be deemed not to be a mutual fund corporation after that time unless

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: throughout the period that begins on the later of February 21, 1990 and the day of its incorporation and ends at that time, all or substantially all of its property consisted of property other than property that would be taxable Canadian property if the definition taxable Canadian property in subsection 248(1) were read without reference to paragraph (b) of that definition; or

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: it has not issued a share (other than a share issued as a stock dividend) of its capital stock after February 20, 1990 and before that time to a person who, after reasonable inquiry, it had reason to believe was non-resident, except where the share was issued to that person under an agreement in writing entered into before February 21, 1990.

Subsection.Text: A corporation (other than a prescribed labour-sponsored venture capital corporation) is deemed not to be a mutual fund corporation after a particular time if, at that time,

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: a person or partnership, or any combination of persons or partnerships that do not deal with each other at arm’s length (in either case, referred to in this subsection and subsection (8.3) as “specified persons”) own, in the aggregate, shares of the capital stock of the corporation having a fair market value of more than 10% of the fair market value of all of the issued and outstanding shares of the capital stock of the corporation; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the corporation is controlled by or for the benefit of one or more specified persons.

Subsection.Text: Subsection (8.2) does not apply to a corporation if, at the particular time referred to in that subsection,

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the corporation was incorporated not more than two years before the particular time; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the aggregate fair market value of the shares of the capital stock of the corporation owned by specified persons does not exceed $5,000,000.

Subsection.MarginalNote: Reduction of refundable capital gains tax on hand
Subsection.Text: Notwithstanding any other provision of this section, the amount determined for A in the definition refundable capital gains tax on hand in subsection 131(6) in respect of the 1972 or 1973 taxation year of a corporation is,

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: in respect of its 1972 taxation year, 91.25% of the amount so determined; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: in respect of its 1973 taxation year, the total of

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: 91.25% of that proportion of the amount so determined that the number of days in that portion of the year that is before 1973 is of the number of days in the whole year, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: 100% of that proportion of the amount so determined that the number of days in that portion of the year that is after 1972 is of the number of days in the whole year.

Subsection.Text: Notwithstanding any other provision of this Act, a mutual fund corporation or an investment corporation that at any time would, but for this subsection, be a restricted financial institution shall, if it has so elected in prescribed manner and prescribed form before that time, be deemed not to be a restricted financial institution at that time.

Subsection.MarginalNote: Rules respecting prescribed labour-sponsored venture capital corporations
Subsection.Text: Notwithstanding any other provision of this Act, in applying this Act to a corporation that was at any time a prescribed labour-sponsored venture capital corporation,

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: for the purposes of subparagraphs (a)(i) and (ii) of the definition non-eligible refundable dividend tax on hand in subsection 129(4), the amount deducted under paragraph 111(1)(b) from the corporation’s income for each taxation year ending after that time shall be deemed to be nil;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the definition aggregate investment income in subsection 129(4) shall be read without reference to paragraph (a) of that definition in its application to taxation years that end after that time;

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: notwithstanding subsection 131(4), if it so elects in its return of income under this Part for a taxation year ending after that time, subsection 84(1) applies for that year and all subsequent taxation years;

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: subsection 131(5) does not apply for taxation years ending after that time; and

Paragraph.Label: (e)
Paragraph.Text: the amount of the corporation’s capital dividend account at any time after that time shall be deemed to be nil.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Section.MarginalNote: Capital gains refund to mutual fund trust

Subsection.Text: Where a trust was, throughout a taxation year, a mutual fund trust and a return of its income for the year has been made within 3 years from the end of the year, the Minister

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: may, on sending the notice of assessment for the year, refund an amount (in this subsection referred to as its “capital gains refund” for the year) equal to the lesser of

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the total of

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: 16.5% of the total of the trust’s capital gains redemptions for the year, and

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: the positive or negative amount, if any, that the Minister determines to be reasonable in the circumstances, after giving consideration to the percentages applicable in determining the trust’s capital gains refunds for the year or any previous taxation year and the percentages applicable in determining the trust’s refundable capital gains tax on hand at the end of the year, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the trust’s refundable capital gains tax on hand at the end of the year; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: shall, with all due dispatch, make that capital gains refund after sending the notice of assessment if an application for it has been made in writing by the trust within the period within which the Minister would be allowed under subsection 152(4) to assess tax payable under this Part by the trust for the year if that subsection were read without reference to paragraph 152(4)(a).

Subsection.Text: Instead of making a refund that might otherwise be made under subsection 132(1) the Minister may, where the trust is liable or about to become liable to make any payment under this Act, apply the amount that would otherwise be refunded to that other liability and notify the trust of that action.

If a capital gains refund for a taxation year is paid to, or applied to a liability of, a mutual fund trust, the Minister shall pay or apply interest on the refund at the prescribed rate for the period beginning on the day that is 30 days after the later of

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the day that is 90 days after the end of the year, and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the day on which the trust’s return of income under this Part for the year was filed under section 150

ContinuedSectionSubsection.Text: and ending on the day on which the refund is paid or applied.

Subsection.MarginalNote: Excess interest on capital gains refund
Subsection.Text: Where at any particular time interest has been paid to, or applied to a liability of, a trust under subsection 132(2.1) in respect of a capital gains refund and it is determined at a subsequent time that the capital gains refund was less than that in respect of which interest was so paid or applied,

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the amount by which the interest that was so paid or applied exceeds the interest, if any, computed in respect of the amount that is determined at the subsequent time to be the capital gains refund shall be deemed to be an amount (in this subsection referred to as the “amount payable”) that became payable under this Part by the trust at the particular time;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the trust shall pay to the Receiver General interest at the prescribed rate on the amount payable, computed from the particular time to the day of payment; and

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: the Minister may at any time assess the trust in respect of the amount payable and, where the Minister makes such an assessment, the provisions of Divisions I and J apply, with such modifications as the circumstances require, in respect of the assessment as though it had been made under section 152.

Subsection.Text: In its application in respect of a mutual fund trust, subsection 104(20) shall be read as if the reference therein to “a dividend (other than a taxable dividend)” were read as a reference to “a capital dividend”.
In this section,

Definition.Text: capital gains redemptions of a mutual fund trust for a taxation year means the amount determined by the formula

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the total of all amounts each of which is the portion of an amount paid by the trust in the year on the redemption of a unit in the trust that is included in the proceeds of disposition in respect of that redemption,
is the total of the fair market value at the end of the year of all the issued units of the trust and the amount determined for A in respect of the trust for the year,
is 100/16.5 of the trust’s refundable capital gains tax on hand at the end of the year,
is the amount determined by the formula
is the amount of the fair market value at the end of the year of all the issued units of the trust,
is the total of all amounts each of which is the amount of any debt owing by the trust, or of any other obligation of the trust to pay an amount, that was outstanding at that time,
is the total of the cost amounts to the trust at that time of all its properties, and
is the amount of any money of the trust on hand at that time, and

is twice the total of all amounts each of which is an amount designated under subsection 104(21) for the year by the trust in respect of a unit of the trust redeemed by the trust at any time in the year and after December 21, 2000; (rachats au titre des gains en capital)

Definition.Text: net asset value has the same meaning as in National Instrument 81-102 Investment Funds, as amended from time to time, of the Canadian Securities Administrators; (valeur liquidative)

pro rata portion, of a beneficiary, of a mutual fund trust’s TCP gains balance for a taxation year, in respect of an amount designated under subsection 104(21) by the mutual fund trust for the taxation year, means the amount determined by the formula

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the mutual fund trust’s TCP gains balance for the taxation year,
is the amount the mutual fund trust has designated under that subsection in respect of the beneficiary for the taxation year, and
is the total of all amounts designated under that subsection by the mutual fund trust for the taxation year; (partie proportionnelle)

Definition.Text: refundable capital gains tax on hand of a mutual fund trust at the end of a taxation year means the amount determined by the formula

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the total of all amounts each of which is an amount in respect of that or any previous taxation year throughout which the trust was a mutual fund trust, equal to the least of

FormulaParagraph.Label: (a)
FormulaParagraph.Text: the highest individual percentage for the year multiplied by its taxable income for the year,

FormulaParagraph.Label: (b)
FormulaParagraph.Text: the highest individual percentage for the year multiplied by its taxed capital gains for the year, and

FormulaParagraph.Label: (c)
FormulaParagraph.Text: where the taxation year ended after May 6, 1974, the tax payable under this Part by it for the year, and

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the total of all amounts each of which is an amount in respect of any previous taxation year throughout which the trust was a mutual fund trust, equal to its capital gains refund for the year; (impôt en main remboursable au titre des gains en capital)

Definition.Text: TCP gains balance, of a mutual fund trust for a particular taxation year, means the amount, if any, by which

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the total of

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the mutual fund trust’s capital gains from dispositions, after March 22, 2004 and at or before the end of the particular taxation year, of taxable Canadian properties, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the TCP gains distributions (including those defined in section 131) received by the mutual fund trust at or before the end of the particular taxation year

ContinuedDefinition.Text: exceeds

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the total of

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the mutual fund trust’s capital losses from dispositions, after March 22, 2004 and at or before the end of the particular taxation year, of taxable Canadian properties, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the total of all amounts deemed, in respect of amounts designated by the mutual fund trust under subsection 104(21) for taxation years that preceded the particular taxation year, to be TCP gains distributions received by beneficiaries under the mutual fund trust; (solde des gains provenant de BCI)

Definition.Text: TCP gains distribution means a TCP gains distribution described in subsection (5.1). (distribution de gains provenant de BCI)

Subsection.Text: In subsection 132(4), taxed capital gains of a taxpayer for a taxation year has the meaning assigned by subsection 130(3).
If a mutual fund trust designates an amount under subsection 104(21) for a taxation year of the trust in respect of a beneficiary under the trust, for the purposes of this Part and Part XIII,

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the beneficiary is deemed to have received from the mutual fund trust a TCP gains distribution equal to the lesser of

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: twice the amount designated, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the beneficiary’s pro rata portion of the mutual fund trust’s TCP gains balance for the taxation year; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: where the beneficiary is a non-resident person or a partnership that is not a Canadian partnership,

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the amount designated is deemed by subsection 104(21) to be a taxable capital gain of the beneficiary only to the extent that it exceeds one half of the TCP gains distribution, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: one half of the TCP gains distribution is to be added to the amount otherwise included under subsection 104(13) in computing the income of the beneficiary, and is deemed to be an amount to which paragraph 212(1)(c) applies.

Subsection.Text: Subsection (5.1) applies to an amount designated under subsection 104(21) by a mutual fund trust for a taxation year only if more than 5% of the total of all amounts each of which is an amount designated under that subsection by the mutual fund trust for the taxation year was designated in respect of beneficiaries under the mutual fund trust each of whom is a non-resident person or is a partnership that is not a Canadian partnership.

If a trust that is a mutual fund trust throughout a taxation year paid or made payable, at any time in the taxation year, to a beneficiary an amount on a redemption by that beneficiary of a unit of the trust (in this subsection and subsection (5.31) referred to as the “allocated amount”) and the beneficiary’s proceeds from the disposition of that unit do not include the allocated amount, in computing its income for the taxation year no deduction may be made by the trust in respect of

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the portion of the allocated amount that would be, without reference to subsection 104(6), an amount paid out of the income (other than taxable capital gains) of the trust; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the portion of the allocated amount determined by the formula

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the portion of the allocated amount that would be, without reference to subsection 104(6), an amount paid out of the taxable capital gains of the trust,
is the beneficiary’s proceeds from the disposition of the unit on the redemption,
is the allocated amount, and
is the amount determined by the trustee to be the beneficiary’s cost amount of that unit, using reasonable efforts to obtain the information required to determine the cost amount.

Subsection.Text: If in a taxation year referred to in subsection (5.3)

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: all of the units offered in the taxation year by a mutual fund trust are listed on a designated stock exchange in Canada and are in continuous distribution (in this subsection referred to as “ETF units”), then paragraph 132(5.3)(b) does not apply and, in computing its income for the taxation year, no deduction may be made by the trust in respect of the amount determined by the formula

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the portion of the total of all allocated amounts for the taxation year in respect of redemptions of ETF units by beneficiaries of the trust during that year that would be, without reference to subsection 104(6), amounts paid out of the taxable capital gains of the trust,
is the lesser of

FormulaParagraph.Label: (i)
FormulaParagraph.Text: the total amount paid for redemptions of the ETF units in the taxation year, and

FormulaParagraph.Label: (ii)
FormulaParagraph.Text: the greater of

FormulaParagraph.Label: (A)
FormulaParagraph.Text: the amount determined for C, and

FormulaParagraph.Label: (B)
FormulaParagraph.Text: the net asset value of the trust at the end of the previous taxation year,

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the net asset value of the trust at the end of the taxation year, and
is the amount that would be, without reference to subsection 104(6), the trust’s net taxable capital gains (as determined under subsection 104(21.3)) for the taxation year; or

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: units offered by a mutual fund trust include units that are not ETF units (in this paragraph referred to as “non-ETF units”) and units that are ETF units, then

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: in respect of redemptions of ETF units, paragraph (5.3)(b) does not apply and paragraph (a) applies, except that

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: the description of C is to be read as “is the portion of the net asset value of the trust at the end of the taxation year that is referable to the ETF units,”,

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: clause (ii)(B) of the description of B shall be read as “the portion of the net asset value of the trust at the end of the previous taxation year that is referable to the ETF units,”, and

Clause.Label: (C)
Clause.Text: the amount determined for D shall be the amount determined by the formula

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the portion of the net asset value of the trust at the end of the taxation year that is referable to the ETF units,
is the net asset value of the trust at the end of the taxation year, and
is the amount that would be, without reference to subsection 104(6), the trust’s net taxable capital gains (as determined under subsection 104(21.3)) for the taxation year; and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: in respect of redemptions of non-ETF units, in addition to the limitation applicable under paragraph (5.3)(b), the total amount of the deductions that may be claimed by the trust for the taxation year for the portion of the allocated amounts described in the description of A in paragraph (5.3)(b) in respect of non-ETF units shall not exceed the amount determined by the formula

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the portion of the net asset value of the trust at the end of the taxation year that is referable to the non-ETF units,
is the net asset value of the trust at the end of the taxation year, and
is the amount that would be, without reference to subsection 104(6), the trust’s net taxable capital gains (as determined under subsection 104(21.3)) for the taxation year.

Subsection.Text: Subject to subsection 132(7), for the purposes of this section, a trust is a mutual fund trust at any time if at that time

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: it was a unit trust resident in Canada,

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: its only undertaking was

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the investing of its funds in property (other than real property or an interest in real property or an immovable or a real right in an immovable),

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the acquiring, holding, maintaining, improving, leasing or managing of any real property (or interest in real property) or of any immovable (or real right in immovables) that is capital property of the trust, or

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: any combination of the activities described in subparagraphs 132(6)(b)(i) and 132(6)(b)(ii), and

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: it complied with prescribed conditions.

Subsection.Text: Where a trust becomes a mutual fund trust at any particular time before the 91st day after the end of its first taxation year, and the trust so elects in its return of income for that year, the trust is deemed to have been a mutual fund trust from the beginning of that year until the particular time.

Subsection.MarginalNote: Retention of status as mutual fund trust
Subsection.Text: A trust is deemed to be a mutual fund trust throughout a calendar year where

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: at any time in the year, the trust would, if this section were read without reference to this subsection, have ceased to be a mutual fund trust

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: because the condition described in paragraph 108(2)(a) ceased to be satisfied,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: because of the application of paragraph (6)(c), or

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: because the trust ceased to exist;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the trust was a mutual fund trust at the beginning of the year; and

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: the trust would, throughout the portion of the year throughout which it was in existence, have been a mutual fund trust if

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: in the case where the condition described in paragraph 108(2)(a) was satisfied at any time in the year, that condition were satisfied throughout the year,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: subsection (6) were read without reference to paragraph (c) of that subsection, and

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: this section were read without reference to this subsection.

Subsection.Text: Where, at any time, it can reasonably be considered that a trust, having regard to all the circumstances, including the terms and conditions of the units of the trust, was established or is maintained primarily for the benefit of non-resident persons, the trust shall be deemed not to be a mutual fund trust after that time unless

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: at that time, all or substantially all of its property consisted of property other than property that would be taxable Canadian property if the definition taxable Canadian property in subsection 248(1) were read without reference to paragraph (b) of that definition; or

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: it has not issued any unit (other than a unit issued to a person as a payment, or in satisfaction of the person’s right to enforce payment, of an amount out of the trust’s income determined before the application of subsection 104(6), or out of the trust’s capital gains) of the trust after February 20, 1990 and before that time to a person who, after reasonable inquiry, it had reason to believe was non-resident, except where the unit was issued to that person under an agreement in writing entered into before February 21, 1990.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Section.MarginalNote: Amounts designated by mutual fund trust

Subsection.Text: Where a trust in its return of income under this Part for a taxation year throughout which it was a mutual fund trust designates an amount in respect of a particular unit of the trust owned by a taxpayer at any time in the year equal to the total of

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: such amount as the trust may determine in respect of the particular unit for the year not exceeding the amount, if any, by which

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the total of all amounts that were determined by the trust under subsection 104(16) of the Income Tax Act, chapter 148 of the Revised Statutes of Canada, 1952, for taxation years of the trust commencing before 1988

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the total of all amounts determined by the trust under this paragraph for the year or a preceding taxation year in respect of all units of the trust, other than amounts determined in respect of the particular unit for the year under this paragraph, and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: such amount as the trust may determine in respect of the particular unit for the year not exceeding the amount, if any, by which

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the total of all amounts described in subparagraph 53(2)(h)(i.1) that became payable by the trust after 1987 and before the year

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the total of all amounts determined by the trust under this paragraph for the year or a preceding taxation year in respect of all units of the trust, other than amounts determined in respect of the particular unit for the year under this paragraph,

ContinuedSectionSubsection.Text: the amount so designated shall

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: subject to subsection 132.1(3), be deductible in computing the income of the trust for the year, and

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: be included in computing the income of the taxpayer for the taxpayer’s taxation year in which the year of the trust ends, except that where the particular unit was owned by two or more taxpayers during the year, such part of the amount so designated as the trust may determine shall be included in computing the income of each such taxpayer for the taxpayer’s taxation year in which the year of the trust ends if the total of the parts so determined is equal to the amount so designated.

Subsection.MarginalNote: Adjusted cost base of unit where designation made
Subsection.Text: In computing, at any time in a taxation year of a taxpayer, the adjusted cost base to the taxpayer of a unit in a mutual fund trust, there shall be added that part of the amount included under subsection 132.1(1) in computing the taxpayer’s income that is reasonably attributable to the amount determined under paragraph 132.1(1)(b) by the trust for its taxation year ending in the year in respect of the unit owned by the taxpayer.

The total of amounts deductible by reason of paragraph 132.1(1)(c) in computing the income of a trust for a taxation year shall not exceed the amount that would be the income of the trust for the year if no deductions were made under this section and subsection 104(6).

The amount, if any, by which the total of all amounts each of which is an amount designated for the year under subsection 132.1(1) exceeds the amount deductible under this section in computing the income of the trust for the year, shall, for the purposes of paragraph 132.1(1)(c) and subsection 132.1(3), be deemed designated under subsection 132.1(1) by the trust for its immediately following taxation year.
Where it is reasonable to conclude that an amount determined by a mutual fund trust

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: under paragraph 132.1(1)(a) or 132.1(1)(b) for a taxation year of the trust in respect of a unit owned at any time in the year by a taxpayer who was a person exempt from tax under this Part by reason of subsection 149(1), or

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: under paragraph 132.1(1)(d) for the year in respect of the amount designated under subsection 132.1(1) for the year in respect of the unit

ContinuedSectionSubsection.Text: differs from the amount that would have been so determined for the year in respect of the taxpayer had the taxpayer not been a person exempt from tax under this Part by reason of subsection 149(1), the amount designated for the year in respect of the unit under subsection 132.1(1) shall have no effect for the purposes of paragraph 132.1(1)(c).

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Section.MarginalNote: Taxation year of mutual fund trust

Subsection.Text: Notwithstanding any other provision of this Act, where a trust (other than a prescribed trust) that was a mutual fund trust on the 74th day after the end of a particular calendar year so elects in writing filed with the Minister with the trust’s return of income for the trust’s taxation year that includes December 15 of the particular year,

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the trust’s taxation year that began before December 16 of the particular year and, but for this paragraph, would end at the end of the particular year (or, where the first taxation year of the trust began after December 15 of the preceding calendar year and no return of income was filed for a taxation year of the trust that ended at the end of the preceding calendar year, at the end of the preceding calendar year) is deemed to end at the end of December 15 of the particular year;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: if the trust’s taxation year ends on December 15 because of paragraph (a), subject to subsection (1.1), each subsequent taxation year of the trust is deemed to be the period that begins at the beginning of December 16 of a calendar year and that ends at the end of December 15 of the following calendar year or at any earlier time that is determined under paragraph 128.1(4)(a), 132.2(3)(b), 142.6(1)(a) or 249(4)(a); and

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: each fiscal period of the trust that begins in a taxation year of the trust that ends on December 15 because of paragraph (a) or that ends in a subsequent taxation year of the trust shall end no later than the end of the year or the subsequent year, as the case may be.

Subsection.Text: Where a particular taxation year of a trust ends on December 15 of a calendar year because of an election made under paragraph (1)(a), the trust applies to the Minister in writing before December 15 of that calendar year (or before a later time that is acceptable to the Minister) to have this subsection apply to the trust, with the concurrence of the Minister

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the trust’s taxation year following the particular taxation year is deemed to begin immediately after the end of the particular taxation year and end at the end of that calendar year; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: each subsequent taxation year of the trust is deemed to be determined as if that election had not been made.

Subsection.MarginalNote: Electing trust’s share of partnership income and losses
Subsection.Text: Where a trust is a member of a partnership a fiscal period of which ends in a calendar year after December 15 of the year and a particular taxation year of the trust ends on December 15 of the year because of subsection (1), each amount otherwise determined under paragraph 96(1)(f) or (g) to be the trust’s income or loss for a subsequent taxation year of the trust is deemed to be the trust’s income or loss determined under paragraph 96(1)(f) or (g) for the particular year and not for the subsequent year.

Subsection.MarginalNote: Electing trust’s income from other trusts
Subsection.Text: Where a particular trust is a beneficiary under another trust a taxation year of which (in this subsection referred to as the “other year”) ends in a calendar year after December 15 of the year and a particular taxation year of the trust ends on December 15 of the year because of subsection (1), each amount determined or designated under subsection 104(13), (19), (21), (22) or (29) for the other year that would otherwise be included, or taken into account, in computing the income of the particular trust for a subsequent taxation year of the trust shall

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: be included, or taken into account, in computing the particular trust’s income for the particular year; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: not be included, or taken into account, in computing the particular trust’s income for the subsequent year.

Subsection.MarginalNote: Amounts paid or payable to beneficiaries
Subsection.Text: Notwithstanding subsection 104(24), for the purposes of subsections (5) and (6) and 104(6) and (13) and paragraph (i) of the definition disposition in subsection 248(1) each amount that is paid, or that becomes payable, by a trust to a beneficiary after the end of a particular taxation year of the trust that ends on December 15 of a calendar year because of subsection (1) and before the end of that calendar year, is deemed to have been paid or to have become payable, as the case may be, to the beneficiary at the end of the particular year and not at any other time.

Subsection.MarginalNote: Special rules where change in status of beneficiary
Subsection.Text: Where an amount is deemed by subsection (4) to have been paid or to have become payable at the end of December 15 of a calendar year by a trust to a beneficiary who was not a beneficiary under the trust at that time,

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: notwithstanding any other provision of this Act, where the beneficiary did not exist at that time, except for the purpose of this paragraph, the first taxation year of the beneficiary is deemed to include the period that begins at that time and ends immediately before the beginning of the first taxation year of the beneficiary;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the beneficiary is deemed to exist throughout the period described in paragraph (a); and

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: where the beneficiary was not a beneficiary under the trust at that time, the beneficiary is deemed to have been a beneficiary under the trust at that time.

Subsection.Text: Where a particular amount is designated under this subsection by a trust in its return of income for a particular taxation year that ends on December 15 because of subsection (1) or throughout which the trust was a mutual fund trust and the trust does not designate an amount under subsection 104(13.1) or (13.2) for the particular year,

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the particular amount shall be added in computing its income for the particular year; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: for the purposes of subsections 104(6) and (13), each portion of the particular amount that is allocated under this paragraph to a beneficiary under the trust in the trust’s return of income for the particular year in respect of an amount paid or payable to the beneficiary in the particular year shall be considered to be additional income of the trust for the particular year (determined without reference to subsection 104(6)) that was paid or payable, as the case may be, to the beneficiary at the end of the particular year.

Subsection.Text: Subject to subsection (8), the lesser of the amount designated under subsection (6) by a trust for a taxation year and the total of all amounts each of which is allocated by the trust under paragraph (6)(b) in respect of the year shall be deducted in computing the trust’s income for the following taxation year.

Subsection (7) does not apply in computing the income of a trust for a taxation year where it is reasonable to consider that the designation under subsection (6) for the preceding taxation year was part of a series of transactions or events that includes a change in the composition of beneficiaries under the trust.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Section.MarginalNote: Definitions re qualifying exchange of mutual funds

Subsection.Text: The following definitions apply in this section.

Definition.Text: first post-exchange year, of a fund in respect of a qualifying exchange, means the taxation year of the fund that begins immediately after the acquisition time. (première année suivant l’échange)
qualifying exchange means a transfer at any time (in this section referred to as the “transfer time”) if

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the transfer is a transfer of all or substantially all of the property (including an exchange of a unit of a mutual fund trust for another unit of that trust) of

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: a mutual fund corporation (other than a SIFT wind-up corporation) to one or more mutual fund trusts, or

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: a mutual fund trust to a mutual fund trust;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: all or substantially all of the shares issued by the mutual fund corporation referred to in subparagraph (a)(i) or the first mutual fund trust referred to in subparagraph (a)(ii) (in this section referred to as the “transferor”) and outstanding immediately before the transfer time are within 60 days after the transfer time disposed of to the transferor;

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: no person disposing of shares of the transferor to the transferor within that 60-day period (otherwise than pursuant to the exercise of a statutory right of dissent) receives any consideration for the shares other than units of one or more mutual fund trusts referred to in subparagraph (a)(i) or the second mutual fund trust referred to in subparagraph (a)(ii) (in this section referred to as a “transferee” and, together with the transferor, as the “funds”);

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: if property of the transferor has been transferred to more than one transferee,

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: all shares of each class of shares, that is recognized under securities legislation as or as part of an investment fund, of the transferor are disposed of to the transferor within 60 days after the transfer time, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the units received in consideration for a particular share of a class of shares, that is recognized under securities legislation as or as part of an investment fund, of the transferor are units of the transferee to which all or substantially all of the assets that were allocated to that investment fund immediately before the transfer time were transferred; and

Paragraph.Label: (e)
Paragraph.Text: the funds jointly so elect, by filing a prescribed form with the Minister on or before the election’s due date. (échange admissible)

Definition.Text: share means a share of the capital stock of a mutual fund corporation and a unit of a mutual fund trust. (action)

Subsection.Text: In respect of a qualifying exchange, a time referred to in the following list immediately follows the time that precedes it in the list

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the transfer time;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the first intervening time;

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: the acquisition time;

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: the beginning of the funds’ first post-exchange years;

Paragraph.Label: (e)
Paragraph.Text: the depreciables disposition time;

Paragraph.Label: (f)
Paragraph.Text: the second intervening time; and

Paragraph.Label: (g)
Paragraph.Text: the depreciables acquisition time.

Subsection.Text: In respect of a qualifying exchange,

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: each property of a fund, other than property disposed of by the transferor to a transferee at the transfer time and depreciable property, is deemed to have been disposed of, and to have been reacquired by the fund, at the first intervening time, for an amount equal to the lesser of

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the fair market value of the property at the transfer time, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the greater of

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: its cost amount, and

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: the amount that the fund designates in respect of the property in a notification to the Minister accompanying the election in respect of the qualifying exchange;

Paragraph.Label: (a.1)
Paragraph.Text: in respect of each property transferred by the transferor to a transferee, including an exchange of a unit of a transferee for another unit of that transferee, the transferor is deemed to have disposed of the property to the transferee, and to have received units of the transferee as consideration for the disposition of the property, at the transfer time;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: subject to paragraph (l), the last taxation years of the funds that began before the transfer time are deemed to have ended at the acquisition time, and their first post-exchange years are deemed to have begun immediately after those last taxation years ended;

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: each depreciable property of a fund (other than property to which subsection (5) applies and property to which paragraph (d) would, if this Act were read without reference to this paragraph, apply) is deemed to have been disposed of, and to have been reacquired, by the fund at the second intervening time for an amount equal to the lesser of

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the fair market value of the property at the depreciables disposition time, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the greater of

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: the lesser of its capital cost and its cost amount to the disposing fund at the depreciables disposition time, and

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: the amount that the fund designates in respect of the property in a notification to the Minister accompanying the election in respect of the qualifying exchange;

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: if at the second intervening time the undepreciated capital cost to a fund of depreciable property of a prescribed class exceeds the fair market value of all the property of that class, the excess is to be deducted in computing the fund’s income for the taxation year that includes the transfer time and is deemed to have been allowed in respect of property of that class under regulations made for the purpose of paragraph 20(1)(a);

Paragraph.Label: (e)
Paragraph.Text: except as provided in paragraph (m), the transferor’s cost of any particular property received by the transferor from a transferee as consideration for the disposition of the property is deemed to be

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: nil, if the particular property is a unit of the transferee, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the particular property’s fair market value at the transfer time, in any other case;

Paragraph.Label: (f)
Paragraph.Text: the transferor’s proceeds of disposition of any units of a transferee that were disposed of by the transferor at any particular time that is within 60 days after the transfer time in exchange for shares of the transferor, are deemed to be equal to the cost amount of the units to the transferor immediately before the particular time;

Paragraph.Label: (g)
Paragraph.Text: if, at any particular time that is within 60 days after the transfer time, a taxpayer disposes of shares of the transferor to the transferor in exchange for units of a transferee

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the taxpayer’s proceeds of disposition of the shares and the cost to the taxpayer of the units are deemed to be equal to the cost amount to the taxpayer of the shares immediately before the particular time,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: for the purposes of applying section 116 in respect of the disposition, the shares are deemed to be excluded property of the taxpayer,

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: where the qualifying exchange occurs after 2004, for the purposes of applying section 218.3 in respect of that exchange, the payment or crediting of the units to the taxpayer by the transferor is deemed not to be an assessable distribution,

Subparagraph.Label: (iv)
Subparagraph.Text: where all of the taxpayer’s shares of the transferor have been so disposed of, for the purpose of applying section 39.1 in respect of the taxpayer after that disposition, the transferee is deemed to be the same entity as the transferor,

Subparagraph.Label: (v)
Subparagraph.Text: for the purpose of the definition designated beneficiary in section 210, the units are deemed not to have been held at any time by the transferor, and

Subparagraph.Label: (vi)
Subparagraph.Text: if the taxpayer is at the particular time affiliated with the transferor or the transferee,

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: those units are deemed not to be identical to any other units of the transferee,

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: if the taxpayer is the transferee, and the units cease to exist when the taxpayer acquires them (or, for greater certainty, when the taxpayer would but for that cessation have acquired them), the taxpayer is deemed

Subclause.Label: (I)
Subclause.Text: to have acquired those units at the particular time, and

Subclause.Label: (II)
Subclause.Text: to have disposed of those units immediately after the particular time for proceeds of disposition equal to the cost amount to the taxpayer of those units at the particular time, and

Clause.Label: (C)
Clause.Text: in any other case, for the purpose of computing any gain or loss of the taxpayer from the taxpayer’s first disposition, after the particular time, of each of those units,

Subclause.Label: (I)
