Subparagraph.Text: the annuitant for the lives, jointly, of the annuitant and the annuitant’s spouse and to the survivor of them for the survivor’s life, or

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: an annuity commencing at maturity, payable to the annuitant, or to the annuitant for the annuitant’s life and to the spouse after the annuitant’s death, for a term of years equal to 90 minus either

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the age in whole years of the annuitant at the maturity of the plan, or

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: where the annuitant’s spouse is younger than the annuitant and the annuitant so elects, the age in whole years of the spouse at the maturity of the plan,

ContinuedParagraph.Text: issued by a person described in the definition retirement savings plan in this subsection with whom an individual may have a contract or arrangement that is a retirement savings plan,

ContinuedDefinition.Text: or any combination thereof; (revenu de retraite)

Definition.Text: retirement savings plan means

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: a contract between an individual and a person licensed or otherwise authorized under the laws of Canada or a province to carry on in Canada an annuities business, under which, in consideration of payment by the individual or the individual’s spouse or common-law partner of any periodic or other amount as consideration under the contract, a retirement income commencing at maturity is to be provided for the individual, or

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: an arrangement under which payment is made by an individual or the individual’s spouse or common-law partner

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: in trust to a corporation licensed or otherwise authorized under the laws of Canada or a province to carry on in Canada the business of offering to the public its services as trustee, of any periodic or other amount as a contribution under the trust,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: to a corporation approved by the Governor in Council for the purposes of this section that is licensed or otherwise authorized under the laws of Canada or a province to issue investment contracts providing for the payment to or to the credit of the holder thereof of a fixed or determinable amount at maturity, of any periodic or other amount as a contribution under such a contract between the individual and that corporation, or

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: as a deposit with a branch or office, in Canada, of

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: a person who is, or is eligible to become, a member of the Canadian Payments Association, or

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: a credit union that is a shareholder or member of a body corporate referred to as a “central” for the purposes of the Canadian Payments Act,

ContinuedSubparagraph.Text: (in this section referred to as a “depositary”)

ContinuedParagraph.Text: to be used, invested or otherwise applied by that corporation or that depositary, as the case may be, for the purpose of providing for the individual, commencing at maturity, a retirement income; (régime d’épargne-retraite)

Definition.Text: spousal or common-law partner plan, in relation to a taxpayer, means

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: a registered retirement savings plan

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: to which the taxpayer has, at a time when the taxpayer’s spouse or common-law partner was the annuitant under the plan, paid a premium, or

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: that has received a payment out of or a transfer from a registered retirement savings plan or a registered retirement income fund that was a spousal or common-law partner plan in relation to the taxpayer, or

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: a registered retirement income fund that has received a payment out of or a transfer from a spousal or common-law partner plan in relation to the taxpayer; (régime au profit de l’époux ou du conjoint de fait)

Definition.Text: tax-paid amount paid to a person in respect of a registered retirement saving plan means

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: an amount paid to the person in respect of the amount that would, if this Act were read without reference to subsection 104(6), be income of a trust governed by the plan for a taxation year for which the trust was subject to tax because of paragraph 146(4)(c), or

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: where

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the plan is a deposit with a depositary referred to in clause (b)(iii)(B) of the definition retirement savings plan in this subsection, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: an amount is received at any time out of or under the plan by the person,

ContinuedParagraph.Text: the portion of the amount that can reasonably be considered to relate to interest or another amount in respect of the deposit that was required to be included in computing the income of any person (other than the annuitant) otherwise than because of this section; (montant libéré d’impôt)

Definition.Text: unused RRSP deduction room of a taxpayer at the end of a taxation year means,

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: for taxation years ending before 1991, nil, and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: for taxation years that end after 1990, the amount, which can be positive or negative, determined by the formula

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the taxpayer’s unused RRSP deduction room at the end of the preceding taxation year,
is the amount, if any, by which

FormulaParagraph.Label: (i)
FormulaParagraph.Text: the lesser of the RRSP dollar limit for the year and 18% of the taxpayer’s earned income for the preceding taxation year

ContinuedFormulaParagraph.Text: exceeds the total of all amounts each of which is

FormulaParagraph.Label: (ii)
FormulaParagraph.Text: the taxpayer’s pension adjustment for the preceding taxation year in respect of an employer, or

FormulaParagraph.Label: (iii)
FormulaParagraph.Text: a prescribed amount in respect of the taxpayer for the year,

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the taxpayer’s net past service pension adjustment for the year,
is the total of all amounts each of which is

FormulaParagraph.Label: (i)
FormulaParagraph.Text: an amount deducted by the taxpayer under any of subsections (5) to (5.2), in computing the taxpayer’s income for the year,

FormulaParagraph.Label: (ii)
FormulaParagraph.Text: an amount deducted by the taxpayer under paragraph 10 of Article XVIII of the Canada-United States Tax Convention signed at Washington on September 26, 1980 or a similar provision in another tax treaty, in computing the taxpayer’s taxable income for the year,

FormulaParagraph.Label: (iii)
FormulaParagraph.Text: a contribution made by an employer in the year to a pooled registered pension plan in respect of the taxpayer, or

FormulaParagraph.Label: (iv)
FormulaParagraph.Text: the amount, if any, by which the taxpayer’s exempt-income contribution amount (as defined in subsection 147.5(1)) for the year exceeds the taxpayer’s unused non-deductible PRPP room (as defined in subsection 147.5(1)) at the end of the preceding taxation year, and

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the taxpayer’s total pension adjustment reversal for the year. (déductions inutilisées au titre des REER)

Subsection.Text: For the purposes of paragraph (b) of the definition refund of premiums in subsection (1), clause 60(l)(v)(B.01), the definition eligible individual in subsection 60.02(1), subparagraph 104(27)(e)(i) and section 147.5, it is assumed, unless the contrary is established, that an individual’s child or grandchild was not financially dependent on the individual for support immediately before the individual’s death if the income of the child or grandchild for the taxation year preceding the taxation year in which the individual died exceeded the amount determined by the formula

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the amount determined for F in subsection 118(1.1) for that preceding taxation year; and

is nil, unless the financial dependency was because of mental or physical infirmity, in which case it is $6,180 adjusted for each such preceding taxation year that is after 2002 in the manner set out in section 117.1.

Subsection.Text: The Minister shall not accept for registration for the purposes of this Act any retirement savings plan unless, in the Minister’s opinion, it complies with the following conditions:

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the plan does not provide for the payment of any benefit before maturity except

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: a refund of premiums, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: a payment to the annuitant;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the plan does not provide for the payment of any benefit after maturity except

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: by way of retirement income to the annuitant,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: to the annuitant in full or partial commutation of retirement income under the plan, and

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: in respect of a commutation referred to in paragraph 146(2)(c.2);

Paragraph.Label: (b.1)
Paragraph.Text: the plan does not provide for a payment to the annuitant of a retirement income except by way of equal annual or more frequent periodic payments until such time as there is a payment in full or partial commutation of the retirement income and, where that commutation is partial, equal annual or more frequent periodic payments thereafter;

Paragraph.Label: (b.2)
Paragraph.Text: the plan does not provide for periodic payments in a year under an annuity after the death of the first annuitant, the total of which exceeds the total of the payments under the annuity in a year before that death;

Paragraph.Label: (b.3)
Paragraph.Text: the plan does not provide for the payment of any premium after maturity;

Paragraph.Label: (b.4)
Paragraph.Text: the plan does not provide for maturity after the end of the year in which the annuitant attains 71 years of age;

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: the plan provides that retirement income under the plan may not be assigned in whole or in part;

Paragraph.Label: (c.1)
Paragraph.Text: notwithstanding paragraph 146(2)(a), the plan permits the payment of an amount to a taxpayer where the amount is paid to reduce the amount of tax otherwise payable under Part X.1 by the taxpayer;

Paragraph.Label: (c.2)
Paragraph.Text: the plan requires the commutation of each annuity payable thereunder that would otherwise become payable to a person other than an annuitant under the plan;

Paragraph.Label: (c.3)
Paragraph.Text: the plan, where it involves a depositary, includes provisions stipulating that

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the depositary has no right of offset as regards the property held under the plan in connection with any debt or obligation owing to the depositary, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the property held under the plan cannot be pledged, assigned or in any way alienated as security for a loan or for any purpose other than that of providing for the annuitant, commencing at maturity, a retirement income; and

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: the plan in all other respects complies with regulations of the Governor in Council made on the recommendation of the Minister of Finance.

Subsection.Text: The Minister may accept for registration for the purposes of this Act any retirement savings plan notwithstanding that the plan

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: provides for the payment of a benefit after maturity by way of dividend;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: provides for any annual or more frequent periodic amount payable

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: to the annuitant referred to in subparagraph (a)(ii) of the definition retirement income in subsection 146(1) by way of an annuity described in paragraph (a) of that definition to be reduced, in the event of the death of the annuitant’s spouse or common-law partner during the lifetime of the annuitant, in such manner as to provide for the payment of equal annual or more frequent periodic amounts throughout the lifetime of the annuitant thereafter,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: to any person by way of an annuity, to be reduced if a pension becomes payable to that person under the Old Age Security Act, by an annual or other periodic amount not exceeding the amount payable to that person in that period under that Act,

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: to any person by way of an annuity, to be increased or reduced depending on the increase or reduction in the value of a specified group of assets constituting the assets of a separate and distinct account or fund maintained in respect of a variable annuities business by a person licensed or otherwise authorized under the laws of Canada or a province to carry on in Canada that business,

Subparagraph.Label: (iii.1)
Subparagraph.Text: to any person by way of an annuity under a contract that provides for the increase or reduction of the annuity in accordance only with a change in the interest rate on which the annuity is based, if the interest rate, as increased or reduced, equals or approximates a generally available Canadian market interest rate,

Subparagraph.Label: (iv)
Subparagraph.Text: that may be adjusted annually to reflect

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: in whole or in part increases in the Consumer Price Index, as published by Statistics Canada under the authority of the Statistics Act, or

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: increases at a rate specified in the annuity contract, not exceeding 4% per annum, or

Subparagraph.Label: (v)
Subparagraph.Text: to the annuitant by way of an annuity to be increased annually to the extent the amount or rate of return that would have been earned on a pool of investment assets (available for purchase by the public and specified in the annuity contract) exceeds an amount or rate specified in the plan and provides that no other increase may be made in the amount payable;

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: provides for the payment of any amount after the death of an annuitant thereunder;

Paragraph.Label: (e)
Paragraph.Text: is adjoined to a contract or other arrangement that is not a retirement savings plan; or

Paragraph.Label: (f)
Paragraph.Text: contains such other terms and provisions, not inconsistent with this section, as are authorized or permitted by regulations of the Governor in Council made on the recommendation of the Minister of Finance.

Subsection.MarginalNote: No tax while trust governed by plan
Subsection.Text: Except as provided in subsection 146(10.1), no tax is payable under this Part by a trust on the taxable income of the trust for a taxation year if, throughout the period in the year during which the trust was in existence, the trust was governed by a registered retirement savings plan, except that

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: if the trust has borrowed money (other than money used in carrying on a business) in the year or has, after June 18, 1971, borrowed money (other than money used in carrying on a business) that it has not repaid before the commencement of the year, tax is payable under this Part by the trust on its taxable income for the year;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: in any case not described in paragraph 146(4)(a), if the trust has carried on any business or businesses in the year, tax is payable under this Part by the trust on the amount, if any, by which

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the amount that its taxable income for the year would be if it had no incomes or losses from sources other than from that business or those businesses, as the case may be,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: such portion of the amount determined under subparagraph 146(4)(b)(i) in respect of the trust for the year as can reasonably be considered to be income from, or from the disposition of, qualified investments for the trust; and

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: if the last annuitant under the plan has died, tax is payable under this Part by the trust on its taxable income for each year after the year following the year in which the last annuitant died.

Subsection.Text: There may be deducted in computing a taxpayer’s income for a taxation year such amount as the taxpayer claims not exceeding the lesser of

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the amount, if any, by which the total of all amounts each of which is a premium paid by the taxpayer after 1990 and on or before the day that is 60 days after the end of the year under a registered retirement savings plan under which the taxpayer was the annuitant at the time the premium was paid, other than the portion, if any, of the premium

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: that was deducted in computing the taxpayer’s income for a preceding taxation year,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: that was designated for any taxation year for the purposes of paragraph 60(j), 60(j.1) or 60(l),

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: in respect of which the taxpayer received a payment that was deducted under subsection 146(8.2) in computing the taxpayer’s income for a preceding taxation year,

Subparagraph.Label: (iii.1)
Subparagraph.Text: that was an exempt-income contribution amount (as defined in subsection 147.5(1)) for any taxation year,

Subparagraph.Label: (iv)
Subparagraph.Text: that was deductible under subsection 146(6.1) in computing the taxpayer’s income for any taxation year or

Subparagraph.Label: (iv.1)
Subparagraph.Text: that would be considered to be withdrawn by the taxpayer as an eligible amount (as defined in subsection 146.01(1) or 146.02(1)) less than 90 days after it was paid, if earnings in respect of a registered retirement savings plan were considered to be withdrawn before premiums paid under that plan and premiums were considered to be withdrawn in the order in which they were paid

Subparagraph.Label: (v)
Subparagraph.Text: the amount, if any, by which

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: the total of all amounts deducted under subsection 147.3(13.1) in computing the taxpayer’s income for the year or a preceding taxation year

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: the total of all amounts, in respect of transfers occurring before 1991 from registered pension plans, deemed by paragraph 147.3(10)(b) or 147.3(10)(c) to be a premium paid by the taxpayer to a registered retirement savings plan, and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the amount, if any, by which the taxpayer’s RRSP deduction limit for the year exceeds the total of all contributions made by an employer in the year to a pooled registered pension plan in respect of the taxpayer.

Subsection.MarginalNote: Amount of spousal RRSP premiums deductible
Subsection.Text: There may be deducted in computing a taxpayer’s income for a taxation year such amount as the taxpayer claims not exceeding the lesser of

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the total of all amounts each of which is a premium paid by the taxpayer after 1990 and on or before the day that is 60 days after the end of the year under a registered retirement savings plan under which the taxpayer’s spouse or common-law partner (or, where the taxpayer died in the year or within 60 days after the end of the year, an individual who was the taxpayer’s spouse or common-law partner immediately before the death) was the annuitant at the time the premium was paid, other than the portion, if any, of the premium

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: that was deducted in computing the taxpayer’s income for a preceding taxation year,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: that was designated for any taxation year for the purposes of paragraph 60(j.2),

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: in respect of which the taxpayer or the taxpayer’s spouse or common-law partner has received a payment that has been deducted under subsection 146(8.2) in computing the taxpayer’s income for a preceding taxation year, or

Subparagraph.Label: (iv)
Subparagraph.Text: that would be considered to be withdrawn by the taxpayer’s spouse or common-law partner as an eligible amount (as defined in subsection 146.01(1) or 146.02(1)) less than 90 days after it was paid, if earnings in respect of a registered retirement savings plan were considered to be withdrawn before premiums paid under that plan and premiums were considered to be withdrawn in the order in which they were paid, and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the amount, if any, by which the taxpayer’s RRSP deduction limit for the year exceeds the total of all amounts each of which is

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the amount deducted under subsection (5) in computing the taxpayer’s income for the year, or

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: a contribution made by an employer in the year to a pooled registered pension plan in respect of the taxpayer.

Subsection.Text: If a taxpayer’s entitlement to benefits under a defined benefit provision of a registered pension plan is transferred in accordance with subsection 147.3(4) after February 2009 and before 2011, there may be deducted in computing the taxpayer’s income for a taxation year that ends on or after the day on which the transfer was made, the amount claimed by the taxpayer in respect of premiums paid by the taxpayer in the year to a registered retirement savings plan under which the taxpayer is the annuitant, not exceeding the amount, if any, determined by the formula

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the amount, if any, that is the lesser of

FormulaParagraph.Label: (a)
FormulaParagraph.Text: the prescribed amount that would have been determined for the purpose of paragraph 147.3(4)(c) if subsection 8517(3.01) of the Regulations had applied in respect of the transfer, and

FormulaParagraph.Label: (b)
FormulaParagraph.Text: the amount of the taxpayer’s entitlement to benefits under the provision commuted in connection with the transfer;

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the prescribed amount for the purpose of paragraph 147.3(4)(c) that applied in respect of the transfer; and
is the total of all amounts deducted by the taxpayer under this subsection for a preceding taxation year.

Subsection.Text: For the purpose of subsection (5.2), a premium paid by a taxpayer before 2013 is deemed to have been paid in the taxation year in which the transfer referred to in that subsection was made and not in the year in which it was actually paid, if the taxpayer so elects in prescribed form.
Notwithstanding any other provision of this section, where

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: a registered pension plan is amended or administered in such a manner as to terminate, suspend or delay

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the membership of an individual in the plan for the individual’s 1990 taxation year,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: contributions under the plan by or for the benefit of the individual in respect of the year, or

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: the accrual of retirement benefits under the plan for the individual in respect of the year, or

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: a deferred profit sharing plan is amended or administered in such a manner as to terminate, suspend or delay contributions under the plan for the year in respect of an individual,

ContinuedSectionSubsection.Text: and one of the main reasons for the termination, suspension or delay may reasonably be considered to be to reduce the pension adjustment of the individual for the year in respect of an employer, the only amount that may be deducted in computing the income for the year of the individual, in respect of premiums paid to registered retirement savings plans, is the amount that would have been deductible had that termination, suspension or delay not occurred.

Subsection.Text: There may be deducted in computing a taxpayer’s income for a particular taxation year the total of all amounts each of which is such portion of a prescribed premium for the particular year as was not designated for any taxation year for the purposes of paragraph 60(j), 60(j.1) or 60(l).

Subsection.MarginalNote: Recovery of property used as security
Subsection.Text: Where in a taxation year a loan, for which a trust governed by a registered retirement savings plan has used or permitted to be used trust property as security, ceases to be extant, and the fair market value of the property so used was included by virtue of subsection 146(10) in computing the income of the taxpayer who is the annuitant under the plan, there may be deducted, in computing the income of the taxpayer for the taxation year, an amount equal to the amount, if any, remaining when

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the net loss (exclusive of payments by the trust as or on account of interest) sustained by the trust in consequence of its using the property, or permitting it to be used, as security for the loan and not as a result of a change in the fair market value of the property

ContinuedSectionSubsection.Text: is deducted from

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the amount so included in computing the income of the taxpayer in consequence of the trust’s using the property, or permitting it to be used, as security for the loan.

Subsection.Text: There shall be included in computing a taxpayer’s income for a taxation year the total of all amounts received by the taxpayer in the year as benefits out of or under registered retirement savings plans, other than excluded withdrawals (as defined in subsection 146.01(1) or 146.02(1)) of the taxpayer and amounts that are included under paragraph (12)(b) in computing the taxpayer’s income.

If a designated withdrawal (as defined in subsection 146.01(1)) or an amount referred to in paragraph (a) of the definition eligible amount in subsection 146.02(1) is received by a taxpayer in a taxation year and, at any time after that year, it is determined that the amount is not an excluded withdrawal (as defined in subsection 146.01(1) or 146.02(1)), notwithstanding subsections 152(4) to (5), such assessments of tax, interest and penalties shall be made as are necessary to give effect to the determination.

Subsection.MarginalNote: Deemed receipt of refund of premiums
Subsection.Text: An individual and the legal representative of a deceased annuitant of a registered retirement savings plan may jointly designate in prescribed form filed with the Minister that all or a portion of a payment made out of or under the plan to the legal representative is deemed to have been received by the individual at the time it was so paid as a benefit that is a refund of premiums, and not to have been paid to the legal representative, if

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: a payment not less than the designated amount is made from the estate of the deceased annuitant to the individual who is entitled to receive the payment

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: as a beneficiary (as defined in subsection 108(1)) under the estate, or

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: under a decree, order or judgment of a competent tribunal or under a written agreement, relating to the rights or interests of a spouse or common-law partner in respect of property as a result of marriage or common-law partnership; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the designated amount would have been a refund of premiums if it had been paid to the individual directly from the registered retirement savings plan.

Subsection.Text: Where

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: all or any portion of the premiums paid in a taxation year by a taxpayer to one or more registered retirement savings plans under which the taxpayer or the taxpayer’s spouse or common-law partner was the annuitant was not deducted in computing the taxpayer’s income for any taxation year,

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the taxpayer or the taxpayer’s spouse or common-law partner can reasonably be regarded as having received a payment from a registered retirement savings plan or a registered retirement income fund in respect of such portion of the undeducted premiums as

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: was not paid by way of a transfer of an amount from a registered pension plan to a registered retirement savings plan,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: was not paid by way of a transfer of an amount from a deferred profit sharing plan to a registered retirement savings plan in accordance with subsection 147(19), and

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: was not paid by way of a transfer of an amount to a registered retirement savings plan from

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: a pooled registered pension plan in circumstances to which subsection 147.5(21) applied, or

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: a specified pension plan in circumstances to which subsection (21) applied,

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: the payment is received by the taxpayer or the taxpayer’s spouse or common-law partner in a particular taxation year that is

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the year in which the premiums were paid by the taxpayer,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the year in which a notice of assessment for the taxation year referred to in subparagraph 146(8.2)(c)(i) was sent to the taxpayer, or

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: the year immediately following the year referred to in subparagraph 146(8.2)(c)(i) or 146(8.2)(c)(ii), and

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: the payment is included in computing the taxpayer’s income for the particular year,

ContinuedSectionSubsection.Text: the payment (except to the extent that it is a prescribed withdrawal) may be deducted in computing the taxpayer’s income for the particular year unless it is reasonable to consider that

Paragraph.Label: (e)
Paragraph.Text: the taxpayer did not reasonably expect that the full amount of the premiums would be deductible in the taxation year in which the premiums were paid or in the immediately preceding taxation year, and

Paragraph.Label: (f)
Paragraph.Text: the taxpayer paid all or any portion of the premiums with the intent of receiving a payment that, but for this paragraph and paragraph 146(8.2)(e), would be deductible under this subsection.

Subsection.Text: Where a taxpayer or the taxpayer’s spouse or common-law partner has, at any time in a taxation year, received a payment from a registered retirement savings plan or a registered retirement income fund in respect of all or any portion of a premium paid by the taxpayer to a registered retirement savings plan and the payment has been deducted under subsection 146(8.2) in computing the taxpayer’s income for the year, the premium or portion thereof, as the case may be, shall,

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: for the purposes of determining, after that time, the amount that may be deducted under subsection 146(5) or 146(5.1) in computing the taxpayer’s income for the year or a preceding taxation year, and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: for the purposes of subsections 146(8.3) and 146.3(5.1) after that time, in the case of a payment received by the taxpayer,

ContinuedSectionSubsection.Text: be deemed not to have been a premium paid by the taxpayer to a registered retirement savings plan.

Subsection.Text: Where at any time in a taxation year a particular amount in respect of a registered retirement savings plan that is a spousal or common-law partner plan in relation to a taxpayer is required by reason of subsection (8) or paragraph (12)(b) to be included in computing the income of the taxpayer’s spouse or common-law partner before the plan matures or as a payment in full or partial commutation of a retirement income under the plan and the taxpayer is not living separate and apart from the taxpayer’s spouse or common-law partner at that time by reason of the breakdown of their marriage or common-law partnership, there shall be included at that time in computing the taxpayer’s income for the year an amount equal to the lesser of

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the total of all amounts each of which is a premium paid by the taxpayer in the year or in one of the two immediately preceding taxation years to a registered retirement savings plan under which the taxpayer’s spouse or common-law partner was the annuitant at the time the premium was paid, and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the particular amount.

Subsection.Text: Where a taxpayer has paid more than one premium described in subsection 146(8.3), such a premium or part thereof paid by the taxpayer at any time shall be deemed to have been included in computing the taxpayer’s income by virtue of that subsection before premiums or parts thereof paid by the taxpayer after that time.

Where, in respect of an amount required at any time in a taxation year to be included in computing the income of a taxpayer’s spouse or common-law partner, all or part of a premium has by reason of subsection 146(8.3) been included in computing the taxpayer’s income for the year, the following rules apply:

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the premium or part thereof, as the case may be, shall, for the purposes of subsections 146(8.3) and 146.3(5.1) after that time, be deemed not to have been a premium paid to a registered retirement savings plan under which the taxpayer’s spouse or common-law partner was the annuitant; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: an amount equal to the premium or part thereof, as the case may be, may be deducted in computing the income of the spouse or common-law partner for the year.

Subsection.Text: Subsection 146(8.3) does not apply

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: in respect of a taxpayer at any time during the year in which the taxpayer died;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: in respect of a taxpayer where either the taxpayer or the taxpayer’s spouse or common-law partner is a non-resident at the particular time referred to in that subsection;

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: in respect of amounts paid out of or under a plan referred to in subsection 146(12) as an “amended plan” to which paragraph 146(12)(a) applied before May 26, 1976;

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: to any payment that is received in full or partial commutation of a registered retirement income fund or a registered retirement savings plan and in respect of which a deduction was made under paragraph 60(l) if, where the deduction was in respect of the acquisition of an annuity, the terms of the annuity provide that it cannot be commuted, and it is not commuted, in whole or in part within 3 years after the acquisition; or

Paragraph.Label: (e)
Paragraph.Text: in respect of an amount that is deemed by subsection 146(8.8) to have been received by an annuitant under a registered retirement savings plan immediately before the annuitant’s death.

Subsection.MarginalNote: Effect of death where person other than spouse becomes entitled
Subsection.Text: Where the annuitant under a registered retirement savings plan (other than a plan that had matured before June 30, 1978) dies after June 29, 1978, the annuitant shall be deemed to have received, immediately before the annuitant’s death, an amount as a benefit out of or under a registered retirement savings plan equal to the amount, if any, by which

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the fair market value of all the property of the plan at the time of death

ContinuedSectionSubsection.Text: exceeds

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: where the annuitant died after the maturity of the plan, the fair market value at the time of the death of the portion of the property described in paragraph 146(8.8)(a) that, as a consequence of the death, becomes receivable by a person who was the annuitant’s spouse or common-law partner immediately before the death, or would become so receivable should that person survive throughout all guaranteed terms contained in the plan.

Subsection.Text: There may be deducted from the amount deemed by subsection 146(8.8) to have been received by an annuitant as a benefit out of or under a registered retirement savings plan an amount not exceeding the amount determined by the formula

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the total of

FormulaParagraph.Label: (a)
FormulaParagraph.Text: all refunds of premiums in respect of the plan,

FormulaParagraph.Label: (b)
FormulaParagraph.Text: all tax-paid amounts in respect of the plan paid to individuals who, otherwise than because of subsection 146(8.1), received refunds of premiums in respect of the plan, and

FormulaParagraph.Label: (c)
FormulaParagraph.Text: all amounts each of which is a tax-paid amount in respect of the plan paid to the legal representative of the annuitant under the plan, to the extent that the legal representative would have been entitled to designate that tax-paid amount under subsection 146(8.1) if tax-paid amounts were not excluded in determining refunds of premiums;

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the fair market value of the property of the plan at the particular time that is the later of

FormulaParagraph.Label: (a)
FormulaParagraph.Text: the end of the first calendar year that begins after the death of the annuitant, and

FormulaParagraph.Label: (b)
FormulaParagraph.Text: the time immediately after the last time that any refund of premiums in respect of the plan is paid out of or under the plan;

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the total of all amounts paid out of or under the plan after the death of the annuitant and before the particular time; and
is the lesser of

FormulaParagraph.Label: (a)
FormulaParagraph.Text: the fair market value of the property of the plan at the time of the annuitant’s death, and

FormulaParagraph.Label: (b)
FormulaParagraph.Text: the sum of the values of B and C in respect of the plan.

Subsection.MarginalNote: Amounts deemed receivable by spouse or common-law partner
Subsection.Text: Where, as a consequence of the death of an annuitant after the maturity of the annuitant’s registered retirement savings plan, the annuitant’s legal representative has become entitled to receive amounts out of or under the plan for the benefit of the spouse or common-law partner of the deceased and the legal representative and the spouse or common-law partner file with the Minister a joint election in prescribed form,

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the spouse or common-law partner shall be deemed to have become the annuitant under the plan as a consequence of the annuitant’s death; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: those amounts shall be deemed to be receivable by the spouse or common-law partner and, when paid, to be received by the spouse or common-law partner as a benefit under the plan, and not to be received by any other person.

Subsection.MarginalNote: Deduction for post-death reduction in value
Subsection.Text: If the annuitant under a registered retirement savings plan dies before the maturity of the plan, there may be deducted in computing the annuitant’s income for the taxation year in which the annuitant dies an amount not exceeding the amount determined, after all amounts payable out of or under the plan have been paid, by the formula

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the total of all amounts each of which is

FormulaParagraph.Label: (a)
FormulaParagraph.Text: the amount deemed by subsection (8.8) to have been received by the annuitant as a benefit out of or under the plan,

FormulaParagraph.Label: (b)
FormulaParagraph.Text: an amount (other than an amount described in paragraph (c)) received, after the death of the annuitant, by a taxpayer as a benefit out of or under the plan and included, because of subsection (8), in computing the taxpayer’s income, or

FormulaParagraph.Label: (c)
FormulaParagraph.Text: a tax-paid amount in respect of the plan; and

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the total of all amounts paid out of or under the plan after the death of the annuitant.

Subsection.Text: Except where the Minister has waived in writing the application of this subsection with respect to all or any portion of the amount determined in subsection (8.92) in respect of a registered retirement savings plan, that subsection does not apply if

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: at any time after the death of the annuitant, a trust governed by the plan held a non-qualified investment; or

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the last payment out of or under the plan was made after the end of the year following the year in which the annuitant died.

Subsection.MarginalNote: Where disposition of property by trust
Subsection.Text: Where in a taxation year a trust governed by a registered retirement savings plan

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: disposes of property for a consideration less than the fair market value of the property at the time of the disposition, or for no consideration, or

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: acquires property for a consideration greater than the fair market value of the property at the time of the acquisition,

ContinuedSectionSubsection.Text: the difference between the fair market value and the consideration, if any, shall be included in computing the income for the taxation year of the annuitant under the plan.

Subsection.MarginalNote: Property used as security for loan
Subsection.Text: If at any time in a taxation year a trust governed by a registered retirement savings plan uses or permits to be used any property of the trust as security for a loan, the fair market value of the property at the time it commenced to be so used shall be included in computing the income for the year of the taxpayer who is the annuitant under the plan at that time.
Where in a taxation year a trust governed by a registered retirement savings plan holds a property that is a non-qualified investment,

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: tax is payable under this Part by the trust on the amount that its taxable income for the year would be if it had no incomes or losses from sources other than non-qualified investments and no capital gains or losses other than from dispositions of non-qualified investments; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: for the purposes of paragraph 146(10.1)(a),

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: income includes dividends described in section 83, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: paragraphs 38(a) and (b) are to be read as if the fraction set out in each of those paragraphs were replaced by the word “all”.

Subsection.Text: Where, on any day after a retirement savings plan has been accepted by the Minister for registration for the purposes of this Act, the plan is revised or amended or a new plan is substituted for it, and the plan as revised or amended or the new plan, as the case may be (in this subsection referred to as the “amended plan”), does not comply with the requirements of this section for its acceptance by the Minister for registration for the purposes of this Act, subject to subsection 146(13.1), the following rules apply:

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the amended plan shall be deemed, for the purposes of this Act, not to be a registered retirement savings plan; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the taxpayer who was the annuitant under the plan before it became an amended plan shall, in computing the taxpayer’s income for the taxation year that includes that day, include as income received at that time an amount equal to the fair market value of all the property of the plan immediately before that time.

Subsection.Text: For the purposes of subsection 146(12), an arrangement under which a right or obligation under a retirement savings plan is released or extinguished either wholly or in part and either in exchange or substitution for any right or obligation, or otherwise (other than an arrangement the sole object and legal effect of which is to revise or amend the plan) or under which payment of any amount by way of loan or otherwise is made on the security of a right under a retirement savings plan, shall be deemed to be a new plan substituted for that retirement savings plan.

Where any amount has been paid in a taxation year as a premium under a retirement savings plan that was, at the end of that taxation year, a registered retirement savings plan, the amount so paid shall be deemed, for the purposes of this Act, to have been paid in that year as a premium under a registered retirement savings plan.

Subsection.MarginalNote: Plan not registered at end of year entered into
Subsection.Text: Notwithstanding anything in this section, where an amount is received in a taxation year as a benefit under a registered retirement savings plan that was not, at the end of the year in which the plan was entered into, a registered retirement savings plan, such part, if any, of the amount so received as may be prescribed shall be deemed, for the purposes of this Act, to have been received in the taxation year otherwise than as a benefit or other payment under a registered retirement savings plan.

Notwithstanding any other provision in this section, a registered retirement savings plan may at any time be revised or amended to provide for the payment or transfer before the maturity of the plan, on behalf of the annuitant under the plan (in this subsection referred to as the “transferor”), of any property thereunder by the issuer thereof

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: to a registered pension plan for the benefit of the transferor or to a registered retirement savings plan or registered retirement income fund under which the transferor is the annuitant,

Paragraph.Label: (a.1)
Paragraph.Text: to a licensed annuities provider to acquire an advanced life deferred annuity for the benefit of the transferor,

Paragraph.Label: (a.2)
Paragraph.Text: to a FHSA for the benefit of the transferor, if subsection (8.3) would not apply to an amount in respect of the property in the case that the property was instead received by the transferor as a benefit out of or under the registered retirement savings plan, or

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: to a registered retirement savings plan or registered retirement income fund under which the spouse or common-law partner or former spouse or common-law partner of the transferor is the annuitant, where the transferor and the transferor’s spouse or common-law partner or former spouse or common-law partner are living separate and apart and the payment or transfer is made under a decree, order or judgment of a competent tribunal, or under a written separation agreement, relating to a division of property between the transferor and the transferor’s spouse or common-law partner or former spouse or common-law partner in settlement of rights arising out of, or on the breakdown of, their marriage or common-law partnership,

ContinuedSectionSubsection.Text: and, where there has been such a payment or transfer of such property on behalf of the transferor before the maturity of the plan,

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: the amount of the payment or transfer shall not, solely because of the payment or transfer, be included in computing the income of the transferor or the transferor’s spouse or common-law partner or former spouse or common-law partner,

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: no deduction may be made under subsection (5), (5.1) or (8.2) or section 8, 60 or 146.6 in respect of the payment or transfer in computing the income of any taxpayer, and

Paragraph.Label: (e)
Paragraph.Text: where the payment or transfer was made to a registered retirement savings plan, for the purposes of subsection 146(8.2), the amount of the payment or transfer shall be deemed not to be a premium paid to that plan by the taxpayer.

Subsection.MarginalNote: Credited or added amount deemed not received
Subsection.Text: Where

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: an amount is credited or added to a deposit with a depositary referred to in subparagraph (b)(iii) of the definition retirement savings plan in subsection 146(1) as interest or income in respect of the deposit,

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the deposit is a registered retirement savings plan at the time the amount is credited or added to the deposit, and

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: during the calendar year in which the amount is credited or added or during the preceding calendar year, the annuitant under the plan was alive,

ContinuedSectionSubsection.Text: the amount shall be deemed not to be received by the annuitant or any other person solely because of the crediting or adding.

Subsection.Text: Where

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: an amount (other than an amount that is part of a series of periodic payments) is transferred directly from an individual’s account under a specified pension plan

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: to a registered retirement savings plan or registered retirement income fund under which the individual, or a spouse or common-law partner or former spouse or common-law partner of the individual, is the annuitant,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: to acquire from a licensed annuities provider an annuity that would be described in subparagraph 60(l)(ii) if the individual, or a spouse or common-law partner or former spouse or common-law partner of the individual, were the taxpayer referred to in that subparagraph and if that subparagraph were read without reference to clause 60(l)(ii)(B), or

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: to an account under the plan of a spouse or common-law partner or former spouse or common-law partner of the individual, and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: if the transfer is in respect of a spouse or common-law partner or former spouse or common-law partner of the individual,

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the individual and the spouse or common-law partner or former spouse or common-law partner are living separate and apart and the transfer is made under a decree, order or judgment of a competent tribunal, or under a written separation agreement, relating to a division of property in settlement of rights arising out of, or on the breakdown of, their marriage or common-law partnership, or

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the amount is transferred as a consequence of the individual’s death,

ContinuedSectionSubsection.Text: the following rules apply:

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: the amount shall not, solely because of the transfer, be included because of subparagraph 56(1)(a)(i) in computing the income of a taxpayer, and

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: no deduction may be made under any provision of this Act in respect of the transfer in computing the income of a taxpayer.

Subsection.Text: For the purposes of this section, paragraphs 18(11)(b), 60(j), (j.1) and (l), 74.5(12)(a), 146.01(3)(a) and 146.02(3)(a) and Parts X.1 and X.5, and for the purposes of section 214.1 of the Income Tax Regulations, a contribution made by an individual to an account of the individual, or of the individual’s spouse or common-law partner, under a specified pension plan is deemed to be a premium paid by the individual to a registered retirement savings plan under which the individual, or the individual’s spouse or common-law partner, as the case may be, is the annuitant.

For the purposes of paragraph (8.2)(b), subsection (8.21), paragraphs (16)(a) and (b) and 18(1)(u), section 60.011, subparagraph (a)(i) of the definition excluded right or interest in subsection 128.1(10), paragraph (b) of the definition excluded premium in subsection 146.01(1), paragraph (c) of the definition excluded premium in subsection 146.02(1), subsections 146.3(14) and 147(19), section 147.3 and paragraphs 147.5(21)(c) and 212(1)(j.1) and (m) and for the purposes of any regulations made under subsection 147.1(18), an individual’s account under a specified pension plan is deemed to be a registered retirement savings plan under which the individual is the annuitant.

For the purposes of subsections (8.3) to (8.7), a payment received by an individual from a specified pension plan is deemed to be a payment received by the individual from a registered retirement savings plan.
If the Minister so directs,

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: except for the purposes of subparagraphs (5)(a)(iv.1) and (5.1)(a)(iv), an amount paid by an individual in a taxation year (other than an amount paid in the first 60 days of the year) as a premium is deemed to have been paid at the beginning of the year and not at the time it was actually paid;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: all or part of the amount may be designated in writing by the individual for the purpose of paragraph 60(j), (j.1) or (l) or subsection 146.01(3) or 146.02(3); and

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: the designation is deemed to have been made in the individual’s return of income for the preceding taxation year or in a prescribed form filed with that return, as the case may be.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Subsection.Text: In this section,

Definition.Text: annuitant has the meaning assigned by subsection 146(1); (rentier)
benefit has the meaning assigned by subsection 146(1); (prestation)
completion date, in respect of an amount received by an individual, is

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: where the amount was received before March 2, 1993, October 1, 1993,

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: where the amount was received after March 1, 1993 and before March 2, 1994, October 1, 1994, and

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: in any other case, October 1 of the calendar year following the calendar year in which the amount was received; (date de clôture)

Definition.Text: designated withdrawal of an individual is an amount received by the individual, as a benefit out of or under a registered retirement savings plan, pursuant to the individual’s written request in the prescribed form referred to in paragraph (a) of the definition eligible amount (as that definition read in its application to amounts received before 1999), paragraph (a) of the definition regular eligible amount or paragraph (a) of the definition supplemental eligible amount; (retrait déterminé)
eligible amount of an individual is a regular eligible amount or supplemental eligible amount of the individual; (montant admissible)
excluded premium in respect of an individual means a premium under a registered retirement savings plan where the premium

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: was designated by the individual for the purposes of paragraph 60(j), 60(j.1), 60(j.2) or 60(l),

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: was an amount transferred directly from a FHSA, registered retirement savings plan, registered pension plan, registered retirement income fund or deferred profit sharing plan,

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: was deductible under subsection 146(6.1) in computing the individual’s income for any taxation year, or

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: was deducted in computing the individual’s income for the 1991 taxation year; (prime exclue)

Definition.Text: excluded withdrawal of an individual means

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: an eligible amount received by the individual,

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: a particular amount (other than an eligible amount) received while the individual was resident in Canada and in a calendar year if

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the particular amount would be an eligible amount of the individual if the definition regular eligible amount were read without reference to paragraphs (c) and (g) of that definition and the definition supplemental eligible amount were read without reference to paragraphs (d) and (f) of that definition,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: a payment (other than an excluded premium) equal to the particular amount is made by the individual under a retirement saving plan that is, at the end of the taxation year of the payment, a registered retirement savings plan under which the individual is the annuitant,

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: the payment is made before the particular time that is

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: if the individual was not resident in Canada at the time the individual filed a return of income for the taxation year in which the particular amount was received, the earlier of

Subclause.Label: (I)
Subclause.Text: the end of the following calendar year, and

Subclause.Label: (II)
Subclause.Text: the time at which the individual filed the return,

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: where clause (A) does not apply and the particular amount would, but for subclause (2)(c)(ii)(A)(II), be an eligible amount, the end of the second following calendar year, and

Clause.Label: (C)
Clause.Text: in any other case, the end of the following calendar year, and

Subparagraph.Label: (iv)
Subparagraph.Text: either

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: if the particular time is before 2000, the payment is made, as a repayment of the particular amount, to the issuer of the registered retirement savings plan from which the particular amount was received, no other payment is made as a repayment of the particular amount and that issuer is notified of the payment in prescribed form submitted to the issuer at the time the payment is made, or

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: the payment is made after 1999 and before the particular time and the payment (and no other payment) is designated under this clause as a repayment of the particular amount in prescribed form filed with the Minister on or before the particular time (or before such later time as is acceptable to the Minister),

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: an amount (other than an eligible amount) that is received in a calendar year before 1999 and that would be an eligible amount of the individual if the definition eligible amount, as it applied to amounts received before 1999, were read without reference to paragraphs (c) and (e) of that definition, where the individual

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: died before the end of the following calendar year, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: was resident in Canada throughout the period that began immediately after the amount was received and ended at the time of the death, or

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: a particular amount (other than an eligible amount) received while the individual was resident in Canada and in a calendar year if

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the particular amount would be a regular eligible amount if subsection (2.1) were read without reference to its subparagraph (a)(iii),

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: a payment (other than an excluded premium) equal to the particular amount is made by the individual under a retirement saving plan that is, at the end of the taxation year of the payment, a registered retirement savings plan under which the individual is the annuitant, and

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: the payment is made before the end of the second calendar year after the calendar year that includes the particular time referred to in subsection (2.1); (retrait exclu)

Definition.Text: HBP balance of an individual at any time means the amount, if any, by which the total of all eligible amounts received by the individual at or before that time exceeds the total of

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: all amounts designated under subsection (3) by the individual for taxation years that ended before that time, and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: all amounts each of which is included under subsection (4) or (5) in computing the individual’s income for a taxation year that ended before that time; (solde RAP)

Definition.Text: issuer has the meaning assigned by subsection 146(1); (émetteur)
participation period of an individual means each period

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: that begins at the beginning of a calendar year in which the individual receives an eligible amount, and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: that ends immediately before the beginning of the first subsequent calendar year at the beginning of which the individual’s HBP balance is nil; (période de participation)

Definition.Text: premium has the meaning assigned by subsection 146(1); (prime)
qualifying home means

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: a housing unit located in Canada, or

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: a share of the capital stock of a cooperative housing corporation, the holder of which is entitled to possession of a housing unit located in Canada,

ContinuedDefinition.Text: except that, where the context so requires, a reference to a qualifying home that is a share described in paragraph (b) means the housing unit to which the share described in that paragraph relates; (habitation admissible)

Definition.Text: regular eligible amount of an individual means an amount received at a particular time by the individual as a benefit out of or under a registered retirement savings plan if

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the amount is received pursuant to the individual’s written request in a prescribed form in which the individual sets out the location of a qualifying home that the individual has begun, or intends not later than one year after its acquisition by the individual to begin, using as a principal place of residence,

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the individual entered into an agreement in writing before the particular time for the acquisition of it or with respect to its construction,

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: the individual

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: acquires the qualifying home (or a replacement property for the qualifying home) before the completion date in respect of the amount, or

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: dies before the end of the calendar year that includes the completion date in respect of the amount,

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: neither the individual nor the individual’s spouse or common-law partner acquired the qualifying home more than 30 days before the particular time,

Paragraph.Label: (e)
Paragraph.Text: the individual did not have an owner-occupied home in the period

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: that began at the beginning of the fourth preceding calendar year that ended before the particular time, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: that ended on the 31st day before the particular time,

Paragraph.Label: (f)
Paragraph.Text: the individual’s spouse or common-law partner did not, in the period referred to in paragraph (e), have an owner-occupied home

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: that was inhabited by the individual during the spouse’s or common-law partner’s marriage or common-law partnership to the individual, or

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: that was a share of the capital stock of a cooperative housing corporation that relates to a housing unit inhabited by the individual during the spouse’s or common-law partner’s marriage or common-law partnership to the individual,

Paragraph.Label: (g)
Paragraph.Text: the individual

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: acquired the qualifying home before the particular time and is resident in Canada at the particular time, or

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: is resident in Canada throughout the period that begins at the particular time and ends at the earlier of the time of the individual’s death and the earliest time at which the individual acquires the qualifying home or a replacement property for it,

Paragraph.Label: (h)
Paragraph.Text: the total of the amount and all other eligible amounts received by the individual in the calendar year that includes the particular time does not exceed $60,000, and

Paragraph.Label: (i)
Paragraph.Text: the individual’s HBP balance at the beginning of the calendar year that includes the particular time is nil; (montant admissible principal)

Definition.Text: replacement property for a particular qualifying home in respect of an individual, or of a specified disabled person in respect of the individual, means another qualifying home that

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the individual or the specified disabled person agrees to acquire, or begins the construction of, at a particular time that is after the latest time that the individual made a request described in the definition designated withdrawal in respect of the particular qualifying home,

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: at the particular time, the individual intends to be used by the individual or the specified disabled person as a principal place of residence not later than one year after its acquisition, and

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: none of the individual, the individual’s spouse or common-law partner, the specified disabled person or that person’s spouse or common-law partner had acquired before the particular time; (bien de remplacement)

Definition.Text: specified disabled person, in respect of an individual at any time, means a person who

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: is the individual or is related at that time to the individual, and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: would be entitled to a deduction under subsection 118.3(1) in computing tax payable under this Part for the person’s taxation year that includes that time if that subsection were read without reference to paragraph (c) of that subsection; (personne handicapée déterminée)

Definition.Text: supplemental eligible amount of an individual means an amount received at a particular time by the individual as a benefit out of or under a registered retirement savings plan if

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the amount is received pursuant to the individual’s written request in a prescribed form identifying a specified disabled person in respect of the individual and setting out the location of a qualifying home

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: that has begun to be used by that person as a principal place of residence, or

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: that the individual intends to be used by that person as a principal place of residence not later than one year after its first acquisition after the particular time,

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the purpose of receiving the amount is to enable the specified disabled person to live

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: in a dwelling that is more accessible by that person or in which that person is more mobile or functional, or

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: in an environment better suited to the personal needs and care of that person,

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: the individual or the specified disabled person entered into an agreement in writing before the particular time for the acquisition of the qualifying home or with respect to its construction,

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: either

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the individual or the specified disabled person acquires the qualifying home (or a replacement property for it) after 1998 and before the completion date in respect of the amount, or

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the individual dies before the end of the calendar year that includes the completion date in respect of the amount,

Paragraph.Label: (e)
Paragraph.Text: none of the individual, the spouse or common-law partner of the individual, the specified disabled person or the spouse or common-law partner of that person acquired the qualifying home more than 30 days before the particular time,

Paragraph.Label: (f)
Paragraph.Text: either

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the individual or the specified disabled person acquired the qualifying home before the particular time and the individual is resident in Canada at the particular time, or

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the individual is resident in Canada throughout the period that begins at the particular time and ends at the earlier of the time of the individual’s death and the earliest time at which

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: the individual acquires the qualifying home or a replacement property for it, or

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: the specified disabled person acquires the qualifying home or a replacement property for it,

Paragraph.Label: (g)
Paragraph.Text: the total of the amount and all other eligible amounts received by the individual in the calendar year that includes the particular time does not exceed $60,000, and

Paragraph.Label: (h)
Paragraph.Text: the individual’s HBP balance at the beginning of the calendar year that includes the particular time is nil. (montant admissible supplémentaire)

Subsection.Text: For the purposes of this section,

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: an individual shall be considered to have acquired a qualifying home if the individual acquired it jointly with one or more other persons;

Paragraph.Label: (a.1)
Paragraph.Text: an individual shall be considered to have an owner-occupied home at any time where, at that time, the individual owns, whether jointly with another person or otherwise, a housing unit or a share of the capital stock of a cooperative housing corporation and

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the housing unit is inhabited by the individual as the individual’s principal place of residence at that time, or

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the share was acquired for the purpose of acquiring a right to possess a housing unit owned by the corporation and that unit is inhabited by the individual as the individual’s principal place of residence at that time;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: except for the purposes of paragraphs (d) and (g) of the definition regular eligible amount and paragraphs (e) and (f) of the definition supplemental eligible amount in subsection (1), where an individual agrees to acquire a condominium unit, the individual shall be deemed to have acquired it on the day the individual is entitled to immediate vacant possession of it;

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: except for the purposes of subparagraph (g)(ii) of the definition regular eligible amount and subparagraph (f)(ii) of the definition supplemental eligible amount, an individual or a specified disabled person in respect of the individual is deemed to have acquired, before the completion date in respect of a designated withdrawal received by the individual, the qualifying home in respect of which the designated withdrawal was received if

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: neither the qualifying home nor a replacement property for it was acquired by the individual or the specified disabled person before that completion date, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: either

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: the individual or the specified disabled person

Subclause.Label: (I)
Subclause.Text: is obliged under the terms of a written agreement in effect on that completion date to acquire the qualifying home (or a replacement property for it) on or after that date, and

Subclause.Label: (II)
Subclause.Text: acquires the qualifying home or a replacement property for it before the day that is one year after that completion date, or

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: the individual or the specified disabled person made payments, the total of which equalled or exceeded the total of all designated withdrawals that were received by the individual in respect of the qualifying home,

Subclause.Label: (I)
Subclause.Text: to persons with whom the individual was dealing at arm’s length,

Subclause.Label: (II)
Subclause.Text: in respect of the construction of the qualifying home or a replacement property for it, and

Subclause.Label: (III)
Subclause.Text: in the period that begins at the time the individual first received a designated withdrawal in respect of the qualifying home and that ends before that completion date; and

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: an amount received by an individual in a particular calendar year is deemed to have been received by the individual at the end of the preceding calendar year and not at any other time if

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the amount is received in January of the particular year (or at such later time as is acceptable to the Minister),

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the amount would not be an eligible amount if this section were read without reference to this paragraph, and

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: the amount would be an eligible amount if the definition regular eligible amount in subsection (1) were read without reference to paragraph (i) of that definition and the definition supplemental eligible amount were read without reference to paragraph (h) of that definition.

Subsection.Text: Notwithstanding paragraph (2)(a.1), for the purposes of the definition regular eligible amount,

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: an individual, and a spouse or common-law partner of the individual, are deemed not to have an owner-occupied home in a period ending before a particular time referred to in that definition if

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: at the particular time, the individual

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: is living separate and apart from the individual’s spouse or common-law partner because of a breakdown of their marriage or common-law partnership,

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: has been living separate and apart from the individual’s spouse or common-law partner for a period of at least 90 days, and

Clause.Label: (C)
Clause.Text: began living separate and apart from the individual’s spouse or common-law partner in the calendar year that includes the particular time or any time in the four preceding calendar years,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: in the absence of this subsection, the individual would not be precluded from having a regular eligible amount because of the application of paragraph (f) of that definition in respect of a spouse or common-law partner (other than the spouse or common-law partner referred to in clauses (i)(A) to (C)), and

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: where the individual has an owner-occupied home at the particular time,

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: the home is not the qualifying home referred to in that definition and the individual disposes of the home no later than the end of the second calendar year after the calendar year that includes the particular time, or

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: the individual acquires the interest, or for civil law the right, of the spouse or common-law partner in the home; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: if an individual to whom paragraph (a) applies has an owner-occupied home at the particular time referred to in that paragraph and the individual acquires the interest, or for civil law the right, of a spouse or common-law partner in the home, the individual is deemed for the purposes of paragraphs (c) and (d) of that definition to have acquired a qualifying home on the date that the individual acquired the interest or the right.

Subsection.Text: An individual may designate a single amount for a taxation year in a prescribed form filed with the individual’s return of income for the year if the amount does not exceed the lesser of

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the total of all amounts (other than excluded premiums, repayments to which paragraph (b) or (d) of the definition excluded withdrawal in subsection (1) applies and amounts paid by the individual in the first 60 days of the year that can reasonably be considered to have been deducted in computing the individual’s income, or designated under this subsection, for the preceding taxation year) paid by the individual in the year or within 60 days after the end of the year under a retirement savings plan that is at the end of the year or the following taxation year a registered retirement savings plan under which the individual is the annuitant, and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the amount, if any, by which

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the total of all eligible amounts received by the individual before the end of the year

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: all amounts designated by the individual under this subsection for preceding taxation years, and

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: all amounts each of which is an amount included in computing the income of the individual under subsection 146.01(4) or 146.01(5) for a preceding taxation year.

Subsection.MarginalNote: Portion of eligible amount not repaid
Subsection.Text: Subject to subsection (4.1), there shall be included in computing an individual’s income for a particular taxation year included in a particular participation period of the individual the amount determined by the formula

FormulaDefinition.Text: is

FormulaParagraph.Label: (a)
FormulaParagraph.Text: where

FormulaParagraph.Label: (i)
FormulaParagraph.Text: the individual died or ceased to be resident in Canada in the particular year, or

FormulaParagraph.Label: (ii)
FormulaParagraph.Text: the completion date in respect of an eligible amount received by the individual was in the particular year

FormulaParagraph.Label: (b)
FormulaParagraph.Text: in any other case, the total of all eligible amounts received by the individual in preceding taxation years included in the particular period,

FormulaDefinition.Text: is

FormulaParagraph.Label: (a)
FormulaParagraph.Text: nil, if the completion date in respect of an eligible amount received by the individual was in the preceding taxation year, and

FormulaParagraph.Label: (b)
FormulaParagraph.Text: in any other case, the total of all amounts each of which is designated under subsection (3) by the individual for a preceding taxation year included in the particular period;

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the total of all amounts each of which is included under this subsection or subsection (5) in computing the individual’s income for a preceding taxation year included in the particular period;
is the lesser of 14 and the number of taxation years of the individual ending in the period beginning

FormulaParagraph.Label: (a)
FormulaParagraph.Text: where the completion date in respect of an eligible amount received by the individual was before 1995, January 1, 1995, and

FormulaParagraph.Label: (b)
FormulaParagraph.Text: in any other case, January 1 of the first calendar year beginning after the completion date in respect of an eligible amount received by the individual

ContinuedFormulaParagraph.Text: and ending at the beginning of the particular year, and

FormulaDefinition.Text: is

FormulaParagraph.Label: (a)
FormulaParagraph.Text: if the completion date in respect of an eligible amount received by the individual was in the preceding taxation year, the total of all amounts each of which is designated under subsection (3) by the individual for the particular year or any preceding taxation year included in the particular period, and

FormulaParagraph.Label: (b)
FormulaParagraph.Text: in any other case, the amount designated under subsection (3) by the individual for the particular year.

Subsection.Text: If the completion date in respect of an eligible amount received by an individual is after 2022 and before 2030

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: subparagraphs (a)(i) and (ii) of the description of A in subsection (4) are to be read as follows:

FormulaParagraph.Label: “(i)
