Clause.Text: as a consequence of the death of the employee or former employee, or

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: under a decree, an order or a judgment of a competent tribunal, or under a written agreement, that relates to a division of property between the employee or former employee and the individual in settlement of rights that arise out of, or on a breakdown of, their marriage or common-law partnership;

ContinuedParagraph.Text: in full or partial satisfaction of the individual’s entitlement to benefits under the plan;

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: would, if it were paid directly to the individual, be included under subsection 147(10) in computing the individual’s income for a taxation year; and

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: is transferred for the benefit of the individual directly to

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: a registered pension plan,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: a registered retirement savings plan under which the individual is the annuitant (within the meaning assigned by subsection 146(1)),

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: a deferred profit sharing plan that can reasonably be expected to have at least 5 beneficiaries at all times throughout the calendar year in which the transfer is made,

Subparagraph.Label: (iv)
Subparagraph.Text: a registered retirement income fund under which the individual is the annuitant (within the meaning assigned by subsection 146.3(1)), or

Subparagraph.Label: (v)
Subparagraph.Text: a licensed annuities provider to acquire an advanced life deferred annuity, if the individual is an employee or former employee of an employer who participated in the plan on the employee’s behalf.

Subsection.Text: Where an amount is transferred on behalf of an individual in accordance with subsection 147(19),

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the amount shall not, by reason only of that transfer, be included by virtue of this section in computing the income of any taxpayer; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: no deduction may be made under any provision of this Act in respect of the amount in computing the income of any taxpayer.

Subsection.Text: A deferred profit sharing plan becomes a revocable plan at any time that an amount is transferred from the plan to a registered pension plan, a registered retirement savings plan or another deferred profit sharing plan unless

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the transfer is in accordance with subsection 147(19); or

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the amount is deductible under paragraph 60(j) or 60(j.2) of this Act or paragraph 60(k) of the Income Tax Act, chapter 148 of the Revised Statutes of Canada, 1952, by the individual on whose behalf the transfer is made.

Subsection.Text: Where

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the transfer of an amount from a deferred profit sharing plan in a calendar year on behalf of a beneficiary under the plan would, but for this subsection, be in accordance with subsection 147(19), and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the requirements of subsection 147(5.1) in respect of the plan are not satisfied for the year by reason that the beneficiary’s pension credits or pension adjustments do not comply with any of paragraphs 147(5.1)(a) to 147(5.1)(c),

ContinuedSectionSubsection.Text: such portion of the amount transferred as may reasonably be considered to derive from amounts allocated or reallocated to the beneficiary in the year or from earnings reasonably attributable to those amounts shall, except to the extent otherwise expressly provided in writing by the Minister, be deemed to be an amount that was not transferred in accordance with subsection 147(19).

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Subsection.Text: In this section and sections 147.2 and 147.3,

Definition.Text: actuary means a Fellow of the Canadian Institute of Actuaries; (actuaire)
administrator of a pension plan means the person or body of persons that has ultimate responsibility for the administration of the plan; (administrateur)

average wage for a calendar year means the amount that is obtained by dividing by 12 the total of all amounts each of which is the wage measure for a month in the 12 month period ending on June 30 of the immediately preceding calendar year; (salaire moyen)
compensation of an individual from an employer for a calendar year means the total of all amounts each of which is

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: an amount in respect of the individual’s employment with the employer, or an office in respect of which the individual is remunerated by the employer, that is required (or that would be required but for paragraph 81(1)(a) as it applies with respect to the Indian Act or the Foreign Missions and International Organizations Act) by section 5 or 6 to be included in computing the individual’s income for the year, except such portion of the amount that

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: meets the following conditions:

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: the portion may reasonably be considered to relate to a period throughout which the individual was not resident in Canada, and

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: the portion is

Subclause.Label: (I)
Subclause.Text: not attributable to the performance of the duties of the office or employment in Canada, or

Subclause.Label: (II)
Subclause.Text: exempt from income tax in Canada by reason of a tax treaty, or

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: is deducted under paragraph 8(1)(o.2) in computing the taxpayer’s income for the year,

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: a prescribed amount, or

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: an amount acceptable to the Minister in respect of remuneration received by the individual from any employer for a period in the year throughout which the individual was not resident in Canada, to the extent that the amount is not otherwise included in the total; (rétribution)

Definition.Text: defined benefit provision of a pension plan means terms of the plan under which benefits in respect of each member are determined in any way other than that described in the definition money purchase provision in this subsection; (disposition à prestations déterminées)

designated money purchase provision, in a calendar year, means a money purchase provision of a registered pension plan under which accounts are maintained in respect of at least 10 members throughout the year or under which the total contributions made for the year on behalf of an individual described in paragraph 8515(4)(a) or (b) of the Income Tax Regulations do not exceed 50% of the total contributions made for the year; (disposition à cotisations déterminées désignée)
former limit for each calendar year after 2005 and before 2010 means the greater of

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the product (rounded to the nearest multiple of $10, or, if that product is equidistant from two such consecutive multiples, to the higher multiple) of

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the quotient obtained when the average wage for the year is divided by the average wage for 2005, and

Paragraph.Label: (b )
Paragraph.Text: for 2006, $18,000, and for any other of those calendar years, the former limit for the preceding calendar year; (ancien plafond)

Definition.Text: member of a pension plan means an individual who has a right, either immediate or in the future and either absolute or contingent, to receive benefits under the plan, other than an individual who has such a right only by reason of the participation of another individual in the plan; (participant)
money purchase limit for a calendar year means

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: for years before 1990, nil,

Paragraph.Label: (g)
Paragraph.Text: for years after 1995 and before 2003, $13,500,

Paragraph.Label: (k)
Paragraph.Text: for 2006, the greater of $19,000 and the former limit for the year,

Paragraph.Label: (l)
Paragraph.Text: for 2007, the greater of $20,000 and the former limit for the year,

Paragraph.Label: (m)
Paragraph.Text: for 2008, the greater of $21,000 and the former limit for the year,

Paragraph.Label: (n)
Paragraph.Text: for 2009, the greater of $22,000 and the former limit for the year, and

Paragraph.Label: (o)
Paragraph.Text: for each year after 2009, the greater of

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the product (rounded to the nearest multiple of $10, or, if that product is equidistant from two such consecutive multiples, to the higher multiple) of

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: the money purchase limit for 2009, and

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: the quotient obtained when the average wage for the year is divided by the average wage for 2009, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the money purchase limit for the preceding year; (plafond des cotisations déterminées)

Definition.Text: money purchase provision of a pension plan means terms of the plan

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: which provide for a separate account to be maintained in respect of each member, to which are credited contributions made to the plan by, or in respect of, the member and any other amounts allocated to the member, and to which are charged payments made in respect of the member, and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: under which the only benefits in respect of a member are benefits

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: determined solely with reference to, and provided by, the amount in the member’s account, or

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: provided under a VPLA fund described in subsection 8506(13) of the Income Tax Regulations; (disposition à cotisations déterminées)

Definition.Text: multi-employer plan in a calendar year has the meaning assigned by regulation; (régime interentreprises)

participating employer, in relation to a pension plan, means an employer who has made, or is required to make, contributions to the plan in respect of the employer’s employees or former employees, or payments under the plan to the employer’s employees or former employees, and includes a prescribed employer; (employeur participant)
past service event has the meaning assigned by regulation; (fait lié aux services passés)

permitted corrective contribution to a registered pension plan means a contribution in a calendar year in respect of an individual that would otherwise have been made in one or more of the 10 immediately preceding years (each such year referred to in this definition as a “retroactive year”) in accordance with the money purchase provision of the plan as registered or a money purchase provision of a registered pension plan of a predecessor employer (for the purposes of this definition, as defined in subsection 8500(1) of the Regulations), but for an error that caused a failure to enroll the individual as a member of the plan or a failure to make a required contribution, to the extent that the amount of the contribution does not exceed the lesser of

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the total of all amounts each of which is an amount, for a retroactive year, determined by the formula

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the total of all amounts each of which is an amount by which a contribution required to be made at a particular time in the retroactive year under the provision in respect of the individual exceeds the amount contributed at the particular time in respect of the individual,
is the amount of interest, if any, calculated in respect of each amount determined for A at a rate that

FormulaParagraph.Label: (i)
FormulaParagraph.Text: is required by the Pension Benefits Standards Act, 1985 or a similar law of a province, or

FormulaParagraph.Label: (ii)
FormulaParagraph.Text: if subparagraph (i) does not apply, does not exceed a reasonable rate, and

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the total amount previously contributed to the provision in respect of the individual under subsection (20) for the retroactive year, and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the amount determined by the formula

FormulaDefinition.Text: is 150% of the money purchase limit for the calendar year, and

is the total amount previously contributed in respect of the individual under subsection (20) to the provision, or to any other money purchase provision, if a participating employer under the provision or a predecessor employer has been a participating employer in respect of the individual under that other provision; (cotisation corrective permise)

Definition.Text: single amount means an amount that is not part of a series of periodic payments; (montant unique)
specified multi-employer plan in a calendar year has the meaning assigned by regulation; (régime interentreprises déterminé)
wage measure for a month means the average weekly wages and salaries of

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the Industrial Aggregate in Canada for the month as published by Statistics Canada under the Statistics Act, or

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: in the event that the Industrial Aggregate ceases to be published, such other measure for the month as is prescribed by regulation under the Canada Pension Plan for the purposes of paragraph 18(5)(b) of that Act. (mesure des gains)

Subsection.Text: The following rules apply with respect to the registration of pension plans:

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the Minister shall not register a pension plan unless

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: application for registration is made in prescribed manner by the plan administrator,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the plan complies with prescribed conditions for registration, and

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: where the plan is required to be registered under the Pension Benefits Standards Act, 1985 or a similar law of a province, application for such registration has been made;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: where a pension plan that was submitted for registration before 1992 is registered by the Minister, the registration is effective from the day specified in writing by the Minister; and

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: where a pension plan that is submitted for registration after 1991 is registered by the Minister, the registration is effective from the later of

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: January 1 of the calendar year in which application for registration is made in prescribed manner by the plan administrator, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the day the plan began.

Subsection.Text: Where application is made to the Minister for registration of a pension plan for the purposes of this Act and, where the manner for making the application has been prescribed, the application is made in that manner by the administrator,

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: subject to paragraph 147.1(3)(b), the plan is, for the purposes of this Act other than paragraphs 60(j) and 60(j.2) and sections 147.3 and 147.4, deemed to be a registered pension plan throughout the period that begins on the latest of

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: January 1 of the calendar year in which the application is made,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the day of commencement of the plan, and

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: January 1, 1989

ContinuedParagraph.Text: and ending on the day on which a final determination is made with respect to the application; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: where the final determination made with respect to the application is a refusal to register the plan, this Act shall, after the day of the final determination, apply as if the plan had never been deemed, under paragraph 147.1(3)(a), to be a registered pension plan, except that

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: any information return otherwise required to be filed under subsection 207.7(3) before the particular day that is 90 days after the day of the final determination is not required to be filed until the particular day, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: subsections 227(8) and 227(8.2) are not applicable with respect to contributions made to the plan on or before the day of the final determination.

Subsection.Text: The Minister shall not accept an amendment to a registered pension plan unless

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: application for the acceptance is made in prescribed manner by the plan administrator;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the plan as amended complies with prescribed conditions for registration; and

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: the amendment complies with prescribed conditions.

Subsection.Text: The Minister may, at any time, impose reasonable conditions applicable with respect to registered pension plans, a class of such plans or a particular registered pension plan.

There shall, for each registered pension plan, be a person or a body of persons that has ultimate responsibility for the administration of the plan and, except as otherwise permitted in writing by the Minister, the person or a majority of the persons who constitute the body shall be a person or persons resident in Canada.
The administrator of a registered pension plan shall

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: administer the plan in accordance with the terms of the plan as registered except that, where the plan fails to comply with the prescribed conditions for registration or any other requirement of this Act or the regulations, the administrator may administer the plan as if it were amended to so comply;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: before July, 1990, in the case of a person or body that is the administrator on January 1, 1989 or becomes the administrator before June, 1990, and, in any other case, within 30 days after becoming the administrator, inform the Minister in writing

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: of the name and address of the person who is the administrator, or

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: of the names and addresses of the persons who constitute the body that is the administrator; and

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: where there is any change in the information provided to the Minister in accordance with this paragraph or paragraph 147.1(7)(b), inform the Minister in writing, within 60 days after the change, of the new information.

Subsection.Text: Except as otherwise provided by regulation, a registered pension plan (other than a multi-employer plan) becomes, at the end of a calendar year after 1990, a revocable plan where

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the pension adjustment for the year of a member of the plan in respect of a participating employer exceeds the lesser of

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the money purchase limit for the year, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: 18% of the member’s compensation from the employer for the year; or

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the total of

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the pension adjustment for the year of a member of the plan in respect of a participating employer, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the total of all amounts each of which is the member’s pension adjustment for the year in respect of an employer who, at any time in the year, does not deal at arm’s length with the employer referred to in subparagraph 147.1(8)(b)(i)

ContinuedParagraph.Text: exceeds the money purchase limit for the year.

Subsection.Text: Except as otherwise provided by regulation, a registered pension plan that is a multi-employer plan (other than a specified multi-employer plan) in a calendar year after 1990 becomes, at the end of the year, a revocable plan where

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: for a member and an employer, the total of all amounts each of which is the member’s pension credit (as prescribed by regulation) for the year in respect of the employer under a defined benefit or money purchase provision of the plan exceeds the lesser of

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the money purchase limit for the year, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: 18% of the member’s compensation from the employer for the year; or

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: for a member, the total of all amounts each of which is the member’s pension credit (as prescribed by regulation) for the year in respect of an employer under a defined benefit or money purchase provision of the plan exceeds the money purchase limit for the year.

Subsection.Text: With respect to each past service event that is relevant to the determination of benefits in respect of a member under a defined benefit provision of a registered pension plan, such benefits as are in respect of periods after 1989 and before the calendar year in which the event occurred shall be determined, for the purpose of a payment to be made from the plan or a contribution to be made to the plan at a particular time, with regard to the event only if

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: where the member is alive at the particular time and except as otherwise provided by regulation, the Minister has certified in writing, before the particular time, that prescribed conditions are satisfied,

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: where the member died before the particular time and the event occurred before the death of the member,

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: this subsection did not require that the event be disregarded in determining benefits that were payable to the member immediately before the member’s death (or that would have been so payable had the member been entitled to receive benefits under the provision immediately before the member’s death), or

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the event, as it affects the benefits provided to each individual who is entitled to benefits as a consequence of the death of the member, is acceptable to the Minister,

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: where the member died before the particular time and the event occurred after the death of the member, the event, as it affects the benefits provided to each individual who is entitled to benefits as a consequence of the death of the member, is acceptable to the Minister, and

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: no past service event that occurred before the event is required by reason of the application of this subsection to be disregarded at the particular time in determining benefits in respect of the member,

ContinuedSectionSubsection.Text: and, for the purposes of this subsection as it applies with respect to contributions that may be made to a registered pension plan, where application has been made for a certification referred to in paragraph 147.1(10)(a) and the Minister has not refused to issue the certification, the Minister shall be deemed to have issued the certification.

Subsection.MarginalNote: Revocation of registration — notice of intention
Subsection.Text: Where, at any time after a pension plan has been registered by the Minister,

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the plan does not comply with the prescribed conditions for registration,

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the plan is not administered in accordance with the terms of the plan as registered,

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: the plan becomes a revocable plan,

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: a condition imposed by the Minister in writing and applicable with respect to the plan (including a condition applicable generally to registered pension plans or a class of such plans and a condition first imposed before 1989) is not complied with,

Paragraph.Label: (e)
Paragraph.Text: a requirement under subsection 147.1(6) or 147.1(7) is not complied with,

Paragraph.Label: (f)
Paragraph.Text: a benefit is paid by the plan, or a contribution is made to the plan, contrary to subsection 147.1(10),

Paragraph.Label: (g)
Paragraph.Text: the administrator of the plan fails to file an information return or actuarial report relating to the plan or to a member of the plan as and when required by regulation,

Paragraph.Label: (h)
Paragraph.Text: a participating employer fails to file an information return relating to the plan or to a member of the plan as and when required by regulation, or

Paragraph.Label: (i)
Paragraph.Text: registration of the plan under the Pension Benefits Standards Act, 1985 or a similar law of a province is refused or revoked,

ContinuedSectionSubsection.Text: the Minister may give notice (in this subsection and subsection 147.1(12) referred to as a “notice of intent”) by registered mail to the plan administrator that the Minister proposes to revoke the registration of the plan as of a date specified in the notice of intent, which date shall not be earlier than the date as of which,

Paragraph.Label: (j)
Paragraph.Text: where paragraph 147.1(11)(a) applies, the plan failed to so comply,

Paragraph.Label: (k)
Paragraph.Text: where paragraph 147.1(11)(b) applies, the plan was not administered in accordance with its terms as registered,

Paragraph.Label: (l)
Paragraph.Text: where paragraph 147.1(11)(c) applies, the plan became a revocable plan,

Paragraph.Label: (m)
Paragraph.Text: where paragraph 147.1(11)(d) or 147.1(11)(e) applies, the condition or requirement was not complied with,

Paragraph.Label: (n)
Paragraph.Text: where paragraph 147.1(11)(f) applies, the benefit was paid or the contribution was made,

Paragraph.Label: (o)
Paragraph.Text: where paragraph 147.1(11)(g) or 147.1(11)(h) applies, the information return or actuarial report was required to be filed, and

Paragraph.Label: (p)
Paragraph.Text: where paragraph 147.1(11)(i) applies, the registration referred to in that paragraph was refused or revoked.

Subsection.Text: Where the Minister gives a notice of intent to the administrator of a registered pension plan, or the plan administrator applies to the Minister in writing for the revocation of the plan’s registration, the Minister may,

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: where the plan administrator has applied to the Minister in writing for the revocation of the plan’s registration, at any time after receiving the administrator’s application, and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: in any other case, after 30 days after the day of mailing of the notice of intent,

ContinuedSectionSubsection.Text: give notice (in this subsection and subsection 147.1(13) referred to as a “notice of revocation”) by registered mail to the plan administrator that the registration of the plan is revoked as of the date specified in the notice of revocation, which date may not be earlier than the date specified in the notice of intent or the administrator’s application, as the case may be.

Subsection.Text: Where the Minister gives a notice of revocation to the administrator of a registered pension plan, the registration of the plan is revoked as of the date specified in the notice of revocation, unless the Federal Court of Appeal or a judge thereof, on application made at any time before the determination of an appeal pursuant to subsection 172(3), orders otherwise.

Where at any time the Minister gives written notice to the administrators of two or more registered pension plans, each of which is a multi-employer plan, that this subsection is applicable in relation to those plans with respect to a calendar year,

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: each of those plans that is a specified multi-employer plan in the year shall, for the purposes of subsection 147.1(9) (other than for the purpose of determining the pension credits referred to in paragraphs 147.1(9)(a) and 147.1(9)(b)), be deemed to be a multi-employer plan that is not a specified multi-employer plan; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the totals determined for the year under paragraphs 147.1(9)(a) and 147.1(9)(b) shall be the amounts that would be determined if all the plans were a single plan.

Subsection.Text: Any reference in this Act and the regulations to a pension plan as registered means the terms of the plan on the basis of which the Minister has registered the plan for the purposes of this Act and as amended by

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: each amendment that has been accepted by the Minister, and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: each amendment that has been submitted to the Minister for acceptance and that the Minister has neither accepted nor refused to accept, if it is reasonable to expect the Minister to accept the amendment,

ContinuedSectionSubsection.Text: and includes all terms that are not contained in the documents constituting the plan but that are terms of the plan by reason of the Pension Benefits Standards Act, 1985 or a similar law of a province.

Subsection.Text: Every person who is a member of a body that is the administrator of a registered pension plan is subject to all obligations imposed on administrators by this Act or a regulation as if the person were the administrator of the plan.
The Minister may, for the purposes of this Act, obtain the advice of the Superintendent of Financial Institutions with respect to any matter relating to pension plans.
The Governor in Council may make regulations

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: prescribing conditions for the registration of pension plans and enabling the Minister to impose additional conditions or waive any conditions that are prescribed;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: prescribing circumstances under which a registered pension plan becomes a revocable plan;

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: specifying the manner of determining, or enabling the Minister to determine, the portion of a member’s benefits under a registered pension plan that is in respect of any period;

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: requiring administrators of registered pension plans to make determinations in connection with the computation of pension adjustments, past service pension adjustments, total pension adjustment reversals or any other related amounts (all such amounts referred to in this subsection as “specified amounts”);

Paragraph.Label: (e)
Paragraph.Text: requiring that the method used to determine a specified amount be acceptable to the Minister, where more than one method would otherwise comply with the regulations;

Paragraph.Label: (f)
Paragraph.Text: enabling the Minister to permit or require a specified amount to be determined in a manner different from that set out in the regulations;

Paragraph.Label: (g)
Paragraph.Text: requiring that any person who has information required by another person in order to determine a specified amount provide the other person with that information;

Paragraph.Label: (h)
Paragraph.Text: enabling the Minister to require any person to provide the Minister with information relating to the method used to determine a specified amount;

Paragraph.Label: (i)
Paragraph.Text: enabling the Minister to require any person to provide the Minister with information relevant to a claim that paragraph 147.1(10)(a) is not applicable by reason of an exemption provided by regulation;

Paragraph.Label: (j)
Paragraph.Text: respecting applications for certifications for the purposes of subsection 147.1(10);

Paragraph.Label: (k)
Paragraph.Text: enabling the Minister to waive the requirement for a certification for the purposes of subsection 147.1(10);

Paragraph.Label: (l)
Paragraph.Text: prescribing rules for the purposes of subsection 147.1(10), so that that subsection applies or does not apply with respect to benefits provided as a consequence of particular transactions, events or circumstances;

Paragraph.Label: (m)
Paragraph.Text: requiring any person to provide the Minister or the administrator of a registered pension plan with information in connection with an application for certification for the purposes of subsection 147.1(10);

Paragraph.Label: (n)
Paragraph.Text: requiring any person who obtains a certification for the purposes of subsection 147.1(10) to provide the individual in respect of whom the certification was obtained with an information return;

Paragraph.Label: (o)
Paragraph.Text: requiring administrators of registered pension plans to file information with respect to amendments to such plans and to the arrangements for funding benefits thereunder;

Paragraph.Label: (p)
Paragraph.Text: requiring administrators of registered pension plans to file information returns respecting such plans;

Paragraph.Label: (q)
Paragraph.Text: enabling the Minister to require any person to provide the Minister with information for the purpose of determining whether the registration of a pension plan may be revoked;

Paragraph.Label: (r)
Paragraph.Text: requiring administrators of registered pension plans to submit reports to the Minister, prescribing the class of persons by whom the reports shall be prepared and prescribing information to be contained in those reports;

Paragraph.Label: (s)
Paragraph.Text: enabling the Minister to impose any requirement that may be imposed by regulation made under paragraph 147.1(18)(r);

Paragraph.Label: (t)
Paragraph.Text: defining, for the purposes of this Act, the expressions multi-employer plan, past service event, past service pension adjustment, pension adjustment, specified multi-employer plan and total pension adjustment reversal; and

Paragraph.Label: (u)
Paragraph.Text: generally to carry out the purposes and provisions of this Act relating to registered pension plans and the determination and reporting of specified amounts.

Subsection.Text: The administrator of a registered pension plan may make a payment (other than a payment made to avoid the revocation of the registration of the plan) that is a return of all or a portion of a contribution made by a member of the plan, or an employer who participates in the plan, if

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the contribution was made to the plan as a consequence of a reasonable error;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the payment is made to the member or employer, as the case may be, who made the contribution; and

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: the payment is made no later than December 31 of the year following the year in which the contribution was made.

Subsection.Text: An individual or an employer may make a contribution in a calendar year under a money purchase provision of a registered pension plan in respect of the individual if it is a permitted corrective contribution and the provision was a designated money purchase provision in each of the prior years in respect of which the contribution is made.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Subsection.Text: For a taxation year ending after 1990, there may be deducted in computing the income of a taxpayer who is an employer the total of all amounts each of which is a contribution made by the employer after 1990 and either in the taxation year or within 120 days after the end of the taxation year to a registered pension plan in respect of the employer’s employees or former employees, to the extent that

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: in the case of a contribution in respect of a money purchase provision of a plan, the contribution was made in respect of periods before the end of the taxation year

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: in accordance with the plan as registered, or

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: under subsection 147.1(20);

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: in the case of a contribution in respect of the defined benefit provisions of a plan (other than a specified multi-employer plan), the contribution

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: is an eligible contribution,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: was made to fund benefits provided to employees and former employees of the employer in respect of periods before the end of the taxation year, and

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: complies with subsection 147.1(10);

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: in the case of a contribution made to a plan that is a specified multi-employer plan, the contribution was made in accordance with the plan as registered and in respect of periods before the end of the taxation year; and

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: the contribution was not deducted in computing the income of the employer for a preceding taxation year.

Subsection.Text: For the purposes of subsection 147.2(1), a contribution made by an employer to a registered pension plan in respect of the defined benefit provisions of the plan is an eligible contribution if it is a prescribed contribution or if it complies with prescribed conditions and is made pursuant to a recommendation by an actuary in whose opinion the contribution is required to be made so that the plan will have sufficient assets to pay benefits under the defined benefit provisions of the plan, as registered, in respect of the employees and former employees of the employer, where

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the recommendation is based on an actuarial valuation that complies with the following conditions, except the conditions in subparagraphs 147.2(2)(a)(iii) and 147.2(2)(a)(iv) to the extent that they are inconsistent with any other conditions that apply for the purpose of determining whether the contribution is an eligible contribution:

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the effective date of the valuation is not more than 4 years before the day on which the contribution is made,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: actuarial liabilities and current service costs are determined in accordance with an actuarial funding method that produces a reasonable matching of contributions with accruing benefits,

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: all assumptions made for the purposes of the valuation are reasonable at the time the valuation is prepared and at the time the contribution is made,

Subparagraph.Label: (iv)
Subparagraph.Text: the valuation is prepared in accordance with generally accepted actuarial principles,

Subparagraph.Label: (v)
Subparagraph.Text: the valuation complies with prescribed conditions, which conditions may include conditions regarding the benefits that may be taken into account for the purposes of the valuation, and

Subparagraph.Label: (vi)
Subparagraph.Text: where more than one employer participates in the plan, assets and actuarial liabilities are apportioned in a reasonable manner among participating employers in respect of their employees and former employees, and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the recommendation is approved by the Minister in writing,

ContinuedSectionSubsection.Text: and, for the purposes of this subsection and except as otherwise provided by regulation,

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: the benefits taken into account for the purposes of a recommendation may include anticipated cost-of-living and similar adjustments where the terms of a pension plan do not require that those adjustments be made but it is reasonable to expect that they will be made, and

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: a recommendation with respect to the contributions required to be made by an employer in respect of the defined benefit provisions of a pension plan may be prepared without regard to such portion of the assets of the plan apportioned to the employer in respect of the employer’s employees and former employees as does not exceed the lesser of

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the amount of actuarial surplus in respect of the employer, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: 25% of the amount of actuarial liabilities apportioned to the employer in respect of the employer’s employees and former employees.

Subsection.Text: Where, for the purposes of subsection 147.2(2), a person seeks the Minister’s approval of a recommendation made by an actuary in connection with the contributions to be made by an employer to a registered pension plan in respect of the defined benefit provisions of the plan, the person shall file with the Minister a report prepared by the actuary that contains the recommendation and any other information required by the Minister.

Subsection.MarginalNote: Amount of employee’s pension contributions deductible
Subsection.Text: There may be deducted in computing the income of an individual for a taxation year ending after 1990 an amount equal to the total of

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the total of all amounts each of which is a contribution (other than a prescribed contribution) made by the individual in the year

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: to a registered pension plan that is in respect of a period after 1989 or that is a prescribed eligible contribution, to the extent that the contribution was made in accordance with the plan as registered, or

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: under subsection 147.1(20);

Paragraph.MarginalNote: Service before 1990 while not a contributor
Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the least of

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the amount, if any, by which

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: the total of all amounts each of which is a contribution (other than an additional voluntary contribution or a prescribed contribution) made by the individual in the year or a preceding taxation year and after 1945 to a registered pension plan in respect of a particular year before 1990, if all or any part of the particular year is included in the individual’s eligible service under the plan and if

Subclause.Label: (I)
Subclause.Text: in the case of a contribution that the individual made before March 28, 1988 or was obliged to make under the terms of an agreement in writing entered into before March 28, 1988, the individual was not a contributor to the plan in the particular year, or

Subclause.Label: (II)
Subclause.Text: in any other case, the individual was not a contributor to any registered pension plan in the particular year

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: the total of all amounts each of which is an amount deducted, in computing the individual’s income for a preceding taxation year, in respect of contributions included in the total determined in respect of the individual for the year under clause 147.2(4)(b)(i)(A),

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: the amount determined by the formula

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the number of calendar years before 1990 each of which is a year

FormulaParagraph.Label: (A)
FormulaParagraph.Text: all or any part of which is included in the individual’s eligible service under a registered pension plan to which the individual has made a contribution that is included in the total determined under clause 147.2(4)(b)(i)(A) and in which the individual was not a contributor to any registered pension plan, or

FormulaParagraph.Label: (B)
FormulaParagraph.Text: all or any part of which is included in the individual’s eligible service under a registered pension plan to which the individual has made a contribution

FormulaParagraph.Label: (I)
FormulaParagraph.Text: that is included in the total determined under clause 147.2(4)(b)(i)(A), and

FormulaParagraph.Label: (II)
FormulaParagraph.Text: that the individual made before March 28, 1988 or was obliged to make under the terms of an agreement in writing entered into before March 28, 1988, and in which the individual was not a contributor to the plan, and

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the total of all amounts each of which is an amount deducted, in computing the individual’s income for a preceding taxation year,

FormulaParagraph.Label: (A)
FormulaParagraph.Text: in respect of contributions included in the total determined in respect of the individual for the year under clause 147.2(4)(b)(i)(A), or

FormulaParagraph.Label: (B)
FormulaParagraph.Text: where the preceding year was before 1987, under subparagraph 8(1)(m)(ii) (as it read in its application to that preceding year) in respect of additional voluntary contributions made in respect of a year that satisfies the conditions in the description of Y, and

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: the lesser of

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the amount, if any, by which

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: the total of all amounts each of which is a contribution (other than an additional voluntary contribution, a prescribed contribution or a contribution included in the total determined in respect of the individual for the year under clause 147.2(4)(b)(i)(A)) made by the individual in the year or a preceding taxation year and after 1962 to a registered pension plan in respect of a particular year before 1990 that is included, in whole or in part, in the individual’s eligible service under the plan

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: the total of all amounts each of which is an amount deducted, in computing the individual’s income for a preceding taxation year, in respect of contributions included in the total determined in respect of the individual for the year under clause 147.2(4)(c)(i)(A), and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the amount, if any, by which $3,500 exceeds the total of the amounts deducted by reason of paragraphs 147.2(4)(a) and 147.2(4)(b) in computing the individual’s income for the year.

Subsection.Text: For the purpose of determining whether a teacher may deduct an amount contributed by the teacher to a registered pension plan in computing the teacher’s income for a taxation year ending after 1990 and before 1995 during which the teacher was employed by Her Majesty or a person exempt from tax for the year under section 149,

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: clause 147.2(4)(b)(i)(A) shall be read without reference to subclauses 147.2(4)(b)(i)(A)(I) and 147.2(4)(b)(i)(A)(II); and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the description of Y in subparagraph 147.2(4)(b)(iii) shall be read as follows:

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the number of calendar years before 1990 each of which is a year all or any part of which is included in the individual’s eligible service under a registered pension plan to which the individual has made a contribution that is included in the total determined under clause 147.2(5)(b)(i)(A), and”

Subsection.Text: Where a taxpayer dies in a taxation year, for the purpose of computing the taxpayer’s income for the year and the preceding taxation year,

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: paragraph 147.2(4)(b) shall be read without reference to subparagraph 147.2(6)(a)(ii) and as if the reference to “the least of” were a reference to “the lesser of”; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: paragraph 147.2(4)(c) shall be read without reference to subparagraph 147.2(6)(b)(ii) and the words “the lesser of”.

Subsection.Text: For the purposes of this section and any regulations made under subsection 147.1(18) in respect of eligible contributions, an amount paid to a registered pension plan by the issuer of a letter of credit issued in connection with an employer’s funding obligations under a defined benefit provision of the plan is deemed to be an eligible contribution made to the plan in respect of the provision by the employer with respect to the employer’s employees or former employees, if

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the amount is paid under the letter of credit;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the use of the letter of credit is permitted under the Pension Benefits Standards Act, 1985 or a similar law of a province; and

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: the amount would have been an eligible contribution under subsection (2) if

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: it had been paid to the plan by the employer, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: this section were read without reference to this subsection.

Subsection.Text: For the purposes of this section and any regulations made under subsection 147.1(18) in respect of eligible contributions, a former employee of a predecessor employer (as defined by regulation) of a participating employer in relation to a pension plan is deemed to be a former employee of the participating employer in relation to the plan if

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the former employee would not otherwise be an employee or former employee of the participating employer; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: benefits are provided to the former employee under a defined benefit provision of the plan in respect of periods of employment with the predecessor employer.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Section.MarginalNote: Transfer — money purchase to money purchase, RRSP or RRIF

Subsection.Text: An amount is transferred from a registered pension plan in accordance with this subsection if the amount

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: is a single amount;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: is transferred on behalf of a member in full or partial satisfaction of the member’s entitlement to benefits under a money purchase provision of the plan as registered; and

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: is transferred directly to

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: another registered pension plan to provide benefits in respect of the member under a money purchase provision of that plan,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: a registered retirement savings plan under which the member is the annuitant (within the meaning assigned by subsection 146(1)),

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: a registered retirement income fund under which the member is the annuitant (within the meaning assigned by subsection 146.3(1)), or

Subparagraph.Label: (iv)
Subparagraph.Text: a licensed annuities provider to acquire an advanced life deferred annuity for the benefit of the member.

Subsection.MarginalNote: Transfer — money purchase to defined benefit
Subsection.Text: An amount is transferred from a registered pension plan in accordance with this subsection if the amount

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: is a single amount;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: is transferred on behalf of a member in full or partial satisfaction of the member’s entitlement to benefits under a money purchase provision of the plan as registered; and

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: is transferred directly to another registered pension plan to fund benefits provided in respect of the member under a defined benefit provision of that plan.

Subsection.MarginalNote: Transfer — defined benefit to defined benefit
Subsection.Text: An amount is transferred from a registered pension plan (in this subsection referred to as the “transferor plan”) in accordance with this subsection if the amount

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: is a single amount;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: consists of all or any part of the property held in connection with a defined benefit provision of the transferor plan;

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: is transferred directly to another registered pension plan to be held in connection with a defined benefit provision of the other plan, unless the transfer is to an individual pension plan (as defined in subsection 8300(1) of the Income Tax Regulations) and is in respect of benefits that are attributable to employment with a former employer that is not a participating employer (or its predecessor employer); and

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: is transferred as a consequence of benefits becoming provided under the defined benefit provision of the other plan to one or more individuals who were members of the transferor plan.

Subsection.MarginalNote: Transfer — defined benefit to money purchase, RRSP or RRIF
Subsection.Text: An amount is transferred from a registered pension plan in accordance with this subsection if the amount

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: is a single amount no portion of which relates to an actuarial surplus;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: is transferred on behalf of a member in full or partial satisfaction of benefits to which the member is entitled, either absolutely or contingently, under a defined benefit provision of the plan as registered;

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: does not exceed a prescribed amount; and

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: is transferred directly to

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: another registered pension plan and allocated to the member under a money purchase provision of that plan,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: a registered retirement savings plan under which the member is the annuitant (within the meaning assigned by subsection 146(1)), or

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: a registered retirement income fund under which the member is the annuitant (within the meaning assigned by subsection 146.3(1)).

Subsection.MarginalNote: Transfer of surplus — defined benefit to money purchase
Subsection.Text: An amount is transferred from a registered pension plan in accordance with this subsection if the amount

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: is transferred in respect of the actuarial surplus under a defined benefit provision of the plan; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: is transferred directly to another registered pension plan and allocated under a money purchase provision of that plan to one or more members of that plan.

Subsection.MarginalNote: Transfer to RPP, RRSP or RRIF for spouse on marriage breakdown
Subsection.Text: An amount is transferred from a registered pension plan in accordance with this subsection if the amount

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: is a single amount no portion of which relates to an actuarial surplus;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: is transferred on behalf of an individual who is a spouse or common-law partner or former spouse or common-law partner of a member of the plan and who is entitled to the amount under a decree, order or judgment of a competent tribunal, or under a written agreement, relating to a division of property between the member and the individual in settlement of rights arising out of, or on a breakdown of, their marriage or common-law partnership; and

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: is transferred directly to

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: another registered pension plan for the benefit of the individual,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: a registered retirement savings plan under which the individual is the annuitant (within the meaning assigned by subsection 146(1)), or

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: a registered retirement income fund under which the individual is the annuitant (within the meaning assigned by subsection 146.3(1)).

Subsection.Text: An amount is transferred from a registered pension plan in accordance with this subsection if the amount

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: is a single amount;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: is transferred on behalf of a member who is entitled to the amount as a return of contributions made (or deemed by regulation to have been made) by the member under a defined benefit provision of the plan before 1991, or as interest (computed at a rate not exceeding a reasonable rate) in respect of those contributions; and

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: is transferred directly to

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: another registered pension plan for the benefit of the member,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: a registered retirement savings plan under which the member is the annuitant (within the meaning assigned by subsection 146(1)), or

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: a registered retirement income fund under which the member is the annuitant (within the meaning assigned by subsection 146.3(1)).

Subsection.MarginalNote: Transfer — lump sum benefits on death
Subsection.Text: An amount is transferred from a registered pension plan in accordance with this subsection if the amount

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: is a single amount no portion of which relates to an actuarial surplus;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: is transferred on behalf of an individual who is entitled to the amount as a consequence of the death of a member of the plan and who was a spouse or common-law partner or former spouse or common-law partner of the member at the date of the member’s death; and

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: is transferred directly to

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: another registered pension plan for the benefit of the individual,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: a registered retirement savings plan under which the individual is the annuitant (within the meaning assigned by subsection 146(1)), or

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: a registered retirement income fund under which the individual is the annuitant (within the meaning assigned by subsection 146.3(1)).

Subsection.MarginalNote: Transfer where money purchase plan replaces money purchase plan
Subsection.Text: An amount is transferred from a registered pension plan (in this subsection referred to as the “transferor plan”) in accordance with this subsection if

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the amount is a single amount;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the amount is transferred in respect of the surplus (as defined by regulation) under a money purchase provision (in this subsection referred to as the “former provision”) of the transferor plan;

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: the amount is transferred directly to another registered pension plan to be held in connection with a money purchase provision (in this subsection referred to as the “current provision”) of the other plan;

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: the amount is transferred in conjunction with the transfer of amounts from the former provision to the current provision on behalf of all or a significant number of members of the transferor plan whose benefits under the former provision are replaced by benefits under the current provision; and

Paragraph.Label: (e)
Paragraph.Text: the transfer is acceptable to the Minister and the Minister has so notified the administrator of the transferor plan in writing.

Subsection.MarginalNote: Transfer where money purchase plan replaces defined benefit plan
Subsection.Text: An amount is transferred from a registered pension plan (in this subsection referred to as the “transferor plan”) in accordance with this subsection if

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the amount is a single amount;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the amount is transferred in respect of the actuarial surplus under a defined benefit provision of the transferor plan;

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: the amount is transferred directly to another registered pension plan to be held in connection with a money purchase provision of the other plan;

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: the amount is transferred in conjunction with the transfer of amounts from the defined benefit provision to the money purchase provision on behalf of all or a significant number of members of the transferor plan whose benefits under the defined benefit provision are replaced by benefits under the money purchase provision; and

Paragraph.Label: (e)
Paragraph.Text: the transfer is acceptable to the Minister and the Minister has so notified the administrator of the transferor plan in writing.

Subsection.Text: Where an amount is transferred in accordance with any of subsections 147.3(1) to (8),

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the amount shall not, by reason only of that transfer, be included by reason of subparagraph 56(1)(a)(i) in computing the income of any taxpayer; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: no deduction may be made under any provision of this Act in respect of the amount in computing the income of any taxpayer.

Subsection.Text: Where, on behalf of an individual, an amount is transferred from a registered pension plan (in this subsection referred to as the “transferor plan”) to another plan or fund (in this subsection referred to as the “transferee plan”) that is a registered pension plan, a registered retirement savings plan or a registered retirement income fund and the transfer is not in accordance with any of subsections 147.3(1) to (7),

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the amount is deemed to have been paid from the transferor plan to the individual;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: subject to paragraph 147.3(10)(c), the individual shall be deemed to have paid the amount as a contribution or premium to the transferee plan; and

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: where the transferee plan is a registered retirement income fund, for the purposes of subsection 146(5) and Part X.1, the individual shall be deemed to have paid the amount at the time of the transfer as a premium under a registered retirement savings plan under which the individual was the annuitant (within the meaning assigned by subsection 146(1)).

Subsection.Text: Where an amount is transferred from a registered pension plan to another registered pension plan, to a registered retirement savings plan or to a registered retirement income fund and a portion, but not all, of the amount is transferred in accordance with any of subsections 147.3(1) to (8),

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: subsection 147.3(9) applies with respect to the portion of the amount that is transferred in accordance with any of subsections 147.3(1) to (8); and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: subsection 147.3(10) applies with respect to the remainder of the amount.

Subsection.Text: A registered pension plan becomes a revocable plan at any time that an amount is transferred from the plan to another registered pension plan, to a registered retirement savings plan or to a registered retirement income fund unless

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the amount is transferred in accordance with any of subsections 147.3(1) to (8); or

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: where the amount is transferred on behalf of an individual,

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the amount is deductible by the individual under paragraph 60(j) or (j.2), or

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the Pension Benefits Standards Act, 1985 or a similar law of a province prohibits the payment of the amount to the individual.

Subsection.Text: Where

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the transfer in a calendar year of an amount from a registered pension plan on behalf of a member of the plan would, but for this subsection, be in accordance with subsection 147.3(1) or (2), and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the plan becomes, at the end of the year, a revocable plan as a consequence of an excess determined under any of paragraphs 147.1(8)(a) and (b) and (9)(a) and (b) with respect to the member (whether or not such an excess is also determined with respect to any other member),

ContinuedSectionSubsection.Text: such portion of the amount transferred as may reasonably be considered to derive from amounts allocated or reallocated to the member in the year or from earnings reasonably attributable to those amounts shall, except to the extent otherwise expressly provided in writing by the Minister, be deemed to be an amount that was not transferred in accordance with subsection 147.3(1) or (2), as the case may be.

Subsection.MarginalNote: Withdrawal of excessive transfers to RRSPs and RRIFs
Subsection.Text: There may be deducted in computing the income of an individual for a taxation year the lesser of

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the amount, if any, by which

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the total of all amounts each of which is an amount included under clause 56(1)(a)(i)(C), paragraph 56(1)(z.3), subsections 146(8), (8.3) or (12) or 146.3(5), (5.1) or (11) in computing the individual’s income for the year, to the extent that the amount is not a prescribed withdrawal,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the total of all amounts each of which is an amount deductible under paragraph 60(l) or subsection 146(8.2) in computing the income of the individual for the year, and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the amount, if any, by which

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the total of all amounts each of which is an amount that was

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: transferred to a registered retirement savings plan or registered retirement income fund under which the individual was the annuitant (within the meaning assigned by subsection 146(1) or 146.3(1), as the case may be),

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: included in computing the income of the individual for the year or a preceding taxation year, and

Clause.Label: (C)
Clause.Text: deemed by paragraph 147.3(10)(b) or 147.3(10)(c) to have been paid by the individual as a premium to a registered retirement savings plan,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the total of all amounts each of which is an amount

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: deductible under this subsection in computing the individual’s income for a preceding taxation year, or

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: deducted under subsection 146(5) in computing the individual’s income for a preceding taxation year, to the extent that the amount can reasonably be considered to be in respect of an amount referred to in subparagraph 147.3(13.1)(b)(i).

Subsection.Text: For the purposes of this section and the regulations, where property held in connection with a particular pension plan is made available to pay benefits under another pension plan, the property shall be deemed to have been transferred from the particular plan to the other plan.

Where property held in connection with a benefit provision of a registered pension plan is made available to pay benefits under another benefit provision of the plan, subsections 147.3(9) to 147.3(11) apply in respect of the transaction by which the property is made so available in the same manner as they would apply if the other benefit provision were in another registered pension plan.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Subsection.Text: Where

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: at any time an individual acquires, in full or partial satisfaction of the individual’s entitlement to benefits under a registered pension plan, an interest in an annuity contract (other than an advanced life deferred annuity) purchased from a licensed annuities provider,

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the rights provided for under the contract are not materially different from those provided for under the plan as registered,

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: the contract does not permit premiums to be paid at or after that time, other than

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: a premium paid at that time out of or under the plan to purchase the contract, or

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: a premium paid after that time to acquire additional benefits consequential to proceedings commenced under the Bankruptcy and Insolvency Act or the Companies’ Creditors Arrangement Act,

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: either the plan is not a plan in respect of which the Minister may, under subsection 147.1(11), give a notice of intent to revoke the registration of the plan or the Minister waives the application of this paragraph with respect to the contract and so notifies the administrator of the plan in writing, and

Paragraph.Label: (e)
Paragraph.Text: the individual does not acquire the interest as a consequence of a transfer of property from the plan to a registered retirement savings plan or a registered retirement income fund,

ContinuedSectionSubsection.Text: the following rules apply for the purposes of this Act:

Paragraph.Label: (f)
Paragraph.Text: the individual is deemed not to have received an amount out of or under the registered pension plan as a consequence of acquiring the interest, and

Paragraph.Label: (g)
Paragraph.Text: other than for the purposes of sections 147.1 and 147.3, any amount received at or after that time by any individual under the contract is deemed to have been received under the registered pension plan.

Subsection.Text: Where

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: an amendment is made at any time to an annuity contract to which subsection (1) or paragraph 254(a) applies, other than an amendment the sole effect of which is to

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: defer annuity commencement to no later than the end of the calendar year in which the individual in respect of whom the contract was purchased attains 71 years of age, or

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: enhance benefits under the annuity contract in connection with the demutualization (as defined by subsection 139.1(1)) of an insurance corporation that is considered for the purpose of section 139.1 to have been a party to the annuity contract, and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the rights provided for under the contract are materially altered as a consequence of the amendment,

ContinuedSectionSubsection.Text: the following rules apply for the purposes of this Act:

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: each individual who has an interest in the contract immediately before that time is deemed to have received at that time the payment of an amount under a pension plan equal to the fair market value of the interest immediately before that time,

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: the contract as amended is deemed to be a separate annuity contract issued at that time otherwise than pursuant to or under a superannuation or pension fund or plan, and

Paragraph.Label: (e)
Paragraph.Text: each individual who has an interest in the separate annuity contract immediately after that time is deemed to have acquired the interest at that time at a cost equal to the fair market value of the interest immediately after that time.

Subsection.Text: For the purposes of this Act, where an annuity contract (in this subsection referred to as the “original contract”) to which subsection 147.4(1) or paragraph 254(a) applies is, at any time, substituted by another contract,

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: if the rights provided for under the other contract

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: are not materially different from those provided for under the original contract, or

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: are materially different from those provided for under the original contract only because of an enhancement of benefits that can reasonably be considered to have been provided solely in connection with the demutualization (as defined by subsection 139.1(1)) of an insurance corporation that is considered for the purposes of section 139.1 to have been a party to the original contract,

ContinuedParagraph.Text: the other contract is deemed to be the same contract as, and a continuation of, the original contract; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: in any other case, each individual who has an interest in the original contract immediately before that time is deemed to have received at that time the payment of an amount under a pension plan equal to the fair market value of the interest immediately before that time.

Subsection.Text: Subsection (5) applies to an amount transferred from an annuity contract described in subsection (1) if

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the conditions set out in paragraphs (1)(a) to (e) were satisfied when the annuitant acquired an interest in the annuity contract; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the transfer is made as a consequence of

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: an individual who is a spouse or common-law partner or former spouse or common-law partner of the annuitant becoming entitled to an interest in the annuity contract under a decree, order or judgment of a competent tribunal, or under a written agreement, relating to a division of property between the annuitant and the individual, in settlement of rights arising out of, or on a breakdown of, their marriage or common-law partnership, or

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: a provision of the Pension Benefits Standards Act, 1985 or a similar law of a province that permits the annuitant to commute all or part of their interest in the annuity contract.

Subsection.Text: Despite paragraph (1)(g), if this subsection applies to an amount transferred from an annuity contract described in subsection (1), the amount transferred is deemed for the purposes of section 147.3

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: not to be transferred from the annuity contract; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: to be transferred from the registered pension plan described in subsection (1) to fully or partially satisfy the individual’s entitlement to benefits under the benefit provision (as defined in subsection 8500(1) of the Income Tax Regulations) under which the individual’s entitlement to benefits was satisfied by the acquisition of the interest in the annuity contract.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Subsection.Text: The following definitions apply in this section.

Definition.Text: administrator, of a pooled pension plan, means

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: a corporation resident in Canada that is responsible for the administration of the plan and that is authorized under the Pooled Registered Pension Plans Act or a similar law of a province to act as an administrator for one or more pooled pension plans; or

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: an entity designated in respect of the plan under section 21 of the Pooled Registered Pension Plans Act or any provision of a law of a province that is similar to that section. (administrateur)

Definition.Text: designated pooled pension plan, for a calendar year, means a pooled pension plan that, at any time in the year (other than the year in which the plan became registered as a PRPP), meets any of the following conditions:

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the plan has fewer than 10 participating employers;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the fair market value of the property held in connection with the accounts of all members of the plan employed by a particular participating employer exceeds 50% of the fair market value of the property held in connection with the plan;

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: more than 50% of the members of the plan are employed by a particular participating employer; or

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: it is reasonable to conclude that the participation in the plan of one or more participating employers occurs primarily to avoid the application of any of paragraphs (a) to (c). (régime de pension collectif désigné)

Definition.Text: exempt earned income, of a taxpayer for a taxation year, means the total of all amounts each of which is an amount that is

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: not included in the taxpayer’s earned income (as defined in subsection 146(1)) for the year and that would be so included but for paragraph 81(1)(a) as it applies with respect to the Indian Act; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: reported by the taxpayer in prescribed form filed with the Minister by the taxpayer’s filing-due date for the year, or such later date as is acceptable to the Minister, provided that the later date is within three calendar years following the end of the year. (revenu gagné exonéré)

Definition.Text: exempt-income contribution amount, of a taxpayer for a taxation year, means the total of

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: all amounts each of which is a contribution to a PRPP made by the taxpayer for the year that is not deductible in computing the income of the taxpayer because of subsection (32), and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the amount, if any, designated under subsection (34) by the taxpayer for the year in prescribed form filed with the Minister by the taxpayer’s filing-due date for the year, or such later date as is acceptable to the Minister, provided that the later date is within three calendar years following the end of the year. (cotisation provenant du revenu exonéré)

Definition.Text: member, of a pooled pension plan, means an individual (other than a trust) who holds an account under the plan. (participant)
participating employer, in relation to a pooled pension plan for a calendar year, means an employer that, in the year,

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: makes contributions to the plan in respect of all or a class of its employees or former employees; or

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: remits to the administrator of the plan contributions made by members of the plan under a contract with the administrator in respect of all or a class of its employees. (employeur participant)

Definition.Text: pooled pension plan means a plan that is registered under the Pooled Registered Pension Plans Act or a similar law of a province. (régime de pension collectif)

pooled registered pension plan or PRPP means a pooled pension plan that has been accepted for registration by the Minister for the purposes of this Act, which registration has not been revoked. (régime de pension agréé collectif ou RPAC)
qualifying annuity, for an individual, means an annuity (other than an advanced life deferred annuity) that

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: is payable to

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the individual for the individual’s life, or

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the individual for the lives, jointly, of the individual and the individual’s spouse or common-law partner and to the survivor of them for the survivor’s life;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: is payable beginning no later than the later of

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the end of the calendar year in which the individual attains 71 years of age, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the end of the calendar year in which the annuity is acquired;

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: unless the annuity is subsequently commuted into a single payment, is payable

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: at least annually, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: in equal amounts or is not so payable solely because of an adjustment that would, if the annuity were an annuity under a retirement savings plan, in accordance with any of subparagraphs 146(3)(b)(iii) to (v);

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: if the annuity includes a guaranteed period, requires that

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the period not exceed 15 years, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: in the event of the later of the death of the individual and that of the individual’s spouse or common-law partner during the period, any remaining amounts otherwise payable be commuted into a single payment as soon as practicable after the later death; and

Paragraph.Label: (e)
Paragraph.Text: does not permit any premiums to be paid, other than the premium paid from the PRPP to acquire the annuity. (rente admissible)

Definition.Text: qualifying survivor, in relation to a member of a PRPP, means an individual who, immediately before the death of the member

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: was a spouse or common-law partner of the member; or

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: was a child or grandchild of the member who was financially dependent on the member for support. (survivant admissible)
