Paragraph.Text: a prescribed form that is required to be filed by the taxpayer, or a partnership of which the taxpayer is a member, under subsection 127.49(15) or (18) is not filed as and when required, and the assessment, reassessment or additional assessment is made in relation to transactions or events described in any of subsections 127.49(11) to (14) or (16) and (17) before the day that is

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: in the case of a taxpayer described in paragraph (3.1)(a), four years after the day on which the form is filed, or

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: in any other case, three years after the day on which the form is filed;

Paragraph.Label: (b.94)
Paragraph.Text: the assessment, reassessment or additional assessment is made before the day that is 36 months after the end of the normal reassessment period for the taxpayer in respect of the year and is made in respect of a disposition, in the year, of shares of the capital stock of a corporation in respect of which the taxpayer claimed a deduction under subsection 110.61(2);

Paragraph.Label: (b.941)
Paragraph.Text: the assessment, reassessment or additional assessment is made before the day that is 36 months after the end of the normal reassessment period for the taxpayer in respect of the year and is made in respect of a disposition, in the year, of shares of the capital stock of a corporation in respect of which the taxpayer claimed a deduction under subsection 110.62(2);

Paragraph.Label: (b.95)
Paragraph.Text: a prescribed form that is required to be filed by the taxpayer, or a partnership of which the taxpayer is a member, under subsection 127.491(24) or (25) is not filed as and when required, and the assessment, re-assessment or additional assessment is made in relation to transactions or events described in any of subsections 127.491(16), (17), (22), (23) or (26) to (30) before the day that is

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: in the case of a taxpayer described in paragraph (3.1)(a), four years after the day on which the form is filed, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: in any other case, three years after the day on which the form is filed;

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: the taxpayer or person filing the return of income has filed with the Minister a waiver in prescribed form within the additional three-year period referred to in paragraph (b) or (b.1);

Paragraph.Label: (c.1)
Paragraph.Text: the taxpayer or person filing the return of income has filed with the Minister a waiver in prescribed form within the additional three-year period referred to in paragraph (b.2); or

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: as a consequence of a change in the allocation of the taxpayer’s taxable income earned in a province as determined under the law of a province that provides rules similar to those prescribed for the purposes of section 124, an assessment, reassessment or additional assessment of tax for a taxation year payable by a corporation under a law of a province that imposes on the corporation a tax similar to the tax imposed under this Part (in this paragraph referred to as a “provincial reassessment”) is made, and as a consequence of the provincial reassessment, an assessment, reassessment or additional assessment is made on or before the day that is one year after the later of

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the day on which the Minister is advised of the provincial reassessment, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the day that is 90 days after the day of sending of a notice of the provincial reassessment.

Subsection.Text: Notwithstanding subsections (4) and (5), an assessment, reassessment or additional assessment to which any of paragraphs (4)(a) to (b.1) or (b.3) to (c) applies in respect of a taxpayer for a taxation year may be made after the taxpayer’s normal reassessment period in respect of the year to the extent that, but only to the extent that, it can reasonably be regarded as relating to,

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: where paragraph 152(4)(a) applies to the assessment, reassessment or additional assessment,

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: any misrepresentation made by the taxpayer or a person who filed the taxpayer’s return of income for the year that is attributable to neglect, carelessness or wilful default or any fraud committed by the taxpayer or that person in filing the return or supplying any information under this Act, or

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: a matter specified in a waiver filed with the Minister in respect of the year;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: if any of paragraphs (4)(b), (b.1) or (b.5) to (c) applies to the assessment, reassessment or additional assessment,

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the assessment, reassessment or additional assessment to which subparagraph 152(4)(b)(i) applies,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the assessment or reassessment referred to in subparagraph 152(4)(b)(ii),

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: the transaction, income, loss or other amount referred to in subparagraph (4)(b)(iii),

Subparagraph.Label: (iv)
Subparagraph.Text: the payment or reimbursement referred to in subparagraph 152(4)(b)(iv),

Subparagraph.Label: (v)
Subparagraph.Text: the reduction referred to in subparagraph 152(4)(b)(v),

Subparagraph.Label: (vi)
Subparagraph.Text: the application referred to in subparagraph 152(4)(b)(vi),

Subparagraph.Label: (vii)
Subparagraph.Text: the deduction or claim referred to in paragraph (4)(b.1),

Subparagraph.Label: (viii)
Subparagraph.Text: the reportable transaction referred to in paragraph (4)(b.5),

Subparagraph.Label: (ix)
Subparagraph.Text: the notifiable transaction referred to in paragraph (4)(b.6),

Subparagraph.Label: (x)
Subparagraph.Text: any transaction, or series of transactions, to which the reportable uncertain tax treatment referred to in paragraph (4)(b.7) relates,

Subparagraph.Label: (xi)
Subparagraph.Text: the transaction referred to in subparagraph (4)(b)(viii),

Subparagraph.Label: (xii)
Subparagraph.Text: the transactions or events referred to in paragraph (4)(b.91),

Subparagraph.Label: (xiii)
Subparagraph.Text: the amounts, transactions or events referred to in paragraph (4)(b.92),

Subparagraph.Label: (xiv)
Subparagraph.Text: the transactions or events referred to in paragraph (4)(b.93), or

Subparagraph.Label: (xv)
Subparagraph.Text: the transactions or events referred to in paragraph (4)(b.95);

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: if paragraph (4)(b.3) applies to the assessment, reassessment or additional assessment, the disposition referred to in that paragraph; and

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: if paragraph (4)(b.4) applies to the assessment, reassessment or additional assessment, the reduction under subparagraph (4)(b.4)(iii).

Subsection.Text: If the Minister would, but for this subsection, be entitled to reassess, make an additional assessment or assess tax, interest or penalties by virtue only of the filing of a waiver under subparagraph (4)(a)(ii) or paragraph (4)(c) or (c.1), the Minister may not make such a reassessment, additional assessment or assessment after the day that is six months after the date on which a notice of revocation of the waiver in prescribed form is filed.

Notwithstanding subsections (4), (4.1) and (5), for the purpose of determining — at any time after the end of the normal reassessment period, of a taxpayer who is an individual (other than a trust) or a graduated rate estate, in respect of a taxation year — the amount of any refund to which the taxpayer is entitled at that time for the year, or a reduction of an amount payable under this Part by the taxpayer for the year, the Minister may, if the taxpayer makes an application for that determination on or before the day that is 10 calendar years after the end of that taxation year,

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: reassess tax, interest or penalties payable under this Part by the taxpayer in respect of that year; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: redetermine the amount, if any, deemed by any of subsections 120(2) or (2.2), 122.5(3) to (3.005), 122.51(2), 122.7(2) or (3), 122.8(4), 122.9(2), 122.91(1), 122.92(3), 122.93(2), 127.1(1), 127.41(3) or 210.2(3) or (4) to be paid on account of the taxpayer’s tax payable under this Part for the year or deemed by subsection 122.61(1) to be an overpayment on account of the taxpayer’s liability under this Part for the year.

Subsection.Text: Notwithstanding subsections (4), (4.1) and (5), if the result of an assessment or a decision on an appeal is to change a particular balance of a taxpayer for a particular taxation year, the Minister may, or if the taxpayer so requests in writing, shall, before the later of the expiration of the normal reassessment period in respect of a subsequent taxation year and the end of the day that is one year after the day on which all rights of objection and appeal expire or are determined in respect of the particular year, reassess the tax, interest or penalties payable by the taxpayer, redetermine an amount deemed to have been paid or to have been an overpayment by the taxpayer or modify the amount of a refund or other amount payable to the taxpayer, under this Part in respect of the subsequent taxation year, but only to the extent that the reassessment, redetermination or modification can reasonably be considered to relate to the change in the particular balance of the taxpayer for the particular year.

Subsection.MarginalNote: Consequential assessment of Part IV tax
Subsection.Text: Notwithstanding subsections (4), (4.1) and (5), if a taxpayer in a taxation year receives a taxable dividend from a corporation that, as a result of having paid the dividend, is entitled to a dividend refund, the Minister may, within one year after the expiration of the normal reassessment period for the taxpayer in respect of the year, assess or reassess the tax, interest or penalties payable under Part IV by the taxpayer in respect of the taxable dividend.

For the purpose of subsection 152(4.3), a balance of a taxpayer for a taxation year is the income, taxable income, taxable income earned in Canada or any loss of the taxpayer for the year, or the tax or other amount payable by, any amount refundable to, or any amount deemed to have been paid or to have been an overpayment by, the taxpayer for the year.

There shall not be included in computing the income of a taxpayer for a taxation year, for the purpose of an assessment, reassessment or additional assessment made under this Part after the taxpayer’s normal reassessment period in respect of the year, any amount that was not included in computing the taxpayer’s income for the purpose of an assessment, reassessment or additional assessment made under this Part before the end of the period.

Where a taxpayer has filed for a particular taxation year the return of income required by section 150 and an amount is subsequently claimed by the taxpayer or on the taxpayer’s behalf for the year as

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: a deduction under paragraph 3(e) of the Income Tax Act, chapter 148 of the Revised Statutes of Canada, 1952, by virtue of the taxpayer’s death in a subsequent taxation year and the consequent application of section 71 of that Act in respect of an allowable capital loss for the year,

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: a deduction under section 41 in respect of the taxpayer’s listed-personal-property loss for a subsequent taxation year,

Paragraph.Label: (b.1)
Paragraph.Text: a deduction under paragraph 60(i) in respect of a premium (within the meaning assigned by subsection 146(1)) paid in a subsequent taxation year under a registered retirement savings plan where the premium is deductible by reason of subsection 146(6.1),

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: a deduction under section 118.1 in respect of a gift made in a subsequent taxation year or under section 111 in respect of a loss for a subsequent taxation year,

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: a deduction under subsection 127(5) in respect of property acquired or an expenditure made in a subsequent taxation year,

Paragraph.Label: (f)
Paragraph.Text: a deduction under section 125.3 in respect of an unused Part I.3 tax credit (within the meaning assigned by subsection 125.3(3)) for a subsequent taxation year,

Paragraph.Label: (f.1)
Paragraph.Text: a deduction under subsection 126(2) in respect of an unused foreign tax credit (within the meaning assigned by subsection 126(7)), or under subsection 126(2.21) or (2.22) in respect of foreign taxes paid, for a subsequent taxation year,

Paragraph.Label: (f.2)
Paragraph.Text: a deduction under subsection 128.1(8) as a result of a disposition in a subsequent taxation year,

Paragraph.Label: (f.3)
Paragraph.Text: a deduction (including for the purposes of this subsection a reduction of an amount otherwise required to be included in computing a taxpayer’s income) under subsection 146(8.9) or (8.92), 146.3(6.2) or (6.3) or 147.5(14) or (19),

Paragraph.Label: (g)
Paragraph.Text: a deduction under subsection 147.2(4) because of the application of subsection 147.2(6) as a result of the taxpayer’s death in the subsequent taxation year, or

Paragraph.Label: (h)
Paragraph.Text: a deduction by virtue of an election for a subsequent taxation year under paragraph 164(6)(c) or 164(6)(d) by the taxpayer’s legal representative,

ContinuedSectionSubsection.Text: by filing with the Minister, on or before the day on or before which the taxpayer is, or would be if a tax under this Part were payable by the taxpayer for that subsequent taxation year, required by section 150 to file a return of income for that subsequent taxation year, a prescribed form amending the return, the Minister shall reassess the taxpayer’s tax for any relevant taxation year (other than a taxation year preceding the particular taxation year) in order to take into account the deduction claimed.

Subsection.MarginalNote: Reassessment if amount under subsection 91(1) is reduced
Subsection.Text: If

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: a taxpayer has filed for a particular taxation year the return of income required by section 150,

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the amount included in computing the taxpayer’s income for the particular year under subsection 91(1) is subsequently reduced because of a reduction in the foreign accrual property income of a foreign affiliate of the taxpayer for a taxation year (referred to in this paragraph as the “claim year”) of the affiliate that ends in the particular year, if

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the reduction is

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: attributable to a foreign accrual property loss (within the meaning assigned by subsection 5903(3) of the Income Tax Regulations) of the affiliate for a taxation year of the affiliate that ends in a subsequent taxation year of the taxpayer, and

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: included in the description of F in the definition foreign accrual property income in subsection 95(1) in respect of the affiliate for the claim year, or

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the reduction is

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: attributable to a foreign accrual capital loss (within the meaning assigned by subsection 5903.1(3) of the Income Tax Regulations) of the affiliate for a taxation year of the affiliate that ends in a subsequent taxation year of the taxpayer, and

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: included in the description of F.1 in the definition foreign accrual property income in subsection 95(1) in respect of the affiliate for the claim year, and

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: the taxpayer has filed with the Minister, on or before the filing-due date for that subsequent taxation year, a prescribed form amending the return,

ContinuedSectionSubsection.Text: the Minister shall reassess the taxpayer’s tax for any relevant taxation year (other than a taxation year preceding the particular year) in order to take into account the reduction in the amount included under subsection 91(1) in computing the income of the taxpayer for the particular year.

Subsection.Text: The Minister shall reassess a taxpayer’s tax for a particular taxation year, in order to take into account the application of paragraph (d) of the definition excluded property in subsection 142.2(1), or the application of subsection 142.6(1.6), in respect of property held by the taxpayer, if

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the taxpayer has filed for the particular taxation year the return of income required by section 150; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the taxpayer files with the Minister a prescribed form amending the return, on or before the filing-due date for the taxpayer’s taxation year that

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: if the filing is in respect of paragraph (d) of that definition excluded property, includes the acquisition of control time referred to in that paragraph, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: if the filing is in respect of subsection 142.6(1.6), immediately follows the particular taxation year.

Subsection.Text: If a taxpayer has filed for a particular taxation year the return of income required by section 150 and an amount is subsequently claimed by the taxpayer, or on the taxpayer’s behalf, for the particular year as a deduction under section 119 in respect of a disposition in a subsequent taxation year, and the taxpayer files with the Minister a prescribed form amending the return on or before the filing-due date of the taxpayer for the subsequent taxation year, the Minister shall reassess the taxpayer’s tax for any relevant taxation year (other than a taxation year preceding the particular taxation year) in order to take into account the deduction claimed.

Subsection.MarginalNote: Assessment not dependent on return or information
Subsection.Text: The Minister is not bound by a return or information supplied by or on behalf of a taxpayer and, in making an assessment, may, notwithstanding a return or information so supplied or if no return has been filed, assess the tax payable under this Part.

An assessment shall, subject to being varied or vacated on an objection or appeal under this Part and subject to a reassessment, be deemed to be valid and binding notwithstanding any error, defect or omission in the assessment or in any proceeding under this Act relating thereto.

At any time after the normal reassessment period, the Minister may advance an alternative basis or argument — including that all or any portion of the income to which an amount relates was from a different source — in support of all or any portion of the total amount determined on assessment to be payable or remittable by a taxpayer under this Act unless, on an appeal under this Act

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: there is relevant evidence that the taxpayer is no longer able to adduce without the leave of the court; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: it is not appropriate in the circumstances for the court to order that the evidence be adduced.

Subsection.Text: Notwithstanding any other provision of this section, an amount of tax is deemed, for the purpose of any agreement entered into by or on behalf of the Government of Canada under section 7 of the Federal-Provincial Fiscal Arrangements Act, not to have been assessed under this Act until

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the end of the period during which the security is accepted by the Minister, if adequate security for the tax is accepted by the Minister under subsection 220(4.5) or (4.6); or

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the amount is collected by the Minister, if information relevant to the assessment of the amount was provided to the Canada Revenue Agency under a contract entered into by a person under a program administered by the Canada Revenue Agency to obtain information relating to tax non-compliance.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Subsection.Text: Every person paying at any time in a taxation year

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: salary, wages or other remuneration, other than

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: amounts described in subsection 212(5.1), and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: amounts paid at any time by an employer to an employee if, at that time, the employer is a qualifying non-resident employer and the employee is a qualifying non-resident employee,

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: a superannuation or pension benefit,

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: a retiring allowance,

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: a death benefit,

Paragraph.Label: (d.1)
Paragraph.Text: an amount described in subparagraph 56(1)(a)(iv), (vii) or (viii),

Paragraph.Label: (d.2)
Paragraph.Text: an amount described in paragraph 56(1)(a.3),

Paragraph.Label: (e)
Paragraph.Text: an amount as a benefit under a supplementary unemployment benefit plan,

Paragraph.Label: (f)
Paragraph.Text: an annuity payment or a payment in full or partial commutation of an annuity,

Paragraph.Label: (g)
Paragraph.Text: fees, commissions or other amounts for services, other than amounts described in subsection 115(2.3) or 212(5.1),

Paragraph.Label: (h)
Paragraph.Text: a payment under a deferred profit sharing plan or a plan referred to in section 147 as a revoked plan,

Paragraph.Label: (i)
Paragraph.Text: a payment from a registered disability savings plan,

Paragraph.Label: (j)
Paragraph.Text: a payment out of or under a registered retirement savings plan or a plan referred to in subsection 146(12) as an “amended plan”,

Paragraph.Label: (k)
Paragraph.Text: an amount as, on account or in lieu of payment of, or in satisfaction of, proceeds of the surrender, cancellation or redemption of an income-averaging annuity contract,

Paragraph.Label: (l)
Paragraph.Text: a payment out of or under a registered retirement income fund or a fund referred to in subsection 146.3(11) as an “amended fund”,

Paragraph.Label: (m)
Paragraph.Text: a prescribed benefit under a government assistance program,

Paragraph.Label: (n)
Paragraph.Text: one or more amounts to an individual who has elected for the year in prescribed form in respect of all such amounts,

Paragraph.Label: (o)
Paragraph.Text: an amount described in paragraph 115(2)(c.1),

Paragraph.Label: (p)
Paragraph.Text: a contribution under a retirement compensation arrangement,

Paragraph.Label: (q)
Paragraph.Text: an amount as a distribution to one or more persons out of or under a retirement compensation arrangement,

Paragraph.Label: (r)
Paragraph.Text: an amount on account of the purchase price of an interest in a retirement compensation arrangement,

Paragraph.Label: (s)
Paragraph.Text: an amount described in paragraph 56(1)(r), (z.2) or (z.4),

Paragraph.Label: (t)
Paragraph.Text: a payment made under a plan that was a registered education savings plan,

Paragraph.Label: (u)
Paragraph.Text: a payment out of or under an advanced life deferred annuity, or

Paragraph.Label: (v)
Paragraph.Text: a payment out of or under a FHSA, if the amount is required by section 146.6 to be included in computing a taxpayer’s income

ContinuedSectionSubsection.Text: must deduct or withhold from the payment the amount determined in accordance with prescribed rules and must, at the prescribed time, remit that amount to the Receiver General on account of the payee’s tax for the year under this Part or Part XI.3, as the case may be, and, where at that prescribed time the person is a prescribed person, the remittance must be made to the account of the Receiver General at or through a designated financial institution.

Subsection.Text: An amount that is deemed to have been received by a taxpayer as a benefit under or because of any of paragraphs 7(1)(a) to (d.1) is remuneration paid as a bonus for the purposes of paragraph (1)(a), except the portion, if any, of the amount that is

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: deductible by the taxpayer under paragraph 110(1)(d) in computing the taxpayer’s taxable income for a taxation year;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: deemed to have been received in a taxation year as a benefit because of a disposition of securities to which subsection 7(1.1) applies; or

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: determined under paragraph 110(2.1)(b) to be deductible by the taxpayer under paragraph 110(1)(d.01) in computing the taxpayer’s taxable income for a taxation year.

Subsection.Text: For the purposes of this Act, if an eligible employer pays, at a particular time that is within the eligible period, eligible remuneration in respect of which a particular amount is required to be deducted or withheld under subsection (1), then the eligible employer is deemed to have remitted to the Receiver General at the particular time in respect of the particular amount, an amount equal to the least of

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the amount determined by the formula

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the prescribed amount, and

is the total of all amounts, each of which is an amount deemed to have been remitted by the eligible employer under this subsection prior to the particular time (and, if more than one such payment is made at the particular time, the eligible employer may designate the order in which the amounts are considered to have been paid),

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the amount determined by the formula

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the prescribed percentage, and
is the amount of the eligible remuneration, and

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: the amount determined by the formula

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the prescribed amount, and
is the total number of eligible employees employed by the eligible employer during the eligible period.

Subsection.Text: The following definitions apply for the purposes of this subsection and subsection (1.02).

Definition.Text: eligible employee means an individual who is employed in Canada. (employé admissible)
eligible employer means a person or partnership that

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: employs one or more eligible employees;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: has, on March 18, 2020, a business number in respect of which the person or partnership is registered with the Minister to make remittances required under this section; and

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: is any of

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: a Canadian-controlled private corporation for the purposes of section 125 that

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: would have a business limit for its last taxation year that ended before the start of the eligible period greater than nil, if the amount determined for paragraph 125(5.1)(b) were deemed to be nil, or

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: if the corporation does not have a taxation year that ended before the start of the eligible period, would meet the condition in clause (A) if its taxation year ended immediately before the start of the eligible period,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: an individual (other than a trust),

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: a partnership, all of the members of which are described in subparagraphs (i) to (iii) or (v),

Subparagraph.Label: (iv)
Subparagraph.Text: a person exempt from tax under Part I because of paragraph 149(1)(l), and

Subparagraph.Label: (v)
Subparagraph.Text: a registered charity. (employeur admissible)

Definition.Text: eligible period means the period beginning on March 18, 2020 and that ends on June 19, 2020. (période d’admissibilité)
eligible remuneration means salary, wages or other remuneration paid to an eligible employee during the eligible period. (rémunération admissible)

Subsection.Text: For greater certainty, amounts deemed under subsection (1.02) to have been remitted to the Receiver General are deemed to not be held in trust under subsections 227(4) and (4.1).
Despite subsection (1.02), an amount is not deemed to have been remitted to the Receiver General if

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the eligible employer made an application in respect of section 125.7 for a qualifying period in respect of which the eligible employer was, without reference to this subsection, deemed under subsection (1.02) to have remitted the amount to the Receiver General; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the amount was not included under the description of B in subsection 125.7(2) for the eligible employer.

Subsection.Text: Where the Minister is satisfied that the deducting or withholding of the amount otherwise required to be deducted or withheld under subsection 153(1) from a payment would cause undue hardship, the Minister may determine a lesser amount and that amount shall be deemed to be the amount determined under that subsection as the amount to be deducted or withheld from that payment.

Where a taxpayer so elects in prescribed manner and prescribed form, the amount required to be deducted or withheld under subsection 153(1) from any payment to the taxpayer shall be deemed to be the total of

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the amount, if any, otherwise required to be deducted or withheld under that subsection from that payment, and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the amount specified by the taxpayer in that election with respect to that payment or with respect to a class of payments that includes that payment.

Subsection.Text: A joint election made or expected to be made under section 60.03 is not to be considered a basis on which the Minister may determine a lesser amount under subsection (1.1).

An amount deemed to have been received as a benefit under or because of any of paragraphs 7(1)(a) to (d.1) shall not be considered a basis on which the Minister may determine a lesser amount under subsection (1.1) solely because it is received as a non-cash benefit.

Subsection.MarginalNote: Exception — remittance to designated financial institution
Subsection.Text: For the purpose of subsection (1), a prescribed person referred to in that subsection is deemed to have remitted an amount to the account of the Receiver General at or through a designated financial institution if the prescribed person has remitted the amount to the Receiver General at least one day before the day upon which the amount is due.

If a pensioner and a pension transferee (as those terms are defined in section 60.03) make a joint election under section 60.03 in respect of a split-pension amount (as defined in that section) for a taxation year, the portion of the amount deducted or withheld under subsection (1) that may be reasonably considered to be in respect of the split-pension amount is deemed to have been deducted or withheld on account of the pension transferee’s tax for the taxation year under this Part and not on account of the pensioner’s tax for the taxation year under this Part.

When an amount has been deducted or withheld under subsection 153(1), it shall, for all the purposes of this Act, be deemed to have been received at that time by the person to whom the remuneration, benefit, payment, fees, commissions or other amounts were paid.
For the purposes of this Act, an amount (referred to in this subsection as the “excess amount”) is deemed to not have been deducted or withheld under subsection (1) by a person if

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the excess amount was, absent the application of this subsection, deducted or withheld by the person under subsection (1);

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the excess amount is in respect of an excess payment (referred to in this subsection as the “total excess payment”) of an individual’s salary, wages or other remuneration by the person to the individual in a particular year, that was paid as a result of a clerical, administrative or system error;

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: before the end of the third year after the calendar year in which the excess amount is deducted or withheld,

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the person elects in prescribed manner to have this subsection apply in respect of the excess amount, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the individual has repaid, or made an arrangement to repay, the total excess payment less the excess amount;

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: an information return correcting for the total excess payment has not been issued by the person to the individual prior to the making of the election in subparagraph (c)(i); and

Paragraph.Label: (e)
Paragraph.Text: any additional criteria specified by the Minister have been met.

Subsection.Text: Where at the end of a taxpayer’s taxation year the person beneficially entitled to an amount received by the taxpayer after 1984 and before the year as or in respect of dividends, interest or proceeds of disposition of property is unknown to the taxpayer, the taxpayer shall remit to the Receiver General on or before the day that is 60 days after the end of the year on account of the tax payable under this Act by that person an amount equal to

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: in the case of dividends, 33 1/3% of the total amount of the dividends,

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: in the case of interest, 50% of the total amount of the interest, and

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: in the case of proceeds of disposition of property, 50% of the total of all amounts each of which is the amount, if any, by which the proceeds of disposition of a property exceed the total of any outlays and expenses made or incurred by the taxpayer for the purpose of disposing of the property (to the extent that those outlays and expenses were not deducted in computing the taxpayer’s income for any taxation year or attributable to any other property),

ContinuedSectionSubsection.Text: except that no remittance under this subsection shall be required in respect of an amount that was included in computing the taxpayer’s income for the year or a preceding taxation year or in respect of an amount on which the tax under this subsection was previously remitted.

Subsection.Text: An amount remitted by a taxpayer under subsection 153(4) in respect of dividends, interest or proceeds of disposition of property shall be deemed

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: to have been received by the person beneficially entitled thereto; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: to have been deducted or withheld from the amount otherwise payable by the taxpayer to the person beneficially entitled thereto.

Subsection.Text: The following definitions apply in this section.

Definition.Text: designated financial institution means a corporation that

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: is a bank, other than an authorized foreign bank that is subject to the restrictions and requirements referred to in subsection 524(2) of the Bank Act;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: is authorized under the laws of Canada or a province to carry on the business of offering its services as a trustee to the public; or

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: is authorized under the laws of Canada or a province to accept deposits from the public and carries on the business of lending money on the security of real property or immovables or investing in indebtedness on the security of mortgages on real property or of hypothecs on immovables. (institution financière désignée)

Definition.Text: qualifying non-resident employee, at any time in respect of a payment referred to in paragraph (1)(a), means an employee who

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: is, at that time, resident in a country with which Canada has a tax treaty;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: is not liable to tax under this Part in respect of the payment because of that treaty; and

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: works in Canada for less than 45 days in the calendar year that includes that time or is present in Canada for less than 90 days in any 12-month period that includes that time. (employé non-résident admissible)

Definition.Text: qualifying non-resident employer, at any time, means an employer

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: that at that time

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: in the case of an employer that is not a partnership,

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: is a resident of a country with which Canada has a tax treaty, or

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: is a corporation that does not satisfy the condition in clause (A), but would be a resident of a country with which Canada has a tax treaty if the corporation were treated, for the purpose of income taxation in that country, as a body corporate, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: in the case of an employer that is a partnership, is a partnership in respect of which the total of all amounts, each of which is a share of the partnership’s income or loss for the fiscal period that includes that time of a member that, at that time, is a resident of a country with which Canada has a tax treaty (or is a corporation that satisfies the condition in clause (i)(B)), is not less than 90% of the income or loss of the partnership for the period (for the purposes of this subparagraph, where the income and loss of the partnership are nil for the period, the income of the partnership for the period is deemed to be $1,000,000); and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: that is at that time certified by the Minister under subsection (7). (employeur non-résident admissible)

Subsection.Text: The Minister may

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: certify an employer for a specified period of time if the employer has applied in prescribed form containing prescribed information and the Minister is satisfied that the employer

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: meets the conditions in paragraph (a) of the definition qualifying non-resident employer in subsection (6), and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: meets the conditions established by the Minister; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: revoke an employer’s certification if the Minister is no longer satisfied that the employer meets the conditions referred to in subparagraph (a)(i) or (ii).

Subsection.Text: The Minister may

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: waive the requirement under subsection (1) to deduct or withhold amounts from payments described in paragraph (1)(g) to a non-resident person during a period of time specified by the Minister if it is established in a manner acceptable to the Minister that

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the payments

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: are income of the non-resident person from a business that is

Subclause.Label: (I)
Subclause.Text: a treaty-protected business, or

Subclause.Label: (II)
Subclause.Text: not carried on in Canada, or

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: would not be included in computing the income of the non-resident person because of paragraph 81(1)(c), and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the conditions established by the Minister are met; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: revoke a waiver made under paragraph (a).

Subsection.Text: A waiver made by the Minister under paragraph (8)(a) may apply in respect of a class of non-resident persons specified by the Minister.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Section.MarginalNote: Agreements providing for tax transfer payments

Subsection.Text: The Minister may, with the approval of the Governor in Council, enter into an agreement with the government of a province to provide for tax transfer payments and the terms and conditions relating to such payments.

Where, on account of the tax for a taxation year payable by an individual under this Part, an amount has been deducted or withheld under subsection 153(1) on the assumption that the individual was resident in a place other than the province in which the individual resided on the last day of the year, and the individual

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: has filed a return of income for the year with the Minister,

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: is liable to pay tax under this Part for the year, and

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: is resident on the last day of the year in a province with which an agreement described in subsection 154(1) has been entered into,

ContinuedSectionSubsection.Text: the Minister may make a tax transfer payment to the government of the province not exceeding an amount equal to the product obtained by multiplying the amount or the total of the amounts so deducted or withheld by a prescribed rate.

Subsection.Text: Where, pursuant to an agreement entered into under subsection 154(1), an amount has been transferred by the Minister to the government of a province with respect to an individual, the amount shall, for all purposes of this Act, be deemed to have been received by the individual at the time the amount was transferred.

Subsection.MarginalNote: Payment deemed received by Receiver General
Subsection.Text: Where, pursuant to an agreement entered into under subsection 154(1), an amount has been transferred by the government of a province to the Minister with respect to an individual, the amount shall, for all purposes of this Act, be deemed to have been received by the Receiver General on account of the individual’s tax under this Part for the year in respect of which the amount was transferred.
In this section, an amount deducted or withheld does not include any refund made in respect of that amount.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Subsection.Text: Subject to section 156.1, every individual whose chief source of income for a taxation year is farming or fishing shall, on or before December 31 in the year, pay to the Receiver General in respect of the year, 2/3 of

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the amount estimated by the individual to be the tax payable under this Part by the individual for the year, or

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the individual’s instalment base for the preceding taxation year.

Subsection.Text: In this section, instalment base of an individual for a taxation year means the amount determined in prescribed manner to be the individual’s instalment base for the year.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Subsection.Text: Subject to section 156.1, in respect of each taxation year every individual (other than one to whom section 155 applies for the year) shall pay to the Receiver General

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: on or before March 15, June 15, September 15 and December 15 in the year, an amount equal to 1/4 of

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the amount estimated by the individual to be the tax payable under this Part by the individual for the year, or

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the individual’s instalment base for the preceding taxation year, or

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: on or before

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: March 15 and June 15 in the year, an amount equal to 1/4 of the individual’s instalment base for the second preceding taxation year, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: September 15 and December 15 in the year, an amount equal to 1/2 of the amount, if any, by which

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: the individual’s instalment base for the preceding taxation year

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: 1/2 of the individual’s instalment base for the second preceding taxation year.

Subsection.Text: Notwithstanding subsection 156(1), the amount payable by a mutual fund trust to the Receiver General on or before any day referred to in paragraph 156(1)(a) in a taxation year shall be deemed to be the amount, if any, by which

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the amount so payable otherwise determined under that subsection,

ContinuedSectionSubsection.Text: exceeds

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: 1/4 of the trust’s capital gains refund (within the meaning assigned by section 132) for the year.

Subsection.Text: In this section, instalment base of an individual for a taxation year means the amount determined in prescribed manner to be the individual’s instalment base for the year.
Subsections (1) to (3) and section 156.1 do not apply to a SIFT trust.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Subsection.Text: For the purposes of this section,

Definition.Text: instalment threshold of an individual for a taxation year means

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: in the case of an individual resident in the Province of Quebec at the end of the year, $1,800, and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: in any other case, $3,000; (plafond des acomptes provisionnels)

Definition.Text: net tax owing by an individual for a taxation year means

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: in the case of an individual resident in the Province of Quebec at the end of the year, the amount determined by the formula

ContinuedDefinition.Text: and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: in any other case, the amount determined by the formula

ContinuedDefinition.Text: where

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the total of the taxes payable under this Part and Parts I.2, X.5 and XI.4 by the individual for the year,

is the total of all income taxes payable by the individual for the year under any law of a province or of an Aboriginal government with which the Minister of Finance has entered into an agreement for the collection of income taxes payable by individuals to the province or Aboriginal government under that law,
is the total of the taxes deducted or withheld under section 153 and Part I.2 on behalf of the individual for the year,
is the amount determined under subsection 120(2) in respect of the individual for the year,

is the total of all amounts deducted or withheld on behalf of the individual for the year under a law of a province or of an Aboriginal government with which the Minister of Finance has entered into an agreement for the collection of income taxes payable by individuals to the province or Aboriginal government under that law, and
is the amount determined under subsection 120(2.2) in respect of the individual for the year. (impôt net à payer)

Subsection.MarginalNote: Values of A and B in net tax owing
Subsection.Text: For the purposes of determining the values of A and B in the definition net tax owing in subsection 156.1(1), income taxes payable by an individual for a taxation year are determined

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: before taking into consideration the specified future tax consequences for the year; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: after deducting all tax credits to which the individual is entitled for the year relating to those taxes (other than tax credits that become payable to the individual after the individual’s balance-due day for the year, prescribed tax credits and amounts deemed to have been paid because of the application of either subsection 120(2) or (2.2)).

Subsection.MarginalNote: Value of D in net tax owing
Subsection.Text: For the purpose of determining the value of D in the definition net tax owing in subsection 156.1(1), the amount deemed by subsection 120(2) to have been paid on account of an individual’s tax under this Part for a taxation year is determined before taking into consideration the specified future tax consequences for the year.

Subsection.MarginalNote: Value of F in net tax owing
Subsection.Text: For the purpose of determining the value of F in the definition net tax owing in subsection (1), the amount deemed by subsection 120(2.2) to have been paid on account of an individual’s tax under this Part for a taxation year is determined before taking into consideration the specified future tax consequences for the year.
Sections 155 and 156 do not apply to an individual for a particular taxation year where

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the individual’s chief source of income for the particular year is farming or fishing and the individual’s net tax owing for the particular year, or either of the 2 preceding taxation years, does not exceed the individual’s instalment threshold for that year;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the individual’s net tax owing for the particular year, or for each of the 2 preceding taxation years, does not exceed the individual’s instalment threshold for that year; or

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: the individual is a graduated rate estate for the particular year.

Subsection.Text: Sections 155 and 156 do not require the payment of any amount in respect of an individual that would otherwise become due under either of those sections on or after the day on which the individual dies.

Every individual shall, on or before the individual’s balance-due day for each taxation year, pay to the Receiver General in respect of the year the amount, if any, by which the individual’s tax payable under this Part for the year exceeds the total of

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: all amounts deducted or withheld under section 153 from remuneration or other payments received by the individual in the year, and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: all other amounts paid to the Receiver General on or before that day on account of the individual’s tax payable under this Part for the year.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Subsection.Text: Subject to subsections (1.1) and (1.5), every corporation shall, in respect of each of its taxation years, pay to the Receiver General

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: either

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: on or before the last day of each month in the year, an amount equal to 1/12 of the total of the amounts estimated by it to be the taxes payable by it under this Part and Parts VI, VI.1 and XIII.1 for the year,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: on or before the last day of each month in the year, an amount equal to 1/12 of its first instalment base for the year, or

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: on or before the last day of each of the first two months in the year, an amount equal to 1/12 of its second instalment base for the year, and on or before the last day of each of the following months in the year, an amount equal to 1/10 of the amount remaining after deducting the amount computed pursuant to this subparagraph in respect of the first two months from its first instalment base for the year; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the remainder of the taxes payable by it under this Part and Parts VI, VI.1 and XIII.1 for the year on or before its balance-due day for the year.

Subsection.Text: A small-CCPC may, in respect of each of its taxation years, pay to the Receiver General

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: one of the following:

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: on or before the last day of each three-month period in the taxation year (or if the period that remains in a taxation year after the end of the last such three-month period is less than three months, on or before the last day of that remaining period), an amount equal to 1/4 of the total of the amounts estimated by it to be the taxes payable by it under this Part and Part VI.1 for the taxation year,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: on or before the last day of each three-month period in the taxation year (or if the period that remains in a taxation year after the end of the last such three-month period is less than three months, on or before the last day of that remaining period), an amount equal to 1/4 of its first instalment base for the taxation year, or

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: on or before the last day

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: of the first period in the taxation year not exceeding three months, an amount equal to 1/4 of its second instalment base for the taxation year, and

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: of each of the following three-month periods in the taxation year (or if the period that remains in a taxation year after the end of the last such three-month period is less than three months, on or before the last day of that remaining period), an amount equal to 1/3 of the amount remaining after deducting the amount computed pursuant to clause (A) from its first instalment base for the taxation year; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the remainder of the taxes payable by it under this Part and Part VI.1 for the taxation year on or before its balance-due day for the taxation year.

Subsection.Text: For the purpose of subsection (1.1), a small-CCPC, at a particular time during a taxation year, is a Canadian-controlled private corporation

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: for which the amount determined under subsection (1.3) for the taxation year, or for the preceding taxation year, does not exceed $500,000;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: for which the amount determined under subsection (1.4) for the taxation year, or for the preceding taxation year, does not exceed $10 million;

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: in respect of which an amount is deducted under section 125 of the Act in computing the corporation’s tax payable for the taxation year or for the preceding taxation year; and

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: that has throughout the 12-month period that ends at the time its last remittance under this section is due,

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: remitted, on or before the day on or before which the amounts were required to be remitted, all amounts that were required to be remitted under subsection 153(1), under Part IX of the Excise Tax Act, under subsection 82(1) of the Employment Insurance Act or under subsection 21(1) of the Canada Pension Plan; and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: filed, on or before the day on or before which the returns were required to be filed, all returns that were required to be filed under this Act or under Part IX of the Excise Tax Act.

Subsection.Text: The amount determined under this subsection in respect of a corporation for a particular taxation year is

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: if the corporation is not associated with another corporation in the particular taxation year, the amount that is the corporation’s taxable income for the particular taxation year; or

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: if the corporation is associated with another corporation in the particular taxation year, the amount that is the total of all amounts each of which is the taxable income of the corporation for the particular taxation year or the taxable income of a corporation with which it is associated in the particular taxation year for a taxation year of that other corporation that ends in the particular taxation year.

Subsection.Text: The amount determined under this subsection in respect of a corporation for a particular taxation year is

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: if the corporation is not associated with another corporation in the particular taxation year, the amount that is the corporation’s taxable capital employed in Canada (for the purpose of this subsection, within the meaning assigned by section 181.2 or 181.3, as the case may be) for the particular taxation year; or

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: if the corporation is associated with another corporation in the particular taxation year, the amount that is the total of all amounts each of which is the taxable capital employed in Canada of the corporation for the particular taxation year or the taxable capital employed in Canada of a corporation with which it is associated in the particular taxation year for a taxation year of that other corporation that ends in the particular taxation year.

Subsection.Text: Notwithstanding subsection (1), where a corporation, that has remitted amounts in accordance with subsection (1.1), ceases at any particular time in a taxation year to be eligible to remit in accordance with subsection (1.1), the corporation shall pay to the Receiver General, the following amounts for the taxation year,

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: on or before the last day of each month, in the taxation year, that ends after the particular time, either

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the amount determined by the formula

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the total of the amounts estimated by the corporation to be the taxes payable by it under this Part and Parts VI, VI.1 and XIII.1 for the taxation year,
is the total of all payments payable by the corporation in the taxation year in accordance with subsection (1.1), and
is the number of months that end in the taxation year and after the particular time, or

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the total of

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: the amount determined by the formula

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the corporation’s first instalment base for the taxation year,
is the total of all payments payable by the corporation in the taxation year in accordance with subsection (1.1), and
is the number of months that end in the taxation year and after the particular time; and

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: the amount obtained when the estimated tax payable by the corporation, if any, under Parts VI and XIII.1 for the taxation year is divided by the number of months that end in the taxation year and after the particular time; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the remainder of the taxes payable by it under this Part and Parts VI, VI.1 and XIII.1 for the taxation year on or before its balance-due day for the year.

Subsection.Text: Subsections (1), (2.1) and (4) apply to a SIFT trust with any modifications that the circumstances require.

A corporation may, instead of paying the instalments required for a taxation year by paragraph (1)(a) or by subsection (1.1), pay to the Receiver General, under paragraph (1)(b), the total of the taxes payable by it under this Part and Parts VI, VI.1 and XIII.1 for the taxation year, if

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the total of the taxes payable under this Part and Parts VI, VI.1 and XIII.1 by the corporation for the taxation year (determined before taking into consideration the specified future tax consequences for the year) is equal to or less than $3,000; or

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the corporation’s first instalment base for the year is equal to or less than $3,000.

Subsection.Text: Notwithstanding subsection (1) and (1.5), the amount payable under subsection (1) or (1.5) for a taxation year by a corporation to the Receiver General on or before the last day of any month in the year is deemed to be the amount, if any, by which

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the amount so payable as determined under that subsection for the month

ContinuedSectionSubsection.Text: exceeds

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: where the corporation is neither a mutual fund corporation nor a non-resident-owned investment corporation, 1/12 of the corporation’s dividend refund (within the meaning assigned by subsection 129(1)) for the year,

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: if the corporation is a mutual fund corporation, 1/12 of the total of

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the corporation’s capital gains refund (within the meaning assigned by section 131) for the year, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the amount that, because of subsection 131(5) or (11), is the corporation’s dividend refund (within the meaning assigned by section 129) for the year,

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: where the corporation is a non-resident-owned investment corporation, 1/12 of the corporation’s allowable refund (within the meaning assigned by section 133) for the year, and

Paragraph.Label: (e)
Paragraph.Text: 1/12 of the total of the amounts each of which is deemed by subsection 125.4(3), 125.5(3), 125.6(2) or (2.1), 127.1(1), 127.41(3), 127.44(2), 127.45(2), 127.48(2), 127.49(2) or 127.491(2) to have been paid on account of the corporation’s tax payable under this Part for the year.

Subsection.Text: Notwithstanding subsection (1.1), the amount payable under subsection (1.1) for a taxation year by a corporation to the Receiver General on or before the last day of any period in the year is deemed to be the amount, if any, by which

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the amount so payable as determined under that subsection for the period

ContinuedSectionSubsection.Text: exceeds the total of

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: 1/4 of the corporation’s dividend refund (within the meaning assigned by subsection 129(1)) for the taxation year, and

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: 1/4 of the total of the amounts each of which is deemed by subsection 125.4(3), 125.5(3), 125.6(2) or (2.1), 127.1(1), 127.41(3), 127.44(2), 127.45(2), 127.48(2), 127.49(2) or 127.491(2) to have been paid on account of the corporation’s tax payable under this Part for the taxation year.

Subsection.Text: In this section, first instalment base and second instalment base of a corporation for a taxation year have the meanings prescribed by regulation.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Section.MarginalNote: Instalment deferral for January, February and March 2002 - definitions

Subsection.Text: The following definitions apply in this section.

Definition.Text: eligible corporation, for a particular taxation year, means a corporation

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: that is resident in Canada throughout the particular taxation year; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: of which the taxable capital employed in Canada, within the meaning assigned by Part I.3, for its preceding taxation year did not exceed,

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: if the corporation is not associated with any other corporation in the particular taxation year, $15 million, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: if the corporation is associated with one or more other corporations in the particular taxation year, the amount by which $15 million exceeds the total of the taxable capital employed in Canada, within the meaning assigned by Part I.3, of those other corporations for their last taxation years that ended in the last calendar year that ended before the end of the particular taxation year. (société admissible)

Definition.Text: eligible instalment day of an eligible corporation means a day in January, February or March, 2002, on which an instalment on account of the corporation’s tax payable under this Part for the taxation year that includes that day would become payable

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: if this Act were read without reference to this section; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: if, in the case of a corporation that is not required by section 157 to make instalment payments on account of its tax payable under this Part for the taxation year, it were so required. (jour admissible)

Subsection.Text: An eligible corporation’s balance-due day for a taxation year that ends after 2001 is deemed to be the later of

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the day that would otherwise be the corporation’s balance-due day for the taxation year, and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the day that is six months after the corporation’s last eligible instalment day in the taxation year.

Subsection.Text: An amount that would, because of paragraph 157(1)(a), otherwise become payable in respect of a taxation year by an eligible corporation on an eligible instalment day of the corporation does not become payable on that day but becomes payable

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: if the particular day that is six months after the eligible instalment day is in the taxation year, on the particular day; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: in any other case, on the day that is deemed by subsection (2) to be the corporation’s balance-due day for the taxation year.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Section.Text: Where the Minister mails a notice of assessment of any amount payable by a taxpayer, that part of the amount assessed then remaining unpaid is payable forthwith by the taxpayer to the Receiver General.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Subsection.Text: For the purposes of this Act, where a person is a legal representative of a taxpayer at any time,

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the legal representative is jointly and severally, or solidarily, liable with the taxpayer

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: to pay each amount payable under this Act by the taxpayer at or before that time and that remains unpaid, to the extent that the legal representative is at that time in possession or control, in the capacity of legal representative, of property that belongs or belonged to, or that is or was held for the benefit of, the taxpayer or the taxpayer’s estate, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: to perform any obligation or duty imposed under this Act on the taxpayer at or before that time and that remains outstanding, to the extent that the obligation or duty can reasonably be considered to relate to the responsibilities of the legal representative acting in that capacity; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: any action or proceeding in respect of the taxpayer taken under this Act at or after that time by the Minister may be so taken in the name of the legal representative acting in that capacity and, when so taken, has the same effect as if it had been taken directly against the taxpayer and, if the taxpayer no longer exists, as if the taxpayer continued to exist.

Subsection.Text: Every legal representative (other than a trustee in bankruptcy) of a taxpayer shall, before distributing to one or more persons any property in the possession or control of the legal representative acting in that capacity, obtain a certificate from the Minister, by applying for one in prescribed form, certifying that all amounts

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: for which the taxpayer is or can reasonably be expected to become liable under this Act at or before the time the distribution is made, and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: for the payment of which the legal representative is or can reasonably be expected to become liable in that capacity

ContinuedSectionSubsection.Text: have been paid or that security for the payment thereof has been accepted by the Minister.

Subsection.Text: If a legal representative (other than a trustee in bankruptcy) of a taxpayer distributes to one or more persons property in the possession or control of the legal representative, acting in that capacity, without obtaining a certificate under subsection (2) in respect of the amounts referred to in that subsection,

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the legal representative is personally liable for the payment of those amounts to the extent of the value of the property distributed;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the Minister may at any time assess the legal representative in respect of any amount payable because of this subsection; and

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: the provisions of this Division (including, for greater certainty, the provisions in respect of interest payable) apply, with any modifications that the circumstances require, to an assessment made under this subsection as though it had been made under section 152 in respect of taxes payable under this Part.

Subsection.Text: For the purposes of subsections 159(2) and 159(3), an appropriation by a legal representative of a taxpayer of property in the possession or control of the legal representative acting in that capacity is deemed to be a distribution of the property to a person.

Where subsection 70(2), 70(5) or 70(5.2) of this Act or subsection 70(9.4) of the Income Tax Act, chapter 148 of the Revised Statutes of Canada, 1952, is applicable in respect of a taxpayer who has died, and the taxpayer’s legal representative so elects and furnishes the Minister with security acceptable to the Minister for payment of any tax the payment of which is deferred by the election, notwithstanding any provision of this Part or the Income Tax Application Rules respecting the time within which payment shall be made of the tax payable under this Part by the taxpayer for the taxation year in which the taxpayer died, all or any portion of such part of that tax as is equal to the amount, if any, by which that tax exceeds the amount that that tax would be, if this Act were read without reference to subsections 70(2), (5) and (5.2) and the Income Tax Act, chapter 148 of the Revised Statutes of Canada, 1952, were read without reference to subsections 70(2), (5), (5.2) and (9.4) of that Act, may be paid in such number (not exceeding 10) of equal consecutive annual instalments as is specified by the legal representative in the election, the first instalment of which shall be paid on or before the day on or before which payment of that tax would, but for the election, have been required to be made and each subsequent instalment of which shall be paid on or before the next following anniversary of that day.

Where, in the taxation year in which a taxpayer dies, an amount is included in computing the taxpayer’s income by virtue of paragraph 23(3)(c) of the Income Tax Application Rules, the provisions of subsection 159(5) apply, with such modifications as the circumstances require, as though the amount were an amount included in computing the taxpayer’s income for the year by virtue of subsection 70(2) or an amount deemed to have been received by the taxpayer by virtue of subsection 70(5).

For the purposes of subsection 159(5), the tax payable under this Part by a taxpayer for the taxation year in which the taxpayer died includes any tax payable under this Part by virtue of an election in respect of the taxpayer’s death made by the taxpayer’s legal representative under subsection 70(2) or under the provisions of that subsection as they are required to be read by virtue of the Income Tax Application Rules.

Where a time determined under paragraph 104(4)(a), (a.1), (a.2), (a.3), (a.4), (b) or (c) in respect of a trust occurs in a taxation year of the trust and the trust so elects and furnishes to the Minister security acceptable to the Minister for payment of any tax the payment of which is deferred by the election, notwithstanding any other provision of this Part respecting the time within which payment shall be made of the tax payable under this Part by the trust for the year, all or any portion of the part of that tax that is equal to the amount, if any, by which that tax exceeds the amount that that tax would be if this Act were read without reference to paragraph 104(4)(a), (a.1), (a.2), (a.3), (a.4), (b) or (c), as the case may be, may be paid in the number (not exceeding 10) of equal consecutive annual instalments that is specified by the trust in the election, the first instalment of which shall be paid on or before the day on or before which payment of that tax would, but for the election, have been required to be made and each subsequent instalment of which shall be paid on or before the next following anniversary of that day.

Subsection.MarginalNote: Form and manner of election and interest
Subsection.Text: Every election made by a taxpayer under subsection 159(4) or 159(6.1) or by the legal representative of a taxpayer under subsection 159(5) shall be made in prescribed form and on condition that, at the time of payment of any amount payment of which is deferred by the election, the taxpayer shall pay to the Receiver General interest on the amount at the prescribed rate in effect at the time the election was made, computed from the day on or before which the amount would, but for the election, have been required to be paid to the day of payment.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Subsection.Text: In this section and section 160.01, a transaction includes an arrangement or event.

Subsection.MarginalNote: Tax liability re property transferred not at arm’s length
Subsection.Text: Where a person has, on or after May 1, 1951, transferred property, either directly or indirectly, by means of a trust or by any other means whatever, to

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the person’s spouse or common-law partner or a person who has since become the person’s spouse or common-law partner,

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: a person who was under 18 years of age, or

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: a person with whom the person was not dealing at arm’s length,

ContinuedSectionSubsection.Text: the following rules apply:

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: the transferee and transferor are jointly and severally, or solidarily, liable to pay a part of the transferor’s tax under this Part for each taxation year equal to the amount by which the tax for the year is greater than it would have been if it were not for the operation of sections 74.1 to 75.1 of this Act and section 74 of the Income Tax Act, chapter 148 of the Revised Statutes of Canada, 1952, in respect of any income from, or gain from the disposition of, the property so transferred or property substituted for it, and

Paragraph.Label: (e)
Paragraph.Text: the transferee and transferor are jointly and severally, or solidarily, liable to pay under this Act an amount equal to the lesser of

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the amount, if any, by which the fair market value of the property at the time it was transferred exceeds the fair market value at that time of the consideration given for the property, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the total of all amounts each of which is an amount that the transferor is liable to pay under this Act (including, for greater certainty, an amount that the transferor is liable to pay under this section, regardless of whether the Minister has made an assessment under subsection (2) for that amount) in or in respect of the taxation year in which the property was transferred or any preceding taxation year,

ContinuedSectionSubsection.Text: but nothing in this subsection limits the liability of the transferor under any other provision of this Act or of the transferee for the interest that the transferee is liable to pay under this Act on an assessment in respect of the amount that the transferee is liable to pay because of this subsection.

Subsection.MarginalNote: Joint and several, or solidary, liability — subsection 69(11)
Subsection.Text: If a particular person or partnership is deemed by subsection 69(11) to have disposed of a property at any time, the person referred to in that subsection to whom a benefit described in that subsection was available in respect of a subsequent disposition of the property or property substituted for the property is jointly and severally, or solidarily, liable with each other taxpayer to pay a part of the other taxpayer’s liabilities under this Act in respect of each taxation year equal to the amount determined by the formula

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the total of amounts payable under this Act by the other taxpayer in respect of the year, and

is the amount that would, if the particular person or partnership were not deemed by subsection 69(11) to have disposed of the property, be determined for A in respect of the other taxpayer in respect of the year,

ContinuedSectionSubsection.Text: but nothing in this subsection limits the liability of the other taxpayer under any other provision of this Act or of any person for the interest that the person is liable to pay under this Act on an assessment in respect of the amount that the person is liable to pay because of this subsection.

Subsection.MarginalNote: Joint and several, or solidary, liability — tax on split income
Subsection.Text: If an amount is required to be added because of subsection 120.4(2) in computing a specified individual’s tax payable under this Part for a taxation year and the specified individual has not attained the age of 24 years before the start of the year, the following rules apply:

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: subject to paragraph (b), a particular individual is jointly and severally, or solidarily, liable with the specified individual for the amount if

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: where the specified individual has not attained the age of 17 years before the year, the particular individual is a parent of the specified individual, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: where the specified individual has attained the age of 17 years before the year,

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: the particular individual is a source individual in respect of the specified individual,

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: the amount was derived directly or indirectly from a related business (within the meaning of paragraph 120.4(1.1)(d)) in respect of the specified individual, and

Clause.Label: (C)
Clause.Text: the particular individual meets the conditions in any of paragraphs (a) to (c) in the definition related business in subsection 120.4(1) in respect of the related business;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the particular individual’s liability under paragraph (a) in respect of the specified individual for the year is to be determined as though the only amounts included in the specified individual’s split income for the year are amounts derived from the related business referred to in subparagraph (a)(ii); and

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: nothing in this subsection limits the liability of

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the specified individual under any other provision of this Act, or

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the particular individual for the interest that the particular individual is liable to pay under this Act on an assessment in respect of the amount that the particular individual is liable to pay because of this subsection.

Subsection.MarginalNote: Joint liability — tax on split-pension income
Subsection.Text: Where a pensioner and a pension transferee (as those terms are defined in section 60.03) make a joint election under section 60.03 in respect of a split-pension amount (as defined in that section) for a taxation year, they are jointly and severally, or solidarily, liable for the tax payable by the pension transferee under this Part for the taxation year to the extent that that tax payable is greater than it would have been if no amount were required to be added because of paragraph 56(1)(a.2) in computing the income of the pension transferee under this Part for the taxation year.

Subsection.MarginalNote: Joint liability — spousal and similar trusts
