Subsection.Text: Despite any other provision of this Act, if a right to acquire securities (as defined in subsection 7(7)) under an agreement in respect of which a benefit was deemed by paragraph 7(1)(e) to have been received by a taxpayer (in this subsection referred to as the “right”) is exercised or disposed of by the taxpayer’s legal representative in a taxation year that is within the first three taxation years of the graduated rate estate of the taxpayer and the representative so elects in prescribed form and manner on or before the filing-due date for the taxation year of the estate,

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the amount, if any, by which

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the amount of the benefit deemed by paragraph 7(1)(e) to have been received by the taxpayer in respect of the right

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the amount, if any, by which the value of the right immediately before the time it was exercised or disposed of exceeds the amount, if any, paid by the taxpayer to acquire the right, and

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: where in computing the taxpayer’s taxable income for the taxation year in which the taxpayer died an amount was deducted under paragraph 110(1)(d) in respect of the benefit deemed by paragraph 7(1)(e) to have been received by the taxpayer in that year by reason of paragraph 7(1)(e) in respect of that right, 1/2 of the amount, if any, by which the amount determined under subparagraph (i) exceeds the amount determined under subparagraph (ii),

ContinuedParagraph.Text: shall be deemed to be a loss of the taxpayer from employment for the taxpayer’s last taxation year;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: there shall be deducted in computing the adjusted cost base to the estate of the right at any time the amount of the loss that would be determined under paragraph (a) if that paragraph were read without reference to subparagraph (a)(iii); and

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: the legal representative shall, at or before the time prescribed for filing the election under this subsection, file a prescribed form amending the return of income of the taxpayer for the taxpayer’s last taxation year to give effect to paragraph (a).

Subsection.Text: In this section, overpayment of a taxpayer for a taxation year means

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: where the taxpayer is not a corporation, the total of all amounts paid on account of the taxpayer’s liability under this Part for the year minus all amounts payable in respect thereof; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: where the taxpayer is a corporation, the total of all amounts paid on account of the corporation’s liability under this Part or Parts I.3, VI or VI.1 for the year minus all amounts payable in respect thereof.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]
[NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Subsection.Text: A taxpayer who objects to an assessment under this Part may serve on the Minister a notice of objection, in writing, setting out the reasons for the objection and all relevant facts,

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: if the assessment is in respect of the taxpayer for a taxation year and the taxpayer is an individual (other than a trust) or a graduated rate estate for the year, on or before the later of

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the day that is one year after the taxpayer’s filing-due date for the year, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the day that is 90 days after the day of sending of the notice of assessment; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: in any other case, on or before the day that is 90 days after the day of sending of the notice of assessment.

Subsection.MarginalNote: Limitation of right to object to assessments or determinations
Subsection.Text: Notwithstanding subsection 165(1), where at any time the Minister assesses tax, interest, penalties or other amounts payable under this Part by, or makes a determination in respect of, a taxpayer

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: under subsection 67.5(2) or 152(1.8), subparagraph 152(4)(b)(i) or subsection 152(4.3) or (6), 161.1(7), 164(4.1), 220(3.4) or 245(8) or in accordance with an order of a court vacating, varying or restoring an assessment or referring the assessment back to the Minister for reconsideration and reassessment,

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: under subsection 165(3) where the underlying objection relates to an assessment or a determination made under any of the provisions or circumstances referred to in paragraph 165(1.1)(a), or

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: under a provision of an Act of Parliament requiring an assessment to be made that, but for that provision, would not be made because of subsections 152(4) to 152(5),

ContinuedSectionSubsection.Text: the taxpayer may object to the assessment or determination within 90 days after the day of sending of the notice of assessment or determination, but only to the extent that the reasons for the objection can reasonably be regarded

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: where the assessment or determination was made under subsection 152(1.8), as relating to any matter or conclusion specified in paragraph 152(1.8)(a), 152(1.8)(b) or 152(1.8)(c), and

Paragraph.Label: (e)
Paragraph.Text: in any other case, as relating to any matter that gave rise to the assessment or determination

ContinuedSectionSubsection.Text: and that was not conclusively determined by the court, and this subsection shall not be read or construed as limiting the right of the taxpayer to object to an assessment or a determination issued or made before that time.

Subsection.Text: Where a corporation that was a large corporation in a taxation year (within the meaning assigned by subsection 225.1(8)) objects to an assessment under this Part for the year, the notice of objection shall

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: reasonably describe each issue to be decided;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: specify in respect of each issue, the relief sought, expressed as the amount of a change in a balance (within the meaning assigned by subsection 152(4.4)) or a balance of undeducted outlays, expenses or other amounts of the corporation; and

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: provide facts and reasons relied on by the corporation in respect of each issue.

Subsection.Text: Notwithstanding subsection 165(1.11), where a notice of objection served by a corporation to which that subsection applies does not include the information required by paragraph 165(1.11)(b) or 165(1.11)(c) in respect of an issue to be decided that is described in the notice, the Minister may in writing request the corporation to provide the information, and those paragraphs shall be deemed to be complied with in respect of the issue if, within 60 days after the request is made, the corporation submits the information in writing to a Chief of Appeals referred to in subsection 165(2).

Subsection.MarginalNote: Limitation on objections by large corporations
Subsection.Text: Notwithstanding subsections 165(1) and 165(1.1), where under subsection 165(3) a particular assessment was made for a taxation year pursuant to a notice of objection served by a corporation that was a large corporation in the year (within the meaning assigned by subsection 225.1(8)), except where the objection was made to an earlier assessment made under any of the provisions or circumstances referred to in paragraph 165(1.1)(a), the corporation may object to the particular assessment in respect of an issue

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: only if the corporation complied with subsection 165(1.11) in the notice with respect to that issue; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: only with respect to the relief sought in respect of that issue as specified by the corporation in the notice.

Subsection.Text: Where a particular assessment is made under subsection 165(3) pursuant to an objection made by a taxpayer to an earlier assessment, subsection 165(1.13) does not limit the right of the taxpayer to object to the particular assessment in respect of an issue that was part of the particular assessment and not part of the earlier assessment.

Notwithstanding subsection 165(1), where the Minister makes a determination under subsection 152(1.4) in respect of a fiscal period of a partnership, an objection in respect of the determination may be made only by one member of the partnership, and that member must be either

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: designated for that purpose in the information return made under section 229 of the Income Tax Regulations for the fiscal period; or

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: otherwise expressly authorized by the partnership to so act.

Subsection.Text: Notwithstanding subsections (1) and (1.1), no objection may be made by a taxpayer to an assessment made under subsection 118.1(11), 152(4.2), 169(3) or 220(3.1) nor, for greater certainty, in respect of an issue for which the right of objection has been waived in writing by the taxpayer.

A notice of objection under this section shall be served by being addressed to the Chief of Appeals in a District Office or a Taxation Centre of the Canada Revenue Agency and delivered or mailed to that Office or Centre.
Notwithstanding any other provision of this Act, paragraph (1)(a) shall apply only in respect of assessments, determinations and redeterminations under this Part and Part I.2.

On receipt of a notice of objection under this section, the Minister shall, with all due dispatch, reconsider the assessment and vacate, confirm or vary the assessment or reassess, and shall thereupon notify the taxpayer in writing of the Minister’s action.
The limitations imposed under subsections 152(4) and 152(4.01) do not apply to a reassessment made under subsection 165(3).
The Minister may accept a notice of objection served under this section that was not served in the manner required by subsection 165(2).

Where a taxpayer has served in accordance with this section a notice of objection to an assessment and thereafter the Minister reassesses the tax, interest, penalties or other amount in respect of which the notice of objection was served or makes an additional assessment in respect thereof and sends to the taxpayer a notice of the reassessment or of the additional assessment, as the case may be, the taxpayer may, without serving a notice of objection to the reassessment or additional assessment,

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: appeal therefrom to the Tax Court of Canada in accordance with section 169; or

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: amend any appeal to the Tax Court of Canada that has been instituted with respect to the assessment by joining thereto an appeal in respect of the reassessment or the additional assessment in such manner and on such terms, if any, as the Tax Court of Canada directs.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Section.Text: An assessment shall not be vacated or varied on appeal by reason only of any irregularity, informality, omission or error on the part of any person in the observation of any directory provision of this Act.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Subsection.Text: Where no notice of objection to an assessment has been served under section 165, nor any request under subsection 245(6) made, within the time limited by those provisions for doing so, the taxpayer may apply to the Minister to extend the time for serving the notice of objection or making the request.

An application made under subsection 166.1(1) shall set out the reasons why the notice of objection or the request was not served or made, as the case may be, within the time otherwise limited by this Act for doing so.

An application under subsection 166.1(1) shall be made by being addressed to the Chief of Appeals in a District Office or a Taxation Centre of the Canada Revenue Agency and delivered or mailed to that Office or Centre, accompanied by a copy of the notice of objection or a copy of the request, as the case may be.
The Minister may accept an application under this section that was not made in the manner required by subsection 166.1(3).

On receipt of an application made under subsection 166.1(1), the Minister shall, with all due dispatch, consider the application and grant or refuse it, and shall thereupon notify the taxpayer in writing of the Minister’s decision.

Subsection.MarginalNote: Date of objection or request if application granted
Subsection.Text: If an application made under subsection (1) is granted, the notice of objection or the request, as the case may be, is deemed to have been served or made on the day on which the decision of the Minister is sent to the taxpayer.
No application shall be granted under this section unless

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the application is made within one year after the expiration of the time otherwise limited by this Act for serving a notice of objection or making a request, as the case may be; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the taxpayer demonstrates that

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: within the time otherwise limited by this Act for serving such a notice or making such a request, as the case may be, the taxpayer

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: was unable to act or to instruct another to act in the taxpayer’s name, or

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: had a bona fide intention to object to the assessment or make the request,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: given the reasons set out in the application and the circumstances of the case, it would be just and equitable to grant the application, and

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: the application was made as soon as circumstances permitted.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Section.MarginalNote: Extension of time by Tax Court

Subsection.Text: A taxpayer who has made an application under subsection 166.1 may apply to the Tax Court of Canada to have the application granted after either

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the Minister has refused the application, or

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: 90 days have elapsed after service of the application under subsection 166.1(1) and the Minister has not notified the taxpayer of the Minister’s decision,

ContinuedSectionSubsection.Text: but no application under this section may be made after the expiration of 90 days after the day on which notification of the decision was mailed to the taxpayer.

Subsection.Text: An application under subsection (1) shall be made by filing in the Registry of the Tax Court of Canada, in accordance with the provisions of the Tax Court of Canada Act, three copies of the documents referred to in subsection 166.1(3) and three copies of the notification, if any, referred to in subsection 166.1(5).
The Tax Court of Canada shall send a copy of each application made under this section to the office of the Commissioner of Revenue.

The Tax Court of Canada may grant or dismiss an application made under subsection 166.2(1) and, in granting an application, may impose such terms as it deems just or order that the notice of objection be deemed to have been served on the date of its order.
No application shall be granted under this section unless

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the application was made under subsection 166.1(1) within one year after the expiration of the time otherwise limited by this Act for serving a notice of objection or making a request, as the case may be; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the taxpayer demonstrates that

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: within the time otherwise limited by this Act for serving such a notice or making such a request, as the case may be, the taxpayer

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: was unable to act or to instruct another to act in the taxpayer’s name, or

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: had a bona fide intention to object to the assessment or make the request,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: given the reasons set out in the application and the circumstances of the case, it would be just and equitable to grant the application, and

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: the application was made under subsection 166.1(1) as soon as circumstances permitted.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Subsection.Text: Where an appeal to the Tax Court of Canada has not been instituted by a taxpayer under section 169 within the time limited by that section for doing so, the taxpayer may make an application to the Court for an order extending the time within which the appeal may be instituted and the Court may make an order extending the time for appealing and may impose such terms as it deems just.
An application made under subsection 167(1) shall set out the reasons why the appeal was not instituted within the time limited by section 169 for doing so.

An application made under subsection (1) shall be made by filing in the Registry of the Tax Court of Canada, in accordance with the provisions of the Tax Court of Canada Act, three copies of the application accompanied by three copies of the notice of appeal.
The Tax Court of Canada shall send a copy of each application made under this section to the office of the Deputy Attorney General of Canada.
No order shall be made under this section unless

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the application is made within one year after the expiration of the time limited by section 169 for appealing; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the taxpayer demonstrates that

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: within the time otherwise limited by section 169 for appealing the taxpayer

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: was unable to act or to instruct another to act in the taxpayer’s name, or

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: had a bona fide intention to appeal,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: given the reasons set out in the application and the circumstances of the case, it would be just and equitable to grant the application,

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: the application was made as soon as circumstances permitted, and

Subparagraph.Label: (iv)
Subparagraph.Text: there are reasonable grounds for the appeal.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Heading.TitleText: Revocation of Registration of Certain Organizations and Associations

Section.MarginalNote: Notice of intention to revoke registration

Subsection.Text: The Minister may, by registered mail, give notice to a person described in any of paragraphs (a) to (c) of the definition qualified donee in subsection 149.1(1) that the Minister proposes to revoke its registration if the person

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: applies to the Minister in writing for revocation of its registration;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: ceases to comply with the requirements of this Act for its registration;

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: in the case of a registered charity, registered Canadian amateur athletic association or registered journalism organization, fails to file an information return as and when required under this Act or a regulation;

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: issues a receipt for a gift otherwise than in accordance with this Act and the regulations or that contains false information;

Paragraph.Label: (e)
Paragraph.Text: fails to comply with or contravenes any of sections 230 to 231.5; or

Paragraph.Label: (f)
Paragraph.Text: in the case of a registered charity, registered Canadian amateur athletic association or registered journalism organization, accepts a gift the granting of which was expressly or implicitly conditional on the charity, association or organization making a gift to another person, club, society, association or organization other than a qualified donee.

Subsection.Text: If the Minister gives notice under subsection (1) to a registered charity, to a registered Canadian amateur athletic association or to a registered journalism organization,

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: if it has applied to the Minister in writing for the revocation of its registration, the Minister shall, forthwith after the mailing of the notice, publish a copy of the notice in the Canada Gazette, and on that publication of a copy of the notice, the registration is revoked; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: in any other case, the Minister may, after the expiration of 30 days from the day of mailing of the notice, or after the expiration of such extended period from the day of mailing of the notice as the Federal Court of Appeal or a judge of that Court, on application made at any time before the determination of any appeal pursuant to subsection 172(3) from the giving of the notice, may fix or allow, publish a copy of the notice in the Canada Gazette, and on that publication of a copy of the notice, the registration is revoked.

Subsection.Text: Notwithstanding subsections (1), (2) and (4), if a registered charity is the subject of a certificate that is determined to be reasonable under subsection 7(1) of the Charities Registration (Security Information) Act, the registration of the charity is revoked as of the making of that determination.

Notwithstanding subsections (1), (2) and (4), if a qualified donee is a listed terrorist entity for the purposes of section 149.1, the registration of the qualified donee is revoked as of the date on which it became a listed terrorist entity.

A person may, on or before the day that is 90 days after the day on which the notice was mailed, serve on the Minister a written notice of objection in the manner authorized by the Minister, setting out the reasons for the objection and all the relevant facts, and the provisions of subsections 165(1), (1.1) and (3) to (7) and sections 166, 166.1 and 166.2 apply, with any modifications that the circumstances require, as if the notice were a notice of assessment made under section 152, if

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: in the case of a person that is or was registered as a registered charity or is an applicant for such registration, it objects to a notice under any of subsections (1) and 149.1(2) to (4.1), (6.3), (22) and (23);

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: in the case of a person that is or was registered as a registered Canadian amateur athletic association or is an applicant for such registration, it objects to a notice under any of subsections (1) and 149.1(4.2) and (22); or

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: in the case of a person described in any of subparagraphs (a)(i) to (v) and paragraph (b.1) of the definition qualified donee in subsection 149.1(1), that is or was registered by the Minister as a qualified donee or is an applicant for such registration, it objects to a notice under any of subsections (1) and 149.1(4.3) and (22).

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Heading.TitleText: Designation of Qualified Canadian Journalism Organizations

Subsection.Text: If an organization is designated for the purpose of the definition qualified Canadian journalism organization in subsection 248(1), the organization is deemed to have become designated on the date that the application for designation of the organization was made, unless otherwise specified by the Minister.

The Minister may, at any time, revoke the designation of an organization made for the purpose of the definition qualified Canadian journalism organization in subsection 248(1) and, for that purpose, the Minister shall take into account any recommendations of a body established for the purpose of that definition and referred to in paragraph (b) of that definition.
If the designation of an organization is revoked under subsection (2),

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the Minister shall provide notice of the revocation to the organization in writing; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the revocation is deemed to be effective as of the date on which the notice in paragraph (a) is sent, unless the Minister specifies an earlier date.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Heading.Label: DIVISION J
Heading.TitleText: Appeals to the Tax Court of Canada and the Federal Court of Appeal

Subsection.Text: Where a taxpayer has served notice of objection to an assessment under section 165, the taxpayer may appeal to the Tax Court of Canada to have the assessment vacated or varied after either

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the Minister has confirmed the assessment or reassessed, or

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: 90 days have elapsed after service of the notice of objection and the Minister has not notified the taxpayer that the Minister has vacated or confirmed the assessment or reassessed,

ContinuedSectionSubsection.Text: but no appeal under this section may be instituted after the expiration of 90 days from the day notice has been sent to the taxpayer under section 165 that the Minister has confirmed the assessment or reassessed.

Subsection.Text: Where at any particular time a taxpayer has disposed of a property, the fair market value of which has been confirmed or redetermined by the Minister of the Environment under subsection 118.1(10.4), the taxpayer may, within 90 days after the day on which that Minister has issued a certificate under subsection 118.1(10.5), appeal the confirmation or redetermination to the Tax Court of Canada.

Subsection.MarginalNote: Limitation of right to appeal from assessments or determinations
Subsection.Text: Notwithstanding subsection 169(1), where at any time the Minister assesses tax, interest, penalties or other amounts payable under this Part by, or makes a determination in respect of, a taxpayer

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: under subsection 67.5(2) or 152(1.8), subparagraph 152(4)(b)(i) or subsection 152(4.3) or 152(6), 164(4.1), 220(3.4) or 245(8) or in accordance with an order of a court vacating, varying or restoring the assessment or referring the assessment back to the Minister for reconsideration and reassessment,

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: under subsection 165(3) where the underlying objection relates to an assessment or a determination made under any of the provisions or circumstances referred to in paragraph 169(2)(a), or

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: under a provision of an Act of Parliament requiring an assessment to be made that, but for that provision, would not be made because of subsections 152(4) to 152(5),

ContinuedSectionSubsection.Text: the taxpayer may appeal to the Tax Court of Canada within the time limit specified in subsection 169(1), but only to the extent that the reasons for the appeal can reasonably be regarded

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: where the assessment or determination was made under subsection 152(1.8), as relating to any matter specified in paragraph 152(1.8)(a), 152(1.8)(b) or 152(1.8)(c), and

Paragraph.Label: (e)
Paragraph.Text: in any other case, as relating to any matter that gave rise to the assessment or determination

ContinuedSectionSubsection.Text: and that was not conclusively determined by the Court, and this subsection shall not be read or construed as limiting the right of the taxpayer to appeal from an assessment or a determination issued or made before that time.

Subsection.MarginalNote: Limitation on appeals by large corporations
Subsection.Text: Notwithstanding subsections 169(1) and 169(2), where a corporation that was a large corporation in a taxation year (within the meaning assigned by subsection 225.1(8)) served a notice of objection to an assessment under this Part for the year, the corporation may appeal to the Tax Court of Canada to have the assessment vacated or varied only with respect to

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: an issue in respect of which the corporation has complied with subsection 165(1.11) in the notice, or

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: an issue described in subsection 165(1.14) where the corporation did not, because of subsection 165(7), serve a notice of objection to the assessment that gave rise to the issue

ContinuedSectionSubsection.Text: and, in the case of an issue described in paragraph 169(2.1)(a), the corporation may so appeal only with respect to the relief sought in respect of the issue as specified by the corporation in the notice.

Subsection.Text: Notwithstanding subsections 169(1) and 169(2), for greater certainty a taxpayer may not appeal to the Tax Court of Canada to have an assessment under this Part vacated or varied in respect of an issue for which the right of objection or appeal has been waived in writing by the taxpayer.

Notwithstanding section 152, for the purpose of disposing of an appeal made under a provision of this Act, the Minister may at any time, with the consent in writing of the taxpayer, reassess tax, interest, penalties or other amounts payable under this Act by the taxpayer.
Division I applies, with such modifications as the circumstances require, in respect of a reassessment made under subsection 169(3) as though it had been made under section 152.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Subsection.Text: Where an appeal is made to the Tax Court of Canada under section 18 of the Tax Court of Canada Act, the Court shall forthwith send a copy of the notice of the appeal to the office of the Commissioner of Revenue.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Subsection.Text: The Tax Court of Canada may dispose of an appeal by

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: dismissing it; or

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: allowing it and

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: vacating the assessment,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: varying the assessment, or

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: referring the assessment back to the Minister for reconsideration and reassessment.

Subsection.Text: On an appeal under subsection 169(1.1), the Tax Court of Canada may confirm or vary the amount determined to be the fair market value of a property and the value determined by the Court is deemed to be the fair market value of the property determined by the Minister of the Environment.
If an appeal raises more than one issue, the Tax Court of Canada may, with the consent in writing of the parties to the appeal, dispose of a particular issue by

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: dismissing the appeal with respect to the particular issue; or

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: allowing the appeal with respect to the particular issue and

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: varying the assessment, or

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: referring the assessment back to the Minister for reconsideration and reassessment.

Subsection.Text: If a particular issue has been disposed of under subsection (2), the appeal with respect to the remaining issues may continue.

Subsection.MarginalNote: Appeal to Federal Court of Appeal
Subsection.Text: If the Tax Court of Canada has disposed of a particular issue under subsection (2), the parties to the appeal may, in accordance with the provisions of the Tax Court of Canada Act or the Federal Courts Act, as they relate to appeals from decisions of the Tax Court of Canada, appeal the disposition to the Federal Court of Appeal as if it were a final judgment of the Tax Court of Canada.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Section.MarginalNote: Appeal from refusal to register, revocation of registration, etc.

Subsection.Text: Where the Minister

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: confirms a proposal or decision in respect of which a notice was issued under any of subsections 149.1(4.2) and (22) and 168(1) by the Minister, to a person that is or was registered as a registered Canadian amateur athletic association or is an applicant for registration as a registered Canadian amateur athletic association, or does not confirm or vacate that proposal or decision within 90 days after service of a notice of objection by the person under subsection 168(4) in respect of that proposal or decision,

Paragraph.Label: (a.1)
Paragraph.Text: confirms a proposal, decision or designation in respect of which a notice was issued by the Minister to a person that is or was registered as a registered charity, or is an applicant for registration as a registered charity, under any of subsections 149.1(2) to (4.1), (6.3), (22) and (23) and 168(1), or does not confirm or vacate that proposal, decision or designation within 90 days after service of a notice of objection by the person under subsection 168(4) in respect of that proposal, decision or designation,

Paragraph.Label: (a.2)
Paragraph.Text: confirms a proposal or decision in respect of which a notice was issued under any of subsections 149.1(4.3) and (22) and 168(1) by the Minister, to a person that is a person described in any of subparagraphs (a)(i) to (v) and paragraph (b.1) of the definition qualified donee in subsection 149.1(1) that is or was registered by the Minister as a qualified donee or is an applicant for such registration, or does not confirm or vacate that proposal or decision within 90 days after service of a notice of objection by the person under subsection 168(4) in respect of that proposal or decision,

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: refuses to accept for registration for the purposes of this Act any retirement savings plan,

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: refuses to accept for registration for the purposes of this Act any profit sharing plan or revokes the registration of such a plan,

Paragraph.Label: (e)
Paragraph.Text: refuses to accept for registration for the purposes of this Act an education savings plan,

Paragraph.Label: (e.1)
Paragraph.Text: sends notice under subsection 146.1(12.1) to a promoter that the Minister proposes to revoke the registration of an education savings plan,

Paragraph.Label: (f)
Paragraph.Text: refuses to register for the purposes of this Act any pension plan or gives notice under subsection 147.1(11) to the administrator of a registered pension plan that the Minister proposes to revoke its registration,

Paragraph.Label: (f.1)
Paragraph.Text: refuses to accept an amendment to a registered pension plan,

Paragraph.Label: (g)
Paragraph.Text: refuses to accept for registration for the purposes of this Act any retirement income fund,

Paragraph.Label: (h)
Paragraph.Text: refuses to accept for registration for the purposes of this Act any pooled pension plan or gives notice under subsection 147.5(24) to the administrator of a pooled registered pension plan that the Minister proposes to revoke its registration, or

Paragraph.Label: (i)
Paragraph.Text: refuses to accept an amendment to a pooled registered pension plan,

ContinuedSectionSubsection.Text: the person described in paragraph (a), (a.1) or (a.2), the applicant in a case described in paragraph (b), (e) or (g), a trustee under the plan or an employer of employees who are beneficiaries under the plan, in a case described in paragraph (c), the promoter in a case described in paragraph (e.1), the administrator of the plan or an employer who participates in the plan, in a case described in paragraph (f) or (f.1), or the administrator of the plan in a case described in paragraph (h) or (i), may appeal from the Minister’s decision, or from the giving of the notice by the Minister, to the Federal Court of Appeal.

Subsection.Text: Paragraphs (3)(a) and (a.1) do not apply to an applicant or a registered charity that is the subject of a certificate that has been determined to be reasonable under subsection 7(1) of the Charities Registration (Security Information) Act.
For the purposes of subsection 172(3), the Minister shall be deemed to have refused

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: to register an applicant for registration as a Canadian amateur athletic association,

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: to accept for registration for the purposes of this Act any retirement savings plan or profit sharing plan,

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: to accept for registration for the purposes of this Act any education savings plan, or

Paragraph.Label: (f)
Paragraph.Text: to accept for registration for the purposes of this Act any retirement income fund,

ContinuedSectionSubsection.Text: where the Minister has not notified the applicant of the disposition of the application within 180 days after the filing of the application with the Minister, and, in any such case, subject to subsection (3.1), an appeal from the refusal to the Federal Court of Appeal pursuant to subsection (3) may, notwithstanding subsection 180(1), be instituted under section 180 at any time by filing a notice of appeal in the Court.

Subsection.Text: An appeal referred to in subsection (3) or (4) is suspended when an applicant or a registered charity is, under subsection 5(1) of the Charities Registration (Security Information) Act, served with a copy of a certificate that has been signed under that Act, whether the appeal was instituted before or after the certificate was so signed, and the appeal is

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: discontinued on the determination, under subsection 7(1) of that Act, that the certificate is reasonable; or

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: reinstated as of the date the certificate is, under subsection 7(2) of that Act, quashed.

Subsection.Text: For the purposes of subsection 172(3), the Minister shall be deemed to have refused

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: to register for the purposes of this Act any pension plan or pooled pension plan, or

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: to accept an amendment to a registered pension plan or a pooled registered pension plan

ContinuedSectionSubsection.Text: where the Minister has not notified the applicant of the Minister’s disposition of the application within 1 year after the filing of the application with the Minister, and, in any such case, an appeal from the refusal to the Federal Court of Appeal pursuant to subsection 172(3) may, notwithstanding anything in subsection 180(1), be instituted under section 180 at any time by filing a notice of appeal in the Court.

Subsection.Text: The definitions in subsection 149.1(1) apply to this section.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Section.MarginalNote: References to Tax Court of Canada

Subsection.Text: Where the Minister and a taxpayer agree in writing that a question of law, fact or mixed law and fact arising under this Act, in respect of any assessment, proposed assessment, determination or proposed determination, should be determined by the Tax Court of Canada, that question shall be determined by that Court.

Subsection.MarginalNote: Time during consideration not to count
Subsection.Text: The time between the day on which proceedings are instituted in the Tax Court of Canada to have a question determined pursuant to subsection 173(1) and the day on which the question is finally determined shall not be counted in the computation of

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the periods determined under subsection 152(4),

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the time for service of a notice of objection to an assessment under section 165, or

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: the time within which an appeal may be instituted under section 169,

ContinuedSectionSubsection.Text: for the purpose of making an assessment of the tax payable by the taxpayer who agreed in writing to the determination of the question, for the purpose of serving a notice of objection thereto or for the purpose of instituting an appeal therefrom, as the case may be.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Subsection.Text: The Minister may apply to the Tax Court of Canada for a determination of a question if the Minister is of the opinion that the question is common to assessments or proposed assessments in respect of two or more taxpayers and is a question of law, fact or mixed law and fact arising out of

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: one and the same transaction or occurrence or series of transactions or occurrences; or

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: substantially similar transactions or occurrences or series of transactions or occurrences.

Subsection.Text: An application under subsection (1)

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: shall set out

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the question in respect of which the Minister requests a determination,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the names of the taxpayers that the Minister seeks to have bound by the determination of the question, and

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: the facts and reasons on which the Minister relies and on which the Minister based or intends to base assessments of tax payable by each of the taxpayers named in the application; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: shall be served by the Minister on each of the taxpayers named in the application and on any other persons who, in the opinion of the Tax Court of Canada, are likely to be affected by the determination of the question,

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: by sending a copy to each taxpayer so named and each other person so likely to be affected, or

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: on ex parte application by the Minister, in accordance with the directions of the Court.

Subsection.MarginalNote: Determination of question by Tax Court
Subsection.Text: If the Tax Court of Canada is satisfied that a question set out in an application under this section is common to assessments or proposed assessments in respect of two or more taxpayers who have been served with a copy of the application, the Tax Court of Canada may

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: make an order naming the taxpayers in respect of whom the question will be determined;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: if one or more of the taxpayers so served has or have appealed an assessment to the Tax Court of Canada in respect of which the question is relevant, make an order joining a party or parties to that or those appeals as it considers appropriate; and

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: proceed to determine the question in such manner as it considers appropriate.

Subsection.Text: Subject to subsection (4.1), if a question set out in an application under this section is determined by the Tax Court of Canada, the determination is final and conclusive for the purposes of any assessments of tax payable by the taxpayers named in the order made under paragraph (3)(a).

If a question set out in an application under this section is determined by the Tax Court of Canada, an appeal from the determination may, in accordance with the provisions of the Tax Court of Canada Act or the Federal Courts Act, as they relate to appeals from decisions of the Tax Court of Canada to the Federal Court of Appeal, be made by

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the Minister; or

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: any taxpayer named in an order of the Court made under paragraph (3)(a) if

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the question arises out of one and the same transaction or occurrence or series of transactions or occurrences,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the taxpayer has appealed an assessment to the Tax Court of Canada in respect of which the question is relevant, or

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: the taxpayer has been granted leave by a judge of the Federal Court of Appeal.

Subsection.Text: Any taxpayer named in an order made under paragraph (3)(a) in respect of a question is bound by any determination in respect of the question under an appeal made to the Federal Court of Appeal or the Supreme Court of Canada.

Subsection.MarginalNote: Time during consideration of question not counted
Subsection.Text: The time between the day on which an application under this section is served on a taxpayer pursuant to subsection 174(2) and

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: in the case of a taxpayer named in an order of the Tax Court of Canada pursuant to subsection 174(3), the day on which the determination becomes final and conclusive and not subject to any appeal, or

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: in the case of any other taxpayer, the day on which the taxpayer is served with notice that the taxpayer has not been named in an order of the Tax Court of Canada pursuant to subsection 174(3),

ContinuedSectionSubsection.Text: shall not be counted in the computation of

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: the periods determined under subsection 152(4),

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: the time for service of a notice of objection to an assessment under section 165, or

Paragraph.Label: (e)
Paragraph.Text: the time within which an appeal may be instituted under section 169,

ContinuedSectionSubsection.Text: for the purpose of making an assessment of the tax, interest or penalties payable by the taxpayer, serving a notice of objection thereto or instituting an appeal therefrom, as the case may be.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Section.Text: An appeal to the Tax Court of Canada under this Act, other than one referred to in section 18 of the Tax Court of Canada Act, shall be instituted in the manner set out in that Act or in any rules made under that Act.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]
[NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Section.Text: Proceedings in the Federal Court of Appeal under this Division may, on the application of the taxpayer, be held in camera if the taxpayer establishes to the satisfaction of the Court that the circumstances of the case justify in camera proceedings.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Section.Text: Where the Tax Court of Canada disposes of an appeal by a taxpayer in respect of an amount payable under this Part or where such an appeal has been discontinued or dismissed without trial, the Court may, on the application of the Minister and whether or not it awards costs, order the taxpayer to pay to the Receiver General an amount not exceeding 10% of any part of the amount that was in controversy in respect of which the Court determines that there were no reasonable grounds for the appeal, if in the opinion of the Court one of the main purposes for instituting or maintaining any part of the appeal was to defer the payment of any amount payable under this Part.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Section.MarginalNote: Appeals to Federal Court of Appeal

Subsection.Text: An appeal to the Federal Court of Appeal pursuant to subsection 172(3) may be instituted by filing a notice of appeal in the Court within 30 days from

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the day on which the Minister notifies a person under subsection 165(3) of the Minister’s action in respect of a notice of objection filed under subsection 168(4),

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: the mailing of notice to the administrator of the registered pension plan under subsection 147.1(11),

Paragraph.Label: (c.1)
Paragraph.Text: the sending of a notice to a promoter of a registered education savings plan under subsection 146.1(12.1),

Paragraph.Label: (c.2)
Paragraph.Text: the mailing of notice to the administrator of the pooled registered pension plan under subsection 147.5(24), or

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: the time the decision of the Minister to refuse the application for acceptance of the amendment to the registered pension plan or pooled registered pension plan was mailed, or otherwise communicated in writing, by the Minister to any person,

ContinuedSectionSubsection.Text: as the case may be, or within such further time as the Court of Appeal or a judge thereof may, either before or after the expiration of those 30 days, fix or allow.

Subsection.MarginalNote: No jurisdiction in a Tax Court of Canada or Federal Court
Subsection.Text: Neither the Tax Court of Canada nor the Federal Court has jurisdiction to entertain any proceeding in respect of a decision of the Minister from which an appeal may be instituted under this section.
An appeal to the Federal Court of Appeal instituted under this section shall be heard and determined in a summary way.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Heading.Label: PART I.01
Heading.TitleText: Tax in Respect of Stock Option Benefit Deferral

Section.MarginalNote: Election — special tax and relief for deferral of stock option benefits

Subsection.Text: A taxpayer may make an election in prescribed form to have subsection (2) apply for a taxation year in respect of particular securities if

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the taxpayer elected to have subsection 7(8) apply, as that subsection applied before 4:00 p.m. Eastern Standard Time, March 4, 2010, in respect of the particular securities; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the taxpayer has, in the year and before 2015, disposed of the particular securities; and

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: the election under this subsection is filed

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: if the taxpayer has disposed of the particular securities before 2010, on or before the taxpayer’s filing-due date for 2010, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: in any other case, on or before the taxpayer’s filing-due date for the year of disposition of the particular securities.

Subsection.Text: If a taxpayer makes an election under subsection (1) for a taxation year in respect of particular securities, the following rules apply:

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: paragraph 110(1)(d) shall be read without reference to the phrase “1/2 of” in respect of the amount of the benefit deemed by subsection 7(1) to have been received by the taxpayer in the year in respect of the particular securities;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the taxpayer is deemed to have realized a capital gain for the year equal to the lesser of

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the amount that is deductible by the taxpayer under paragraph 110(1)(d), as modified by paragraph (a), and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the taxpayer’s capital loss in respect of the disposition of the particular securities;

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: the taxpayer is liable to pay a tax for the year equal to

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: in the case of a taxpayer resident in the Province of Quebec at the end of the year, 2/3 of the taxpayer’s proceeds of disposition (as defined in section 54, but determined without reference to subsection 73(1)) of the particular securities, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: in any other case, the taxpayer’s proceeds of disposition (as defined in section 54, but determined without reference to subsection 73(1)) of the particular securities;

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: to the extent that the taxation year is outside the normal reassessment period (as defined in subsection 152(3.1)), the election is deemed to be an application for reassessment under subsection 152(4.2);

Paragraph.Label: (e)
Paragraph.Text: notwithstanding subsection 152(4) and as the circumstances require, the Minister shall re-determine the taxpayer’s net capital loss (as defined in subsection 111(8)) for the taxation year and reassess any taxation year in which an amount has been deducted under paragraph 111(1)(b).

Paragraph.Label: (f)
Paragraph.Text: subparagraph 127.52(1)(h)(ii) is to be read as “the amount deducted under paragraph 110(1)(d)” for the year in respect of the particular securities; and

Paragraph.Label: (g)
Paragraph.Text: notwithstanding subsection 152(4) and as the circumstances require, the Minister shall re-determine the taxpayer’s additional tax under subsection 120.2(3) for the taxation year and reassess any taxation year in which an amount has been deducted under subsection 120.2(1).

Subsection.Text: An amount included under subsection (2)(b) in computing a person’s income under Part I of this Act for a taxation year shall not be included in determining the income of the person for the year under Part VII of the Employment Insurance Act.
Subsection 150(3), sections 150.1 to 152, 155 to 156.1 and 158 to 167 and Division J of Part I apply to this Part with any modifications that the circumstances require.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]
[NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Heading.Label: PART I.2
Heading.TitleText: Tax on Old Age Security Benefits

Subsection.Text: The definitions in this subsection apply in this Part.

Definition.Text: adjusted income of an individual for a taxation year means the amount that would be the individual’s income under Part I for the year if in computing that income no amount were

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: included

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: under paragraph 56(1)(q.1) or subsection 56(6),

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: in respect of a gain from a disposition of property to which section 79 applies, or

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: in respect of a gain described in subsection 40(3.21), or

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: deductible under paragraph 20(1)(ww) or 60(w), (y) or (z). (revenu modifié)

Definition.Text: base taxation year in relation to a month, means

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: where the month is any of the first 6 months of a calendar year, the taxation year that ended on December 31 of the second preceding calendar year, and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: where the month is any of the last 6 months of a calendar year, the taxation year that ended on December 31 of the preceding calendar year. (année de base)

Definition.Text: return of income in respect of an individual for a taxation year means

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: where the individual was resident in Canada throughout the year, the individual’s return of income (other than a return of income filed under subsection 70(2) or 104(23), paragraph 128(2)(e) or subsection 150(4)) that is filed or required to be filed under Part I for the year, and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: in any other case, a prescribed form containing prescribed information. (déclaration de revenu)

Subsection.Text: Every individual shall pay a tax under this Part for each taxation year equal to the amount determined by the formula

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the lesser of

FormulaParagraph.Label: (a)
FormulaParagraph.Text: the amount, if any, by which

FormulaParagraph.Label: (i)
FormulaParagraph.Text: the total of all amounts each of which is the amount of any pension, supplement or spouse’s or commmon-law partner’s allowance under the Old Age Security Act included in computing the individual’s income under Part I for the year

FormulaParagraph.Label: (ii)
FormulaParagraph.Text: the amount of any deduction allowed under subparagraph 60(n)(i) in computing the individual’s income under Part I for the year, and

FormulaParagraph.Label: (b)
FormulaParagraph.Text: 15% of the amount, if any, by which the individual’s adjusted income for the year exceeds $50,000; and

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the rate of tax payable by the individual under Part XIII on amounts described in paragraph (a) of the description of A.

Subsection.Text: Where at any time Her Majesty pays an amount described in paragraph (a) of the description of A in subsection 180.2(2) in respect of a month to an individual, there shall be deducted or withheld from that amount on account of the individual’s tax payable under this Part for the year the amount determined under subsection 180.2(4) in respect of that amount.

Subsection.MarginalNote: Determination of amount to be withheld
Subsection.Text: The amount determined in respect of a particular amount described in subsection 180.2(3) is

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: where the individual has filed a return of income for the base taxation year in relation to the month in which the particular amount is paid, the lesser of

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the amount by which the particular amount exceeds the amount of tax payable under Part XIII by the individual on the particular amount, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the amount determined by the formula

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the individual’s adjusted income for the base taxation year, and
is the rate of tax payable under Part XIII by the individual on the particular amount;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: where the individual has not filed a return of income for the base taxation year in relation to the month and

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the Minister has demanded under subsection 150(2) that the individual file the return, or

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the individual was non-resident at any time in the base taxation year,

ContinuedParagraph.Text: the amount by which the particular amount exceeds the amount of tax payable under Part XIII by the individual on the particular amount; and

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: in any other case, nil.

Subsection.Text: Every individual liable to pay tax under this Part for a taxation year shall

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: file with the Minister, without notice or demand therefor,

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: where the individual is resident in Canada throughout the taxation year, a return for the year under this Part in prescribed form and containing prescribed information on or before the individual’s filing-due date for the year, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: in any other case, a return of income for the year on or before the individual’s balance-due day for the year; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: pay the individual’s tax payable under this Part for the year on or before the individual’s balance-due day for the year.

Subsection.Text: Subsection 150(3), sections 150.1, 151 and 152, subsections 153(1.1), 153(1.2) and 153(3), sections 155 to 156.1 and 158 to 167 and Division J of Part I apply to this Part with any modifications that the circumstances require.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Subsection.Text: For the purposes of this Part,

Definition.Text: financial institution, in respect of a taxation year, means a corporation that at any time in the year is

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: a bank or credit union,

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: an insurance corporation that carries on business in Canada,

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: authorized under the laws of Canada or a province to carry on the business of offering its services as a trustee to the public,

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: authorized under the laws of Canada or a province to accept deposits from the public and carries on the business of lending money on the security of real property or immovables or investing in indebtedness on the security of mortgages on real property or of hypothecs on immovables,

Paragraph.Label: (e)
Paragraph.Text: a registered securities dealer,

Paragraph.Label: (f)
Paragraph.Text: a mortgage investment corporation, or

Paragraph.Label: (g)
Paragraph.Text: a corporation

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: listed in the schedule, or

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: all or substantially all of the assets of which are shares or indebtedness of financial institutions to which the corporation is related; (institution financière)

Definition.Text: long-term debt means

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: in the case of a bank, its subordinated indebtedness (within the meaning assigned by section 2 of the Bank Act) evidenced by obligations issued for a term of not less than 5 years,

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: in the case of an insurance corporation, its subordinated indebtedness (within the meaning assigned by section 2 of the Insurance Companies Act) evidenced by obligations issued for a term of not less than 5 years, and

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: in the case of any other corporation, its subordinated indebtedness (within the meaning that would be assigned by section 2 of the Bank Act if the definition of that expression in that section were applied with such modifications as the circumstances require) evidenced by obligations issued for a term of not less than 5 years,

ContinuedDefinition.Text: but does not include, where the corporation is a prescribed federal Crown corporation for the purpose of section 27, any indebtedness evidenced by obligations issued to and held by Her Majesty in right of Canada; (passif à long terme)

Definition.Text: reserves, in respect of a corporation for a taxation year, means the amount at the end of the year of all of the corporation’s reserves, provisions and allowances (other than allowances in respect of depreciation or depletion) and, for greater certainty, includes any provision in respect of deferred taxes. (réserves)

Subsection.Text: For the purposes of this Part, the expressions attributed surplus, Canadian assets, Canadian premiums, Canadian reserve liabilities, contractual service margin, group of insurance contracts, group of reinsurance contracts, permanent establishment, policyholders’ liabilities, reinsurance contract held amount, total assets, total premiums and total reserve liabilities have such meanings as may be prescribed.

For the purposes of determining the carrying value of a corporation’s assets or any other amount under this Part in respect of a corporation’s capital, investment allowance, taxable capital or taxable capital employed in Canada for a taxation year or in respect of a partnership in which a corporation has an interest,

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the equity and consolidation methods of accounting shall not be used; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: subject to paragraph 181(3)(a) and except as otherwise provided in this Part, the amounts reflected in the balance sheet

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: presented to the shareholders of the corporation (in the case of a corporation that is neither an insurance corporation to which subparagraph 181(3)(b)(ii) applies nor a bank) or the members of the partnership, as the case may be, or, where such a balance sheet was not prepared in accordance with generally accepted accounting principles or no such balance sheet was prepared, the amounts that would be reflected if such a balance sheet had been prepared in accordance with generally accepted accounting principles, or

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: accepted by the Superintendent of Financial Institutions, in the case of a bank or an insurance corporation that is required by law to report to the Superintendent, or the superintendent of insurance or other similar officer or authority of the province under whose laws the corporation is incorporated, in the case of an insurance corporation that is required by law to report to that officer or authority,

Subsection.Text: Unless a contrary intention is evident, no provision of this Part shall be read or construed to require the inclusion or to permit the deduction, in computing the amount of a corporation’s capital, investment allowance, taxable capital or taxable capital employed in Canada for a taxation year, of any amount to the extent that that amount has been included or deducted, as the case may be, in computing the first-mentioned amount under, in accordance with or by reason of any other provision of this Part.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Subsection.Text: Every corporation shall pay a tax under this Part for each taxation year equal to the amount obtained by multiplying the corporation’s specified percentage for the taxation year by the amount, if any, by which

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: its taxable capital employed in Canada for the year

ContinuedSectionSubsection.Text: exceeds

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: its capital deduction for the year.

Subsection.Text: For the purpose of subsection (1), the specified percentage of a corporation for a taxation year that ends after 2003 is the total of

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: that proportion of 0.225% that the number of days in the taxation year that are before 2004 is of the number of days in the taxation year,

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: that proportion of 0.200% that the number of days in the taxation year that are in 2004 is of the number of days in the taxation year, and

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: that proportion of 0.175% that the number of days in the taxation year that are in 2005 is of the number of days in the taxation year.

Subsection.Text: Notwithstanding subsection (1.1), for the purposes of applying subsection 125(5.1) and the definitions unused surtax credit in subsections (6) and 190.1(5), the amount of tax in respect of a corporation under subsection (1) for a taxation year is to be determined as if the specified percentage of the corporation for the taxation year were 0.225%.

Where a taxation year of a corporation is less than 51 weeks, the amount determined under subsection 181.1(1) for the year in respect of the corporation shall be reduced to that proportion of that amount that the number of days in the year is of 365.
No tax is payable under this Part for a taxation year by a corporation

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: that was a non-resident-owned investment corporation throughout the year;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: that was a bankrupt at the end of the year;

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: that was throughout the year exempt from tax under section 149 on all of its taxable income;

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: that neither was resident in Canada nor carried on business through a permanent establishment in Canada at any time in the year;

Paragraph.Label: (e)
Paragraph.Text: that was throughout the year a deposit insurance corporation (within the meaning assigned by subsection 137.1(5)) or a corporation deemed by subsection 137.1(5.1) to be a deposit insurance corporation; or

Paragraph.Label: (f)
Paragraph.Text: that was throughout the year a corporation described in subsection 136(2) the principal business of which was marketing (including processing incidental to or connected therewith) natural products belonging to or acquired from its members or customers.

Subsection.Text: There may be deducted from a corporation’s tax otherwise payable under this Part for a taxation year an amount equal to the total of

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: its Canadian surtax payable for the year, and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: such part as the corporation claims of its unused surtax credits for its 7 immediately preceding and 3 immediately following taxation years,

ContinuedSectionSubsection.Text: to the extent that that total does not exceed the amount by which

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: the amount that would, but for this subsection, be its tax payable under this Part for the year

ContinuedSectionSubsection.Text: exceeds

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: the total of all amounts each of which is the amount deducted under subsection 125.3(1) in computing the corporation’s tax payable under Part I for a taxation year ending before 1992 in respect of its unused Part I.3 tax credit (within the meaning assigned by section 125.3) for the year.

Subsection.Text: For the purposes of this subsection and subsections 181.1(4), 181.1(6) and 181.1(7),

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: an amount may not be claimed under subsection 181.1(4) in computing a corporation’s tax payable under this Part for a particular taxation year in respect of its unused surtax credit for another taxation year until its unused surtax credits, if any, for taxation years preceding the other year that may be claimed under this Part for the particular year have been claimed; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: an amount in respect of a corporation’s unused surtax credit for a taxation year may be claimed under subsection 181.1(4) in computing its tax payable under this Part for another taxation year only to the extent that it exceeds the total of all amounts each of which is an amount claimed in respect of that unused surtax credit in computing its tax payable under this Part or Part VI for a taxation year preceding that other year.

Subsection.Text: For the purposes of this subsection and subsections 181.1(4), 181.1(5) and 181.1(7),

Definition.Text: Canadian surtax payable of a corporation for a taxation year has the meaning assigned by subsection 125.3(4); (surtaxe canadienne payable)
unused surtax credit for a taxation year ending after 1991

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: of a corporation (other than a corporation that was throughout the year a financial institution, within the meaning assigned by section 190) means the amount, if any, by which

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: its Canadian surtax payable for the year

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the amount that would, but for subsection 181.1(4), be its tax payable under this Part for the year, and

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: the amount, if any, deducted under section 125.3 in computing the corporation’s tax payable under Part I for the year, and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: of a corporation that was throughout the year a financial institution (within the meaning assigned by section 190) means the lesser of

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the amount, if any, by which

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: its Canadian surtax payable for the year

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: the amount that would, but for subsection 181.1(4), be its tax payable under this Part for the year, and

Clause.Label: (C)
Clause.Text: the amount, if any, deducted under section 125.3 in computing the corporation’s tax payable under Part I for the year, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the amount, if any, by which its tax payable under Part I for the year exceeds the amount that would, but for subsection 181.1(4) and subsection 190.1(3), be the total of its taxes payable under Parts I.3 and VI for the year. (crédit de surtaxe inutilisé)

Subsection.Text: Where at any time control of a corporation has been acquired by a person or group of persons, no amount in respect of its unused surtax credit for a taxation year ending before that time is deductible by the corporation for a taxation year ending after that time and no amount in respect of its unused surtax credit for a taxation year ending after that time is deductible by the corporation for a taxation year ending before that time, except that

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the corporation’s unused surtax credit for a particular taxation year that ended before that time is deductible by the corporation for a taxation year that ends after that time (in this paragraph referred to as the “subsequent year”) to the extent of that proportion of the corporation’s Canadian surtax payable for the particular year that

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the amount, if any, by which

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: the total of all amounts each of which is

Subclause.Label: (I)
Subclause.Text: its income under Part I for the particular year from a business that was carried on by the corporation throughout the subsequent year for profit or with a reasonable expectation of profit, or

Subclause.Label: (II)
Subclause.Text: where properties were sold, leased, rented or developed or services were rendered in the course of carrying on that business before that time, its income under Part I for the particular year from any other business all or substantially all of the income of which was derived from the sale, leasing, rental or development, as the case may be, of similar properties or the rendering of similar services

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: the total of all amounts each of which is an amount deducted under paragraph 111(1)(a) or 111(1)(d) in computing its taxable income for the particular year in respect of a non-capital loss or a farm loss, as the case may be, for taxation year in respect of any business referred to in clause 181.1(7)(a)(i)(A)

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the amount determined under subparagraph 181.1(7)(a)(i), and

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: the corporation’s taxable income for the particular year; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the corporation’s unused surtax credit for a particular taxation year that ends after that time is deductible by the corporation for a taxation year that ended before that time (in this paragraph referred to as the “preceding year”) to the extent of that proportion of the corporation’s Canadian surtax payable for the particular year that

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the amount, if any, by which

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: the total of all amounts each of which is

Subclause.Label: (I)
Subclause.Text: its income under Part I for the particular year from a business that was carried on by the corporation in the preceding year and throughout the particular year for profit or with a reasonable expectation of profit, or

Subclause.Label: (II)
Subclause.Text: where properties were sold, leased, rented or developed or services were rendered in the course of carrying on that business before that time, the corporation’s income under Part I for the particular year from any other business all or substantially all of the income of which was derived from the sale, leasing, rental or development, as the case may be, of similar properties or the rendering of similar services

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: the total of all amounts each of which is an amount deducted under paragraph 111(1)(a) or 111(1)(d) in computing the corporation’s taxable income for the particular year in respect of a non-capital loss or a farm loss, as the case may be, for a taxation year in respect of any business referred to in clause 181.1(7)(b)(i)(A)

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the amount determined under subparagraph 181.1(7)(b)(i), and

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: the corporation’s taxable income for the particular year.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Subsection.Text: The taxable capital employed in Canada of a corporation for a taxation year (other than a financial institution or a corporation that was throughout the year not resident in Canada) is the prescribed proportion of the corporation’s taxable capital for the year.
The taxable capital of a corporation (other than a financial institution) for a taxation year is the amount, if any, by which its capital for the year exceeds its investment allowance for the year.
The capital of a corporation (other than a financial institution) for a taxation year is the amount, if any, by which the total of

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the amount of its capital stock (or, in the case of a corporation incorporated without share capital, the amount of its members’ contributions), retained earnings, contributed surplus and any other surpluses at the end of the year,

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the amount of its reserves for the year, except to the extent that they were deducted in computing its income for the year under Part I,

Paragraph.Label: (b.1)
Paragraph.Text: the amount of its deferred unrealized foreign exchange gains at the end of the year,

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: the amount of all loans and advances to the corporation at the end of the year,

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: the amount of all indebtedness of the corporation at the end of the year represented by bonds, debentures, notes, mortgages, hypothecary claims, banker’s acceptances or similar obligations,

Paragraph.Label: (e)
Paragraph.Text: the amount of any dividends declared but not paid by the corporation before the end of the year,

Paragraph.Label: (f)
Paragraph.Text: the amount of all other indebtedness (other than any indebtedness in respect of a lease) of the corporation at the end of the year that has been outstanding for more than 365 days before the end of the year, and

Paragraph.Label: (g)
Paragraph.Text: the total of all amounts, each of which is the amount, if any, in respect of a partnership in which the corporation held a membership interest at the end of the year, either directly or indirectly through another partnership, determined by the formula

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the total of all amounts that would be determined under paragraphs (b) to (d) and (f) in respect of the partnership for its last fiscal period that ends at or before the end of the year if

FormulaParagraph.Label: (a)
FormulaParagraph.Text: those paragraphs applied to partnerships in the same manner that they apply to corporations, and

FormulaParagraph.Label: (b)
FormulaParagraph.Text: those amounts were computed without reference to amounts owing by the partnership

FormulaParagraph.Label: (i)
FormulaParagraph.Text: to any corporation that held a membership interest in the partnership either directly or indirectly through another partnership, or

FormulaParagraph.Label: (ii)
