Subclause.Text: to receive dividends at the discretion of the board of directors of the corporation, and

Subclause.Label: (III)
Subclause.Text: to receive, on dissolution of the corporation, all the assets of the corporation that remain after payment of all amounts payable to the holders of all other classes of shares of the corporation,

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: Class B shares that are issuable only to and may be held only by eligible labour bodies, that entitle each of those shareholders

Subclause.Label: (I)
Subclause.Text: to receive notice of and, subject to the Canada Business Corporations Act, to attend and vote at all meetings of the shareholders of the corporation, and

Subclause.Label: (II)
Subclause.Text: to receive, on dissolution of the corporation, an amount equal to the amount of the consideration received by the corporation on the issue of the Class B shares,

ContinuedClause.Text: but that do not entitle them to receive dividends, and

Clause.Label: (C)
Clause.Text: any additional classes of shares that are authorized, if the rights, privileges, restrictions and conditions attached to the shares are approved by the Minister of Finance,

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: the business and affairs of the corporation shall be managed by a board of directors, at least 1/2 of whom are appointed by the Class B shareholders,

Subparagraph.Label: (iv)
Subparagraph.Text: the corporation shall not reduce its paid-up capital in respect of a class of shares (other than Class B shares) otherwise than by way of

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: a redemption of shares of the corporation, or

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: a reduction in its paid-up capital attributable to a class of shares for which no shares have been issued in the eight-year period ending at the time of the reduction,

Subparagraph.Label: (v)
Subparagraph.Text: the corporation shall not redeem a Class A share in respect of which an information return described in paragraph 204.81(6)(c) has been issued unless

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: if the share is held by the specified individual in respect of the share, a spouse or common-law partner or former spouse or common-law partner of that individual or a trust governed by a registered retirement savings plan, TFSA or registered retirement income fund under which that individual, spouse or common-law partner is the annuitant,

Subclause.Label: (I)
Subclause.Text: a request in writing to redeem the share is made by the holder to the corporation and the information return referred to in paragraph 204.81(6)(c) has been returned to the corporation, or

Subclause.Label: (III)
Subclause.Text: the corporation is notified in writing that the specified individual in respect of the share became disabled and permanently unfit for work or terminally ill after the share was issued,

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: there is no specified individual in respect of the share,

Clause.Label: (D)
Clause.Text: the corporation is notified in writing that the share is held by a person on whom the share has devolved as a consequence of the death of

Subclause.Label: (I)
Subclause.Text: a holder of the share, or

Subclause.Label: (II)
Subclause.Text: an annuitant under a trust governed by a registered retirement savings plan, TFSA or registered retirement income fund that was a holder of the share,

Clause.Label: (E)
Clause.Text: the redemption occurs

Subclause.Label: (I)
Subclause.Text: more than eight years after the day on which the share was issued, or

Subclause.Label: (II)
Subclause.Text: if the day that is eight years after that issuance is in February or March of a calendar year, in February or on March 1st of that calendar year but not more than 31 days before that day, or

Clause.Label: (F)
Clause.Text: the holder of the share has satisfied such other conditions as are prescribed,

Subparagraph.Label: (vii)
Subparagraph.Text: the corporation shall not register a transfer of a Class A share by the specified individual in respect of the share, a spouse or common-law partner of the specified individual or a trust governed by a registered retirement savings plan, TFSA or registered retirement income fund under which the specified individual or spouse or common-law partner is the annuitant, unless

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: no information return has been issued under paragraph 204.81(6)(c) in respect of the share,

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: the transfer occurs more than eight years after the day on which the share was issued,

Clause.Label: (C)
Clause.Text: the transfer is to the specified individual, a spouse or common-law partner or former spouse or common-law partner of the specified individual or a trust governed by a registered retirement savings plan, TFSA or registered retirement income fund under which the specified individual or the spouse or common-law partner or former spouse or common-law partner of the specified individual is the annuitant,

Clause.Label: (D)
Clause.Text: the corporation is notified in writing that the transfer occurs as a consequence of the death of the specified individual or a spouse or common-law partner of the specified individual,

Clause.Label: (E)
Clause.Text: the corporation is notified in writing that the transfer occurs after the specified individual dies,

Clause.Label: (G)
Clause.Text: the corporation is notified in writing that the specified individual became disabled and permanently unfit for work or terminally ill after the share was issued and before the transfer, or

Clause.Label: (H)
Clause.Text: such other conditions as are prescribed are satisfied.

Subparagraph.Label: (viii)
Subparagraph.Text: the corporation shall not pay any fee or remuneration to a shareholder, director or officer of the corporation unless the payment was approved by a resolution of the directors of the corporation, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ix)
Subparagraph.Text: the corporation shall not make any investment in an eligible business entity with which the corporation or any of the directors of the corporation does not deal at arm’s length unless

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: the corporation would deal at arm’s length with the eligible business entity but for the corporation’s interest as the holder of eligible investments in such entity, or

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: the investment was approved by special resolution of the shareholders of the corporation before the investment was made.

Subsection.Text: In applying clause (1)(c)(v)(E) in relation to any time before 2004 in respect of a corporation incorporated before March 6, 1996, the references in that clause to “eight” are replaced with references to “five” if, at that time, the relevant statements in the corporation’s articles refer to “five”.

In applying subsection (1) in relation to any time before 2004, to a corporation incorporated before February 7, 2000, if the articles of the corporation comply with subclause (1)(c)(v)(E)(I) (as modified, where relevant, by subsection (1.1)), those articles are deemed to provide the statement required by subclause (1)(c)(v)(E)(II).
On registering a corporation under subsection 204.81(1), the Minister shall assign to it a registration number.

Where an eligible labour body causes more than one corporation to be registered under this Part, for the purposes of paragraph 204.81(6)(h) and section 204.82, each of those corporations shall be deemed

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: to have issued a Class A share at the earliest time any such corporation issued a Class A share,

ContinuedSectionSubsection.Text: and, where the corporation did not exist at the time referred to in paragraph 204.81(3)(a),

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: to have been in existence during the particular period beginning immediately before that time and ending immediately after the corporation was incorporated, and

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: to have had, throughout the particular period, fiscal periods ending on the same calendar day in each year in the particular period as the calendar day on which its first fiscal period after it was incorporated ended.

Subsection.Text: For the purposes of this Part, the cost at any time to a corporation of an eligible investment that is a guarantee shall be deemed to be 25% of the amount of the debt obligation subject to the guarantee at that time.
Where the Minister registers a corporation for the purposes of this Part, the corporation shall be deemed to have become so registered on the later of

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the day the application for registration of the plan is received by the Minister, and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: where in the application for registration a day is specified as the day on which the registration is to take effect, that day.

Subsection.Text: The Minister may revoke the registration of a corporation for the purposes of this Part where

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the articles of the corporation do not comply with paragraph 204.81(1)(c) and would not comply with that paragraph if the corporation had been incorporated after December 5, 1996;

Paragraph.Label: (a.1)
Paragraph.Text: the corporation does not comply with any of the provisions of its articles described in paragraph 204.81(1)(c), except where there would be no failure to comply if the provisions of its articles were consistent with the articles of a corporation that would be permitted to be registered under this Part if it had been incorporated after December 5, 1996;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: an individual acquires or irrevocably subscribes and pays for a Class A share of the capital stock of the corporation in the period beginning on the 61st day of a calendar year and ending on the 60th day of the following calendar year and the corporation fails to file with the Minister an information return in prescribed form containing prescribed information before April of that following calendar year;

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: an individual acquires or irrevocably subscribes and pays for a Class A share of the capital stock of the corporation in the period beginning on the 61st day of a calendar year and ending on the 60th day of the following calendar year and the corporation fails to issue to the individual before April of that following calendar year an information return in prescribed form stating the amount of the consideration paid for the share in that period;

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: the corporation issues more than one information return described in paragraph 204.81(6)(c) in respect of the same acquisition of or subscription for a Class A share;

Paragraph.Label: (e)
Paragraph.Text: the financial statements of the corporation presented to its shareholders are not prepared in accordance with generally accepted accounting principles;

Paragraph.Label: (f)
Paragraph.Text: the corporation fails within 6 months after the end of any taxation year to have an independent valuation of its shares made as of the end of that year;

Paragraph.Label: (h)
Paragraph.Text: the corporation does not pay the tax or penalty payable under section 204.82 by it on or before the day on or before which that tax or penalty is required to be paid;

Paragraph.Label: (i)
Paragraph.Text: tax was payable under subsection 204.82(3) by the corporation for 3 or more taxation years;

Paragraph.Label: (j)
Paragraph.Text: the corporation provides a guarantee that is an eligible investment and fails to maintain, at any time during the term of the guarantee, a reserve equal to the cost to the corporation of the guarantee at that time;

Paragraph.Label: (k)
Paragraph.Text: the corporation pays a fee or commission in excess of a reasonable amount in respect of the offering for sale, or the sale, of its shares; or

Paragraph.Label: (l)
Paragraph.Text: the corporation has a monthly deficiency in 18 or more months in any 36-month period.

Subsection.MarginalNote: Notice of intent to revoke registration
Subsection.Text: Where the Minister proposes to revoke the registration of a corporation under subsection 204.81(6), the Minister shall, by registered mail, give notice to the corporation of the proposal.

Where the Minister gives notice under subsection 204.81(7) to a registered labour-sponsored venture capital corporation, the Minister may, after the expiration of 30 days after the day of mailing of the notice, or after the expiration of such extended period after the day of mailing as the Federal Court of Appeal or a judge thereof, on application made at any time before the determination of any appeal under subsection 204.81(9) from the giving of the notice, may fix or allow, publish a copy of the notice in the Canada Gazette and, on the publication of a copy of the notice, the registration of the corporation is revoked.
Where at any time the Minister receives a certified copy of a resolution of the directors of a corporation seeking the revocation of the corporation’s registration under this Part,

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the registration is revoked at that time; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the Minister shall, with all due dispatch, give notice in the Canada Gazette of the revocation.

Subsection.Text: Subsection 248(7) does not apply for the purpose of subsection (8.1).
If a registered labour-sponsored venture capital corporation notifies the Minister in writing of its intent to revoke its registration under this Part, the following rules apply:

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the corporation shall not, on or after the day the notice is provided to the Minister (referred to in this subsection and subsection (8.4) as the “notification date”), issue any tax credit certificates, other than duplicate certificates to replace certificates issued before that day;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: section 204.841 does not apply on the discontinuance of its venture capital business;

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: subsections 204.82(1) to (4) do not apply to taxation years of the corporation that begin on or after the notification date; and

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: subsection 204.83(1) does not apply in respect of a period, referred to in that subsection as the “second period”, that ends after the notification date.

Subsection.Text: Subsection (8.3) applies to a corporation only if,

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: on the notification date, the percentage determined in respect of the corporation by the following formula is less than 20 per cent:

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the amount of equity capital received by the corporation on the issue of Class A shares that were issued in the 24 months immediately preceding the notification date and are still outstanding on that date,
is the total amount of equity capital received by the corporation on the issue of Class A shares that are still outstanding on the notification date, and
is the amount of equity capital received by the corporation on the issue of Class A shares that, as of the notification date, have been outstanding for at least eight years.

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the corporation has revoked its registration before the third anniversary of the notification date.

Subsection.Text: Where the Minister refuses to accept a corporation for registration under subsection 204.81(1) or gives notice of a proposal to revoke the registration of a corporation under subsection 204.81(7), the corporation may appeal to the Federal Court of Appeal from the decision or from the giving of the notice.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Subsection.Text: Where, at any time that is both in a taxation year included in the start-up period of a corporation that was registered under this Part and before its venture capital business is first discontinued,

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: 80% of the amount, if any, by which the total consideration received by it for Class A shares issued by it before that time exceeds the total of all amounts paid by it before that time to its shareholders as a return of capital on such shares

ContinuedSectionSubsection.Text: exceeds

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the total of all amounts each of which is the cost to the corporation of an eligible investment or reserve of the corporation at that time,

ContinuedSectionSubsection.Text: the corporation shall pay a tax under this Part for the year equal to the amount determined by the formula

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the greatest amount by which the amount determined under paragraph 204.82(1)(a) exceeds the amount determined under paragraph 204.82(1)(b) for the year, and
is the total of all taxes payable under this subsection by the corporation for preceding taxation years.

Subsection.Text: Each corporation that has been registered under this Part shall, in respect of each month that ends before its venture capital business is first discontinued and in a particular taxation year of the corporation that begins after the end of the corporation’s start-up period (or, where the corporation has no start-up period, that begins after the time the corporation first issues a Class A share), pay a tax under this Part equal to the amount obtained when the greatest investment shortfall at any time that is in the month and in the particular year (in this section and sections 204.81 and 204.83 referred to as the “monthly deficiency”) is multiplied by 1/60 of the prescribed rate of interest in effect during the month.
Subject to subsection 204.82(2.2), a corporation’s investment shortfall at any time in a particular taxation year is the amount determined by the formula

FormulaDefinition.Text: is 60% of the lesser of

FormulaParagraph.Label: (a)
FormulaParagraph.Text: the amount, if any, by which the amount of the shareholders’ equity in the corporation at the end of the preceding taxation year exceeds the specified adjustment in respect of the shareholders’ equity in the corporation at the end of that year, and

FormulaParagraph.Label: (b)
FormulaParagraph.Text: the amount, if any, by which the amount of the shareholders’ equity in the corporation at the end of the particular taxation year exceeds the specified adjustment in respect of the shareholders’ equity in the corporation at the end of the particular year;

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the greater of

FormulaParagraph.Label: (a)
FormulaParagraph.Text: the total of all amounts each of which is the adjusted cost to the corporation of an eligible investment of the corporation at that time, and

FormulaParagraph.Label: (b)
FormulaParagraph.Text: 50% of the total of all amounts each of which is

FormulaParagraph.Label: (i)
FormulaParagraph.Text: the adjusted cost to the corporation of an eligible investment of the corporation at the beginning of the particular year, or

FormulaParagraph.Label: (ii)
FormulaParagraph.Text: the adjusted cost to the corporation of an eligible investment of the corporation at the end of the particular year; and

FormulaDefinition.Text: is 60% of the amount, if any, by which

FormulaParagraph.Label: (a)
FormulaParagraph.Text: the total of all amounts each of which is a tax or penalty under subsection (3) or (4), or a prescribed tax or penalty, paid before that time by the corporation (other than the portion, if any, of that tax or penalty the liability for which resulted in a reduction in the amount of the shareholders’ equity at the end of any preceding taxation year)

FormulaParagraph.Label: (b)
FormulaParagraph.Text: the total of all amounts each of which is a refund before that time of any portion of the total described in paragraph (a).

Subsection.Text: For the purpose of this subsection and for the purpose of computing a corporation’s investment shortfall under subsection (2.1) at any time in a taxation year (in this subsection referred to as the “relevant year”),

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: unrealized gains and losses in respect of its eligible investments shall not be taken into account in computing the amount of the shareholders’ equity in the corporation;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: where

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the relevant year ends after 1998, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: it is expected that a redemption of its Class A shares will occur after the end of a particular taxation year and, as a consequence, the amount of the shareholders’ equity in the corporation at the end of the particular year would otherwise be reduced to take into account the expected redemption,

ContinuedParagraph.Text: subject to paragraph 204.82(2.2)(c), the amount (or, where the relevant year ends in 1999, 2000, 2001 or 2002, 20%, 40%, 60% or 80%, respectively of the amount) expected to be redeemed shall not be taken into account in determining the amount of the shareholders’ equity in the corporation at the end of the particular year;

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: paragraph 204.82(2.2)(b) does not apply to a redemption expected to be made after the end of a taxation year where

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the redemption is made within 60 days after the end of the year, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: either

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: tax under Part XII.5 became payable as a consequence of the redemption, or

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: tax under Part XII.5 would not have become payable as a consequence of the redemption if the redemption had occurred at the end of the year;

Paragraph.Label: (c.1)
Paragraph.Text: the specified adjustment in respect of shareholders’ equity in the corporation at the end of a taxation year is the amount determined by the formula

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the shareholders’ equity at the end of the year,
is the total of

FormulaParagraph.Label: (i)
FormulaParagraph.Text: the fair market value at the end of the year of all Class A shares issued by it before March 6, 1996 and more than five years before the end of the year,

FormulaParagraph.Label: (ii)
FormulaParagraph.Text: the fair market value at the end of the year of all Class A shares issued by it after March 5, 1996 and more than eight years before the end of the year,

FormulaParagraph.Label: (iii)
FormulaParagraph.Text: the fair market value at the end of the year of all Class A shares issued by it in the last 60 days of the year, and

FormulaParagraph.Label: (iv)
FormulaParagraph.Text: if the corporation so elects in writing filed with the Minister not more than six months after the end of the year and is not a revoked corporation at the end of the year, the fair market value at the end of the year of all shares of classes, of the capital stock of the corporation, to which clause 204.81(1)(c)(ii)(C) applies,

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the fair market value at the end of the year of all shares issued by it, and

is the amount by which the shareholders’ equity in the corporation at the end of the year has been reduced to take into account the expected subsequent redemption of shares of the capital stock of the corporation; and

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: the adjusted cost to the corporation of an eligible investment of the corporation at any time is

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: 150% of the cost to the corporation of the eligible investment at that time where the eligible investment is

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: a property acquired by the corporation after February 18, 1997 (other than a property to which subparagraph (i.1) applies) that would be an eligible investment of the corporation if the reference to “$50,000,000” in paragraph (f) of the definition eligible investment in subsection 204.8(1) were read as “$10,000,000”, or

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: a share of the capital stock of a prescribed corporation,

Subparagraph.Label: (i.1)
Subparagraph.Text: 200% of the cost to the corporation of the eligible investment at that time where the eligible investment is a property acquired by the corporation after February 16, 1999 (other than a property described in clause (i)(B)) that would be an eligible investment of the corporation if the reference to “$50,000,000” in paragraph (f) of the definition eligible investment in subsection 204.8(1) were read as “$2,500,000”, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: in any other case, the cost to the corporation of the eligible investment of the corporation at that time.

Subsection.Text: Where a corporation is liable under subsection 204.82(2) to pay a tax in respect of 12 consecutive months (in this subsection referred to as the “particular period”), the corporation shall pay a tax under this Part for a taxation year in respect of each particular period that ends in the year equal to the total of the amounts determined by the formula

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the total of the monthly deficiencies for each month in the particular period;

is the total of all taxes payable by the corporation under subsection 204.82(1) for preceding taxation years and taxes payable by it under this subsection in respect of a period ending before the end of the particular period; and
is the total of all amounts refunded under section 204.83 in respect of the tax paid under this subsection by the corporation for preceding taxation years.

Subsection.Text: Where a corporation is liable under subsection 204.82(3) to pay a tax for a taxation year, the corporation shall pay, in addition to the tax payable under that subsection, a penalty for the year equal to that tax.
Where

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: an amount (other than interest on an amount to which this subsection applies or an amount payable under or as a consequence of a prescribed provision of a law of a province) is payable to the government of a province by a corporation,

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the amount is payable as a consequence of a failure to acquire sufficient properties of a character described in the law of the province,

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: the corporation has been prescribed for the purpose of the definition approved share in subsection 127.4(1), and

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: the corporation is not a registered labour-sponsored venture capital corporation or a revoked corporation,

ContinuedSectionSubsection.Text: the corporation shall pay a tax under this Part for the taxation year in which the amount became payable equal to that amount.

Subsection.MarginalNote: Further matching of amounts payable to a province
Subsection.Text: Where

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: a particular amount is payable (other than interest on an amount to which this subsection applies) by a registered labour-sponsored venture capital corporation or a revoked corporation to the government of a province as a consequence of a failure of a prescribed corporation to acquire sufficient properties of a character described in a law of the province, and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the particular amount became payable before the corporation first discontinued its venture capital business,

ContinuedSectionSubsection.Text: the corporation shall pay a tax under this Part for the taxation year in which the particular amount became payable equal to that amount.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Subsection.Text: If a corporation is required, under subsections 204.82(3) and (4), to pay a tax and a penalty under this Part for a taxation year, it has no monthly deficiency throughout any period of 12 consecutive months (in this section referred to as the “second period”) that begins after the 12-month period in respect of which the tax became payable (in this section referred to as the “first period”) and it so requests in an application filed with the Minister in prescribed form, the Minister shall refund to it an amount equal to the total of the amount that was paid under subsection 204.82(3) and 80% of the amount that was paid under subsection 204.82(4) in respect of the first period on or before the later of

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the 30th day after receiving the application, and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the 60th day after the end of the second period.

Subsection.MarginalNote: Refunds of amounts payable to provinces
Subsection.Text: Where

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the government of a province refunds, at any time, an amount to a corporation,

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the refund is of an amount that had been paid in satisfaction of a particular amount payable in a taxation year of the corporation, and

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: tax was payable under subsection 204.82(5) or (6) by the corporation for a taxation year because the particular amount became payable,

ContinuedSectionSubsection.Text: the corporation is deemed to have paid at that time an amount equal to the refund on account of its tax payable under this Part for the year.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Section.Text: Every corporation that for a taxation year issues an information return described in paragraph 204.81(6)(c) in respect of

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the issuance of a share when the corporation was a revoked corporation, or

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: a subscription in respect of a share if the share is not issued on or before the day that is 180 days after the day the information return was issued,

ContinuedSectionSubsection.Text: is liable to a penalty for the year equal to the amount of the consideration for which the share was or was to be issued.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Section.MarginalNote: Penalty tax where venture capital business discontinued
Section.Text: Where, at a particular time in a taxation year, a particular corporation that is a registered labour-sponsored venture capital corporation or a revoked corporation first discontinues its venture capital business, the particular corporation shall pay a tax under this Part for the year equal to the total of all amounts each of which is the amount in respect of a Class A share of the capital stock of the particular corporation outstanding immediately before the particular time that is determined by the formula

FormulaDefinition.Text: is

FormulaParagraph.Label: (a)
FormulaParagraph.Text: if the original acquisition of the share was before March 6, 1996 and less than five years before the particular time, 4% of the consideration received by the particular corporation for the issue of the share,

FormulaParagraph.Label: (b)
FormulaParagraph.Text: if the original acquisition of the share was after March 5, 1996 and less than eight years before the particular time, 1.875% of the consideration received by the particular corporation for the issue of the share, and

FormulaParagraph.Label: (c)
FormulaParagraph.Text: in any other case, nil; and

FormulaDefinition.Text: is

FormulaParagraph.Label: (a)
FormulaParagraph.Text: if the original acquisition of the share was before March 6, 1996, the number obtained when the number of whole years throughout which the share was outstanding before the particular time is subtracted from five, and

FormulaParagraph.Label: (b)
FormulaParagraph.Text: in any other case, the number obtained when the number of whole years throughout which the share was outstanding is subtracted from eight.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Subsection.Text: A registered labour-sponsored venture capital corporation or a revoked corporation that has issued any Class A shares shall send written notification of any proposed amalgamation, merger, liquidation or dissolution of the corporation to the Minister at least 30 days before the amalgamation, merger, liquidation or dissolution, as the case may be.
Where

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: an amount (other than interest on an amount to which this subsection applies or an amount payable under or as a consequence of a prescribed provision of a law of a province) is payable to the government of a province by a corporation,

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the amount is payable as a consequence of the amalgamation or merger of the corporation with another corporation, the winding-up or dissolution of the corporation or the corporation ceasing to be registered under a law of the province,

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: the corporation has been prescribed for the purpose of the definition approved share in subsection 127.4(1), and

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: the corporation is not a registered labour-sponsored venture capital corporation or a revoked corporation,

ContinuedSectionSubsection.Text: the corporation shall pay a tax under this Part for the taxation year in which the amount became payable equal to that amount.

Subsection.Text: For the purposes of section 127.4, this Part and Part XII.5, where two or more corporations (each of which is referred to in this subsection as a “predecessor corporation”) amalgamate or merge to form one corporate entity (in this subsection referred to as the “new corporation”) and at least one of the predecessor corporations was, immediately before the amalgamation or merger, a registered labour-sponsored venture capital corporation or a revoked corporation,

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: subject to paragraphs (d) and (e), the new corporation is deemed to be the same corporation as, and a continuation of, each predecessor corporation;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: where a predecessor corporation was authorized to issue a class of shares to which clause 204.81(1)(c)(ii)(C) applies, the new corporation is deemed to have received approval from the Minister of Finance to issue substantially similar shares at the time of the amalgamation or merger;

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: where a share of a predecessor corporation (in this paragraph referred to as the “predecessor share”) is replaced on the amalgamation or merger by a new share of the new corporation,

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the new share

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: is deemed not to have been issued on the amalgamation or merger, and

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: is deemed to have been issued by the new corporation at the time the predecessor corporation issued the predecessor share, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: if the new share was issued to a person who acquired the predecessor share as a consequence of a transfer the registration of which by the predecessor corporation was permitted under paragraph 204.81(1)(c), the issuance of the new share is deemed to be in compliance with the conditions described in paragraph 204.81(1)(c);

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: the Minister is deemed to have registered the new corporation for the purposes of this Part unless

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the new corporation is not governed by the Canada Business Corporations Act,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: one or more of the predecessor corporations was a registered labour-sponsored venture capital corporation the venture capital business of which was discontinued before the amalgamation or merger,

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: one or more of the predecessor corporations was, immediately before the amalgamation or merger, a revoked corporation,

Subparagraph.Label: (iv)
Subparagraph.Text: immediately after the amalgamation or merger, the articles of the new corporation do not comply with paragraph 204.81(1)(c),

Subparagraph.Label: (v)
Subparagraph.Text: shares other than Class A shares of the capital stock of the new corporation were issued to any shareholder of the new corporation in satisfaction of any share (other than a share to which clause 204.81(1)(c)(ii)(B) or (C) applied) of a predecessor corporation,

Subparagraph.Label: (vi)
Subparagraph.Text: immediately before the amalgamation or merger, one or more of the predecessor corporations is a corporation that has given notification under subsection 204.81(8.3) and one or more of the predecessor corporations is a registered labour-sponsored venture capital corporation that has not given notification under that subsection;

Paragraph.Label: (e)
Paragraph.Text: where paragraph (d) does not apply, the new corporation is deemed to be a revoked corporation;

Paragraph.Label: (f)
Paragraph.Text: subsection 204.82(1) does not apply to the new corporation; and

Paragraph.Label: (g)
Paragraph.Text: subsection 204.82(2) shall, in its application to the new corporation, be read without reference to the words “that begins after the end of the corporation’s start-up period (or, where the corporation has no start-up period, that begins after the time the corporation first issues a Class A share)”.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Section.MarginalNote: Return and payment of tax for federally-registered LSVCCs

Subsection.Text: Every registered labour-sponsored venture capital corporation and every revoked corporation shall

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: on or before its filing-due date for a taxation year, file with the Minister a return for the year under this Part in prescribed form and containing prescribed information, without notice or demand therefor;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: estimate in the return the amount of tax and penalties, if any, payable under this Part by it for the year; and

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: on or before its balance-due day for the year, pay to the Receiver General the amount of tax and penalties, if any, payable under this Part by it for the year.

Subsection.MarginalNote: Return and payment of tax for other LSVCCs
Subsection.Text: Where tax is payable under this Part for a taxation year by a corporation because of subsection 204.82(5) or 204.85(2), the corporation shall

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: on or before its filing-due date for the year, file with the Minister a return for the year under this Part in prescribed form and containing prescribed information, without notice or demand therefor;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: estimate in the return the amount of tax payable under this Part by it for the year; and

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: on or before its balance-due day for the year, pay to the Receiver General the amount of tax payable under this Part by it for the year.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Section.Text: Subsection 150(3), sections 152 and 158, subsections 161(1) and 161(11), sections 162 to 164 and 165 to 167, Division J of Part I and section 227.1 apply to this Part, with such modifications as the circumstances require.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Heading.Label: PART X.4
Heading.TitleText: Tax in Respect of Overpayments to Registered Education Savings Plans

Subsection.Text: The definitions in this subsection apply in this Part.

Definition.Text: excess amount for a year at any time in respect of an individual means

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: for years before 2007, the amount, if any, by which the total of all contributions made after February 20, 1990 in the year and before that time into all registered education savings plans by or on behalf of all subscribers in respect of the individual exceeds the lesser of

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the RESP annual limit for the year, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the amount, if any, by which the RESP lifetime limit for the year exceeds the total of all contributions made into registered education savings plans by or on behalf of all subscribers in respect of the individual in all preceding years; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: for years after 2006, the amount, if any, by which the total of all contributions made in the year and before that time into all registered education savings plans by or on behalf of all subscribers in respect of the individual exceeds the amount, if any, by which

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the RESP lifetime limit for the year

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the total of all contributions made into registered education savings plans by or on behalf of all subscribers in respect of the individual in all preceding years. (excédent)

Definition.Text: RESP lifetime limit for a year means

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: for 2007 and subsequent years, $50,000. (plafond cumulatif de REEE)

Definition.Text: subscriber’s gross cumulative excess at any time in respect of an individual means the total of all amounts each of which is the subscriber’s share of the excess amount for a relevant year at that time in respect of the individual and, for the purpose of this definition, a relevant year at any time is a year that began before that time. (excédent cumulatif brut du souscripteur)
subscriber’s share of the excess amount for a year at any time in respect of an individual means the amount determined by the formula

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the total of all contributions made after February 20, 1990, in the year and before that time into all registered education savings plans by or on behalf of the subscriber in respect of the individual;

is the total of all contributions made after February 20, 1990, in the year and before that time into all registered education savings plans by or on behalf of all subscribers in respect of the individual; and
is the excess amount for the year at that time in respect of the individual. (part du souscripteur sur l’excédent)

Subsection.Text: The definitions in subsection 146.1(1) apply to this Part.

Where a subscriber is required, pursuant to an agreement in writing entered into before February 21, 1990, to make payments of specified amounts on a periodic basis into a registered education savings plan in respect of a beneficiary, and the subscriber makes at least one payment under the agreement before that day,

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the excess amount for a year in respect of the beneficiary shall be deemed not to exceed the excess amount for the year that would be determined under subsection 204.9(1) if the total of all such payments made in the year and, where the agreement so provides, amounts paid in the year in satisfaction of the requirement to make such payments under all such agreements by all such subscribers in respect of the beneficiary were equal to the lesser of the amounts described in paragraphs (a) and (b) of the definition excess amount in subsection 204.9(1); and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: in determining a subscriber’s share of an excess amount for a year, any payment included in the total described in paragraph 204.9(2)(a) in respect of the year shall be excluded in determining the values for A and B in the definition subscriber’s share of the excess amount in subsection 204.9(1).

Subsection.Text: For the purposes of subsection 204.9(1) and section 146.1, where an individual entered into an education savings plan before February 21, 1990, pursuant to a preliminary prospectus issued by a promoter, and the promoter refunds all payments made into the plan and all income accrued thereon to the individual, each payment made by the individual into a registered education savings plan before December 31, 1990 shall be deemed to be a payment made before February 21, 1990, to the extent that the total of all such payments does not exceed the amount so refunded to the individual.

For the purposes of this Part, if at any particular time an individual (in this subsection referred to as the “new beneficiary”) becomes a beneficiary under a registered education savings plan in place of another individual (in this subsection referred to as the “former beneficiary”) who ceased at or before the particular time to be a beneficiary under the plan,

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: except as provided by paragraph 204.9(4)(b), each contribution made at an earlier time by or on behalf of a subscriber into the plan in respect of the former beneficiary is deemed also to have been made at that earlier time in respect of the new beneficiary;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: except for the purpose of applying this subsection to a replacement of a beneficiary after the particular time, applying subsection (5) to a distribution after the particular time and applying subsection 204.91(3) to events after the particular time, paragraph (a) does not apply as a consequence of the replacement at the particular time of the former beneficiary if

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the new beneficiary had not attained 21 years of age before the particular time and a parent of the new beneficiary was a parent of the former beneficiary, or

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: both beneficiaries were connected by blood relationship or adoption to an original subscriber under the plan and neither had attained 21 years of age before the particular time; and

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: except where paragraph 204.9(4)(b) applies, each contribution made by or on behalf of a subscriber under the plan in respect of the former beneficiary under the plan is, without affecting the determination of the amount withdrawn from the plan in respect of the new beneficiary, deemed to have been withdrawn at the particular time from the plan to the extent that it was not withdrawn before the particular time.

Subsection.Text: For the purposes of this Part, if property held by a trust governed by a registered education savings plan (in this subsection referred to as the “transferor plan”) is distributed at a particular time to a trust governed by another registered education savings plan (in this subsection referred to as the “transferee plan”),

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: except as provided by paragraphs 204.9(5)(b) and 204.9(5)(c), the amount of the distribution is deemed not to have been contributed into the transferee plan;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: subject to paragraph 204.9(5)(c), each contribution made at any earlier time by or on behalf of a subscriber into the transferor plan in respect of a beneficiary under the transferor plan is deemed also to have been made at that earlier time by the subscriber in respect of each beneficiary under the transferee plan;

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: except for the purpose of applying this subsection to a distribution after the particular time, applying subsection 204.9(4) to a replacement of a beneficiary after the particular time and applying subsection 204.91(3) to events after the particular time, paragraph 204.9(5)(b) does not apply as a consequence of the distribution where

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: any beneficiary under the transferee plan was, immediately before the particular time, a beneficiary under the transferor plan, or

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: a parent of a beneficiary under the transferee plan was a parent of an individual who was, immediately before the particular time, a beneficiary under the transferor plan and

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: the transferee plan is a plan that allows more than one beneficiary under the plan at any one time, or

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: in any other case, the beneficiary under the transferee plan had not attained 21 years of age at the time the transferee plan was entered into;

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: where subparagraph 204.9(5)(c)(i) or 204.9(5)(c)(ii) applies in respect of the distribution, the amount of the distribution is deemed not to have been withdrawn from the transferor plan; and

Paragraph.Label: (e)
Paragraph.Text: each subscriber under the transferor plan is deemed to be a subscriber under the transferee plan.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Subsection.Text: Every subscriber under a registered education savings plan shall pay a tax under this Part in respect of each month equal to 1% of the amount, if any, by which

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the total of all amounts each of which is the subscriber’s gross cumulative excess at the end of the month in respect of an individual

ContinuedSectionSubsection.Text: exceeds

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the total of all amounts each of which is the portion of such an excess that has been withdrawn from a registered education savings plan before the end of the month.

Subsection.Text: If a subscriber under a registered education savings plan would, but for this subsection, be required to pay a tax in respect of a month under subsection 204.91(1) in respect of an individual, the Minister may waive or cancel all or part of the tax where it is just and equitable to do so having regard to all the circumstances, including

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: whether the tax arose as a consequence of reasonable error;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: whether, as a consequence of one or more transactions or events to which subsection 204.9(4) or 204.9(5) applies, the tax is excessive; and

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: the extent to which further contributions could be made into registered education savings plans in respect of the individual before the end of the month without causing additional tax to be payable under this Part if this Part were read without reference to this subsection.

Subsection.Text: If at any time an individual (in this subsection referred to as the “former subscriber”) ceases to be a subscriber under a registered education savings plan as a consequence of the settlement of rights arising out of, or on the breakdown of, the marriage or common-law partnership of the former subscriber and another individual (in this subsection referred to as the “current subscriber”) who is a subscriber under the plan immediately after that time, for the purpose of determining tax payable under this Part in respect of a month that ends after that time, each contribution made before that time into the plan by or on behalf of the former subscriber is deemed to have been made into the plan by the current subscriber and not by or on behalf of the former subscriber.

For the purpose of applying this section where a subscriber has died, the subscriber’s estate is deemed to be the same person as, and a continuation of, the subscriber for each month that ends after the death.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Section.Text: Every person who is liable to pay tax under this Part in respect of a month in a year shall, within 90 days after the end of the year,

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: file with the Minister a return for the year under this Part in prescribed form and containing prescribed information, without notice or demand therefor;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: estimate in the return the amount of tax, if any, payable under this Part by the person in respect of each month in the year; and

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: pay to the Receiver General the amount of tax, if any, payable by the person under this Part in respect of each month in the year.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Section.Text: Subsections 150(2) and 150(3), sections 152, 158 and 159, subsections 161(1) and 161(11), sections 162 to 167 and Division J of Part I are applicable to this Part, with such modifications as the circumstances require.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Heading.Label: PART X.5
Heading.TitleText: Payments Under Registered Education Savings Plans

Subsection.Text: The definitions in subsection 146.1(1) apply for the purposes of this Part, except that the definition subscriber in that subsection shall be read without reference to paragraph (c).
Every person (other than a public primary caregiver that is exempt from tax under Part I) shall pay a tax under this Part for each taxation year equal to the amount determined by the formula

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the total of all amounts each of which is an accumulated income payment made at any time that is

FormulaParagraph.Label: (a)
FormulaParagraph.Text: either

FormulaParagraph.Label: (i)
FormulaParagraph.Text: under a registered education savings plan under which the person is a subscriber at that time, or

FormulaParagraph.Label: (ii)
FormulaParagraph.Text: under a registered education savings plan under which there is no subscriber at that time, where the person has been a spouse or common-law partner of an individual who was a subscriber under the plan, and

FormulaParagraph.Label: (b)
FormulaParagraph.Text: included in computing the person’s income under Part I for the year;

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the total of all amounts each of which is an accumulated income payment that is

FormulaParagraph.Label: (a)
FormulaParagraph.Text: not included in the value of A in respect of the person for the year, and

FormulaParagraph.Label: (b)
FormulaParagraph.Text: included in computing the person’s income under Part I for the year;

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the lesser of

FormulaParagraph.Label: (a)
FormulaParagraph.Text: the lesser of the value of A in respect of the person for the year and the total of all amounts each of which is an amount deducted under subsection 146(5) or 146(5.1) in computing the person’s income under Part I for the year, and

FormulaParagraph.Label: (b)
FormulaParagraph.Text: the amount, if any, by which $50,000 exceeds the total of all amounts each of which is an amount determined under paragraph (a) in respect of the person for a preceding taxation year; and

FormulaDefinition.Text: is

FormulaParagraph.Label: (a)
FormulaParagraph.Text: where a tax, similar to the tax provided under this Part, is payable by the person for the year under a law of the province of Quebec, 12%, and

FormulaParagraph.Label: (b)
FormulaParagraph.Text: in any other case, 20%.

Subsection.Text: Every person who is liable to pay tax under this Part for a taxation year shall, on or before the person’s filing-due date for the year,

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: file with the Minister a return for the year under this Part in prescribed form and containing prescribed information, without notice or demand therefor;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: estimate in the return the amount of tax payable under this Part by the person for the year; and

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: pay to the Receiver General the amount of tax payable under this Part by the person for the year.

Subsection.Text: Subsections 150(2) and 150(3), sections 152, 155 to 156.1 and 158 to 167 and Division J of Part I apply with any modifications that the circumstances require.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Heading.Label: PART XI
Heading.TitleText: Tax in Respect of Advanced Life Deferred Annuity

Subsection.Text: The following definitions apply in this section.

Definition.Text: ALDA dollar limit, for a calendar year, means

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: for each year after 2020, the amount (rounded to the nearest multiple of $10,000, or if that amount is equidistant from two such consecutive multiples, to the higher multiple) that is equal to $150,000 adjusted for each year after 2020 in the manner set out in section 117.1. (plafond de la RVDAA)

Definition.Text: cumulative excess amount, of an individual at any particular time in a calendar year, means the amount determined by the formula

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the greater of

FormulaParagraph.Label: (a)
FormulaParagraph.Text: the total of all amounts each of which is an excess ALDA transfer of the individual at or before the particular time, and

FormulaParagraph.Label: (b)
FormulaParagraph.Text: the amount determined by the formula

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the total of all amounts each of which is the amount of a transfer at or before the particular time to acquire an advanced life deferred annuity on behalf of the individual, and
is the ALDA dollar limit for the calendar year; and

is the total of all amounts each of which is the amount of a refund described in paragraph (g) of the definition advanced life deferred annuity in subsection 146.5(1) made at or before the particular time on behalf of the individual. (excédent cumulatif)

Definition.Text: excess ALDA transfer, of an individual, means the portion of the amount of a transfer, made from a transferor plan under any of subsections 146(16) and 146.3(14.1) and paragraphs 147(19)(d), 147.3(1)(c) and 147.5(21)(c) to acquire an advanced life deferred annuity on behalf of the individual, determined by the formula

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the amount of the transfer; and
is the amount determined by the formula

is the total value of the property held for the benefit of the individual under the transferor plan at the end of the calendar year preceding the calendar year in which the transfer is made, other than

FormulaParagraph.Label: (a)
FormulaParagraph.Text: if the transferor plan is a registered pension plan, property held in connection with

FormulaParagraph.Label: (i)
FormulaParagraph.Text: a defined benefit provision (as defined in subsection 147.1(1)) of the transferor plan, or

FormulaParagraph.Label: (ii)
FormulaParagraph.Text: a VPLA fund, as described in subsection 8506(13) of the Income Tax Regulations,

FormulaParagraph.Label: (b)
FormulaParagraph.Text: if the transferor plan is a pooled registered pension plan, property held in connection with benefits that would be described in paragraph 147.5(5)(a) if the reference in that paragraph to “8506(1)(e.1) or (e.2)” were read as a reference to “8506(1)(e.2)”,

FormulaParagraph.Label: (c)
FormulaParagraph.Text: if the transferor plan is a registered retirement income fund, contracts for annuities held in connection with the fund other than annuities described in paragraph (b.1) of the definition qualified investment in subsection 146.3(1), and

FormulaParagraph.Label: (d)
FormulaParagraph.Text: if the transferor plan is a registered retirement savings plan, contracts for annuities held in connection with the plan other than annuities described in paragraph (c.1) of the definition qualified investment in subsection 146(1),

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the total of all amounts each of which is the amount transferred from the transferor plan, in a calendar year preceding the calendar year in which the transfer is made, to acquire an advanced life deferred annuity on behalf of the individual, and

is the total of all amounts each of which is the amount of a previous transfer from the transferor plan to acquire an advanced life deferred annuity on behalf of the individual. (excédent de transfert au titre de la RVDAA)

Subsection.Text: If at the end of any month an individual has a cumulative excess amount, the individual shall, in respect of that month, pay a tax under this Part equal to 1% of that cumulative excess amount.

If an individual would, but for this subsection, be required to pay a tax under subsection (2) in respect of a month, the Minister may waive or cancel all or part of the tax if the individual establishes to the satisfaction of the Minister that

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the cumulative excess amount on which the tax is based arose as a consequence of reasonable error; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: reasonable steps are being taken to eliminate the cumulative excess amount.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Subsection.Text: Every person who is liable to pay tax under this Part for all or part of a calendar year shall,

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: on or before the person’s filing-due date for the year, file with the Minister a return for the year under this Part in prescribed form and containing prescribed information, without notice or demand; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: on or before the person’s balance-due day for the year, pay to the Receiver General the amount of tax payable under this Part by the person for the year.

Subsection.Text: Subsections 150(2) and (3), sections 152 and 158 to 167 and Division J of Part I apply with any modifications that the circumstances require.

Heading.Label: PART XI.01
Heading.TitleText: Taxes in Respect of Registered Plans

Subsection.Text: The following definitions and the definitions in subsections 146(1) (other than the definition benefit), 146.1(1), 146.2(1), 146.3(1), 146.4(1) and 146.6(1) apply in this Part and Part XLIX of the Income Tax Regulations.

Definition.Text: advantage, in relation to a registered plan, means

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: any benefit, loan or indebtedness that is conditional in any way on the existence of the registered plan, other than

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: a benefit derived from the provision of administrative or investment services in respect of the registered plan,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: a loan or an indebtedness (including, in the case of a TFSA, a loan or an indebtedness in respect of which the conditions in subsection 146.2(4) or (4.1) are met) the terms and conditions of which are terms and conditions that persons dealing at arm’s length with each other would have entered into,

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: a payment out of or under the registered plan in satisfaction of all or part of a beneficiary’s or controlling individual’s interest in the registered plan,

Subparagraph.Label: (iv)
Subparagraph.Text: the payment or allocation of any amount to the registered plan by the issuer, carrier or promoter,

Subparagraph.Label: (iv.1)
Subparagraph.Text: an amount paid under or because of the Canada Disability Savings Act, the Canada Education Savings Act or under a designated provincial program, and

Subparagraph.Label: (v)
Subparagraph.Text: a benefit provided under an incentive program that is — in a normal commercial or investment context in which parties deal with each other at arm’s length and act prudently, knowledgeably and willingly — offered to a broad class of persons, if it is reasonable to conclude that none of the main purposes of the program is to enable a person or partnership to benefit from the exemption from tax under Part I of any amount in respect of the plan;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: a benefit that is an increase in the total fair market value of the property held in connection with the registered plan if it is reasonable to consider, having regard to all the circumstances, that the increase is attributable, directly or indirectly, to

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: a transaction or event or a series of transactions or events (other than a payment, not exceeding a reasonable amount, by the controlling individual of the registered plan where the payment would be described by paragraph 20(1)(bb) if the reference to “the taxpayer” in subparagraph (i) of that paragraph were read as a reference to “a controlling individual of a registered plan” and if the references to “the taxpayer” in subparagraph (ii) of that paragraph were read as references to “the registered plan”) that

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: would not have occurred in a normal commercial or investment context in which parties deal with each other at arm’s length and act prudently, knowledgeably and willingly, and

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: had as one of its main purposes to enable a person or a partnership to benefit from the exemption from tax under Part I of any amount in respect of the registered plan,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: a payment received as, on account or in lieu of, or in satisfaction of, a payment

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: for services provided by a person who is, or who does not deal at arm’s length with, the controlling individual of the registered plan, or

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: of interest, of a dividend, of rent, of a royalty or of any other return on investment, or of proceeds of disposition, in respect of property (other than property held in connection with the registered plan) held by a person who is, or who does not deal at arm’s length with, the controlling individual of the registered plan,

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: a swap transaction, or

Subparagraph.Label: (iv)
Subparagraph.Text: specified non-qualified investment income that has not been paid from the registered plan to its controlling individual within 90 days of receipt by the controlling individual of a notice issued by the Minister under subsection 207.06(4);

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: a benefit that is income (determined without reference to paragraph 82(1)(b)), or a capital gain, that is reasonably attributable, directly or indirectly, to

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: a prohibited investment in respect of the registered plan or any other registered plan of the controlling individual,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: in the case of a registered plan that is not a TFSA, an amount received by the controlling individual of the registered plan, or by a person who does not deal at arm’s length with the controlling individual (if it is reasonable to consider, having regard to all the circumstances, that the amount was paid in relation to, or would not have been paid but for, property held in connection with the registered plan) and the amount was paid as, on account or in lieu of, or in satisfaction of, a payment

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: for services provided by a person who is, or who does not deal at arm’s length with, the controlling individual of the registered plan, or

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: of interest, of a dividend, of rent, of a royalty or of any other return on investment, or of proceeds of disposition, or

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: a deliberate over-contribution;

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: a registered plan strip in respect of the registered plan; and

Paragraph.Label: (e)
Paragraph.Text: a prescribed benefit. (avantage)

Definition.Text: allowable refund of a person for a calendar year means the total of all amounts each of which is a refund, for the year, to which the person is entitled under subsection 207.04(4). (remboursement admissible)
controlling individual, of a registered plan, means

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the holder of a TFSA;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: a holder of a RDSP;

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: a subscriber of a RESP;

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: the annuitant of a RRIF or RRSP; or

Paragraph.Label: (e)
Paragraph.Text: the holder of a FHSA. (particulier contrôlant)

Definition.Text: deliberate over-contribution of an individual means a contribution made under a TFSA by the individual that results in, or increases, an excess TFSA amount, unless it is reasonable to conclude that the individual neither knew nor ought to have known that the contribution could result in liability for a penalty, tax or similar consequence under this Act. (cotisation excédentaire intentionnelle)
designated amount of an individual means an amount, not exceeding the excess FHSA amount of the individual, designated by the individual in the prescribed form and manner that is

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: a transfer in accordance with subparagraph 146.‍6(7)‍(b)‍(ii), to the extent that it does not exceed the total of all amounts transferred under paragraph 146(16)‍(a.‍2) to a FHSA under which the individual is the holder on or before the date of the designation less the total of all amounts previously designated under this paragraph; or

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: a withdrawal from a FHSA under which the individual is the holder, to the extent that it does not exceed the total of all amounts contributed to a FHSA under which the individual is the holder on or before the date of the designation less the total of all amounts previously designated under this paragraph. (montant désigné)

Definition.Text: equity, of a corporation, trust or partnership, means

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: in the case of a corporation, a share of the capital stock of the corporation;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: in the case of a trust, an income or capital interest in the trust; and

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: in the case of a partnership, an interest as a member of the partnership. (droit sur l’actif)

Definition.Text: excess FHSA amount of an individual at a particular time in a taxation year means

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the amount determined by the formula

Formula.FormulaText: A + B + C − D − E − F

FormulaDefinition.Text: is

FormulaParagraph.Label: (i)
FormulaParagraph.Text: nil, if the individual had not started their maximum participation period in the preceding taxation year, and

FormulaParagraph.Label: (ii)
FormulaParagraph.Text: the individual’s excess FHSA amount determined at the end of the immediately preceding taxation year, in any other case;

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the total of all amounts each of which is a contribution made to a FHSA by the individual in the taxation year at or before the particular time;
is the total of all amounts transferred in the taxation year under paragraph 146(16)(a.2), at or before the particular time, to a FHSA under which the individual is the holder;
is the lesser of

FormulaParagraph.Label: (i)
FormulaParagraph.Text: $8,000 plus an amount that would have been the individual’s FHSA carryforward for the taxation year if each amount that was included in that individual’s income under subsection 146.6(6) and could have been, immediately prior to the time it was received, a designated amount, had been designated by the individual as a designated amount, and

FormulaParagraph.Label: (ii)
FormulaParagraph.Text: the amount determined by the formula

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the total of all amounts that were deducted, could have been deducted or would have been deductible by the individual under subsection 146.6(5) in respect of all preceding taxation years if

FormulaParagraph.Label: (A)
FormulaParagraph.Text: no amounts were transferred under paragraph 146(16)(a.2) to a FHSA of the individual, and

FormulaParagraph.Label: (B)
FormulaParagraph.Text: notwithstanding clause (A), an amount had been contributed by the individual to a FHSA in each preceding taxation year that is the amount by which the individual’s net RRSP-to-FHSA transfer amount at the end of that year exceeds the individual’s net RRSP-to-FHSA transfer amount at the start of that year;

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the total of all amounts each of which is a designated amount in respect of a transfer or withdrawal made by the individual in the taxation year before the particular time or an amount required to be included in computing the income of the individual under subsection 146.6(6) in the taxation year before the particular time; and

is the total of all amounts, each of which is the portion of an amount required to be included in computing the income of the individual under subsection 146.6(6) in any preceding taxation year, to the extent that it did not reduce what otherwise would have been the individual’s excess FHSA amount in any preceding taxation year; or

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: where the Minister determines that the formula in paragraph (a) does not yield an appropriate result having regard to the circumstances of the individual, a lower amount that, in the Minister’s opinion, is appropriate in the circumstances. (excédent de CELIAPP)

Definition.Text: excess TFSA amount of an individual at a particular time in a calendar year means the amount, if any, determined by the formula

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the total of all amounts each of which is a contribution made under a TFSA by the individual in the calendar year and at or before the particular time, other than a contribution that is

FormulaParagraph.Label: (a)
FormulaParagraph.Text: a qualifying transfer, or

FormulaParagraph.Label: (b)
FormulaParagraph.Text: an exempt contribution;

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the individual’s unused TFSA contribution room at the end of the preceding calendar year;

is the total of all amounts each of which was a distribution made in the preceding calendar year under a TFSA of which the individual was the holder at the time of the distribution, other than a distribution that is

FormulaParagraph.Label: (a)
FormulaParagraph.Text: a qualifying transfer, or

FormulaParagraph.Label: (b)
FormulaParagraph.Text: a specified distribution;

FormulaDefinition.Text: is

FormulaParagraph.Label: (a)
FormulaParagraph.Text: the TFSA dollar limit for the calendar year if, at any time in the calendar year, the individual is resident in Canada, and

FormulaParagraph.Label: (b)
FormulaParagraph.Text: nil, in any other case; and

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the total of all amounts each of which is the qualifying portion of a distribution made in the calendar year and at or before the particular time under a TFSA of which the individual was the holder at the time of the distribution and, for this purpose, the qualifying portion of a distribution is

FormulaParagraph.Label: (a)
FormulaParagraph.Text: nil, if the distribution is a qualifying transfer or a specified distribution, and

FormulaParagraph.Label: (b)
FormulaParagraph.Text: in any other case, the lesser of

FormulaParagraph.Label: (i)
FormulaParagraph.Text: the amount of the distribution, and

FormulaParagraph.Label: (ii)
FormulaParagraph.Text: the amount that would be the individual’s excess TFSA amount at the time of the distribution if the amount of the distribution were nil. (excédent CÉLI)

Definition.Text: excluded property, at any time for a trust governed by a registered plan, means

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: property described in paragraph 4900(1)(j.1) of the Income Tax Regulations;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: an equity of a mutual fund corporation, mutual fund trust or registered investment if

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: either

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: the equity is equity of a mutual fund corporation or mutual fund trust that derives all or substantially all its value from one or more mutual funds that are subject to, and substantially comply with, the requirements of National Instrument 81–102 Mutual Funds, as amended from time to time, of the Canadian Securities Administrators, or

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: the corporation, trust or registered investment follows a reasonable policy of investment diversification,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the time is

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: during the 24-month period that begins on the day on which the first taxation year of the corporation, trust or registered investment begins,

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: during the 24-month period that ends on the day on which the last taxation year of the corporation, trust or registered investment ends, or

Clause.Label: (C)
Clause.Text: where the equity is a share of the capital stock of a mutual fund corporation and the share derives all or substantially all its value from a particular mutual fund,

Subclause.Label: (I)
Subclause.Text: during the 24-month period that begins on the day on which the particular mutual fund is established, or

Subclause.Label: (II)
Subclause.Text: during the 24-month period that ends on the day on which the particular mutual fund is terminated,

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: it is reasonable to conclude that none of the main purposes of the structure of the corporation, trust or registered investment, or of the terms and conditions of the equity, is to accommodate transactions or events that could affect the fair market value of the property held by the trust governed by the registered plan in a manner that would not occur in a normal commercial or investment context in which parties deal with each other at arm’s length and act prudently, knowledgeably and willingly, and

Subparagraph.Label: (iv)
Subparagraph.Text: it is reasonable to conclude that none of the main purposes of the incorporation, establishment or operation of the corporation, trust or registered investment, or of the particular mutual fund, is to benefit from this paragraph; or

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: equity of a corporation, partnership or trust (in this paragraph referred to as the “investment entity”) if at that time

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the fair market value of the equity (in this paragraph referred to as the “arm’s length equity”) of the investment entity that is owned by persons who deal at arm’s length with the controlling individual of the registered plan is at least 90% of the fair market value of all the equity of the investment entity,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the total fair market value of the arm’s length equity and the debt of the investment entity that is owned by persons who deal at arm’s length with the controlling individual is at least 90% of the total fair market value of all the equity and debt of the investment entity,

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: the controlling individual, either alone or together with persons with whom the controlling individual does not deal at arm’s length, does not have the right to cast at least 10% of the votes, if any, that could be cast regarding the governance of the investment entity,

Subparagraph.Label: (iv)
Subparagraph.Text: the specific terms and conditions of each share or unit of equity of the investment entity held by the trust governed by the registered plan are the same as, or substantially similar to, the terms and conditions of particular equity that is included in the arm’s length equity,

Subparagraph.Label: (v)
Subparagraph.Text: the fair market value of the particular equity referred to in subparagraph (iv) is equal to at least 10% of the total fair market value of all equity of the investment entity having the specific terms and conditions referred to in subparagraph (iv) or terms and conditions that are substantially similar to those terms and conditions,

Subparagraph.Label: (vi)
Subparagraph.Text: the controlling individual deals at arm’s length with the investment entity, and

Subparagraph.Label: (vii)
