Paragraph.Text: for greater certainty, all amounts payable by the taxpayer under this Act in respect of the particular taxation year are to be paid in Canadian currency.

Subsection.MarginalNote: Application of subsections (7) and (8) to reversionary years
Subsection.Text: In applying this Act to a reversionary year of a taxpayer, subsections (7) and (8) are to be read as if the references in those subsections to

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: “Canadian currency” were references to “the taxpayer’s elected functional currency”;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: “Canadian currency year” were references to “functional currency year”;

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: “functional currency year” were references to “reversionary year”;

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: “first functional currency year” were references to “first reversionary year”;

Paragraph.Label: (e)
Paragraph.Text: “last Canadian currency year” were references to “last functional currency year”;

Paragraph.Label: (f)
Paragraph.Text: “pre-transition debt” were references to “pre-reversion debt”; and

Paragraph.Label: (g)
Paragraph.Text: “the taxpayer’s elected functional currency” were references to “Canadian currency”.

Subsection.Text: A pre-reversion debt of a taxpayer that is denominated in a currency other than Canadian currency is deemed to have been issued immediately before the taxpayer’s first reversionary year for the purposes of

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: determining the amount of the taxpayer’s income, gain or loss, for a reversionary year of the taxpayer (other than an amount that subsection (14) deems to arise), that is attributable to a fluctuation in the value of a currency; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: applying paragraph 80(2)(k) in respect of a reversionary year of the taxpayer.

Subsection.MarginalNote: Deferred amounts relating to pre-reversion debts
Subsection.Text: If a taxpayer has, at any time in a reversionary year of the taxpayer, made a particular payment on account of the principal amount of a pre-reversion debt of the taxpayer:

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: where the taxpayer would have made a gain — or, if the pre-reversion debt was not on account of capital, would have had income — (referred to in this paragraph as the “hypothetical gain or income”) attributable to a fluctuation in the value of a currency if the pre-reversion debt had been settled by the taxpayer’s having paid, immediately before the end of its last functional currency year, an amount equal to the principal amount (expressed in the currency in which the pre-reversion debt is denominated, which currency is referred to in this subsection as the “debt currency”) at that time, the taxpayer is deemed to make a gain or to have income, as the case may be, for the reversionary year equal to the amount determined by the formula

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the amount of the hypothetical gain or income converted to Canadian currency using the relevant spot rate for the last day of the taxpayer’s last functional currency year,
is the amount of the particular payment (expressed in the debt currency), and
is the principal amount of the pre-reversion debt at the beginning of the taxpayer’s first reversionary year (expressed in the debt currency); and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: where the taxpayer would have sustained a loss — or, if the pre-reversion debt was not on account of capital, would have had a loss — (referred to in this paragraph as the “hypothetical loss”) attributable to a fluctuation in the value of a currency if the pre-reversion debt had been settled by the taxpayer’s having paid, immediately before the end of its last functional currency year, an amount equal to the principal amount (expressed in the debt currency) at that time, the taxpayer is deemed to sustain or to have a loss in respect of the particular payment for the reversionary year equal to the amount that would be determined by the formula in paragraph (a) if the reference in the description of A in that paragraph to “hypothetical gain or income” were read as a reference to “hypothetical loss”.

Subsection.Text: For the purposes of determining a taxpayer’s gain under subsection (14), if at a particular time a pre-reversion debt of the taxpayer (referred to in this subsection as the debtor) that is denominated in a currency other than the taxpayer’s elected functional currency becomes a parked obligation (within the meaning assigned by subsection 39(2.02)), the debtor is deemed to have made, at that time, a particular payment on account of the principal amount of the debt equal to

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: if the debt has become a parked obligation at that particular time as a result of its acquisition by the holder of the debt, the portion of the amount paid by the holder to acquire the debt that can reasonably be considered to relate to the principal amount of the debt at the particular time; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: in any other case, the portion of the fair market value of the debt that can reasonably be considered to relate to the principal amount of the debt at the particular time.

Subsection.Text: For the purposes of determining the amount that may be deducted, in respect of a particular amount that arises in a taxation year (referred to in this subsection as the “later year”) of a taxpayer, under section 111 or subsection 126(2), 127(5), 181.1(4) or 190.1(3) in computing the taxpayer’s Canadian tax results for a taxation year (referred to in this subsection as the “current year”) that ended before the later year, and for the purposes of determining the amount by which the amount included under subsection 91(1) for the current year is reduced because of a reduction referred to in paragraph 152(6.1)(b) in respect of the later year,

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: if the later year is a functional currency year of the taxpayer and the current year is a Canadian currency year of the taxpayer, the following amounts (expressed in the taxpayer’s elected functional currency) are to be converted to Canadian currency using the relevant spot rate for the last day of the taxpayer’s last Canadian currency year:

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the particular amount, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: any amount so deducted in computing the taxpayer’s Canadian tax results for another functional currency year of the taxpayer;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: if the later year is a reversionary year of the taxpayer and the current year is a functional currency year of the taxpayer,

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the following amounts (expressed in Canadian currency) are to be converted to the taxpayer’s elected functional currency using the relevant spot rate for the last day of the taxpayer’s last functional currency year:

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: the particular amount, and

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: any amount so deducted in computing the taxpayer’s Canadian tax results for another reversionary year of the taxpayer, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: any amount (expressed in Canadian currency) so deducted in computing the taxpayer’s Canadian tax results for a Canadian currency year of the taxpayer is to be converted to the taxpayer’s elected functional currency using the relevant spot rate for the last day of the taxpayer’s last Canadian currency year;

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: if the later year is a reversionary year of the taxpayer and the current year is a Canadian currency year of the taxpayer, the following amounts (expressed in the taxpayer’s elected functional currency) are to be converted to Canadian currency using the relevant spot rate for the last day of the taxpayer’s last Canadian currency year:

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the amount that would be determined under clause (b)(i)(A) in respect of the particular amount if the current year were a functional currency year of the taxpayer, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: any amount so deducted in computing the taxpayer’s Canadian tax results for a functional currency year of the taxpayer; and

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: in any other case, this subsection does not apply.

Subsection.Text: If a winding-up described in subsection 88(1) commences at any time (referred to in this subsection as the “commencement time”) and the parent and the subsidiary referred to in that subsection would, in the absence of this subsection, have different tax reporting currencies at the commencement time, the following rules apply for the purposes of determining the subsidiary’s Canadian tax results for its taxation years that end after the commencement time:

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: where the subsidiary’s tax reporting currency is Canadian currency,

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: notwithstanding subsection (3), subsection (5) is deemed to apply to the subsidiary in respect of its taxation year that includes the commencement time and each of its subsequent taxation years, if any,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the subsidiary is deemed to have as its elected functional currency the parent’s tax reporting currency, and

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: if the subsidiary’s taxation year that includes the commencement time would, in the absence of this subsection, be a reversionary year of the subsidiary, this section is to be read with any modifications that the circumstances require; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: where the subsidiary’s tax reporting currency is not Canadian currency,

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the subsidiary is deemed to have filed, at the time that is six months and one day before the beginning of its taxation year that includes the commencement time, in prescribed form and manner, a notice of revocation described in subsection (4), and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: if the parent’s tax reporting currency is not Canadian currency,

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: the subsidiary’s first reversionary year is deemed to have ended at the particular time that is immediately after the time at which it began,

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: a new taxation year of the subsidiary is deemed to have begun immediately after the particular time,

Clause.Label: (C)
Clause.Text: notwithstanding subsection (3), subsection (5) is deemed to apply to the subsidiary in respect of its taxation year that includes the commencement time and each of its subsequent taxation years, if any, and

Clause.Label: (D)
Clause.Text: the subsidiary is deemed to have as its elected functional currency the parent’s tax reporting currency.

Subsection.Text: If a predecessor corporation and the new corporation, in respect of an amalgamation within the meaning of subsection 87(1), have different tax reporting currencies for their last and first taxation years, respectively, paragraphs (16)(a) and (b) apply, for the purposes of determining the predecessor corporation’s Canadian tax results for its last taxation year, as if the tax reporting currencies referred to in those paragraphs were the tax reporting currencies referred to in this subsection and as if the references in those paragraphs to

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: “subsidiary” were references to “predecessor corporation”;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: “parent” were references to “new corporation”; and

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: “taxation year that includes the commencement time” were references to “last taxation year”.

Subsection.Text: Notwithstanding subsection (3), if each predecessor corporation in respect of an amalgamation (within the meaning assigned by subsection 87(1)) has the same elected functional currency for its last taxation year, then, unless a predecessor corporation has filed a notice of revocation under subsection (4) on or before the day that is six months before the end of its last taxation year,

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the new corporation formed as a result of the amalgamation is deemed to have made an election under paragraph (3)(b) and to have filed that election on the first day of its first taxation year; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: that elected functional currency is deemed to be the new corporation’s functional currency for its first taxation year.

Subsection.Text: The Canadian tax results of a corporation for any one or more taxation years shall be determined using a particular currency if

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: at any time (referred to in this subsection as the “transfer time”) one or more properties are directly or indirectly transferred

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: by the corporation to another corporation (referred to in this subsection as the “transferor” and the “transferee”, respectively), or

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: by another corporation to the corporation (referred to in this subsection as the “transferor” and the “transferee”, respectively);

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the transferor and the transferee are related at the transfer time or become related in the course of a series of transactions or events that includes the transfer;

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: the transfer time

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: is, or would in the absence of subsections (16) and (17) be, in a functional currency year of the transferor or the transferee and the transferor and the transferee have, or would in the absence of those subsections have, different tax reporting currencies at the transfer time, or

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: is, or would in the absence of those subsections be, in a reversionary year of the transferor and is not in a reversionary year of the transferee;

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: it can reasonably be considered that one of the main purposes of the transfer or of any portion of a series of transactions or events that includes the transfer is to change, or to enable the changing of, the currency in which the Canadian tax results in respect of the property, or property substituted for it, for a taxation year would otherwise be determined; and

Paragraph.Label: (e)
Paragraph.Text: the Minister directs that those Canadian tax results be determined in the particular currency.

Subsection.Text: For the purposes of subsection (18), if one corporate entity (referred to in this subsection as the “new corporation”) is formed at a particular time by the amalgamation or other merger of two or more corporations (each of which is referred to in this subsection as a “predecessor corporation”),

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the predecessor corporation is deemed to have transferred to the new corporation at the time (referred to in this subsection as the “merger transfer time”) that is immediately before the particular time each property that was held at the merger transfer time by the predecessor corporation and at the particular time by the new corporation;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the new corporation is deemed to exist, and to be related to the predecessor corporation, at the merger transfer time; and

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: the new corporation is deemed to have as its tax reporting currency at the merger transfer time its tax reporting currency at the particular time.

Subsection.Text: Subsection (21) applies in determining a taxpayer’s income, gain or loss for a taxation year in respect of a transaction (referred to in this subsection and subsection (21) as a “specified transaction”) if

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the specified transaction was entered into, directly or indirectly, at any time by the taxpayer and a person (referred to in this subsection as the “related person”) to which the taxpayer is at that time related;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the taxpayer and the related person had different tax reporting currencies at any time during the period (referred to in this subsection as the “accrual period”) in which the income, gain or loss accrued; and

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: it would, in the absence of this subsection and subsection (21), be reasonable to consider that a fluctuation at any time in the accrual period in the value of the taxpayer’s tax reporting currency relative to the value of the related person’s tax reporting currency

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: increased the taxpayer’s loss in respect of the specified transaction,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: reduced the taxpayer’s income or gain in respect of the specified transaction, or

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: caused the taxpayer to have a loss, instead of income or a gain, in respect of the specified transaction.

Subsection.Text: If this subsection applies, each fluctuation in value referred to in paragraph (20)(c) is, for the purposes of determining the taxpayer’s income, gain or loss in respect of the specified transaction and notwithstanding any other provision of this Act, deemed not to have occurred.
For the purposes of this subsection and subsections (18) to (21),

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: if a property is directly or indirectly transferred to or by a partnership, the property is deemed to have been transferred to or by (as the case may be) each member of the partnership; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: if a partnership is a party to a transaction, each member of the partnership is deemed to be that party to that transaction.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Subsection.Text: The Minister of Finance may designate a stock exchange, or a part of a stock exchange, for the purposes of this Act.
The Minister of Finance may revoke the designation of a stock exchange, or a part of a stock exchange, designated under subsection (1).

A designation under subsection (1) or a revocation under subsection (2) shall specify the time at and after which it is in effect, which time may, for greater certainty, precede the time at which the designation or revocation is made.

The Minister of Finance shall cause to be published, by posting on the Internet website of the Department of Finance or by any other means that the Minister of Finance considers appropriate, the names of those stock exchanges, or parts of stock exchanges, as the case may be, that are or at any time were designated under subsection (1).

The Minister of Finance is deemed to have designated under subsection (1) each stock exchange and each part of a stock exchange that was, immediately before the day on which this section came into force, a prescribed stock exchange, with effect on and after that day.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Subsection.Text: The following definitions apply in this Part.

Definition.Text: agreement has the same meaning as in section 2 of the Canada–United States Enhanced Tax Information Exchange Agreement Implementation Act. (accord)
electronic filing means using electronic media in a manner specified by the Minister. (transmission électronique)
listed financial institution means a financial institution that is

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: an authorized foreign bank within the meaning of section 2 of the Bank Act in respect of its business in Canada, or a bank to which that Act applies;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: a cooperative credit society, a savings and credit union or a caisse populaire regulated by a provincial Act;

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: an association regulated by the Cooperative Credit Associations Act;

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: a central cooperative credit society, as defined in section 2 of the Cooperative Credit Associations Act, or a credit union central or a federation of credit unions or caisses populaires that is regulated by a provincial Act other than one enacted by the legislature of Quebec;

Paragraph.Label: (e)
Paragraph.Text: a financial services cooperative regulated by An Act respecting financial services cooperatives, R.S.Q., c. C-67.3, or An Act respecting the Mouvement Desjardins, S.Q. 2000, c. 77;

Paragraph.Label: (f)
Paragraph.Text: a life company or a foreign life company to which the Insurance Companies Act applies or a life insurance company regulated by a provincial Act;

Paragraph.Label: (g)
Paragraph.Text: a company to which the Trust and Loan Companies Act applies;

Paragraph.Label: (h)
Paragraph.Text: a trust company regulated by a provincial Act;

Paragraph.Label: (i)
Paragraph.Text: a loan company regulated by a provincial Act;

Paragraph.Label: (j)
Paragraph.Text: an entity authorized under provincial legislation to engage in the business of dealing in securities or any other financial instruments, or to provide portfolio management, investment advising, fund administration, or fund management, services;

Paragraph.Label: (k)
Paragraph.Text: an entity that is represented or promoted to the public as a collective investment vehicle, mutual fund, exchange traded fund, private equity fund, hedge fund, venture capital fund, leveraged buyout fund or similar investment vehicle that is established to invest or trade in financial assets and that is managed by an entity referred to in paragraph (j);

Paragraph.Label: (l)
Paragraph.Text: an entity that is a clearing house or clearing agency; or

Paragraph.Label: (m)
Paragraph.Text: a department or an agent of Her Majesty in right of Canada or of a province that is engaged in the business of accepting deposit liabilities. (institution financière particulière)

Definition.Text: non-reporting Canadian financial institution means any Canadian financial institution or other entity resident in Canada that

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: is described in any of paragraphs C, D and G to J of section III of Annex II to the agreement;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: makes a reasonable determination that it is described in any of paragraphs A, B, E and F of section III of Annex II to the agreement;

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: qualifies as an exempt beneficial owner under relevant U.S. Treasury Regulations in effect on the date of signature of the agreement; or

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: makes a reasonable determination that it qualifies as a deemed-compliant FFI under relevant U.S. Treasury Regulations in effect on the date of signature of the agreement. (institution financière canadienne non déclarante)

Definition.Text: U.S. reportable account means a financial account that, under the agreement, is to be treated as a U.S. reportable account. (compte déclarable américain)

Subsection.Text: For the purposes of this Part, Canadian financial institution and reporting Canadian financial institution each have the meaning that would be assigned by the agreement, and the definition non-reporting Canadian financial institution in subsection (1) has the meaning that would be assigned by that subsection, if the definition Financial Institution in subparagraph 1(g) of Article 1 of the agreement were read as follows:

Provision.Label: g)
Provision.Text: The term Financial Institution means any Entity that is a Custodial Institution, a Depository Institution, an Investment Entity or a Specified Insurance Company, and that is a listed financial institution within the meaning of Part XVIII of the Income Tax Act.

Subsection.Text: For the purposes of this Part, the agreement is to be read as if the definition Financial Account in subparagraph 1(s) of Article 1 of the agreement included the following subparagraph after subparagraph (1):

Provision.Text: an account that is a client name account maintained by a person or entity that is authorized under provincial legislation to engage in the business of dealing in securities or any other financial instruments, or to provide portfolio management or investment advising services.

Subsection.Text: For the purposes of this Part, a reference in the agreement to “Canadian TIN” or “taxpayer identification number” is to be read as including a reference to Social Insurance Number.
In this Part, a term has the meaning that is defined in, or assigned by, the agreement unless the term is defined in this Part.
No person shall be liable for a failure to comply with a duty or obligation imposed by this Act that results from an amendment to the agreement unless at the date of the alleged failure,

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the text of the instrument that effected the amendment had been published in the Canada Gazette; or

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: reasonable steps had been taken to bring the purport of the amendment to the notice of those persons likely to be affected by it.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Subsection.Text: Subject to subsection (2), a reporting Canadian financial institution may designate a financial account to not be a U.S. reportable account for a calendar year if the account is

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: a preexisting individual account described in paragraph A of section II of Annex I to the agreement;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: a new individual account described in paragraph A of section III of Annex I to the agreement;

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: a preexisting entity account described in paragraph A of section IV of Annex I to the agreement; or

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: a new entity account described in paragraph A of section V of Annex I to the agreement.

Subsection.Text: A reporting Canadian financial institution may not designate a financial account for a calendar year unless the account is part of a clearly identifiable group of accounts all of which are designated for the year.
The rules in paragraph C of section VI of Annex I to the agreement apply in determining whether a financial account is described in any of paragraphs (1)(a) to (d).

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Subsection.Text: Every reporting Canadian financial institution shall establish, maintain and document the due diligence procedures set out in subsections (2) and (3).
Every reporting Canadian financial institution shall have the following due diligence procedures:

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: for preexisting individual accounts that are lower value accounts, other than accounts described in paragraph A of section II of Annex I to the agreement, the procedures described in paragraphs B and C of that section, subject to paragraph F of that section;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: for preexisting individual accounts that are high value accounts, other than accounts described in paragraph A of section II of Annex I to the agreement, the procedures described in paragraphs D and E of that section, subject to paragraph F of that section;

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: for new individual accounts, other than accounts described in paragraph A of section III of Annex I to the agreement, the procedures described in paragraph B of section III of Annex I to the agreement;

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: for preexisting entity accounts, other than accounts described in paragraph A of section IV of Annex I to the agreement, the procedures described in paragraphs D and E of that section; and

Paragraph.Label: (e)
Paragraph.Text: for new entity accounts, other than accounts described in paragraph A of section V of Annex I to the agreement, the procedures described in paragraphs B to E of that section.

Subsection.Text: If a reporting Canadian financial institution does not designate a financial account under subsection 264(1) for a calendar year, the institution shall have the following due diligence procedures with respect to the account:

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: if the account is a preexisting individual account described in paragraph A of section II of Annex I to the agreement, the procedures described in paragraphs B and C of that section, subject to paragraph F of that section;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: if the account is a new individual account described in paragraph A of section III of Annex I to the agreement, the procedures described in paragraph B of section III of Annex I to the agreement;

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: if the account is a preexisting entity account described in paragraph A of section IV of Annex I to the agreement, the procedures described in paragraphs D and E of that section; and

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: if the account is a new entity account described in paragraph A of section V of Annex I to the agreement, the procedures described in paragraphs B to E of that section.

Subsection.Text: For the purposes of subsections (2) and (3), subparagraphs B(1) to (3) of section I, and section VI, of Annex I to the agreement apply except that

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: in applying paragraph C of that section VI, an account balance that has a negative value is deemed to be nil; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the definition NFFE in subparagraph B(2) of that section VI is to be read as follows:

Provision.Text: An NFFE means any Non-U.S. Entity that is not an FFI as defined in relevant U.S. Treasury Regulations or is an Entity described in subparagraph B(4)(j) of this section, and also includes any Non-U.S. Entity

Provision.Label: a)
Provision.Text: that is resident in Canada and is not a listed financial institution within the meaning of Part XVIII of the Income Tax Act; or

Provision.Label: b)
Provision.Text: that is resident in a Partner Jurisdiction other than Canada and is not a Financial Institution.

Subsection.Text: For the purposes of paragraphs (2)(a) and (b), subparagraph (2)(c)(ii), paragraph (3)(a) and subparagraph (3)(b)(ii), subparagraph B(3) of section II of Annex I to the agreement is to be read as follows:

Provision.Text: If any of the U.S indicia listed in subparagraph B(1) of this section are discovered in the electronic search, or if there is a change in circumstances that results in one or more U.S. indicia being associated with the account, then the Reporting Canadian Financial Institution must seek to obtain or review the information described in the portion of subparagraph B(4) of this section that is relevant in the circumstances and must treat the account as a U.S. Reportable Account unless one of the exceptions in subparagraph B(4) applies with respect to that account.

Subsection.Text: For the purpose of applying the procedures referred to in paragraphs (2)(d) and (e) and (3)(c) and (d) to a financial account of an account holder that is resident in Canada, the definition Financial Institution in subparagraph 1(g) of Article 1 of the agreement is to be read as follows:

Provision.Label: g)
Provision.Text: The term Financial Institution means any Entity that is a Custodial Institution, a Depository Institution, an Investment Entity or a Specified Insurance Company, and that is a listed financial institution within the meaning of Part XVIII of the Income Tax Act.

Subsection.Text: Subsection (8) applies to a reporting Canadian financial institution in respect of a client name account maintained by the institution if

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: property recorded in the account is also recorded in a financial account (in this subsection and subsection (8) referred to as the “related account”) maintained by a financial institution (in this subsection and subsection (8) referred to as the “dealer”) that is authorized under provincial legislation to engage in the business of dealing in securities or any other financial instrument, or to provide portfolio management or investment advising services; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the dealer has advised the institution whether the related account is a U.S. reportable account.

ContinuedSectionSubsection.Text: However, subsection (8) does not apply if it can reasonably be concluded by the institution that the dealer has failed to comply with its obligations under this section.

Subsection.Text: If this subsection applies to a reporting Canadian financial institution in respect of a client name account,

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: subsections (1) to (4) do not apply to the institution in respect of the account; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the institution shall rely on the determination of the dealer in respect of the related account in determining whether the account is a U.S. reportable account.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Subsection.Text: Every reporting Canadian financial institution shall file with the Minister, before May 2 of each calendar year, an information return in prescribed form relating to each U.S. reportable account maintained by the institution at any time during the immediately preceding calendar year and after June 29, 2014.

Every reporting Canadian financial institution shall file with the Minister, before May 2 of each calendar year, an information return in prescribed form relating to payments, to a nonparticipating financial institution that is the holder of a financial account maintained by the reporting Canadian financial institution, during the immediately preceding calendar year if the immediately preceding year is 2015 or 2016.
An information return required under subsection (1) or (2) shall be filed by way of electronic filing.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Subsection.Text: Every reporting Canadian financial institution shall keep, at the institution’s place of business or at such other place as may be designated by the Minister, records that the institution obtains or creates for the purpose of complying with this Part, including self-certifications and records of documentary evidence.

Every reporting Canadian financial institution required by this Part to keep records that does so electronically shall retain them in an electronically readable format for the retention period referred to in subsection (3).
Every reporting Canadian financial institution that is required to keep, obtain, or create records under this Part shall retain those records for a period of at least six years following

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: in the case of a self-certification, the last day on which a related financial account is open; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: in any other case, the end of the last calendar year in respect of which the record is relevant.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Section.Text: If a person enters into an arrangement or engages in a practice, the primary purpose of which can reasonably be considered to be to avoid an obligation under this Part, the person is subject to the obligation as if the person had not entered into the arrangement or engaged in the practice.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Section.Text: If a Canadian financial institution makes a reasonable determination that it is to be treated as a deemed-compliant FFI under Annex II to the agreement, this Part applies to the institution, with such modifications as the circumstances require, to the extent that the agreement imposes due diligence and reporting obligations on the institution.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Subsection.Text: The following definitions apply in this Part.

Definition.Text: account holder means

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the person listed or identified as the holder of a financial account by the financial institution that maintains the account, other than a person (other than a financial institution) holding a financial account for the benefit of, or on behalf of, another person as agent, custodian, nominee, signatory, investment advisor or intermediary; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: in the case of a cash value insurance contract or an annuity contract,

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: any person entitled to access the cash value or change the beneficiary,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: if no person can access the cash value or change the beneficiary,

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: any person named as the owner in the contract, and

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: any person with a vested entitlement to payment under the terms of the contract, and

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: upon maturity of the cash value insurance contract or annuity contract, each person entitled to receive a payment under the contract. (titulaire de compte)

Definition.Text: active NFE means, at any time, a non-financial entity that meets any of the following criteria:

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: less than 50% of the NFE’s gross income for the preceding fiscal period is passive income and less than 50% of the assets held by the NFE during the preceding fiscal period are assets that produce or are held for the production of passive income;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: either

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: interests in the NFE are regularly traded on an established securities market, or

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the NFE is a related entity of an entity interests in which are regularly traded on an established securities market;

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: the NFE is

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: a governmental entity,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: an international organization,

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: a central bank, or

Subparagraph.Label: (iv)
Subparagraph.Text: an entity wholly owned by one or more entities described in subparagraphs (i) to (iii);

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: both

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: all or substantially all of the activities of the NFE consist of holding (in whole or in part) the outstanding stock of, or providing financing and services to, one or more of its subsidiaries that engage in trades or businesses other than the business of a financial institution, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the NFE does not function as (and is not represented or promoted to the public as) an investment fund, including

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: a private equity fund,

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: a venture capital fund,

Clause.Label: (C)
Clause.Text: a leveraged buyout fund, and

Clause.Label: (D)
Clause.Text: an investment vehicle whose purpose is to acquire or fund companies and then hold interests in those companies as capital assets for investment purposes;

Paragraph.Label: (e)
Paragraph.Text: the NFE

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: is not yet operating a business,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: has no prior operating history,

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: is investing capital into assets with the intent to operate a business other than that of a financial institution, and

Subparagraph.Label: (iv)
Subparagraph.Text: was initially organized no more than 24 months prior to that time;

Paragraph.Label: (f)
Paragraph.Text: the NFE has not been a financial institution in any of the past five years and is in the process of liquidating its assets or is reorganizing with the intent to continue or recommence operations in a business other than that of a financial institution;

Paragraph.Label: (g)
Paragraph.Text: the NFE primarily engages in financing and hedging transactions with, or for, related entities that are not financial institutions, and does not provide financing or hedging services to any entity that is not a related entity, provided that the group of those related entities is primarily engaged in a business other than that of a financial institution; and

Paragraph.Label: (h)
Paragraph.Text: the NFE meets all of the following requirements:

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: it

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: is established and operated in its jurisdiction of residence exclusively for religious, charitable, scientific, artistic, cultural, athletic or educational purposes, or

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: is established and operated in its jurisdiction of residence and it is a professional organization, business league, chamber of commerce, labour organization, agricultural or horticultural organization, civic league or an organization operated exclusively for the promotion of social welfare,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: it is exempt from income tax in its jurisdiction of residence,

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: it has no shareholders or members who have a proprietary or beneficial interest in its income or assets,

Subparagraph.Label: (iv)
Subparagraph.Text: the applicable laws of the NFE’s jurisdiction of residence or the NFE’s formation documents do not permit any income or assets of the NFE to be distributed to, or applied for the benefit of, a private person or non-charitable entity other than pursuant to the conduct of the NFE’s charitable activities, or as payment of reasonable compensation for services rendered, or as payment representing the fair market value of property which the NFE has purchased, and

Subparagraph.Label: (v)
Subparagraph.Text: the applicable laws of the NFE’s jurisdiction of residence or the NFE’s formation documents require that, upon the NFE’s liquidation or dissolution, all of its assets be distributed to a governmental entity or other non-profit organization, or escheat to the government of the NFE’s jurisdiction of residence or any political subdivision thereof. (ENF active)

Definition.Text: annuity contract means a contract under which the issuer agrees to make payments for a period of time determined in whole or in part by reference to the life expectancy of one or more individuals and includes a contract

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: that is considered to be an annuity contract in accordance with the law, regulation or practice of the jurisdiction in which the contract was issued; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: under which the issuer agrees to make payments for a term of years. (contrat de rente)

Definition.Text: anti-money laundering and know your customer procedures or AML/KYC procedures means the record keeping, verification of identity, reporting of suspicious transactions and registration requirements required of a reporting financial institution under the Proceeds of Crime (Money Laundering) and Terrorist Financing Act. (procédures de connaissance de la clientèle et de lutte contre le blanchiment d’argent ou procédures AML/KYC)

broad participation retirement fund means a fund that is established to provide retirement, disability or death benefits to beneficiaries that are current or former employees (or persons designated by those employees) of one or more employers in consideration for services rendered, if the fund

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: does not have a single beneficiary with a right to more than 5% of the fund’s assets;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: is subject to government regulation and provides information reporting to the Minister; and

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: satisfies at least one of the following requirements:

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the fund is generally exempt from tax on investment income, or taxation of investment income is deferred or taxed at a reduced rate, due to its status as a retirement or pension plan,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the fund receives at least 50% of its total contributions (other than transfers of assets from broad participation retirement funds, narrow participation retirement funds or from retirement and pension accounts described in paragraph (a) of the definition excluded account) from the sponsoring employers,

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: distributions or withdrawals from the fund are

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: allowed only upon the occurrence of specified events related to retirement, disability or death (except rollover distributions to broad participation retirement funds, narrow participation retirement funds and pension funds of a governmental entity, international organization or central bank or retirement and pension accounts described in paragraph (a) of the definition excluded account), or

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: subject to penalties if they are made before such specified events, and

Subparagraph.Label: (iv)
Subparagraph.Text: contributions (other than permitted make-up contributions) by an employee to the fund

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: are limited by reference to the employee’s remuneration, or

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: must not exceed 50,000 USD annually, applying the rules set forth in subsection 277(3). (fonds de retraite à large participation)

Definition.Text: Canadian financial institution means a financial institution that is

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: either

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: resident in Canada, but excluding any branch of the financial institution that is located outside Canada, or

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: a branch of a financial institution that is not resident in Canada, if the branch is located in Canada; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: a listed financial institution as defined in subsection 263(1). (institution financière canadienne)

Definition.Text: cash value, in respect of a contract held by a policyholder, means the greater of the amount that the policyholder is entitled to receive upon surrender or termination of the contract (determined without reduction for any surrender charge or policy loan) and the amount the policyholder can borrow under or with regard to the contract, but does not include an amount payable under an insurance contract

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: solely by reason of the death of an individual insured under a life insurance contract;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: as a personal injury or sickness benefit, or other benefit, providing indemnification of an economic loss incurred upon the occurrence of an event insured against;

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: as a refund of a previously paid premium (less any cost of insurance charges whether or not actually imposed) under an insurance contract (other than an investment-linked life insurance or annuity contract) due to the cancellation or termination of the contract, a decrease in risk exposure during the effective period of the contract or arising from the correction of a posting or similar error with regard to the premium for the contract;

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: as a policyholder dividend (other than a termination dividend) if the dividend relates to an insurance contract under which the only benefits payable are described in paragraph (b); or

Paragraph.Label: (e)
Paragraph.Text: as a return of an advance premium or premium deposit for an insurance contract for which the premium is payable at least annually, if the amount of the advance premium or premium deposit does not exceed the next annual premium that will be payable under the contract. (valeur de rachat)

Definition.Text: cash value insurance contract means an insurance contract (other than an indemnity reinsurance contract between two insurance companies) that has a cash value. (contrat d’assurance avec valeur de rachat)

central bank means an institution that is, by law or government sanction, the principal authority, other than the government of the jurisdiction itself, issuing instruments intended to circulate as currency and may include an instrumentality that is separate from the government of the jurisdiction, whether or not owned in whole or in part by the jurisdiction. (banque centrale)

controlling persons, in respect of an entity, means the natural persons who exercise control over the entity (interpreted in a manner consistent with the Financial Action Task Force Recommendations — International Standards on Combating Money Laundering and the Financing of Terrorism and Proliferation, adopted in February 2012 and as amended from time to time) and includes

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: in the case of a trust,

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: its settlors,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: its trustees,

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: its protectors (if any),

Subparagraph.Label: (iv)
Subparagraph.Text: its beneficiaries (for this purpose, a discretionary beneficiary of a trust will only be considered a beneficiary of the trust in a calendar year if a distribution has been paid or made payable to the discretionary beneficiary in the calendar year), and

Subparagraph.Label: (v)
Subparagraph.Text: any other natural persons exercising ultimate effective control over the trust; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: in the case of a legal arrangement other than a trust, persons in equivalent or similar positions to those described in paragraph (a). (personnes détenant le contrôle)

Definition.Text: custodial account means an account (other than an insurance contract or annuity contract) that holds one or more financial assets for the benefit of another person. (compte de dépositaire)

custodial institution means an entity, if the entity’s gross income attributable to the holding of financial assets for the account of others and related financial services equals or exceeds 20% of the entity’s gross income during the shorter of

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the three-year period that ends at the end of the entity’s last fiscal period, and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the period during which the entity has been in existence. (établissement de garde de valeurs)

Definition.Text: depository account includes

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: any commercial, chequing, savings, time or thrift account, or an account that is evidenced by a certificate of deposit, thrift certificate, investment certificate, certificate of indebtedness or other similar instrument maintained by a financial institution in the ordinary course of a banking or similar business; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: an amount held by an insurance company under a guaranteed investment contract or similar agreement to pay or credit interest on the contract. (compte de dépôt)

Definition.Text: depository institution means any entity that accepts deposits in the ordinary course of a banking or similar business. (établissement de dépôt)
documentary evidence includes

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: a certificate of residence issued by an authorized government body (such as a government or agency thereof, or a municipality) of the jurisdiction in which the payee claims to be a resident;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: with respect to an individual (other than a trust), any valid identification issued by an authorized government body that includes the individual’s name and is typically used for identification purposes;

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: with respect to an entity, any official documentation issued by an authorized government body that includes the name of the entity and either the address of its principal office in the jurisdiction in which it claims to be resident or the jurisdiction in which the entity was incorporated or organized; and

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: any audited financial statement, third-party credit report, bankruptcy filing or securities regulator’s report. (preuve documentaire)

Definition.Text: entity means a person (other than a natural person) or a legal arrangement, such as a corporation, partnership, trust or foundation. (entité)
equity or debt interest includes, in the case of a partnership that is a financial institution, either a capital or profits interest in the partnership. (titre de participation ou d’intérêt)
established securities market means an exchange that

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: is officially recognized and supervised by a governmental authority in which the market is located; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: has an annual value of shares traded on the exchange (or a predecessor exchange) exceeding one billion USD during each of the three calendar years immediately preceding the calendar year in which the determination is being made. For this purpose, if an exchange has more than one tier of market level on which stock may be separately listed or traded, each of those tiers must be treated as a separate exchange. (marché boursier réglementé)

Definition.Text: excluded account means

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: a retirement or pension account that satisfies the following requirements:

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the account is

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: subject to regulation as a personal retirement account, or

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: part of a registered or regulated retirement or pension plan for the provision of retirement or pension benefits (including disability or death benefits),

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the account is tax-favoured in that

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: contributions to the account that would otherwise be subject to tax are deductible or excluded from the gross income of the account holder or taxed at a reduced rate, or

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: taxation of investment income within the account is deferred or investment income within the account is taxed at a reduced rate,

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: information reporting to the Minister is required with respect to the account,

Subparagraph.Label: (iv)
Subparagraph.Text: withdrawals are

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: conditioned on reaching a specified retirement age, disability or death, or

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: subject to penalties if made before the events specified in clause (A), and

Subparagraph.Label: (v)
Subparagraph.Text: after applying the rules in subsection 277(3) to all similar accounts, annual contributions to the account are limited to 50,000 USD or less or there is a maximum lifetime contribution limit to the account of 1,000,000 USD or less (and an account that otherwise satisfies this requirement will not fail to satisfy this requirement solely because the account may receive assets or funds transferred from one or more accounts that meet the requirements of this paragraph or paragraph (b) or from one or more broad participation retirement funds, narrow participation retirement funds or pension funds of a governmental entity, international organization or central bank);

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: an account that satisfies the following requirements:

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the account is

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: both

Subclause.Label: (I)
Subclause.Text: subject to regulation as an investment vehicle for purposes other than for retirement, and

Subclause.Label: (II)
Subclause.Text: regularly traded on an established securities market, or

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: subject to regulation as a savings vehicle for purposes other than for retirement,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the account is tax-favoured in that

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: contributions to the account that would otherwise be subject to tax are deductible or excluded from the gross income of the account holder or taxed at a reduced rate, or

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: taxation of investment income within the account is deferred or investment income within the account is taxed at a reduced rate,

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: withdrawals are

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: conditioned on meeting specific criteria related to the purpose of the investment or savings account (including the provision of educational or medical benefits), or

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: subject to penalties if made before the criteria in clause (A) are met, and

Subparagraph.Label: (iv)
Subparagraph.Text: annual contributions are, after applying the rules in subsection 277(3) to all similar accounts, limited to 50,000 USD or less (and an account that otherwise satisfies this requirement will not fail to satisfy this requirement solely because the account may receive assets or funds transferred from one or more accounts that meet the requirements of paragraph (a) or this paragraph or from one or more broad participation retirement funds, narrow participation retirement funds or pension funds of a governmental entity, international organization or central bank);

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: a life insurance contract with a coverage period that ends before the insured individual attains age 90, if the contract satisfies the following requirements:

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: periodic premiums, which do not decrease over time, are payable at least annually until the earlier of

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: the end of the period in which the contract is in existence, and

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: the date that the insured attains age 90,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the contract has no contract value that any person can access (by withdrawal, loan or otherwise) without terminating the contract,

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: the amount (other than a death benefit) payable upon cancellation or termination of the contract must not exceed the amount determined by the formula

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the aggregate premiums paid for the contract,
is the total of all mortality, morbidity and expense charges (whether or not actually imposed) for the period or periods of the contract’s existence, and
is the total of all amounts paid prior to the cancellation or termination of the contract, and

Subparagraph.Label: (iv)
Subparagraph.Text: the contract has not been acquired by a transferee for value;

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: an account held solely by an estate of a deceased individual, if the documentation for the account includes a copy of the will or death certificate of the individual;

Paragraph.Label: (e)
Paragraph.Text: an account established in connection with any of the following:

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: a court order or judgement,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: a sale, exchange or lease of property, if the account satisfies the following requirements:

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: the account is funded

Subclause.Label: (I)
Subclause.Text: solely with a down payment, earnest money, deposit in an amount appropriate to secure an obligation directly related to the transaction or a similar payment, or

Subclause.Label: (II)
Subclause.Text: with a financial asset that is deposited in the account in connection with the sale, exchange or lease of the property,

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: the account is established and used solely to secure the obligation of

Subclause.Label: (I)
Subclause.Text: the purchaser to pay the purchase price for the property,

Subclause.Label: (II)
Subclause.Text: the seller to pay any contingent liability, or

Subclause.Label: (III)
Subclause.Text: the lessor or lessee to pay for any damages relating to the leased property as agreed under the lease,

Clause.Label: (C)
Clause.Text: the assets of the account, including the income earned on the account, will be paid or otherwise distributed for the benefit of the purchaser, seller, lessor or lessee (including to satisfy such person’s obligation) when the property is sold, exchanged or surrendered or the lease terminates,

Clause.Label: (D)
Clause.Text: the account is not a margin or similar account established in connection with a sale or exchange of a financial asset, and

Clause.Label: (E)
Clause.Text: the account is not associated with an account described in paragraph (f),

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: an obligation of a financial institution servicing a loan secured by real or immovable property to set aside a portion of a payment solely to facilitate the payment of taxes or insurance related to the property at a later time, or

Subparagraph.Label: (iv)
Subparagraph.Text: an obligation of a financial institution solely to facilitate the payment of taxes at a later time;

Paragraph.Label: (f)
Paragraph.Text: a depository account that satisfies the following requirements:

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the account exists solely because a customer makes a payment in excess of a balance due with respect to a credit card or other revolving credit facility and the overpayment is not immediately returned to the customer, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: after June 2017, policies and procedures are in effect relating to overpayments (for this purpose, a customer overpayment does not include credit balances to the extent of disputed charges but does include credit balances resulting from merchandise returns) to either

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: prevent a customer from making an overpayment in excess of 50,000 USD, or

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: ensure that any customer overpayment in excess of 50,000 USD is refunded to the customer within 60 days; and

Paragraph.Label: (g)
Paragraph.Text: a prescribed account. (compte exclu)

Definition.Text: exempt collective investment vehicle means an investment entity that is regulated as a collective investment vehicle, provided that all of the interests in the collective investment vehicle are held by or through individuals or entities (other than a passive NFE with a controlling person who is a reportable person) that are not reportable persons. (mécanisme de placement collectif dispensé)
financial account means an account maintained by a financial institution, and

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: includes

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: a depository account,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: a custodial account,

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: in the case of an investment entity, any equity or debt interest in the financial institution, except that it does not include any equity or debt interest in an entity that is an investment entity solely because it,

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: renders investment advice to, and acts on behalf of, a customer for the purpose of investing, managing or administering financial assets deposited in the name of the customer with a financial institution other than such entity, or

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: manages portfolios for, and acts on behalf of, a customer for the purpose of investing, managing, or administering financial assets deposited in the name of the customer with a financial institution other than such entity,

Subparagraph.Label: (iv)
Subparagraph.Text: any equity or debt interest in the financial institution if one of the purposes of establishing the class of interests was to avoid reporting in accordance with section 271, except that it does not include any equity or debt interest in an entity that is an investment entity solely because it meets the conditions described in clauses (iii)(A) or (B),

Subparagraph.Label: (v)
Subparagraph.Text: any cash value insurance contract and any annuity contract issued or maintained by a financial institution, other than a non-investment-linked, non-transferable immediate life annuity that is issued to an individual and monetizes a pension or disability benefit provided under an account that is an excluded account, and

Subparagraph.Label: (vi)
Subparagraph.Text: an account that is a client name account maintained by a person or entity that is authorized under provincial legislation to engage in the business of dealing in securities or any other financial instruments, or to provide portfolio management or investment advising services; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: despite paragraph (a), does not include an excluded account. (compte financier)

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: includes

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: a security, such as

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: a share of the capital stock of a corporation,

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: an income or capital interest in a widely held or publicly traded trust, or

Clause.Label: (C)
Clause.Text: a note, bond, debenture or other evidence of indebtedness,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: a partnership interest,

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: a commodity,

Subparagraph.Label: (iv)
Subparagraph.Text: a swap (such as interest rate swaps, currency swaps, basis swaps, interest rate caps, interest rate floors, commodity swaps, equity swaps, equity index swaps and similar agreements),

Subparagraph.Label: (v)
Subparagraph.Text: an insurance contract or annuity contract, and

Subparagraph.Label: (vi)
Subparagraph.Text: any interest (including a futures or forward contract or option) in a security, partnership interest, commodity, swap, insurance contract or annuity contract; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: does not include a non-debt, direct interest in real or immovable property. (actif financier)

Definition.Text: financial institution means an entity, other than a passive NFE, that is a custodial institution, a depository institution, an investment entity or a specified insurance company. (institution financière)

governmental entity means the government of a jurisdiction, any political subdivision of a jurisdiction (which, for greater certainty, includes a state, province, county or municipality), a public body performing a function of government in a jurisdiction or any agency or instrumentality of a jurisdiction wholly owned by one or more of the foregoing, unless it is not an integral part or a controlled entity of a jurisdiction (or a political subdivision of a jurisdiction) and for these purposes

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: an integral part of a jurisdiction means any person, organization, agency, bureau, fund, instrumentality or other body, however designated, that constitutes a governing authority of a jurisdiction and where the net earnings of the governing authority are credited to its own account or to other accounts of the jurisdiction, with no portion inuring to the benefit of any private person, except that an integral part does not include any individual who is a sovereign, official or administrator acting in a private or personal capacity;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: a controlled entity means an entity that is separate in form from the jurisdiction or that otherwise constitutes a separate juridical entity, provided that

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the entity is wholly owned and controlled by one or more governmental entities directly or indirectly through one or more controlled entities,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the entity’s net earnings are credited to its own account or to the accounts of one or more governmental entities, with no portion of its income inuring to the benefit of any private person, and

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: the entity’s assets vest in one or more governmental entities upon liquidation and dissolution; and

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: for the purposes of paragraphs (a) and (b),

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: income is deemed not to inure to the benefit of private persons if such persons are the intended beneficiaries of a governmental program and the program activities are performed for the general public with respect to the common welfare or relate to the administration of government, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: income is deemed to inure to the benefit of private persons if the income is derived from the use of a governmental entity to conduct a commercial business that provides financial services to private persons. (entité gouvernementale)

Definition.Text: group annuity contract means an annuity contract under which the obligees are individuals who are associated through an employer, trade association, labour union or other association or group. (contrat de rente de groupe)
group cash value insurance contract means a cash value insurance contract that

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: provides coverage on individuals who are associated through an employer, trade association, labour union or other association or group; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: charges a premium for each member of the group (or member of a class within the group) that is determined without regard to the individual health characteristics other than age, gender and smoking habits of the member (or class of members) of the group. (contrat d’assurance de groupe avec valeur de rachat)

Definition.Text: high value account means a preexisting individual account with an aggregate balance or value that exceeds 1 million USD on June 30, 2017 or on December 31 of any subsequent year. (compe de valeur élevée)

insurance contract means a contract (other than an annuity contract) under which the issuer agrees to pay an amount upon the occurrence of a specified contingency involving mortality, morbidity, accident, liability or property risk. (contrat d’assurance)
international organization means any intergovernmental organization (or wholly owned agency or instrumentality thereof), including a supranational organization

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: that is comprised primarily of governments;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: that has in effect a headquarters or substantially similar agreement with a jurisdiction; and

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: the income of which does not inure to the benefit of private persons. (organisation internationale)

Definition.Text: investment entity means any entity (other than an entity that is an active NFE because of any of paragraphs (d) to (g) of that definition)

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: that primarily carries on as a business one or more of the following activities or operations for or on behalf of a customer:

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: trading in money market instruments (such as cheques, bills, certificates of deposit and derivatives), foreign exchange, transferable securities or commodity futures, exchange, interest rate and index instruments,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: individual and collective portfolio management, or

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: otherwise investing, administering or managing financial assets or money on behalf of other persons; or

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the gross income of which is primarily attributable to investing, reinvesting or trading in financial assets, if the entity is managed by another entity that is a depository institution, a custodial institution, a specified insurance company or an investment entity described in paragraph (a). (entité d’investissement)

Definition.Text: lower value account means a preexisting individual account with an aggregate balance or value as of June 30, 2017 that does not exceed 1 million USD. (compte de faible valeur)

narrow participation retirement fund means a fund that is established to provide retirement, disability or death benefits to beneficiaries who are current or former employees (or persons designated by those employees) of one or more employers in consideration for services rendered, if

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the fund has fewer than 50 participants;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the fund is sponsored by one or more employers that are not investment entities or passive NFEs;

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: the employee and employer contributions to the fund (other than transfers of assets from retirement and pension accounts described in paragraph (a) of the definition excluded account) are limited by reference to the employee’s remuneration;

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: participants that are not resident in Canada are not entitled to more than 20% of the fund’s assets; and

Paragraph.Label: (e)
Paragraph.Text: the fund is subject to government regulation and provides information reporting to the Minister. (fonds de retraite à participation étroite)

Definition.Text: natural person means an individual other than a trust. (personne physique)
new account means a financial account maintained by a reporting financial institution opened after June 2017. (nouveau compte)
new entity account means a new account held by one or more entities. (nouveau compte d’entité)
new individual account means a new account held by one or more individuals (other than trusts). (nouveau compte de particulier)
non-financial entity or NFE means an entity if

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: in the case of an entity that is resident in Canada, it is not a Canadian financial institution; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: in the case of a non-resident entity, it is not a financial institution. (entité non financière ou ENF)

Definition.Text: non-reporting financial institution means a Canadian financial institution that is

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the Bank of Canada;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: a governmental entity or international organization, other than with respect to a payment that is derived from an obligation held in connection with a commercial financial activity of a type engaged in by a specified insurance company, custodial institution or depository institution;

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: a broad participation retirement fund, a narrow participation retirement fund, a pension fund of a governmental entity, international organization or central bank, or a qualified credit card issuer;

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: an exempt collective investment vehicle;

Paragraph.Label: (e)
Paragraph.Text: a trust if a trustee of the trust is a reporting financial institution and reports all information required to be reported under this Part with respect to all reportable accounts of the trust; or

Paragraph.Label: (f)
Paragraph.Text: a prescribed entity. (institution financière non déclarante)

Definition.Text: participating jurisdiction means

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: Canada; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: each jurisdiction identified as a participating jurisdiction by the Minister on the Internet website of the Canada Revenue Agency or by any other means that the Minister considers appropriate. (juridiction partenaire)

Definition.Text: participating jurisdiction financial institution means

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: a financial institution that is resident in a participating jurisdiction, but excludes a branch of that financial institution that is located outside a participating jurisdiction; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: a branch of a financial institution that is not resident in a participating jurisdiction, if that branch is located in a participating jurisdiction. (institution financière d’une jurisdiction partenaire)

Definition.Text: passive NFE means

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: a non-financial entity that is not an active NFE; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: an entity that is

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: described in paragraph (b) of the definition investment entity, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: not a participating jurisdiction financial institution. (ENF passive)

Definition.Text: pension fund of a governmental entity, international organization or central bank means a fund that is established by a governmental entity, international organization or central bank to provide retirement, disability or death benefits to beneficiaries or participants

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: that are current or former employees (or persons designated by those employees); or

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: that are not current or former employees, if the benefits provided to them are in consideration of personal services performed for the governmental entity, international organization or central bank. (fonds de pension désigné)

Definition.Text: preexisting account means

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: a financial account maintained by a reporting financial institution on June 30, 2017; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: a financial account of an account holder (other than a financial account described in paragraph (a)) maintained by a reporting financial institution if

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the account holder also holds with the reporting financial institution (or with a related entity within Canada) a financial account that is a preexisting account under paragraph (a),

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the reporting financial institution (and, as applicable, the related entity within Canada) treats both of the aforementioned financial accounts, and any other financial accounts of the account holder that are preexisting accounts under this paragraph, as a single financial account for the purposes of

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: satisfying the standards and knowledge requirements set forth under this Part, and

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: determining the balance or value of any of the financial accounts, when applying any of the account thresholds,

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: with respect to a financial account that is subject to AML/KYC procedures, the reporting financial institution is permitted to satisfy those AML/KYC procedures for the financial account by relying upon the AML/KYC procedures performed for the preexisting account described in paragraph (a), and

Subparagraph.Label: (iv)
Subparagraph.Text: the opening of the financial account does not require the provision of new, additional or amended customer information by the account holder other than for purposes of this Part. (compte préexistant)

Definition.Text: preexisting entity account means a preexisting account held by one or more entities. (compte d’entité préexistant)
preexisting individual account means a preexisting account held by one or more individuals (other than trusts). (compte de particulier préexistant)
qualified credit card issuer means a financial institution that satisfies the following requirements:

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the financial institution is a financial institution solely because it is an issuer of credit cards that accepts deposits only when a customer makes a payment in excess of a balance due with respect to the card and the overpayment is not immediately returned to the customer; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
