Section.Text: Within two years after the coming into force of this section, the committee of the Senate that normally considers electoral matters, and the committee of the House of Commons that normally considers electoral matters, shall each undertake a comprehensive review of the amendments made by this Act and submit a report to its House containing its recommendations concerning those amendments.

For the purpose of applying section 118.1 of the Act, a gift made by an individual after 2004 and before January 12, 2005 is deemed to have been made by the individual in the individual’s 2004 taxation year and not in the individual’s 2005 taxation year if

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the individual claims an amount under subsection 118.1(3) of the Act in respect of the gift for the individual’s 2004 taxation year;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the gift was made to a registered charity listed under the International Humanitarian Assistance program of the Canadian International Development Agency;

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: the individual directed the charity to apply the gift to the tsunami relief effort; and

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: the gift was in the form of cash or was transferred by way of cheque, credit card or money order.

Subsection.Text: Subsection (1) applies in respect of overpayments that are deemed to arise during months that are after June 2007, and, for overpayments that are deemed to arise during months that are after June 2006 and before July 2007, the description of D in subsection 122.61(1) of the Act is to be read as follows:

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the product obtained by multiplying $249 by the number of qualified dependants who have attained the age of 6 years before the month and have not attained the age of 7 years before the month and in respect of whom the person is an eligible individual at the beginning of the month, and

Subsection.Text: Sections 63 and 64 come into force or are deemed to have come into force on January 1, 2007, but do not apply in respect of monetary contributions made before that day.

Section.Text: Sections 1 and 2 apply to taxation years that end after the day on which this Act is assented to.

Subsection.Text: For the purposes of the Income Tax Act and the Canada Disability Savings Act, specified RDSP events are deemed to have occurred, in the order that they actually occurred, on December 31, 2008 and not on the day or days that they actually occurred.
For the purposes of subsection (1), specified RDSP event means an event occurring after 2008 and before March 3, 2009 that

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: establishes a disability savings plan as defined in subsection 146.4(1) of the Income Tax Act;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: satisfies conditions in subsection 146.4(2) of the Income Tax Act;

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: establishes a registered disability savings plan as defined in subsection 146.4(1) of the Income Tax Act for a beneficiary who is, in respect of the 2008 taxation year, a DTC-eligible individual as defined in subsection 146.4(1) of the Income Tax Act and who was resident in Canada at the end of that year;

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: is the making of any contribution to the registered disability savings plan;

Paragraph.Label: (e)
Paragraph.Text: satisfies the requirement in paragraph 3(b) of the Canada Disability Savings Regulations; or

Paragraph.Label: (f)
Paragraph.Text: is the taking of any other action to ensure that the registered disability savings plan is validly established and contributions to the plan are validly made.

Section.Text: For the purpose of subsection 164(1.6) of the Income Tax Act, the Minister of National Revenue may make payments to a person or partnership out of the Consolidated Revenue Fund, at the times and in the manner that the Minister considers appropriate.

Section.MarginalNote: Payment out of Consolidated Revenue Fund
Section.Text: Any amount payable by the Minister of Employment and Social Development in relation to the administration of a program to provide a one-time payment to persons with disabilities for reasons related to the coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19), including any administrative cost, is to be paid out of the Consolidated Revenue Fund.

Subsection.Text: The Minister of Finance must prepare a report on proposed measures to

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: prevent publicly traded companies and their subsidiaries from paying dividends or repurchasing their own shares while receiving the Canada Emergency Wage Subsidy, for the period that is after the tabling of the report under subsection (32.2); and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: recover wage subsidy amounts from publicly traded companies and their subsidiaries that paid dividends or repurchased their own shares while receiving the Canada Emergency Wage Subsidy, for the period that is before the tabling of the report under subsection (32.2).

Subsection.Text: The Minister of Finance must cause the report to be tabled in each House of Parliament no later than 30 days after the day on which this Act receives royal assent or, if either House is not then sitting, on any of the first 15 days on which that House is sitting.

Before 2026, the taxpayer may file an election with the Minister of National Revenue to include income that is described in paragraph (b.01) of the definition earned income in subsection 146(1) of the Act, and received by the taxpayer after 2010 and before 2021, for the purposes of computing the taxpayer’s RRSP deduction limit (as defined in that subsection) on or after the date the election is filed.

For the purpose of determining if the condition in paragraph 93.3(2)(e) of the Act, as amended by subsection (4), is met at any particular time on or after January 1, 2022, if a non-resident corporation has a beneficial interest in a trust resident in India at the beginning of the day on January 1, 2022, the non-resident corporation is deemed to have first acquired a beneficial interest in the trust at that time.

Subsections (2) to (6) apply if Bill C-15, introduced in the 1st session of the 45th Parliament and entitled the Budget 2025 Implementation Act, No. 1 (in this section referred to as the “other Act”), receives royal assent.

Paragraph 152(1)(b) of the Income Tax Act, as enacted by subsection (2), comes into force on the day on which this Act receives royal assent, except that, for the period beginning on January 1, 2026 and ending on the day immediately before the day on which this Act receives royal assent, that paragraph is to be read as follows:

Paragraph 152(4.2)(b) of the Income Tax Act, as enacted by subsection (4), comes into force on the day on which this Act receives royal assent, except that, for the period beginning on January 1, 2026 and ending on the day immediately before the day on which this Act receives royal assent, that paragraph is to be read as follows:

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: redetermine the amount, if any, deemed by any of subsections 120(2) or (2.2), 122.5(3) to (3.003), 122.51(2), 122.7(2) or (3), 122.8(4), 122.9(2), 122.91(1), 122.92(3), 122.93(2), 127.1(1), 127.41(3) or 210.2(3) or (4) to be paid on account of the taxpayer’s tax payable under this Part for the year or deemed by subsection 122.61(1) to be an overpayment on account of the taxpayer’s liability under this Part for the year.

Subsection.Text: The Minister of Finance must prepare a report that outlines the impact of reducing the personal income tax rate provided in paragraph 117(2)(a) of the Income Tax Act on all tax credits that are calculated using the appropriate percentage as defined in that Act.

The Minister of Finance must cause the report to be tabled in each House of Parliament within 90 days after the day on which this section comes into force or, if the House is not then sitting, on any of the first 15 days of the next sitting of the House.
The Minister of Finance must publish the report on the website of the Department of Finance within 10 days after the day on which the report is tabled in both Houses of Parliament.
A written application made by a person under subsection 227(6) of the Act in respect of an amount that has been paid to the Receiver General is deemed to be filed on time if

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the application is filed with the Minister of National Revenue within 180 days after the day on which this Act receives royal assent; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the person is no longer liable to pay the amount as a result of the enactment by subsection (1) of the portion of paragraph 212.1(6)(b) of the Act before subparagraph (i).

Section.MarginalNote: Payment out of Consolidated Revenue Fund
Section.Text: Any amount payable by the Minister of National Revenue in relation to the application of subsection 127.491(2) of the Income Tax Act is to be paid out of the Consolidated Revenue Fund.

Subsection.Text: Subparagraph 56(1)(a)(i) of the Act is amended by striking out “and” at the end of clause (F), by adding “and” at the end of clause (G) and by adding the following after clause (G):

Clause.Label: (H)
Clause.Text: an amount paid or transferred from a registered pension plan, in respect of an unlocated individual, to an unclaimed property authority,

Subsection.Text: The definition issuer in subsection 146(1) of the Act is replaced by the following:

Definition.Text: issuer means the person referred to in the definition retirement savings plan

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: with whom an annuitant has a contract or arrangement described in paragraph (a) or (b) of that definition, or

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: that established an arrangement described in paragraph (c) of that definition; (émetteur)

Subsection.Text: The definition benefit in subsection 146(1) of the Act is amended by striking out “and” at the end of paragraph (c), by adding “and” at the end of paragraph (c.1) and by adding the following after paragraph (c.1):

Paragraph.Label: (c.2)
Paragraph.Text: an amount that is paid or transferred to an unclaimed property authority in respect of an unlocated individual

Subsection.Text: The portion of the definition refund of premiums in subsection 146(1) of the Act before paragraph (a) is replaced by the following:

Definition.Text: refund of premiums means any amount paid out of or under an RRSP (other than a tax-paid amount in respect of the plan or an amount paid from an arrangement described in paragraph (c) of the definition retirement savings plan in this subsection) as a consequence of the death of the annuitant under the plan,

Subsection.Text: The definition retirement savings plan in subsection 146(1) of the Act is amended by striking out “or” at the end of paragraph (a), by adding “or” at the end of paragraph (b) and by adding the following after paragraph (b):

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: an arrangement established at the direction of an unclaimed property authority to receive property from an RRSP or registered pension plan in respect of an unlocated individual; (régime d’épargne-retraite)

Subsection.Text: Subsection 146(3) of the Act is amended by adding the following after paragraph (b):

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: does not meet the conditions in subsection (2), if the plan is an arrangement described in paragraph (c) of the definition retirement savings plan in subsection (1);

Subsection.Text: Section 146 of the Act is amended by adding the following after subsection (22):
If an unclaimed property authority has established an RRSP to receive property in respect of an unlocated individual,

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: subsections (8.8) to (8.93) do not apply to the unlocated individual in respect of the property (or property substituted for it) while such property is held under the RRSP;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: paragraph (4)(c) does not apply to any trust governed by the RRSP; and

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: subsection (20) is to be read without reference to its paragraph (c) in respect of an amount credited or added to a deposit while the property (or property substituted for it) is held under the RRSP.

Subsection.Text: If an unclaimed property authority has established an RRSP to receive property in respect of an unlocated individual and the property (or property substituted for it) is claimed by an individual that is eligible to receive it in accordance with applicable law, the individual who made the claim is deemed to be the annuitant under the RRSP for the purposes of subsection (16), provided that individual is or was

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: if the property was received by the authority from a registered pension plan, the member (as defined in subsection 147.1(1)) of the registered pension plan;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: if the property was received by the authority from an RRSP, the annuitant (as defined in subsection 146(1)) of the RRSP;

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: a spouse or common-law partner of an individual described in paragraph (a) or (b), immediately before the death of that individual; or

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: a child or grandchild of an individual described in paragraph (a) or (b) who was, immediately before the death of that individual, financially dependent on that individual for support because of mental or physical infirmity.

Subsection.Text: The definition retirement income fund in subsection 146.3(1) of the Act is replaced by the following:

Definition.Text: retirement income fund means an arrangement

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: between a carrier and an annuitant under which, in consideration for the transfer to the carrier of property, the carrier undertakes to pay amounts to the annuitant (and, if the annuitant so elects, to the annuitant’s spouse or common-law partner after the annuitant’s death), the total of which is, in each year in which the minimum amount under the arrangement for the year is greater than nil, not less than the minimum amount under the arrangement for that year, but the amount of any such payment does not exceed the value of the property held in connection with the arrangement immediately before the time of the payment, or

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: established at the direction of an unclaimed property authority to receive property from a RRIF, RRSP or registered pension plan in respect of an unlocated individual. (fonds de revenu de retraite)

Subsection.Text: The portion of the definition designated benefit in subsection 146.3(1) of the Act before paragraph (a) is replaced by the following:

Definition.Text: designated benefit of an individual in respect of a RRIF (other than an arrangement described in paragraph (b) of the definition retirement income fund in this subsection) means the total of

Subsection.Text: The portion of the definition carrier in subsection 146.3(1) of the English version of the Act after paragraph (d) is repealed.
The portion of the definition émetteur in subsection 146.3(1) of the French version of the Act before paragraph (a) is replaced by the following:

Definition.Text: émetteur À l’égard d’un fonds de revenu de retraite, l’une des personnes suivantes :

Subsection.Text: Section 146.3 of the Act is amended by adding the following after subsection (1.5):

Despite the definition minimum amount in subsection (1), and subject to subsection (1.7), the minimum amount under a retirement income fund for a year is nil, if at the beginning of the year the fund is held under the direction of an unclaimed property authority in respect of an unlocated individual.

If an unclaimed property authority directs a carrier of a retirement income fund to transfer all or part of the property held in connection with the fund to a RRIF of an individual who is entitled to claim the property in accordance with applicable law,

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: despite the definition minimum amount in subsection (1), the minimum amount under the fund for the year that includes the transfer is equal to the total of all amounts each of which is the minimum amount that, in the absence of this subsection and subsection (1.6), would have been the minimum amount under the fund in the year of the transfer or a preceding year to which subsection (1.6) applied; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: an amount that is not less than the minimum amount determined under paragraph (a) must be paid directly to the individual from the fund before the first such transfer.

Subsection.Text: Section 146.3 of the Act is amended by adding the following after subsection (2):

Despite subsection (2), the Minister may accept for registration for the purposes of this Act any arrangement that does not meet the conditions in subsection (2) if the arrangement is described in paragraph (b) of the definition retirement income fund in subsection (1).
Subsection 146.3(5) of the Act is amended by striking out “or” at the end of paragraph (c), by adding “or” at the end of paragraph (d) and by adding the following after paragraph (d):

Paragraph.Label: (e)
Paragraph.Text: an amount that is paid or transferred to an unclaimed property authority in respect of an unlocated individual.

Subsection.Text: Section 146.3 of the Act is amended by adding the following after subsection (15):
If an unclaimed property authority has established a RRIF to receive property in respect of an unlocated individual,

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: subsections (6) to (6.4) do not apply to the unlocated individual in respect of the property (or property substituted for it) while such property is held under the RRIF;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: subsection (3.1) does not apply to any trust governed by the RRIF; and

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: subsection (15) is to be read without reference to its paragraph (c) in respect of an amount credited or added to a deposit while the property (or property substituted for it) is held under the RRIF.

Subsection.Text: If an unclaimed property authority has established a RRIF to receive property in respect of an unlocated individual and the property (or property substituted for it) is claimed by an individual that is eligible to receive it in accordance with applicable law, the individual who made the claim is deemed to be the annuitant under the RRIF for the purposes of paragraphs (2)(d) and (e) and subsection (14.1), provided that individual is or was

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: if the property was received by the authority from a registered pension plan, the member (as defined in subsection 147.1(1)) of the registered pension plan;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: if the property was received by the authority from an RRSP, the annuitant (as defined in subsection 146(1)) of the RRSP;

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: if the property was received by the authority from a RRIF, the annuitant (as defined in subsection 146.3(1)) of the RRIF;

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: a spouse or common-law partner of an individual described in paragraph (a), (b) or (c), immediately before the death of that individual; or

Paragraph.Label: (e)
Paragraph.Text: a child or grandchild of an individual described in paragraph (a), (b) or (c) who was, immediately before the death of that individual, financially dependent on that individual for support because of mental or physical infirmity.

Subsection.Text: Paragraph 153(1)(b) of the Act is replaced by the following:

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: a superannuation or pension benefit, other than an amount described in clause 56(1)(a)(i)(H),

Paragraph.Label: (j)
Paragraph.Text: a payment out of or under an RRSP or a plan referred to in subsection 146(12) as an “amended plan”, other than an amount described in paragraph (c.2) of the definition benefit in subsection 146(1),

Paragraph.Label: (l)
Paragraph.Text: a payment out of or under a RRIF or a fund referred to in subsection 146.3(11) as an “amended fund”, other than an amount described in paragraph 146.3(5)(e),

Subsection.Text: The definition superannuation or pension benefit in subsection 248(1) of the Act is replaced by the following:

Definition.Text: superannuation or pension benefit includes any amount received out of or under a superannuation or pension fund or plan (including, except for the purposes of subparagraph 56(1)(a)(i), a pooled registered pension plan) and, without restricting the generality of the foregoing, includes

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: any payment made to a beneficiary under the fund or plan or to an employer or former employer of the beneficiary under the fund or plan

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: in accordance with the terms of the fund or plan,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: resulting from an amendment to or modification of the fund or plan, or

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: resulting from the termination of the fund or plan, and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: any payment made to an individual by an unclaimed property authority, if an amount in respect of the payment had been paid to the unclaimed property authority directly from a registered pension plan, an RRSP or a RRIF in respect of an unlocated individual; (prestation de retraite ou de pension)

Subsection.Text: Subsection 248(1) of the Act is amended by adding the following in alphabetical order:

Definition.Text: unclaimed property authority means an entity that receives and holds property on behalf of individuals that cannot be located, as authorized under the provisions of

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the Pension Benefits Standards Act, 1985,

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the Unclaimed Property Act, CQLR, c. B-5.1,

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: the Unclaimed Property Act, S.B.C. 1999, c. 48, or

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: a prescribed law or a law designated by the Minister of Finance for the purpose of this definition that is published in such a manner as the Minister of Finance deems appropriate; (autorité des biens non réclamés)

Definition.Text: unlocated individual means an individual in respect of whom property held under a registered pension plan, RRIF or RRSP can be paid or transferred to an unclaimed property authority in accordance with the laws of Canada or a province; (particulier introuvable)

Section.Text: Clause 241(9.5)(a)(i)(D) of the Income Tax Act is replaced by the following:

Clause.Label: (D)
Clause.Text: sections 144, 264, 264.01, 271, 279, 279.02, 281 and 333.1, paragraphs 334(a) and 348(1)(e) and sections 349, 435 and 462.31 of the Criminal Code,
